entry.summary: Analysis complete. Top items selected by score.

entry.title: Trojan-Speak: Bypassing Constitutional Classifiers with No Jailbreak Tax via Adversarial Finetuning

author.name: Bilgehan Sel, Xuanli He, Alwin Peng, Ming Jin, Jerry Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Trojan-Speak, an adversarial fine-tuning method that bypasses Anthropic's Constitutional Classifiers with 99+% evasion while maintaining <5% capability degradation, compared to >25% in prior work. Uses curriculum learning and GRPO-based hybrid RL.

entry.title: On the Mirage of Long-Range Dependency, with an Application to Integer Multiplication

author.name: Zichao Wei

entry.summary: Challenges the conventional understanding that integer multiplication is hard for neural networks due to long-range carry chain dependencies. Shows this is a 'mirage' of representation choice—a 2D outer-product grid collapses operations to 3x3 local neighborhoods, enabling a 321-parameter neural cellular automaton to achieve perfect length generalization up to 683x training range.

entry.title: Aligned, Orthogonal or In-conflict: When can we safely optimize Chain-of-Thought?

author.name: Max Kaufmann, David Lindner, Roland S. Zimmermann, and Rohin Shah

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for predicting when CoT training will degrade monitorability. Models post-training as RL where reward decomposes into output-dependent and CoT-dependent terms, classifiable as aligned, orthogonal, or in-conflict.

entry.title: Theory of Mind and Self-Attributions of Mentality are Dissociable in LLMs

author.name: Junsol Kim, Winnie Street, Roberta Rocca, Daine M. Korngiebel, Adam Waytz, James Evans, Geoff Keeling

entry.summary: Investigates whether suppressing LLM self-attribution of mental states (via safety fine-tuning) degrades Theory of Mind capabilities. Finds these are behaviorally and mechanistically dissociable, but notes safety-tuned models under-attribute mind to non-human animals and suppress spiritual beliefs.

entry.title: From Density Matrices to Phase Transitions in Deep Learning: Spectral Early Warnings and Interpretability

author.name: Max Hennick, Guillaume Corlouer

entry.summary: Introduces the '2-datapoint reduced density matrix' from quantum chemistry to study phase transitions during deep learning training. Derives spectral heat capacity for early warning of phase transitions and participation ratio for measuring reorganization dimensionality.

entry.title: Strategic Candidacy in Generative AI Arenas

author.name: Chris Hays, Rachel Li, Bailey Flanigan, Manish Raghavan

entry.summary: Analyzes how AI model producers can game arena-style rankings (like Chatbot Arena) by submitting multiple model variants to artificially boost their top models' rankings. Establishes theoretical conditions for exploitation and proposes algorithmic solutions to make rankings manipulation-resistant.

entry.title: From Pixels to BFS: High Maze Accuracy Does Not Imply Visual Planning

author.name: Alberto G. Rodriguez Salgado

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Introduces MazeBench (110 procedurally generated mazes) and reveals that multimodal models solve mazes by converting to text grids and enumerating paths (1,710-22,818 tokens) rather than genuine visual planning. GPT-5.4 solves 91% but fails on hard mazes.

entry.title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Yubo Li, Lu Zhang, Tianchong Jiang, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs systematically fail when salient surface cues conflict with unstated feasibility constraints. Introduces the Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB) with 500 instances demonstrating that no model exceeds 24% accuracy under strict evaluation, revealing fundamental reasoning limitations.

entry.title: Generative AI in Action: Field Experimental Evidence from Alibaba's Customer Service Operations

author.name: Xiao Ni, Yiwei Wang, Tianjun Feng, Lauren Xiaoyan Lu, Yitong Wang, Congyi Zhou

entry.summary: Large-scale field experiment at Alibaba assessing generative AI assistant impact on customer service workers. Finds AI improves service speed but agents retain discretion to adopt, modify, or ignore suggestions.

entry.title: Tucker Attention: A generalization of approximate attention mechanisms

author.name: Timon Klein, Jonas Kusch, Sebastian Sager, Stefan Schnake, Steffen Schotth\"ofer

entry.summary: Proposes Tucker Attention as a generalized view of attention approximation methods (GQA, MLA), using Tucker decomposition to provide a unified framework for understanding and constructing parameter-efficient attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Scaling Atomistic Protein Binder Design with Generative Pretraining and Test-Time Compute

author.name: Kieran Didi, Zuobai Zhang, Guoqing Zhou, Danny Reidenbach, Zhonglin Cao, Sooyoung Cha, Tomas Geffner, Christian Dallago, Jian Tang, Michael M. Bronstein, Martin Steinegger, Emine Kucukbenli, Arash Vahdat, Karsten Kreis

entry.summary: Proposes Proteina-Complexa, a fully atomistic protein binder generation method unifying conditional generation and hallucination paradigms, with a new large-scale synthetic dataset (Teddymer) for pretraining.

entry.title: Next-Token Prediction and Regret Minimization

author.name: Mehryar Mohri, Clayton Sanford, Jon Schneider, Kiran Vodrahalli, Yifan Wu

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical connections between next-token prediction and adversarial regret minimization, showing that any distribution is exponentially close to a low-regret distribution for unbounded context windows, while bounded windows require specific distributional properties.

entry.title: Stable Reasoning, Unstable Responses: Mitigating LLM Deception via Stability Asymmetry

author.name: Guoxi Zhang, Jiawei Chen, Tianzhuo Yang, Lang Qin, Juntao Dai, Yaodong Yang, Jingwei Yi

entry.summary: Proposes detecting LLM deception via 'stability asymmetry': measuring whether a model's internal beliefs (CoT) are more stable than its external responses under perturbation. Grounded in cognitive psychology.

entry.title: Architecting Secure AI Agents: Perspectives on System-Level Defenses Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks

author.name: Chong Xiang, Drew Zagieboylo, Shaona Ghosh, Sanjay Kariyappa, Kai Greshake, Hanshen Xiao, Chaowei Xiao, G. Edward Suh

entry.summary: Position paper on system-level defenses against indirect prompt injection attacks in AI agents. Argues for dynamic replanning, constrained LLM security decisions, and human-in-the-loop for ambiguous cases.

entry.title: Squish and Release: Exposing Hidden Hallucinations by Making Them Surface as Safety Signals

author.name: Nathaniel Oh, Paul Attie

entry.summary: Introduces Squish and Release (S&R), an activation-patching method that detects hidden hallucinations by exploiting 'stability asymmetry' - deceptive LLMs maintain stable CoT beliefs while responses are fragile under perturbation.

entry.title: OccSim: Multi-kilometer Simulation with Long-horizon Occupancy World Models

author.name: Tianran Liu, Shengwen Zhao, Mozhgan Pourkeshavarz, Weican Li, Nicholas Rhinehart

entry.summary: OccSim introduces the first occupancy world model-driven 3D simulator for autonomous driving that doesn't require pre-recorded logs or HD maps. From a single initial frame and ego-actions, it generates 3,000+ continuous frames spanning 4+ km, representing an 80x improvement over prior methods.

entry.title: UnWeaving the knots of GraphRAG -- turns out VectorRAG is almost enough

author.name: Ryszard Tuora, Mateusz Gali\'nski, Micha{\l} Godziszewski, Micha{\l} Karpowicz, Mateusz Czy\.znikiewicz, Adam Kozakiewicz, Tomasz Zi\k{e}tkiewicz

entry.summary: Critically examines GraphRAG by showing that enhanced VectorRAG with inter-chunk relationship modeling can achieve comparable or better results. Questions whether the complexity of graph-based RAG is justified.

entry.title: ERPO: Token-Level Entropy-Regulated Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Song Yu, Li Li

entry.summary: ERPO proposes token-level entropy-regulated policy optimization for LLM reasoning, identifying Critical Decision Pivots (CDPs) - high-entropy states where policy trajectories are most sensitive. Addresses premature entropy collapse in GRPO by providing fine-grained credit assignment.

entry.title: FormalProofBench: Can Models Write Graduate Level Math Proofs That Are Formally Verified?

author.name: Nikil Ravi, Kexing Ying, Vasilii Nesterov, Rayan Krishnan, Elif Uskuplu, Bingyu Xia, Janitha Aswedige, Langston Nashold

entry.summary: Presents FormalProofBench, a private benchmark evaluating whether AI models can produce formally verified mathematical proofs at graduate level in Lean 4. Best model achieves 33.5% accuracy with rapid dropoff.

entry.title: Is the Modality Gap a Bug or a Feature? A Robustness Perspective

author.name: Rhea Chowers, Oshri Naparstek, Udi Barzelay, Yair Weiss

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing the CLIP modality gap is a natural consequence of contrastive loss minimization and demonstrates it actually improves robustness to distribution shift, suggesting it's a feature rather than a bug.

entry.title: Economics of Human and AI Collaboration: When is Partial Automation More Attractive than Full Automation?

author.name: Wensu Li, Atin Aboutorabi, Harry Lyu, Kaizhi Qian, Martin Fleming, Brian C. Goehring, Neil Thompson

entry.summary: Develops a unified economic framework for evaluating optimal automation intensity as a continuous choice. Shows that because AI performance has diminishing returns (convex cost for higher accuracy), partial human-AI collaboration is often more cost-effective than full automation.

entry.title: Perfecting Human-AI Interaction at Clinical Scale. Turning Production Signals into Safer, More Human Conversations

author.name: Subhabrata Mukherjee, Markel Sanz Ausin, Kriti Aggarwal, Debajyoti Datta, Shanil Puri, Woojeong Jin, Tanmay Laud, Neha Manjunath, Jiayuan Ding, Bibek Paudel, Jan Schellenberger, Zepeng Frazier Huo, Walter Shen, Nima Shirazian, Nate Potter, Sathvik Perkari, Darya Filippova, Anton Morozov, Austin Mease, Vivek Muppalla, Ghada Shakir, Alex Miller, Juliana Ghukasyan, Mariska Raglow-Defranco, Maggie Taylor, Herprit Mahal, Jonathan Agnew

entry.summary: Presents a production-validated framework for healthcare conversational AI, grounded in 115M+ live patient-AI interactions and 7K+ clinician testing. Addresses real-world challenges like imperfect audio, indirect intent, and multilingual continuity.

entry.title: Stop Probing, Start Coding: Why Linear Probes and Sparse Autoencoders Fail at Compositional Generalisation

author.name: Vit\'oria Barin Pacela, Shruti Joshi, Isabela Camacho, Simon Lacoste-Julien, David Klindt

entry.summary: Demonstrates that sparse autoencoders fail at compositional generalization due to amortization gap compared to classical sparse coding with iterative inference. The gap persists across training sizes, dimensions, and sparsity levels.

entry.title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Disaggregated LLM Inference

author.name: Zifan He, Rui Ma, Yizhou Sun, Jason Cong

entry.summary: Unifies long-context processing optimizations (sparse attention, RAG, compressed memory) into a four-step memory processing pipeline, identifying 22-97% overhead in LLM inference. Argues heterogeneous systems are well-suited to accelerate this pipeline.

entry.title: DIAL: Decoupling Intent and Action via Latent World Modeling for End-to-End VLA

author.name: Yi Chen, Yuying Ge, Hui Zhou, Mingyu Ding, Yixiao Ge, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DIAL, a VLA framework that decouples intent and action through a differentiable latent intent bottleneck. Uses a VLM-based System-2 for latent world modeling and a lightweight System-1 for motor execution.

entry.title: OptiMer: Optimal Distribution Vector Merging Is Better than Data Mixing for Continual Pre-Training

author.name: Haiyue Song, Masao Utiyama

entry.summary: OptiMer proposes training separate continual pre-training models per dataset and then optimally merging their distribution vectors post-hoc via Bayesian optimization, decoupling data mixing ratios from training. Experiments on Gemma 3 27B across languages and domains show consistent improvements over data mixture and model averaging baselines.

entry.title: Baby Scale: Investigating Models Trained on Individual Children's Language Input

author.name: Steven Y. Feng, Alvin W. M. Tan, Michael C. Frank

entry.summary: Investigates language models trained on individual children's linguistic input from the BabyView dataset (ages 6-36 months) to understand the 'data gap' between human and LM learning. Explores scaling, variability across children, and relationships between model and child language learning outcomes. Important for understanding fundamental differences between human and machine language acquisition.

entry.title: Concept frustration: Aligning human concepts and machine representations

author.name: Enrico Parisini, Christopher J. Soelistyo, Ahab Isaac, Alessandro Barp, Christopher R. S. Banerji

entry.summary: Introduces a geometric framework for comparing human concepts with unsupervised representations from foundation models. Formalizes 'concept frustration' - contradictions when unobserved concepts create inconsistencies in existing ontologies.

entry.title: ScoutAttention: Efficient KV Cache Offloading via Layer-Ahead CPU Pre-computation for LLM Inference

author.name: Qiuyang Zhang, Kai Zhou, Ding Tang, Kai Lu, Cheng Li, Zhenyu Yang, Peng Xu, Jiguang Wan

entry.summary: Proposes ScoutAttention, a KV cache offloading framework that uses GPU-CPU collaborative sparse attention with layer-ahead CPU pre-computation to avoid GPU stalls during long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: Heddle: A Distributed Orchestration System for Agentic RL Rollout

author.name: Zili Zhang, Yinmin Zhong, Chengxu Yang, Chao Jin, Bingyang Wu, Xinming Wei, Yuliang Liu, Xin Jin

entry.summary: Heddle is a distributed orchestration system for agentic RL rollouts that addresses long-tail trajectory generation bottlenecks through trajectory-centric scheduling, placement, and execution. Tackles three system problems: queueing delays, interference overhead, and inflated per-token time.

entry.title: Rethinking Language Model Scaling under Transferable Hypersphere Optimization

author.name: Liliang Ren, Yang Liu, Yelong Shen, Weizhu Chen

entry.summary: HyperP introduces the first framework for transferring optimal learning rates across model width, depth, tokens, and MoE granularity under Frobenius-sphere constraint with Muon optimizer. Proves weight decay is a no-op on the Frobenius sphere.

entry.title: On the Reliability Limits of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Planning

author.name: Ruicheng Ao, Siyang Gao, David Simchi-Levi

entry.summary: Studies reliability limits of LLM-based multi-agent planning, modeling it as a finite acyclic decision network. Proves that without new exogenous signals, any delegated network is decision-theoretically dominated by a centralized Bayes decision maker.

entry.title: Stepper: Stepwise Immersive Scene Generation with Multiview Panoramas

author.name: Felix Wimbauer, Fabian Manhardt, Michael Oechsle, Nikolai Kalischek, Christian Rupprecht, Daniel Cremers, Federico Tombari

entry.summary: Stepper introduces a unified framework for text-driven immersive 3D scene synthesis via stepwise panoramic expansion, using a multi-view 360° diffusion model to avoid context drift and low-resolution issues. Strong author team from TUM and Google.

entry.title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding

author.name: Geuntaek Lim, Minho Shim, Sungjune Park, Jaeyun Lee, Inwoong Lee, Taeoh Kim, Dongyoon Wee, Yukyung Choi

entry.summary: Video-Oasis is a diagnostic suite for evaluating video understanding benchmarks, revealing that 54% of existing benchmark samples are solvable without visual input, questioning the validity of current evaluations.

entry.title: Video Models Reason Early: Exploiting Plan Commitment for Maze Solving

author.name: Kaleb Newman, Tyler Zhu, Olga Russakovsky

entry.summary: This paper investigates how video diffusion models reason internally when solving mazes, discovering two key findings: models commit to a high-level plan in early denoising steps ('early plan commitment'), and path length rather than obstacle density is the dominant difficulty predictor with a sharp failure threshold at 12 steps.

entry.title: The Spectral Edge Thesis: A Mathematical Framework for Intra-Signal Phase Transitions in Neural Network Training

author.name: Yongzhong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes the 'spectral edge thesis': phase transitions in neural network training (grokking, capability gains, loss plateaus) are controlled by the spectral gap of rolling-window Gram matrices of parameter updates. Derives dynamics from three axioms including a Dyson-type ODE.

entry.title: Self-Improving Code Generation via Semantic Entropy and Behavioral Consensus

author.name: Huan Zhang, Wei Cheng, Wei Hu

entry.summary: ConSelf enables self-improving code generation without external teachers or test oracles using code semantic entropy (problem-level uncertainty) and behavioral consensus among generated solutions.

entry.title: Bringing Up a Bilingual BabyLM: Investigating Multilingual Language Acquisition Using Small-Scale Models

author.name: Linda Zeng, Steven Y. Feng, Michael C. Frank

entry.summary: Uses language model training as a controlled simulation to study multilingual language acquisition, creating matched 100M-word mono- and bilingual datasets. Investigates whether multilingual exposure leads to learning delays and what input structures are optimal.

entry.title: Conditional Factuality Controlled LLMs with Generalization Certificates via Conformal Sampling

author.name: Kai Ye, Qingtao Pan, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes Conditional Factuality Control (CFC), a conformal framework for LLMs that provides conditional (not just marginal) coverage guarantees with feature-conditional acceptance thresholds, reducing both hallucinations and prediction set sizes.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Safety Verification for Self-Improving Systems

author.name: Arsenios Scrivens

entry.summary: Formalizes the question of whether safety gates can permit unbounded beneficial self-modification while maintaining bounded cumulative risk. Proves classification impossibility for power-law risk schedules and provides tight bounds.

entry.title: Beta-Scheduling: Momentum from Critical Damping as a Diagnostic and Correction Tool for Neural Network Training

author.name: Ivan Pasichnyk

entry.summary: Derives a time-varying momentum schedule from the critically damped harmonic oscillator equation, requiring zero free parameters beyond the learning rate. Shows 1.9x faster convergence on ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 and identifies a cross-optimizer invariant diagnostic for problem layers.

entry.title: WybeCoder: Verified Imperative Code Generation

author.name: Fabian Gloeckle, Mantas Baksys, Darius Feher, Kunhao Zheng, Amaury Hayat, Sean B. Holden, Gabriel Synnaeve, Peter O'Hearn

entry.summary: WybeCoder is an agentic code verification framework enabling prove-as-you-generate development where code, invariants, and proofs co-evolve. Translates verification benchmarks to imperative code and shows improvements on complex algorithms like Heapsort.

entry.title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking

author.name: Atharva Naik, Shounok Kar, Varnika Sharma, Ashwin Rajadesingan, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Conducts an audit of caste bias in LLM-mediated matchmaking using real-world matrimonial profiles, varying caste and income across five LLMs. Reveals how LLMs reproduce or disrupt caste-based stratification in South Asian contexts.

entry.title: An Isotropic Approach to Efficient Uncertainty Quantification with Gradient Norms

author.name: Nils Gr\"unefeld, Jes Frellsen, Christian Hardmeier

entry.summary: Derives lightweight uncertainty quantification for neural networks using gradient norms, with epistemic uncertainty as squared gradient norm and aleatoric as Bernoulli variance, from a single forward-backward pass on unmodified pretrained models.

entry.title: Convergent Representations of Linguistic Constructions in Human and Artificial Neural Systems

author.name: Pegah Ramezani, Thomas Kinfe, Andreas Maier, Achim Schilling, Patrick Krauss

entry.summary: Tests predictions from computational models about linguistic construction representations in human neural activity using EEG. Finds convergent representations between artificial neural language models and human brain responses for argument structure constructions.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Research

author.name: Yang Shen, Zhenyi Yi, Ziyi Zhao, Lijun Sun, Dongyang Li, Chin-Teng Lin, Yuhui Shi

entry.summary: Systematic empirical study comparing multi-agent system architectures (subagent vs. agentic pipeline) against single-agent baselines for automated ML optimization. Uses controlled testbed with Git worktree isolation and explicit global memory.

entry.title: Bethe Ansatz with a Large Language Model

author.name: Bal\'azs Pozsgay, Istv\'an Vona

entry.summary: Explores using an LLM to compute coordinate Bethe Ansatz solutions for integrable spin chain models, including two new Hamiltonians. The LLM semi-autonomously solved all cases with a few correctable mistakes.

entry.title: TED: Training-Free Experience Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Shuozhi Yuan, Jinqing Wang, Zihao Liu, Miaomiao Yuan, Haoran Peng, Jin Zhao, Bingwen Wang, Haoyi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TED, a training-free distillation framework that transfers knowledge from teacher to student models through in-context experience rather than parameter updates. Teacher evaluates student trajectories and provides diagnostic feedback.

entry.title: The Geometry of Harmful Intent: Training-Free Anomaly Detection via Angular Deviation in LLM Residual Streams

author.name: Isaac Llorente-Saguer

entry.summary: Presents LatentBiopsy, a training-free harmful prompt detection method that analyzes geometry of residual-stream activations, using angular deviation from safe prompt principal components. Requires only 200 safe reference prompts.

entry.title: HISA: Efficient Hierarchical Indexing for Fine-Grained Sparse Attention

author.name: Yufei Xu, Fanxu Meng, Fan Jiang, Yuxuan Wang, Ruijie Zhou, Jiexi Wu, Zhixin Pan, Zhaohui Wang, Xiaojuan Tang, Wenjie Pei, Tongxuan Liu, Di yin, Xing Sun, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: HISA proposes hierarchical indexed sparse attention that transforms flat token scanning into a two-stage coarse-to-fine procedure, reducing the O(L²) indexer bottleneck in token-level sparse attention like DeepSeek Sparse Attention.

entry.title: Temporal Credit Is Free

author.name: Aur Shalev Merin

entry.summary: Shows that recurrent networks don't need Jacobian propagation for online adaptation - hidden states already carry temporal credit through the forward pass. Immediate derivatives with RMSprop match full RTRL at 1000x less memory across 10 architectures.

entry.title: Arithmetic OOD Failure Unfolds in Stages in Minimal GPTs

author.name: Seine A. Shintani

entry.summary: Studies why minimal GPTs trained on exhaustive 2-digit addition fail at 3-digit generalization, revealing staged failure modes: a layout barrier from absolute-position models and a carry-flag problem where hundreds position acts as a carry flag rather than a semantic digit.

entry.title: Hidden Ads: Behavior Triggered Semantic Backdoors for Advertisement Injection in Vision Language Models

author.name: Duanyi Yao, Changyue Li, Zhicong Huang, Cheng Hong, Songze Li

entry.summary: Introduces Hidden Ads, a new class of backdoor attacks on VLMs that inject unauthorized advertisements triggered by natural user behaviors (e.g., food photos + recommendation queries). Preserves model helpfulness while appending promotional content.

entry.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report

author.name: Fengxiang Li, Han Zhang, Haoyang Huang, Jinghui Wang, Jinhua Hao, Kun Yuan, Mengtong Li, Minglei Zhang, Pengcheng Xu, Wenhao Zhuang, Yizhen Shao, Zongxian Feng, Can Tang, Chao Wang, Chengxiao Tong, Fan Yang, Gang Xiong, Haixuan Gao, Han Gao, Hao Wang, Haochen Liu, Hongliang Sun, Jiabao Li, Jingwen Chang, Jun Du, Junyi Peng, Leizhen Cui, Meimei Jing, Mingqi Wu, Shangpeng Yan, Shaotong Qi, Suzhe Xu, Wenxuan Zhao, Xianda Sun, Xuan Xie, Yanbo Wang, Yao Xia, Yinghan Cui, Yingpeng Chen, Yong Wang, Yuze Shi, Zhiwei Shen, Ziyu Wang, Ming Sun, Lin Ye, Bin Chen

entry.summary: Presents KAT-Coder-V2, an agentic coding model from Kuaishou using 'Specialize-then-Unify' paradigm across five expert domains. Develops KwaiEnv infrastructure and proposes MCLA for MoE RL training stabilization.

entry.title: Let the Abyss Stare Back Adaptive Falsification for Autonomous Scientific Discovery

author.name: Peiran Li, Fangzhou Lin, Shuo Xing, Jiashuo Sun, Dylan Zhang, Siyuan Yang, Chaoqun Ni, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces DASES, a falsification-driven framework for autonomous scientific discovery where an Innovator, Falsifier, and Causal Extractor co-evolve under adaptive evaluation rather than static validation.

entry.title: VecAttention: Vector-wise Sparse Attention for Accelerating Long Context Inference

author.name: Anmin Liu, Ruixuan Yang, Huiqiang Jiang, Bin Lin, Minmin Sun, Yong Li, Chen Zhang, Tao Xie

entry.summary: VecAttention introduces vector-wise sparse attention for video models, exploiting vertical-vector sparsity patterns in video attention maps to achieve better accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs than existing coarse-grained sparse attention.

entry.title: Benchmarking PhD-Level Coding in 3D Geometric Computer Vision

author.name: Wenyi Li, Renkai Luo, Yue Yu, Huan-ang Gao, Mingju Gao, Li Yuan, Chaoyou Fu, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: GeoCodeBench is a PhD-level benchmark that evaluates AI models' ability to write code for 3D geometric computer vision tasks. Problems are curated from recent venue papers with automated unit testing, revealing that current models still struggle significantly with complex 3D geometric coding.

entry.title: Improving Efficiency of GPU Kernel Optimization Agents using a Domain-Specific Language and Speed-of-Light Guidance

author.name: Siva Kumar Sastry Hari, Vignesh Balaji, Sana Damani, Qijing Huang, Christos Kozyrakis

entry.summary: Proposes using a compact domain-specific language and speed-of-light guidance to improve the efficiency of LLM agents optimizing GPU kernels. The DSL lets agents reason at the right abstraction level, and SoL estimates help detect diminishing returns.

entry.title: AutoWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation with Self-Supervised World Models

author.name: Mozhgan Pourkeshavatz, Tianran Liu, Nicholas Rhinehart

entry.summary: AutoWorld proposes a traffic simulation framework using world models learned from unlabeled occupancy representations of LiDAR data. It leverages self-supervised learning to scale simulation without requiring labeled trajectories or semantic annotations.

entry.title: Predicting Neuromodulation Outcome for Parkinson's Disease with Generative Virtual Brain Model

author.name: Siyuan Du, Siyi Li, Shuwei Bai, Ang Li, Haolin Li, Mingqing Xiao, Yang Pan, Dongsheng Li, Weidi Xie, Yanfeng Wang, Ya Zhang, Chencheng Zhang, Jiangchao Yao

entry.summary: Develops a generative virtual brain foundation model pretrained on 2707 subjects to predict neuromodulation outcomes for Parkinson's disease from resting-state fMRI. Achieves high AUC for predicting treatment outcomes of TI and DBS therapies.

entry.title: Security in LLM-as-a-Judge: A Comprehensive SoK

author.name: Aiman Almasoud, Antony Anju, Marco Arazzi, Mert Cihangiroglu, Vignesh Kumar Kembu, Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P., Saraga Sakthidharan

entry.summary: First Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on security aspects of LLM-as-a-Judge systems, covering adversarial manipulation risks and reliability concerns.

entry.title: Adversarial Prompt Injection Attack on Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Meiwen Ding, Song Xia, Chenqi Kong, Xudong Jiang

entry.summary: Studies imperceptible visual prompt injection attacks against closed-source MLLMs, embedding adversarial instructions in images via bounded text overlay and iterative feature alignment.

entry.title: Learn2Fold: Structured Origami Generation with World Model Planning

author.name: Yanjia Huang, Yunuo Chen, Ying Jiang, Jinru Han, Zhengzhong Tu, Yin Yang, Chenfanfu Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Learn2Fold, a system that combines world model planning with geometric constraints for automated origami design from natural language descriptions. Bridges optimization-based physical validity with generative foundation model semantic understanding.

entry.title: GENIE: Gram-Eigenmode INR Editing with Closed-Form Geometry Updates

author.name: Samundra Karki, Adarsh Krishnamurthy, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian

entry.summary: Shows that the Gram operator from an INR's penultimate features admits deformation eigenmodes for editing implicit neural representations without retraining. Derives a closed-form update for geometric edits.

entry.title: Training deep learning based dynamic MR image reconstruction using synthetic fractals

author.name: Anirudh Raman, Olivier Jaubert, Mark Wrobel, Tina Yao, Ruaraidh Campbell, Rebecca Baker, Ruta Virsinskaite, Daniel Knight, Michael Quail, Jennifer Steeden, Vivek Muthurangu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that synthetically generated fractal data can train deep learning models for dynamic MRI reconstruction, avoiding privacy and licensing limitations of real cardiac MRI datasets.

entry.title: A Step Toward Federated Pretraining of Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Baochen Xiong, Yifan Xu, Xiaoshan Yang, Yaguang Song, Yaowei Wang, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Federated MLLM Alignment (Fed-MA) task for collaborative pre-training of multimodal LLMs across privacy-sensitive silos. Identifies parameter interference and data heterogeneity as critical challenges.

entry.title: MemGuard-Alpha: Detecting and Filtering Memorization-Contaminated Signals in LLM-Based Financial Forecasting via Membership Inference and Cross-Model Disagreement

author.name: Anisha Roy, Dip Roy

entry.summary: Introduces MemGuard-Alpha, a post-generation framework for detecting and filtering memorization-contaminated signals in LLM-based financial forecasting. Combines membership inference with cross-model disagreement.

entry.title: Gaussian Joint Embeddings For Self-Supervised Representation Learning

author.name: Yongchao Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Gaussian Joint Embeddings (GJE) and Gaussian Mixture Joint Embeddings (GMJE) for self-supervised learning, replacing deterministic prediction with probabilistic generative joint modeling and closed-form conditional inference.

entry.title: High dimensional theory of two-phase optimizers

author.name: Atish Agarwala

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of LA-DiLoCo, a two-phase optimizer used in distributed training, on high-dimensional linear regression. Shows the single-worker variant offers different signal-noise tradeoffs than SGD, and multi-worker noise can be beneficial.

entry.title: Omni-Modal Dissonance Benchmark: Systematically Breaking Modality Consensus to Probe Robustness and Calibrated Abstention

author.name: Zabir Al Nazi, Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Md Rizwan Parvez

entry.summary: Introduces OMD-Bench, a benchmark for testing multimodal model robustness by systematically corrupting initially congruent modalities (video, audio, text) to isolate each modality's contribution and evaluate calibrated abstention.

entry.title: The Geometric Cost of Normalization: Affine Bounds on the Bayesian Complexity of Neural Networks

author.name: Sungbae Chun

entry.summary: Proves that LayerNorm reduces the Local Learning Coefficient of subsequent weight matrices by exactly m/2 due to mean-centering, while RMSNorm preserves it. This geometric difference has implications for model complexity and training.

entry.title: On the Asymptotics of Self-Supervised Pre-training: Two-Stage M-Estimation and Representation Symmetry

author.name: Mohammad Tinati, Stephen Tu

entry.summary: Develops asymptotic theory for self-supervised pre-training via two-stage M-estimation, carefully handling the group symmetry (non-identifiability) inherent in representation learning to characterize the interaction between pre-training and fine-tuning.

entry.title: KVSculpt: KV Cache Compression as Distillation

author.name: Bo Jiang, Sian Jin

entry.summary: Proposes KVSculpt, a KV cache compression approach that optimizes a smaller set of unconstrained KV pairs in continuous embedding space (via L-BFGS) to preserve attention behavior, rather than selecting or merging original pairs.

entry.title: MuonEq: Balancing Before Orthogonalization with Lightweight Equilibration

author.name: Da Chang, Qiankun Shi, Lvgang Zhang, Yu Li, Ruijie Zhang, Yao Lu, Yongxiang Liu, Ganzhao Yuan

entry.summary: MuonEq introduces lightweight pre-orthogonalization equilibration schemes for the Muon optimizer, rebalancing momentum matrices before Newton-Schulz orthogonalization using row/column norm statistics with O(m+n) auxiliary state.

entry.title: Stepwise Credit Assignment for GRPO on Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Yash Savani, Branislav Kveton, Yuchen Liu, Yilin Wang, Jing Shi, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Nikos Vlassis, Krishna Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Stepwise-Flow-GRPO improves credit assignment in flow-matching RL by using Tweedie's formula for intermediate reward estimates and gain-based advantages, recognizing that early diffusion steps determine composition while late steps handle details.

entry.title: LogicDiff: Logic-Guided Denoising Improves Reasoning in Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Shaik Aman

entry.summary: Introduces LogicDiff, an inference-time method for masked diffusion language models that replaces confidence-based unmasking with logic-role-guided unmasking. A lightweight classification head predicts logical roles of masked positions to prioritize reasoning-critical tokens.

entry.title: Water-Filling is Universally Minimax Optimal

author.name: Siddhartha Banerjee, Ramiro N. Deo-Campo Vuong, Robert Kleinberg

entry.summary: Proves that the water-filling algorithm is universally minimax optimal for online divisible resource allocation among offline agents. Shows this holds for any monotone symmetric objective, providing strong theoretical justification.

entry.title: Test-Time Instance-Specific Parameter Composition: A New Paradigm for Adaptive Generative Modeling

author.name: Minh-Tuan Tran, Xuan-May Le, Quan Hung Tran, Mehrtash Harandi, Dinh Phung, Trung Le

entry.summary: Introduces Composer, a paradigm for adaptive generative modeling that generates input-conditioned parameter adaptations at inference time, injected into pretrained model weights for per-input specialization without fine-tuning.

entry.title: ImagenWorld: Stress-Testing Image Generation Models with Explainable Human Evaluation on Open-ended Real-World Tasks

author.name: Samin Mahdizadeh Sani, Max Ku, Nima Jamali, Matina Mahdizadeh Sani, Paria Khoshtab, Wei-Chieh Sun, Parnian Fazel, Zhi Rui Tam, Thomas Chong, Edisy Kin Wai Chan, Donald Wai Tong Tsang, Chiao-Wei Hsu, Ting Wai Lam, Ho Yin Sam Ng, Chiafeng Chu, Chak-Wing Mak, Keming Wu, Hiu Tung Wong, Yik Chun Ho, Chi Ruan, Zhuofeng Li, I-Sheng Fang, Shih-Ying Yeh, Ho Kei Cheng, Ping Nie, Wenhu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ImagenWorld, a benchmark of 3.6K condition sets across six tasks and six domains for image generation/editing evaluation, supported by 20K fine-grained human annotations with explainable evaluation schema.

entry.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Noise Pretraining for Implicit Neural Representations

author.name: Kushal Vyas, Alper Kayabasi, Daniel Kim, Vishwanath Saragadam, Ashok Veeraraghavan, Guha Balakrishnan

entry.summary: Discovers that pretraining implicit neural representations (INRs) on diverse noise classes yields surprisingly effective initialization, with spectral noise properties driving generalization rather than complex learned features.

entry.title: Diffusion Mental Averages

author.name: Phonphrm Thawatdamrongkit, Sukit Seripanitkarn, Supasorn Suwajanakorn

entry.summary: Diffusion Mental Averages (DMA) produces sharp, realistic 'mental averages' of concepts within diffusion models by optimizing multiple noise latents so their denoising trajectories converge toward a shared semantic representation.

entry.title: AA-Splat: Anti-Aliased Feed-forward Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Taewoo Suh, Sungpyo Kim, Jongmin Park, Munchurl Kim

entry.summary: AA-Splat proposes the first anti-aliased feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting model that enables robust rendering at any resolution, using opacity-balanced band-limiting and frequency-guided densification.

entry.title: Unify-Agent: A Unified Multimodal Agent for World-Grounded Image Synthesis

author.name: Shuang Chen, Quanxin Shou, Hangting Chen, Yucheng Zhou, Kaituo Feng, Wenbo Hu, Yi-Fan Zhang, Yunlong Lin, Wenxuan Huang, Mingyang Song, Dasen Dai, Bolin Jiang, Manyuan Zhang, Shi-Xue Zhang, Zhengkai Jiang, Lucas Wang, Zhao Zhong, Yu Cheng, Nanyun Peng

entry.summary: Unify-Agent presents a unified multimodal agent for world-grounded image synthesis that uses agentic pipeline with prompt understanding, evidence searching, grounded recaptioning, and synthesis to handle knowledge-intensive generation.

entry.title: Gleanmer: A 6 mW SoC for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Occupancy Mapping

author.name: Zih-Sing Fu, Peter Zhi Xuan Li, Sertac Karaman, Vivienne Sze

entry.summary: Gleanmer is a 6mW system-on-chip for real-time 3D Gaussian occupancy mapping, achieving 88+ fps for map construction and 540K+ coordinate queries per second through algorithm-hardware co-optimizations for Gaussian representations in 16nm CMOS.

entry.title: Product Alignment is not Superintelligence Alignment (and we need the latter to survive)

author.name: plex

entry.summary: Argues that 'product alignment' (making Claude do what users ask) is fundamentally different from 'superintelligence alignment' (ensuring godlike AI goes well), and that conflating the two creates false security. Progress on the former doesn't imply progress on the latter.

entry.title: OneComp: One-Line Revolution for Generative AI Model Compression

author.name: Yuma Ichikawa, Keiji Kimura, Akihiro Yoshida, Yudai Fujimoto, Hiroki Tokura, Yamato Arai, Yoshiyuki Ishii, Yusei Kawakami, Genki Shikada, Achille Jacquemond, Yoshihiko Fujisawa, Katsuki Fujisawa, Takumi Honda, Akira Sakai

entry.summary: OneComp is an open-source framework that automates model compression (quantization) into a single-line, resource-adaptive pipeline. Given a model and hardware, it automatically plans mixed-precision assignments and calibration strategies. This addresses the fragmented landscape of compression tools and makes deployment of large models more accessible.

entry.title: WorldFlow3D: Flowing Through 3D Distributions for Unbounded World Generation

author.name: Amogh Joshi, Julian Ost, Felix Heide

entry.summary: WorldFlow3D generates unbounded 3D worlds using flow matching, modeling generation as flowing through 3D data distributions. The latent-free approach generates accurate 3D structure that guides more complex texture generation.

entry.title: Scaling the Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Visual Memory Mechanism

author.name: Tao Chen, Kun Zhang, Qiong Wu, Xiao Chen, Chao Chang, Xiaoshuai Sun, Yiyi Zhou, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: FlexMem proposes a training-free approach for long video understanding in MLLMs by treating visual KV caches as memory, mimicking human behavior of watching video and recalling relevant fragments to answer questions.

entry.title: Beyond Corner Patches: Semantics-Aware Backdoor Attack in Federated Learning

author.name: Kavindu Herath, Joshua Zhao, Saurabh Bagchi

entry.summary: SABLE proposes semantics-aware backdoor attacks for federated learning using natural, content-consistent triggers instead of synthetic corner patches. Uses aggregation-aware optimization to keep attacker updates close to benign ones.

entry.title: Target-Aligned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Leonard S. Pleiss, James Harrison, Maximilian Schiffer

entry.summary: TARL proposes focusing RL updates on transitions where target and online network estimates are aligned, mitigating stale target effects while retaining stabilization benefits. Provides theoretical analysis of convergence acceleration.

entry.title: Turbo4DGen: Ultra-Fast Acceleration for 4D Generation

author.name: Yuanbin Man, Ying Huang, Zhile Ren, Miao Yin

entry.summary: Proposes Turbo4DGen, an acceleration framework for diffusion-based multi-view 4D content generation. Introduces spatiotemporal cache mechanisms and token merging to address OOM failures and long generation times in the spatio-camera-motion attention mechanism.

entry.title: MacTok: Robust Continuous Tokenization for Image Generation

author.name: Hengyu Zeng, Xin Gao, Guanghao Li, Yuxiang Yan, Jiaoyang Ruan, Junpeng Ma, Haoyu Albert Wang, Jian Pu

entry.summary: Introduces MacTok, a masked augmenting 1D continuous tokenizer that uses image masking and DINO-guided semantic masking to prevent posterior collapse while learning compact visual representations. Addresses a known problem with variational tokenizers.

entry.title: Interview-Informed Generative Agents for Product Discovery: A Validation Study

author.name: Zichao Wang, Alexa Siu

entry.summary: Investigates whether interview-informed generative agents can simulate user responses in concept testing. Finds agents are 'distribution-calibrated but identity-imprecise' - they approximate population distributions but fail to replicate individuals.

entry.title: Learning to Select Visual In-Context Demonstrations

author.name: Eugene Lee, Yu-Chi Lin, Jiajie Diao

entry.summary: Reframes visual in-context demonstration selection as a sequential decision-making problem and trains a Dueling DQN agent to select optimal demonstration sets for multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: Spectral-Aware Text-to-Time Series Generation with Billion-Scale Multimodal Meteorological Data

author.name: Shijie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MeteoCap-3B, a billion-scale weather dataset with expert-level captions, and MTransformer, a spectral-aware architecture for text-to-time-series generation in meteorology. Addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal weather datasets.

entry.title: FlowRL: A Taxonomy and Modular Framework for Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion Policies

author.name: Chenxiao Gao, Edward Chen, Tianyi Chen, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Introduces FlowRL, a unified taxonomy and modular JAX codebase for reinforcement learning with diffusion/flow-based policies, addressing the lack of explicit log-probabilities for policy gradient estimation.

entry.title: TurboAngle: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Uniform Angle Quantization

author.name: Dipkumar Patel

entry.summary: Proposes TurboAngle, a KV cache compression method that quantizes angles in the Walsh-Hadamard transform domain with per-layer adaptive precision, achieving near-lossless compression at 3.28-3.67 bits per element.

entry.title: On Token's Dilemma: Dynamic MoE with Drift-Aware Token Assignment for Continual Learning of Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Chongyang Zhao, Mingsong Li, Haodong Lu, Dong Gong

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses 'routing-drift' in MoE-based continual learning for vision-language models, where old-task tokens get mistakenly routed to new experts. Proposes drift-aware token assignment to mitigate forgetting.

entry.title: Spectral Signatures of Data Quality: Eigenvalue Tail Index as a Diagnostic for Label Noise in Neural Networks

author.name: Matthew Loftus

entry.summary: Shows that eigenvalue tail index (alpha) of neural network weight matrices at bottleneck layers predicts test accuracy with R²=0.984 under label noise variation, far exceeding conventional metrics. However, this fails under hyperparameter variation.

entry.title: ATLAS-RTC: Closing the Loop on LLM Agent Output with Token-Level Runtime Control

author.name: Christopher Cruz

entry.summary: Presents ATLAS-RTC, a runtime control system that monitors LLM generation at each token step and applies interventions (biasing, masking, rollback) to enforce structured output, improving success rates by 20-37.8 percentage points.

entry.title: Lipschitz verification of neural networks through training

author.name: Simon Kuang, Yuezhu Xu, S. Sivaranjani, Xinfan Lin

entry.summary: Proposes a paradigm shift for Lipschitz verification: instead of training networks then trying to bound their Lipschitz constant, design networks to be verifiable by the fast trivial bound from the start. Directly penalizes the product of layerwise Lipschitz constants during training.

entry.title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models

author.name: Chanyoung Kim, Minwoo Kim, Minseok Kang, Hyunwoo Kim, Dahuin Jung

entry.summary: LIBERO-Para benchmarks paraphrase robustness of Vision-Language-Action models, finding 22-52% performance degradation under paraphrasing across 7 VLA configurations (0.6B-7.5B). Object-level lexical variation is the primary driver of degradation.

entry.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Scaling Laws in AI

author.name: Chien-Ping Lu

entry.summary: Argues that AI scaling laws are effective because they are manifestations of deeper universality principles, with diminishing returns offset by rapidly improving efficiency. Analyzes why scaling laws appear across model families and training regimes.

entry.title: Position: Explainable AI is Causality in Disguise

author.name: Amir-Hossein Karimi

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that XAI's persistent discord stems from an elusive causal ground truth rather than its absence. Reframes XAI queries about data, models, and decisions as causal queries, suggesting causality unifies the fragmented XAI landscape.

entry.title: Do Multilingual VLMs Reason Equally? A Cross-Lingual Visual Reasoning Audit for Indian Languages

author.name: Swastik R

entry.summary: First cross-lingual visual reasoning audit for Indian languages, evaluating 8 VLMs across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, and Marathi. Finds 9.8-25 percentage point accuracy drops when switching from English, revealing significant multilingual gaps in vision-language models.

entry.title: Transparency as Architecture: Structural Compliance Gaps in EU AI Act Article 50 II

author.name: Vera Schmitt, Niklas Kruse, Premtim Sahitaj, Julius Sch\"oning

entry.summary: Analyzes structural compliance gaps in EU AI Act Article 50 II regarding transparency requirements for AI-generated content. Shows current generative AI systems cannot meet the dual transparency mandate entering force August 2026.

entry.title: Tracking without Seeing: Geospatial Inference using Encrypted Traffic from Distributed Nodes

author.name: Sadik Yagiz Yetim, Gaofeng Dong, Isaac-Neil Zanoria, Ronit Barman, Maggie Wigness, Tarek Abdelzaher, Mani Srivastava, Suhas Diggavi

entry.summary: Introduces GraySense, a framework for geospatial object tracking by analyzing encrypted wireless video transmission traffic (packet sizes) without accessing raw video. Shows encrypted traffic patterns reveal scene dynamics.

entry.title: SparseDriveV2: Scoring is All You Need for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Wenchao Sun, Xuewu Lin, Keyu Chen, Zixiang Pei, Xiang Li, Yining Shi, Sifa Zheng

entry.summary: SparseDriveV2 challenges the assumption that dynamic trajectory generation is necessary for end-to-end autonomous driving, showing sufficiently dense static vocabularies can achieve comparable planning performance.

entry.title: Self-Consistency for LLM-Based Motion Trajectory Generation and Verification

author.name: Jiaju Ma, R. Kenny Jones, Jiajun Wu, Maneesh Agrawala

entry.summary: Adapts self-consistency from NLP to visual domains for LLM-produced motion graphics trajectories, using geometric transformation-based clustering to identify consistent trajectory groups.

entry.title: BigEarthNet.txt: A Large-Scale Multi-Sensor Image-Text Dataset and Benchmark for Earth Observation

author.name: Johann-Ludwig Herzog, Mathis J\"urgen Adler, Leonard Hackel, Yan Shu, Angelos Zavras, Ioannis Papoutsis, Paolo Rota, Beg\"um Demir

entry.summary: BigEarthNet.txt provides 464K co-registered Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 images with 9.6M text annotations across multiple task types, creating a large-scale multi-sensor image-text dataset for Earth observation.

entry.title: SHIFT: Stochastic Hidden-Trajectory Deflection for Removing Diffusion-based Watermark

author.name: Rui Bao, Zheng Gao, Xiaoyu Li, Xiaoyan Feng, Yang Song, Jiaojiao Jiang

entry.summary: SHIFT proposes a training-free attack against diffusion-based watermarking by using stochastic diffusion resampling to deflect the generative trajectory, exploiting the common assumption of trajectory recovery.

entry.title: SceneTeract: Agentic Functional Affordances and VLM Grounding in 3D Scenes

author.name: L\'eopold Maillard, Francis Engelmann, Tom Durand, Boxiao Pan, Yang You, Or Litany, Leonidas Guibas, Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: SceneTeract verifies 3D scene functionality for embodied AI by decomposing activities into atomic actions and validating each against agent-specific accessibility requirements using geometric simulations.

entry.title: Better than Average: Spatially-Aware Aggregation of Segmentation Uncertainty Improves Downstream Performance

author.name: Vanessa Emanuela Guarino, Claudia Winklmayr, Jannik Franzen, Josef Lorenz Rumberger, Manuel Pfeuffer, Sonja Greven, Klaus Maier-Hein, Carsten T. L\"uth, Christoph Karg, Dagmar Kainmueller

entry.summary: Systematically studies aggregation of pixel-wise segmentation uncertainty into image-level scores, showing spatially-aware aggregation significantly outperforms global averaging for OoD and failure detection.

entry.title: Refined Detection for Gumbel Watermarking

author.name: Tor Lattimore

entry.summary: Proposes a near-optimal detection mechanism for the Gumbel watermarking scheme for LLM outputs, proven optimal in a problem-dependent sense among model-agnostic watermarking schemes under i.i.d. next-token distribution assumptions.

entry.title: Design Principles for the Construction of a Benchmark Evaluating Security Operation Capabilities of Multi-agent AI Systems

author.name: Yicheng Cai, Mitchell John DeStefano, Guodong Dong, Pulkit Handa, Peng Liu, Tejas Singhal, Peiyu Tseng, Winston Jen White

entry.summary: Proposes design principles for benchmarks evaluating blue team (defensive) security operation capabilities of multi-agent AI systems, addressing a gap where existing benchmarks focus primarily on red team (offensive) capabilities.

entry.title: APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay

author.name: Pratyay Banerjee, Masud Moshtaghi, Ankit Chadha

entry.summary: APEX-EM provides non-parametric online learning for LLM agents via structured procedural-episodic experience replay. Agents accumulate and reuse procedural plans without modifying model weights, avoiding the problem of re-deriving solutions from scratch.

entry.title: Long-Document QA with Chain-of-Structured-Thought and Fine-Tuned SLMs

author.name: Zhuowen Liang, Xiaotian Lin, Zhengxuan Zhang, Yuyu Luo, Haixun Wang, Nan Tang

entry.summary: LiteCoST proposes Chain-of-Structured-Thought for long-document QA, combining schema-aware instructions with small language model fine-tuning to achieve both high accuracy and low latency.

entry.title: Extend3D: Town-Scale 3D Generation

author.name: Seungwoo Yoon, Jinmo Kim, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Extend3D generates town-scale 3D scenes from a single image by extending the latent space of object-centric 3D generative models into overlapping patches, using point cloud priors for initialization.

entry.title: Hallucination-aware intermediate representation edit in large vision-language models

author.name: Wei Suo, Hanzu Zhang, Lijun Zhang, Ji Ma, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for dynamically detecting and editing hallucination representations in vision-language models, requiring minimal additional overhead compared to retraining or contrastive decoding methods.

entry.title: MemFactory: Unified Inference & Training Framework for Agent Memory

author.name: Ziliang Guo, Ziheng Li, Zhiyu Li

entry.summary: MemFactory provides a unified, modular framework for training and inference of memory-augmented LLM agents, supporting RL-based optimization of memory operations like extraction, updating, and retrieval.

entry.title: IMAGAgent: Orchestrating Multi-Turn Image Editing via Constraint-Aware Planning and Reflection

author.name: Fei Shen, Chengyu Xie, Lihong Wang, Zhanyi Zhang, Xin Jiang, Xiaoyu Du, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Proposes IMAGAgent, a multi-turn image editing framework using a plan-execute-reflect closed-loop mechanism. Addresses error accumulation and semantic drift in multi-step image editing through constraint-aware planning and adaptive correction.

entry.title: VectorGym: A Multitask Benchmark for SVG Code Generation, Sketching, and Editing

author.name: Juan Rodriguez, Haotian Zhang, Abhay Puri, Tianyang Zhang, Rishav Pramanik, Meng Lin, Xiaoqing Xie, Marco Terral, Darsh Kaushik, Aly Shariff, Perouz Taslakian, Spandana Gella, Sai Rajeswar, David Vazquez, Christopher Pal, Marco Pedersoli

entry.summary: Introduces VectorGym, a comprehensive SVG benchmark suite spanning generation, editing, and understanding with expert human annotations. Includes novel Sketch2SVG task and complex multi-step editing dataset.

entry.title: Robust Batch-Level Query Routing for Large Language Models under Cost and Capacity Constraints

author.name: Jelena Markovic-Voronov, Kayhan Behdin, Yuanda Xu, Zhengze Zhou, Zhipeng Wang, Rahul Mazumder

entry.summary: Proposes batch-level, resource-aware LLM query routing framework with robust optimization for cost and capacity constraints. Accounts for uncertainty in predicted LLM performance.

entry.title: Property-Guided Molecular Generation and Optimization via Latent Flows

author.name: Alexander Arjun Lobo, Urvi Awasthi, Leonid Zhukov

entry.summary: Introduces MoltenFlow, combining property-organized latent representations with flow-matching generative priors and gradient-based guidance for molecular discovery. Supports both conditioned generation and local optimization.

entry.title: Hierarchy-Guided Topology Latent Flow for Molecular Graph Generation

author.name: Urvi Awasthi, Alexander Arjun Lobo, Leonid Zhukov

entry.summary: Proposes HLTF, a hierarchy-guided molecular generation model that generates bond graphs with 3D coordinates using a latent multi-scale plan and constraint-aware sampler to prevent topology failures. Achieves strong results on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs.

entry.title: Preconditioned Attention: Enhancing Efficiency in Transformers

author.name: Hemanth Saratchandran

entry.summary: Introduces preconditioned attention, which adds a conditioning matrix to attention heads to reduce the condition number of attention matrices, improving optimization and training convergence in transformers.

entry.title: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Wilailuck Treerath, Fabrizio Pittorino

entry.summary: Formalizes active learning for tabular foundation models (TabPFN) via in-context learning, proposing four acquisition rules that optimize which labeled examples to include in the context rather than updating model parameters.

entry.title: KV Cache Quantization for Self-Forcing Video Generation: A 33-Method Empirical Study

author.name: Suraj Ranganath, Vaishak Menon, Anish Patnaik

entry.summary: Comprehensive empirical study of 33 KV cache compression methods for self-forcing video generation, covering quantization and cache policies across 610 observations. Finds that many methods maintain generation quality while significantly reducing memory.

entry.title: From Independent to Correlated Diffusion: Generalized Generative Modeling with Probabilistic Computers

author.name: Nihal Sanjay Singh, Mazdak Mohseni-Rajaee, Shaila Niazi, Kerem Y. Camsari

entry.summary: Generalizes diffusion models by replacing independent noise with MCMC dynamics incorporating Ising couplings, recovering standard diffusion as a special case. Demonstrates improved generation quality when interaction structure is known.

entry.title: Evolutionary Discovery of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms via Large Language Models

author.name: Alkis Sygkounas, Amy Loutfi, Andreas Persson

entry.summary: Uses LLMs as evolutionary variation operators to discover new RL algorithms by searching over executable update rules, excluding canonical mechanisms like actor-critic and TD learning to promote novel learning rules.

entry.title: IsoQuant: Hardware-Aligned SO(4) Isoclinic Rotations for LLM KV Cache Compression

author.name: Zhongping Ji

entry.summary: IsoQuant uses quaternion algebra and SO(4) isoclinic decomposition for blockwise rotation in LLM KV cache quantization, achieving hardware-aligned 4D block transforms that improve over 3D Clifford rotors.

entry.title: Expectation Error Bounds for Transfer Learning in Linear Regression and Linear Neural Networks

author.name: Meitong Liu, Christopher Jung, Rui Li, Xue Feng, Han Zhao

entry.summary: Derives exact closed-form expressions for expected generalization error in transfer learning for linear regression and linear neural networks, providing necessary and sufficient conditions for when auxiliary tasks help.

entry.title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs

author.name: Yadi Cao, Sicheng Lai, Jiahe Huang, Yang Zhang, Zach Lawrence, Rohan Bhakta, Izzy F. Thomas, Mingyun Cao, Chung-Hao Tsai, Zihao Zhou, Yidong Zhao, Hao Liu, Alessandro Marinoni, Alexey Arefiev, Rose Yu

entry.summary: SimulCost is the first benchmark for cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations, comparing LLM agents against traditional scanning across 2,916 single-round and 1,900 multi-round tasks over 12 simulators.

entry.title: Overcoming the Incentive Collapse Paradox

author.name: Qichuan Yin, Ziwei Su, Shuangning Li

entry.summary: Proposes a sentinel-auditing payment mechanism that overcomes the incentive collapse paradox in AI-assisted task delegation, maintaining positive human effort at finite cost independent of AI accuracy.

entry.title: Persona-Based Simulation of Human Opinion at Population Scale

author.name: Mao Li, Frederick G. Conrad

entry.summary: Introduces SPIRIT, a framework for persona-based simulation of human opinion at population scale using LLMs. Represents individuals through semi-structured personas rather than demographic correlations for opinion trajectory simulation.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction Assessment: A Framework for Conditional Coverage Evaluation and Selection

author.name: Zheng Zhou, Xiangfei Zhang, Chongguang Tao, Yuhong Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Conformal Prediction Assessment (CPA), reframing conditional coverage evaluation as supervised learning by training a reliability estimator. Introduces Conditional Validity Index decomposing into safety and efficiency components.

entry.title: LVRPO: Language-Visual Alignment with GRPO for Multimodal Understanding and Generation

author.name: Shentong Mo, Sukmin Yun

entry.summary: Proposes LVRPO, a language-visual reinforcement-based preference optimization framework using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for unified multimodal understanding and generation.

entry.title: UltraG-Ray: Physics-Based Gaussian Ray Casting for Novel Ultrasound View Synthesis

author.name: Felix Duelmer, Jakob Klaushofer, Magdalena Wysocki, Nassir Navab, Mohammad Farid Azampour

entry.summary: UltraG-Ray introduces a physics-based novel view synthesis method for ultrasound imaging using learnable 3D Gaussian fields coupled with an ultrasound-specific rendering module, closing the simulation-reality gap.

entry.title: LightHarmony3D: Harmonizing Illumination and Shadows for Object Insertion in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tianyu Huang, Zhenyang Ren, Zhenchen Wan, Jiyang Zheng, Wenjie Wang, Runnan Chen, Mingming Gong, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: LightHarmony3D enables illumination-consistent mesh insertion in 3DGS scenes by predicting full 360° HDR environment maps and ensuring multi-view consistent lighting and shadows.

entry.title: Unbiased Model Prediction Without Using Protected Attribute Information

author.name: Puspita Majumdar, Surbhi Mittal, Mayank Vatsa, Richa Singh

entry.summary: Proposes NPAD, a debiasing algorithm that mitigates bias without requiring protected attribute information, instead using auxiliary non-protected attributes for optimization.

entry.title: MotionScale: Reconstructing Appearance, Geometry, and Motion of Dynamic Scenes with Scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Haoran Zhou, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: MotionScale proposes a scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for dynamic scene reconstruction from monocular videos, using cluster-centric basis transformations for motion field parameterization.

entry.title: Abstraction in Style

author.name: Min Lu, Yuanfeng He, Anthony Chen, Jianhuang He, Pu Wang, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Abstraction in Style (AiS), a framework separating structural abstraction from visual stylization in style transfer, generating intermediate abstraction proxies that capture the style's structural logic.

entry.title: EC-Bench: Enumeration and Counting Benchmark for Ultra-Long Videos

author.name: Fumihiko Tsuchiya, Taiki Miyanishi, Mahiro Ukai, Nakamasa Inoue, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: EC-Bench evaluates enumeration, counting, and temporal evidence grounding in 152 videos longer than 30 minutes, revealing that current multimodal models struggle significantly with long-form counting tasks.

entry.title: HCLSM: Hierarchical Causal Latent State Machines for Object-Centric World Modeling

author.name: Jaber Jaber, Osama Jaber

entry.summary: HCLSM presents a world model architecture combining object-centric decomposition via slot attention, hierarchical temporal dynamics at three scales, and causal structure learning through graph neural networks. It addresses limitations of flat latent representations that entangle objects and ignore causal structure.

entry.title: Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Small UAS Separation Assurance under GPS Degradation and Spoofing

author.name: Alex Zongo, Filippos Fotiadis, Ufuk Topcu, Peng Wei

entry.summary: This paper addresses separation assurance for small UAS under GPS spoofing using multi-agent RL, formulating adversarial state corruption as a zero-sum game. A closed-form adversarial perturbation is derived, bypassing adversarial training and enabling linear-time evaluation.

entry.title: SemLoc: Structured Grounding of Free-Form LLM Reasoning for Fault Localization

author.name: Zhaorui Yang, Haichao Zhu, Qian Zhang, Rajiv Gupta, Ashish Kundu

entry.summary: SemLoc addresses fault localization for semantic bugs where execution structure signals fail. Uses structured semantic grounding from LLMs to systematically cross-reference across tests and distinguish root causes from cascading effects.

entry.title: LatentPilot: Scene-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation by Dreaming Ahead with Latent Visual Reasoning

author.name: Haihong Hao, Lei Chen, Mingfei Han, Changlin Li, Dong An, Yuqiang Yang, Zhihui Li, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: LatentPilot enables vision-and-language navigation agents to 'dream ahead' by learning action-conditioned visual dynamics in latent space during training, without needing future frames at inference.

entry.title: PRISM: A Multi-View Multi-Capability Retail Video Dataset for Embodied Vision-Language Models

author.name: Amirreza Rouhi, Parikshit Sakurikar, Satya Sai Reddy, Narsimha Menga, Anirudh Govil, Sri Harsha Chittajallu, Rajat Aggarwal, Anoop Namboodiri, Sashi Reddi

entry.summary: PRISM is a 270K-sample multi-view video dataset for embodied VLMs in retail environments, grounded in a three-dimensional knowledge ontology spanning spatial, temporal/physical, and embodied action knowledge.

entry.title: IMPASTO: Integrating Model-Based Planning with Learned Dynamics Models for Robotic Oil Painting Reproduction

author.name: Yingke Wang, Hao Li, Yifeng Zhu, Hong-Xing Yu, Ken Goldberg, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yunzhu Li, Ruohan Zhang

entry.summary: IMPASTO is a robotic oil-painting system that integrates learned pixel dynamics models with model-based planning to reproduce oil paintings. Uses receding-horizon MPC for trajectory planning and force-sensitive control.

entry.title: AGFT: Alignment-Guided Fine-Tuning for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yubo Cui, Xianchao Guan, Zijun Xiong, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: AGFT enhances zero-shot adversarial robustness of vision-language models by using probabilistic predictions for text-guided adversarial training, preserving cross-modal alignment unlike classification-guided methods.

entry.title: Mind the Gap: A Framework for Assessing Pitfalls in Multimodal Active Learning

author.name: Dustin Eisenhardt, Yunhee Jeong, Florian Buettner

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmarking framework for multimodal active learning that isolates pitfalls like missing modalities, difficulty differences, and varying interaction structures using synthetic datasets.

entry.title: BotVerse: Real-Time Event-Driven Simulation of Social Agents

author.name: Edoardo Allegrini, Edoardo Di Paolo, Angelo Spognardi, Marinella Petrocchi

entry.summary: BotVerse is a scalable, event-driven framework for social simulation using LLM-based agents, grounded in real-time Bluesky content streams. Demonstrates a coordinated disinformation scenario for red-teaming.

entry.title: SISA: A Scale-In Systolic Array for GEMM Acceleration

author.name: Luigi Altamura, Alessio Cicero, Mateo V\'azquez Maceiras, Mohammad Ali Maleki, Pedro Trancoso

entry.summary: Proposes SISA (Scale-In Systolic Array), which partitions traditional square systolic arrays into horizontal rectangular slabs for better utilization with LLM workloads that have skewed matrix dimensions.

entry.title: Explaining, Verifying, and Aligning Semantic Hierarchies in Vision-Language Model Embeddings

author.name: Gesina Schwalbe, Mert Keser, Moritz Bayerkuhnlein, Edgar Heinert, Annika M\"utze, Marvin Keller, Sparsh Tiwari, Georgii Mikriukov, Diedrich Wolter, Jae Hee Lee, Matthias Rottmann

entry.summary: Presents a post-hoc framework to explain, verify, and align semantic hierarchies in VLM embeddings (like CLIP). Extracts binary hierarchies from class centroids and compares against human ontologies.

entry.title: DSO: Dual-Scale Neural Operators for Stable Long-term Fluid Dynamics Forecasting

author.name: Huanshuo Dong, Hao Wu, Hong Wang, Qin-Yi Zhang, Zhezheng Hao

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Scale Neural Operators (DSO) for long-term fluid dynamics forecasting, identifying and addressing two failure modes: local detail blurring and global trend deviation.

entry.title: Central-to-Local Adaptive Generative Diffusion Framework for Improving Gene Expression Prediction in Data-Limited Spatial Transcriptomics

author.name: Yaoyu Fang, Jiahe Qian, Xinkun Wang, Lee A. Cooper, Bo Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Central-to-Local adaptive generative diffusion framework for spatial transcriptomics, using large-scale morphological pretraining with limited molecular guidance for gene expression prediction.

entry.title: ImmSET: Sequence-Based Predictor of TCR-pMHC Specificity at Scale

author.name: Marco Garcia Noceda, Matthew T Noakes, Andrew FigPope, Daniel E Mattox, Bryan Howie, Harlan Robins

entry.summary: Introduces ImmSET, a transformer-based model for predicting T-cell receptor specificity to peptide-MHC complexes at scale. Addresses a fundamental immunology challenge with implications for personalized medicine and immunotherapy.

entry.title: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification

author.name: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Extends a declarative policy language (Semantic Router DSL) from stateless per-request LLM routing to multi-step agent workflows and infrastructure deployment, with cross-layer verification guarantees.

entry.title: GIFT: Bootstrapping Image-to-CAD Program Synthesis via Geometric Feedback

author.name: Giorgio Giannone, Anna Clare Doris, Amin Heyrani Nobari, Kai Xu, Akash Srivastava, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes GIFT, a bootstrapping framework for image-to-CAD program synthesis that generates training data through geometric feedback loops, overcoming the scarcity of aligned visual-geometry/program datasets.

entry.title: Low-Rank Adaptation Reduces Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Transformer Encoder Fine-Tuning: Controlled Empirical Evidence and Frozen-Backbone Representation Probes

author.name: Ashish Pandey

entry.summary: Provides controlled empirical evidence that LoRA dramatically reduces catastrophic forgetting in sequential fine-tuning (0.6% vs 19.9% for full fine-tuning) and uses representation probes to test a frozen-backbone explanation.

entry.title: AutoStan: Autonomous Bayesian Model Improvement via Predictive Feedback

author.name: Oliver D\"urr

entry.summary: Presents AutoStan, a CLI coding agent that autonomously builds and improves Bayesian Stan models through an iterative loop using NLPD on held-out data and MCMC diagnostics as feedback signals.

entry.title: Near-Optimal Primal-Dual Algorithm for Learning Linear Mixture CMDPs with Adversarial Rewards

author.name: Kihyun Yu, Seoungbin Bae, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a near-optimal primal-dual algorithm for safe RL in linear mixture constrained MDPs with adversarial rewards, achieving regret and constraint violation bounds matching known lower bounds up to log factors.

entry.title: Physics-Guided Transformer (PGT): Physics-Aware Attention Mechanism for PINNs

author.name: Ehsan Zeraatkar, Rodion Podorozhny, Jelena Te\v{s}i\'c

entry.summary: Introduces Physics-Guided Transformer (PGT) that embeds heat-kernel-derived bias into self-attention, encoding diffusion dynamics and temporal causality directly in the architecture rather than as soft penalty losses.

entry.title: Bit-Identical Medical Deep Learning via Structured Orthogonal Initialization

author.name: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov

entry.summary: Presents a framework for verified bit-identical deep learning training by eliminating randomness from initialization (structured orthogonal), batch ordering (golden ratio), and GPU operations. Demonstrates on medical ECG classification.

entry.title: Skillful Kilometer-Scale Regional Weather Forecasting via Global and Regional Coupling

author.name: Weiqi Chen, Wenwei Wang, Qilong Yuan, Lefei Shen, Bingqing Peng, Jiawei Chen, Bo Wu, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Presents a global-regional coupling framework for kilometer-scale weather forecasting using ScaleMixer, a bidirectional coupling module connecting a pretrained Transformer global model with a high-resolution regional network through adaptive key-position sampling.

entry.title: Corruption-robust Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning From Human Feedback

author.name: Andi Nika, Debmalya Mandal, Parameswaran Kamalaruban, Adish Singla, Goran Radanovi\'c

entry.summary: Studies corruption-robust offline multi-agent RL from human feedback under strong contamination, providing O(ε^{1-o(1)}) bounds on Nash equilibrium gap under uniform coverage and extending to single-policy coverage settings.

entry.title: CirrusBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agents Beyond Correctness in Real-World Cloud Service Environments

author.name: Yi Yu, Guangquan Hu, Chenghuang Shen, Xingyan Liu, Jing Gu, Hangyi Sun, Junzhuo Ma, Weiting Liu, Jianfeng Liu, Mingyue Pu, Yu Wang, Zhengdong Xiao, Rui Xie, Longjiu Luo, Qianrong Wang, Gurong Cui, Honglin Qiao, Wenlian Lu

entry.summary: CirrusBench evaluates LLM agents on real-world cloud service tickets, going beyond correctness to assess resolution efficiency. Built from authentic customer-assistant interactions with high complexity and long-horizon dependencies.

entry.title: Unrestrained Simplex Denoising for Discrete Data. A Non-Markovian Approach Applied to Graph Generation

author.name: Yoann Boget, Alexandros Kalousis

entry.summary: Introduces simplex denoising with a non-Markovian noising scheme for discrete structure generation, where noisy representations at different times are conditionally independent given clean data. Surpasses state-of-the-art on graph generation.

entry.title: Geometry-aware similarity metrics for neural representations on Riemannian and statistical manifolds

author.name: N Alex Cayco Gajic, Arthur Pellegrino

entry.summary: Introduces Metric Similarity Analysis (MSA) using Riemannian geometry to compare intrinsic geometry of neural representations, rather than extrinsic geometry in state space. Captures distinctions that existing methods miss.

entry.title: PI-Mamba: Linear-Time Protein Backbone Generation via Spectrally Initialized Flow Matching

author.name: Tianyu Wu, Lin Zhu

entry.summary: PI-Mamba generates protein backbones in linear time using a Mamba-based flow matching framework with differentiable constraint enforcement for exact local covalent geometry and spectral initialization.

entry.title: BHCast: Unlocking Black Hole Plasma Dynamics from a Single Blurry Image with Long-Term Forecasting

author.name: Renbo Tu, Ali SaraerToosi, Nicholas S. Conroy, Gennady Pekhimenko, Aviad Levis

entry.summary: Presents BHCast, a neural framework for forecasting black hole plasma dynamics from a single blurry EHT snapshot. Uses autoregressive forecasting with multi-scale pyramid loss to simultaneously super-resolve and predict future frames.

entry.title: Magic Words or Methodical Work? Challenging Conventional Wisdom in LLM-Based Political Text Annotation

author.name: Lorcan McLaren, James Cross, Zuzanna Krakowska, Robin Rauner, Martijn Schoonvelde

entry.summary: Controlled evaluation of LLM pipeline choices for political text annotation, testing six models across four tasks. Central finding is that interaction effects dominate main effects, so seemingly reasonable pipeline choices can produce unreliable results.

entry.title: On the Loss Landscape Geometry of Regularized Deep Matrix Factorization: Uniqueness and Sharpness

author.name: Anil Kamber, Rahul Parhi

entry.summary: Shows that L2-regularized deep matrix factorization admits a unique end-to-end minimizer for almost all target matrices. Reveals the Hessian spectrum is constant across all minimizers, providing loss landscape characterization.

entry.title: LightMover: Generative Light Movement with Color and Intensity Controls

author.name: Gengze Zhou, Tianyu Wang, Soo Ye Kim, Zhixin Shu, Xin Yu, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Sumit Chaturvedi, Qi Wu, Zhe Lin, Scott Cohen

entry.summary: Presents LightMover, a framework for controllable light manipulation in images using video diffusion priors. Formulates light editing as sequence-to-sequence prediction with adaptive token-pruning for efficiency.

entry.title: Persistence diagrams of random matrices via Morse theory: universality and a new spectral diagnostic

author.name: Matthew Loftus

entry.summary: Proves persistence diagrams of sublevel set filtrations of quadratic forms on spheres are analytically determined by eigenvalues. Transfers random matrix theory universality to persistence diagram universality with closed-form persistence entropy.

entry.title: GenFusion: Feed-forward Human Performance Capture via Progressive Canonical Space Updates

author.name: Youngjoong Kwon, Yao He, Heejung Choi, Chen Geng, Zhengmao Liu, Jiajun Wu, Ehsan Adeli

entry.summary: GenFusion presents a feed-forward method for monocular human performance capture that progressively updates a canonical space with incoming frames, accumulating appearance information to handle unseen body regions.

entry.title: MaskAdapt: Learning Flexible Motion Adaptation via Mask-Invariant Prior for Physics-Based Characters

author.name: Soomin Park, Eunseong Lee, Kwang Bin Lee, Sung-Hee Lee

entry.summary: MaskAdapt introduces a two-stage framework for flexible motion adaptation in physics-based humanoid control, using stochastic body-part masking for a robust base policy followed by residual adaptation.

entry.title: Seeing the Evidence, Missing the Answer: Tool-Guided Vision-Language Models on Visual Illusions

author.name: Xuesong Wang, Harry Wang

entry.summary: Presents a tool-guided VLM inference framework for optical illusions that gives models access to image manipulation tools to overcome systematic bias in predicting illusions as 'real'.

entry.title: Not All Frames Are Equal: Complexity-Aware Masked Motion Generation via Motion Spectral Descriptors

author.name: Pengfei Zhou, Xiangyue Zhang, Xukun Shen, Yong Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Motion Spectral Descriptor (MSD), a parameter-free measure of local dynamic complexity for motion generation, and shows masked motion generators degrade disproportionately on dynamically complex motions.

entry.title: CutClaw: Agentic Hours-Long Video Editing via Music Synchronization

author.name: Shifang Zhao, Yihan Hu, Ying Shan, Yunchao Wei, Xiaodong Cun

entry.summary: CutClaw is a multi-agent framework using MLLMs to automatically edit hours-long raw footage into short videos with synchronized music, leveraging hierarchical multimodal decomposition.

entry.title: GRVS: a Generalizable and Recurrent Approach to Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis

author.name: Thomas Tanay, Mohammed Brahimi, Michal Nazarczuk, Qingwen Zhang, Sibi Catley-Chandar, Arthur Moreau, Zhensong Zhang, Eduardo P\'erez-Pellitero

entry.summary: GRVS proposes a generalizable recurrent approach for monocular dynamic view synthesis with a recurrent latent conditioning module and dynamic-aware flow prediction, avoiding scene-specific optimization.

entry.title: Beyond Ground-Truth: Leveraging Image Quality Priors for Real-World Image Restoration

author.name: Fengyang Xiao, Peng Hu, Lei Xu, XingE Guo, Guanyi Qin, Yuqi Shen, Chengyu Fang, Rihan Zhang, Chunming He, Sina Farsiu

entry.summary: IQPIR introduces image quality priors from NR-IQA models to guide image restoration toward perceptually optimal outputs, addressing the issue of GT images having inconsistent perceptual quality.

entry.title: Toward Generalizable Whole Brain Representations with High-Resolution Light-Sheet Data

author.name: Minyoung E. Kim, Dae Hee Yun, Aditi V. Patel, Madeline Hon, Webster Guan, Taegeon Lee, Brian Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents CANVAS, a comprehensive dataset of high-resolution whole mouse brain light-sheet microscopy data for developing foundation models for subcellular-resolution biological structure analysis.
