entry.title: Large-scale nonlinear optical computing with incoherent light via linear diffractive systems

author.name: Alexander Chen, Yuntian Wang, Md Sadman Sakib Rahman, Yuhang Li, Aydogan Ozcan

entry.summary: This paper demonstrates that linear optical systems using passive diffractive surfaces can perform large-scale nonlinear computation with incoherent light, overcoming the traditional challenge of requiring strong optical nonlinearity for nonlinear processing.

entry.title: The Claude Code Source Leak

author.name: Error

entry.summary: Discussion of an apparent accidental leak of Claude Code source code via an npm package update, analyzing the security implications and noting that model weights (the dangerous part) were not leaked.

entry.title: PromptForge-350k: A Large-Scale Dataset and Contrastive Framework for Prompt-Based AI Image Forgery Localization

author.name: Jianpeng Wang, Haoyu Wang, Baoying Chen, Jishen Zeng, Yiming Qin, Yiqi Yang, Zhongjie Ba

entry.summary: PromptForge-350k is a large-scale dataset for localizing AI image forgeries from prompt-based editing, with an automated mask annotation framework and ICL-Net for detection.

entry.title: Online Learning of Kalman Filtering: From Output to State Estimation

author.name: Lintao Ye, Ankang Zhang, Ming Chi, Bin Du, Jianghai Hu

entry.summary: Studies online learning of Kalman filtering with unknown system models, achieving log(T) regret for output estimation and establishing fundamental limitations for state estimation with function approximation.

entry.title: Koopman Operator Identification of Model Parameter Trajectories for Temporal Domain Generalization (KOMET)

author.name: Randy C. Hoover, Jacob James, Paul May, Kyle Caudle

entry.summary: Presents KOMET, a framework treating trained model parameter sequences as trajectories of a nonlinear dynamical system, using Koopman operator identification via Extended DMD to predict parameter evolution under temporal domain drift.

entry.title: RTLSeek: Boosting the LLM-Based RTL Generation with Multi-Stage Diversity-Oriented Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Zhiteng Chao, Yonghao Wang, Bin Sun, Tianyun Ma, Tianmeng Yang, Jianan Mu, Jing Justin Ye, Huawei Li

entry.summary: Proposes RTLSeek for LLM-based RTL/Verilog generation using diversity-oriented reinforcement learning. Multi-stage framework with rule-based rewards integrating EDA feedback to improve both correctness and design diversity.

entry.title: Hierarchical Visual Relocalization with Nearest View Synthesis from Feature Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Huaqi Tao, Bingxi Liu, Guangcheng Chen, Fulin Tang, Li He, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: SplatHLoc proposes a hierarchical visual relocalization framework using Feature Gaussian Splatting, with adaptive viewpoint retrieval and synthesized virtual candidates for improved pose estimation.

entry.title: StereoVGGT: A Training-Free Visual Geometry Transformer for Stereo Vision

author.name: Ziyang Chen, Yansong Qu, You Shen, Xuan Cheng, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: StereoVGGT leverages the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) pretrained on 3D priors including camera poses for training-free stereo vision tasks, addressing the lack of geometric supervision in existing backbones.

entry.title: All-in-One Augmented Reality Guided Head and Neck Tumor Resection

author.name: Yue Yang, Matthieu Chabanas, Carrie Reale, Annie Benson, Jason Slagle, Matthew Weinger, Michael Topf, Jie Ying Wu

entry.summary: Presents an all-in-one AR system using HoloLens 2 for relocalizing positive tumor margins from resected specimens to the resection bed during head and neck cancer surgery, achieving median 1.8mm registration error.

entry.title: CoRe-DA: Contrastive Regression for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Surgical Skill Assessment

author.name: Dimitrios Anastasiou, Razvan Caramalau, Jialang Xu, Runlong He, Freweini Tesfai, Matthew Boal, Nader Francis, Danail Stoyanov, Evangelos B. Mazomenos

entry.summary: Introduces the first benchmark for unsupervised domain adaptation in surgical skill assessment regression, spanning four datasets across dry-lab and clinical settings, and proposes CoRe-DA method.

entry.title: World2Rules: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Learning World-Governing Safety Rules for Aviation

author.name: Haichuan Wang, Jay Patrikar, Sebastian Scherer

entry.summary: World2Rules is a neuro-symbolic framework for learning safety rules from real-world multimodal aviation data, combining neural methods for extracting structure from text/visual data with symbolic methods for verifiable rule generation.

entry.title: Storing Less, Finding More: How Novelty Filtering Improves Cross-Modal Retrieval on Edge Cameras

author.name: Sherif Abdelwahab

entry.summary: Presents a streaming retrieval architecture for edge cameras with an on-device novelty filter that retains only semantically novel frames, achieving 45.6% Hit@5 with an 8M parameter encoder at ~2.7mW.

entry.title: Gloria: Consistent Character Video Generation via Content Anchors

author.name: Yuhang Yang, Fan Zhang, Huaijin Pi, Shuai Guo, Guowei Xu, Wei Zhai, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: Gloria proposes representing character visual attributes through compact anchor frames for consistent character video generation, addressing copy-pasting and multi-reference conflict challenges.

entry.title: Efficient Camera Pose Augmentation for View Generalization in Robotic Policy Learning

author.name: Sen Wang, Huaiyi Dong, Jingyi Tian, Jiayi Li, Zhuo Yang, Tongtong Cao, Anlin Chen, Shuang Wu, Le Wang, Sanping Zhou

entry.summary: GenSplat uses feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse, uncalibrated inputs to render diverse synthetic views for training view-generalized robotic manipulation policies, addressing the brittleness of 2D visuomotor policies to camera viewpoint changes.

entry.title: Multi-Agent LLMs for Adaptive Acquisition in Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Andrea Carbonati, Mohammadsina Almasi, Hadis Anahideh

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs reason about exploration-exploitation tradeoffs in Bayesian optimization, proposing a multi-agent LLM framework for adaptive acquisition. Provides metric-level analysis of LLM-mediated search policy learning.

entry.title: Human-Like Lifelong Memory: A Neuroscience-Grounded Architecture for Infinite Interaction

author.name: Diego C. Lerma-Torres (Universidad de Guanajuato)

entry.summary: Proposes a bio-inspired memory framework for LLMs grounded in complementary learning systems theory, cognitive behavioral therapy, dual-process cognition, and fuzzy-trace theory. Features pre-computed emotional-associative summaries and retrieval based on gist before verbatim recall.

entry.title: SLVMEval: Synthetic Meta Evaluation Benchmark for Text-to-Long Video Generation

author.name: Ryosuke Matsuda, Keito Kudo, Haruto Yoshida, Nobuyuki Shimizu, Jun Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes SLVMEval, a benchmark for meta-evaluating text-to-video evaluation systems on long videos (up to ~3 hours). Uses pairwise comparisons with synthetically degraded videos and crowdsourced filtering.

entry.title: Software Vulnerability Detection Using a Lightweight Graph Neural Network

author.name: Miles Farmer, Ekincan Ufuktepe, Anne Watson, Hialo Muniz Carvalho, Vadim Okun, Zineb Maasaoui, Kannappan Palaniappan

entry.summary: Proposes VulGNN, a lightweight GNN-based model for software vulnerability detection that is 100x smaller than LLMs while achieving comparable performance. Leverages the natural graph structure of code.

entry.title: Derived Fields Preserve Fine-Scale Detail in Budgeted Neural Simulators

author.name: Wenshuo Wang, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Shows that derived fields (rather than primitive fields) preserve fine-scale detail better under fixed storage budgets in neural simulations. Proposes Derived-Field Optimization (DerivOpt) for optimal field selection.

entry.title: Scaling Whole-Body Human Musculoskeletal Behavior Emulation for Specificity and Diversity

author.name: Yunyue Wei, Chenhui Zuo, Shanning Zhuang, Haixin Gong, Yaming Liu, Yanan Sui

entry.summary: Introduces a large-scale parallel musculoskeletal computation framework for whole-body motion reproduction using deep RL. Addresses the curse of dimensionality in muscle-driven control systems.

entry.title: FigAgent: Towards Automatic Method Illustration Figure Generation for AI Scientific Papers

author.name: Zhuoling Li, Jiarui Zhang, Jason Kuen, Jiuxiang Gu, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FigAgent, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating method illustration figures for scientific papers. Uses multi-agent collaboration to distill drawing experiences and create reusable tools for figure generation.

entry.title: Exploring the Impact of Skin Color on Skin Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Kuniko Paxton, Medina Kapo, Amila Akagi\'c, Koorosh Aslansefat, Dhavalkumar Thakker, Yiannis Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Evaluates impact of skin color on skin lesion segmentation using three architectures (UNet, DeepLabV3, DINOv2) and introduces a continuous pigmentation metric rather than discrete skin tone categories.

entry.title: Quantifying Cross-Modal Interactions in Multimodal Glioma Survival Prediction via InterSHAP: Evidence for Additive Signal Integration

author.name: Iain Swift, JingHua Ye, Ruairi O'Reilly

entry.summary: Adapts InterSHAP (Shapley interaction index) from classification to Cox proportional hazards models for glioma survival prediction. Finds an inverse relationship between predictive performance and cross-modal interaction strength.

entry.title: Mitigating Forgetting in Continual Learning with Selective Gradient Projection

author.name: Anika Singh, Aayush Dhaulakhandi, Varun Chopade, Likhith Malipati, David Martinez, Kevin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SFAO for continual learning that uses cosine similarity and per-layer gating to regulate gradient directions, with Monte Carlo approximation for efficiency. Achieves competitive accuracy with lower memory.

entry.title: Sparse-by-Design Cross-Modality Prediction: L0-Gated Representations for Reliable and Efficient Learning

author.name: Filippo Cenacchi

entry.summary: Proposes L0-gated representations as a unified sparsification primitive across graphs, language, and tabular modalities. Enables comparable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different data types.

entry.title: A Comparative Investigation of Thermodynamic Structure-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Guojie Li, Liu Hong

entry.summary: Systematic comparison of thermodynamic structure-informed neural networks, comparing Newtonian, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, Onsager, and extended irreversible thermodynamics formulations for physics-informed learning.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Sheaf Spectral Embedding Framework for Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis

author.name: Xiang Xiang Wang, Guo-Wei We

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical sheaf spectral embedding (HSSE) for single-cell RNA-seq analysis, constructing data-driven cellular sheaves at multiple resolutions and extracting spectral statistics from persistent sheaf Laplacians.

entry.title: Unsupervised Behavioral Compression: Learning Low-Dimensional Policy Manifolds through State-Occupancy Matching

author.name: Andrea Fraschini, Davide Tenedini, Riccardo Zamboni, Mirco Mutti, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: Proposes Occupancy-based Policy Compression (OPC) that compresses RL policy parameter spaces into low-dimensional manifolds using state-occupancy matching instead of action-matching, addressing compounding errors in sequential decisions.

entry.title: Semantic Interaction Information mediates compositional generalization in latent space

author.name: John Schwarcz

entry.summary: Introduces Semantic Interaction Information (SII), a metric measuring how latent variable interactions contribute to task performance in compositional generalization settings. Uses a novel Cognitive Gridworld POMDP to study this.

entry.title: Interpretable Physics Extraction from Data for Linear Dynamical Systems using Lie Generator Networks

author.name: Shafayeth Jamil, Rehan Kapadia

entry.summary: Introduces Lie Generator Networks that learn structured generators for linear dynamical systems and compute trajectories via matrix exponentiation, guaranteeing physical invariants like energy conservation and dissipation.

entry.title: Decomposing Discrimination: Causal Mediation Analysis for AI-Driven Credit Decisions

author.name: Duraimurugan Rajamanickam

entry.summary: Formalizes causal mediation analysis for AI-driven credit decisions using Pearl's framework, distinguishing direct discrimination from structural inequality propagating through financial features. Provides identification strategy under treatment-induced confounding.

entry.title: CrossHGL: A Text-Free Foundation Model for Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Learning

author.name: Xuanze Chen, Jiajun Zhou, Yadong Li, Shanqing Yu, Qi Xuan

entry.summary: Proposes CrossHGL, a text-free foundation model for cross-domain heterogeneous graph learning that transfers multi-relational structural semantics without requiring textual attributes, addressing few-shot cross-domain HGRL.

entry.title: ITQ3_S: High-Fidelity 3-bit LLM Inference via Interleaved Ternary Quantization with Rotation-Domain Smoothing

author.name: Edward J. Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes ITQ3_S, a 3-bit weight quantization method using Walsh-Hadamard pre-rotation to spread outlier energy before ternary coding, with a fused CUDA dequantization procedure for efficiency.

entry.title: Efficient Inference of Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Surendra Pathak

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of techniques for efficient inference of Large Vision Language Models, covering visual token compression, memory management, efficient architectures, and hardware optimization.

entry.title: Gradient Manipulation in Distributed Stochastic Gradient Descent with Strategic Agents: Truthful Incentives with Convergence Guarantees

author.name: Ziqin Chen, Yongqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a distributed payment mechanism for gradient-based distributed learning that guarantees truthful gradient reporting from strategic agents while maintaining convergence, addressing gradient manipulation vulnerabilities.

entry.title: A Perturbation Approach to Unconstrained Linear Bandits

author.name: Andrew Jacobsen, Dorian Baudry, Shinji Ito, Nicol\`o Cesa-Bianchi

entry.summary: Revisits perturbation-based approaches for unconstrained Bandit Linear Optimization, showing it reduces BLO to standard Online Linear Optimization. Derives comparator-adaptive and dynamic regret guarantees with optimal path-length dependencies.

entry.title: Mixture-Model Preference Learning for Many-Objective Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Manisha Dubey, Sebastiaan De Peuter, Wanrong Wang, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for many-objective optimization that learns latent preference archetypes via a Dirichlet process mixture model, with hybrid queries targeting mode identity and within-mode trade-offs.

entry.title: AMIGO: Agentic Multi-Image Grounding Oracle Benchmark

author.name: Min Wang, Ata Mahjoubfar

entry.summary: AMIGO is a long-horizon benchmark for agentic vision-language models requiring hidden-target identification through sequential Yes/No questioning over galleries of similar images. Tests question selection, constraint tracking, and fine-grained discrimination.

entry.title: See it to Place it: Evolving Macro Placements with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ikechukwu Uchendu, Swati Goel, Karly Hou, Ebrahim Songhori, Kuang-Huei Lee, Joe Wenjie Jiang, Vijay Janapa Reddi, Vincent Zhuang

entry.summary: VeoPlace uses VLMs without fine-tuning to guide macro placement in chip floorplanning through visual evolutionary optimization, leveraging VLMs' spatial reasoning to constrain a base placer to subregions of the chip canvas.

entry.title: GeoBlock: Inferring Block Granularity from Dependency Geometry in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Lipeng Wan, Junjie Ma, Jianhui Gu, Zeyang Liu, Xuyang Lu, Xuguang Lan

entry.summary: GeoBlock determines block granularity in diffusion language models from attention-derived dependency geometry, reasoning that causally ordered regions need sequential updates while cohesive regions allow parallel refinement.

entry.title: FEMBA on the Edge: Physiologically-Aware Pre-Training, Quantization, and Deployment of a Bidirectional Mamba EEG Foundation Model on an Ultra-low Power Microcontroller

author.name: Anna Tegon, Nicholas Lehmann, Yawei Li, Andrea Cossettini, Luca Benini, Thorir Mar Ingolfsson

entry.summary: FEMBA deploys a bidirectional Mamba EEG foundation model on ultra-low-power microcontrollers, pre-trained on 21,000+ hours of EEG with a novel physiologically-aware objective and 2-bit quantization via QAT.

entry.title: Efficient Encrypted Computation in Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks with TFHE

author.name: Longfei Guo, Pengbo Li, Ting Gao, Yonghai Zhong, Haojie Fan, Jinqiao Duan

entry.summary: Introduces FHE-DiCSNN, a framework combining Fully Homomorphic Encryption with Spiking Neural Networks for privacy-preserving computation. Leverages the discrete nature of SNNs to complement FHE's integer-based operations.

entry.title: Concerning Uncertainty -- A Systematic Survey of Uncertainty-Aware XAI

author.name: Helena L\"ofstr\"om, Tuwe L\"ofstr\"om, Anders Hjort, Fatima Rabia Yapicioglu

entry.summary: Systematic survey of uncertainty-aware explainable AI (UAXAI), examining how uncertainty is incorporated into explanatory pipelines. Identifies three main UQ approaches (Bayesian, Monte Carlo, Conformal) and finds evaluation practices remain fragmented.

entry.title: Sovereign Context Protocol: An Open Attribution Layer for Human-Generated Content in the Age of Large Language Models

author.name: Praneel Panchigar, Torlach Rush, Matthew Canabarro

entry.summary: Proposes Sovereign Context Protocol (SCP), an open-source attribution-aware data access layer between LLMs and human-generated content, addressing creator invisibility in the AI value chain.

entry.title: StretchCast: Global-Regional AI Weather Forecasting on Stretched Cubed-Sphere Mesh

author.name: Jin Feng

entry.summary: Introduces StretchCast, a global-regional AI weather forecasting framework using variable-resolution stretched cubed-sphere mesh. Develops one-step and multi-step predictors demonstrating feasibility of SCS-based forecasting.

entry.title: Rainbow-DemoRL: Combining Improvements in Demonstration-Augmented Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dwait Bhatt, Shih-Chieh Chou, Nikolay Atanasov

entry.summary: Classifies demonstration-augmented RL approaches into three categories and performs extensive empirical study of their interactions. Studies whether these approaches combine beneficially or have diminishing returns.

entry.title: RSR-core: A High-Performance Engine for Low-Bit Matrix-Vector Multiplication

author.name: Mohsen Dehghankar, Abolfazl Asudeh

entry.summary: Presents RSR-core, a high-performance engine for low-bit matrix-vector multiplication targeting quantized neural network inference. Provides hardware-level implementation beyond application-level optimizations.

entry.title: Statistical Guarantees for Distributionally Robust Optimization with Optimal Transport and OT-Regularized Divergences

author.name: Jeremiah Birrell, Xiaoxi Shen

entry.summary: Derives concentration inequalities for DRO with optimal transport and OT-regularized divergences for adversarial training. First results covering soft-constraint norm-ball OT costs and combined adversarial sampling + DRO.

entry.title: Deflation-PINNs: Learning Multiple Solutions for PDEs and Landau-de Gennes

author.name: Sean Disar\`o, Ruma Rani Maity, Aras Bacho

entry.summary: Introduces Deflation-PINNs, integrating deflation with PINNs and DeepONets to systematically find multiple distinct solution branches of nonlinear PDEs. Provides convergence theory and demonstrates on Landau-de Gennes model.

entry.title: MEDiC: Multi-objective Exploration of Distillation from CLIP

author.name: Konstantinos Georgiou, Maofeng Tang, Hairong Qi

entry.summary: MEDiC combines pixel reconstruction, patch-level token distillation, and global CLS alignment from CLIP in a unified masked image modeling framework, achieving 73.9% kNN accuracy on ImageNet-1K.

entry.title: HSFM: Hard-Set-Guided Feature-Space Meta-Learning for Robust Classification under Spurious Correlations

author.name: Aryan Yazdan Parast, Khawar Islam, Soyoun Won, Basim Azam, Naveed Akhtar

entry.summary: HSFM proposes a bilevel meta-learning method that performs augmentation in feature space to improve robustness under spurious correlations, building on the finding that ERM feature extractors learn rich representations.

entry.title: Native-Domain Cross-Attention for Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration Under Large Initial Perturbations

author.name: Ni Ou, Zhuo Chen, Xinru Zhang, Junzheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an extrinsic-aware cross-attention framework for camera-LiDAR calibration that directly aligns image patches and LiDAR point groups in their native domains, avoiding geometry distortion from depth map projection.

entry.title: A2BFR: Attribute-Aware Blind Face Restoration

author.name: Chenxin Zhu, Yushun Fang, Lu Liu, Shibo Yin, Xiaohong Liu, Xiaoyun Zhang, Qiang Hu, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: A2BFR unifies high-fidelity blind face restoration with prompt-controllable generation using a Diffusion Transformer backbone with unified image-text cross-modal attention.

entry.title: FlowID : Enhancing Forensic Identification with Latent Flow-Matching Models

author.name: Jules Ripoll, David Bertoin, Alasdair Newson, Charles Dossal, Jose Pablo Baraybar

entry.summary: FlowID leverages flow-matching generative models for identity-preserving facial reconstruction of deceased persons, combining single-image fine-tuning with attention-based masking for forensic identification.

entry.title: Scaling Video Pretraining for Surgical Foundation Models

author.name: Sicheng Lu, Zikai Xiao, Jianhui Wei, Danyu Sun, Qi Lu, Keli Hu, Yang Feng, Jian Wu, Zongxin Yang, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: SurgRec proposes a scalable, reproducible pretraining recipe for surgical video foundation models, curating 10,535 videos across multiple surgical domains and standardizing evaluation across 16 downstream datasets. It offers two variants (MAE and JEPA) and aims to address data scale and reproducibility limitations in surgical AI.

entry.title: CADReasoner: Iterative Program Editing for CAD Reverse Engineering

author.name: Soslan Kabisov, Vsevolod Kirichuk, Andrey Volkov, Gennadii Savrasov, Marina Barannikov, Anton Konushin, Andrey Kuznetsov, Dmitrii Zhemchuzhnikov

entry.summary: CADReasoner is a model trained to iteratively refine CAD reverse engineering predictions by comparing input shapes with reconstructions and modifying CadQuery Python programs based on geometric discrepancies, mimicking how human engineers iteratively refine designs.

entry.title: Unbounded Density Ratio Estimation and Its Application to Covariate Shift Adaptation

author.name: Ren-Rui Liu, Jun Fan, Lei Shi, Zheng-Chu Guo

entry.summary: Addresses the understudied problem of unbounded density ratio estimation and its application to covariate shift adaptation, proposing a three-step method that works when density ratios are neither bounded nor known exactly—conditions common in practice.

entry.title: Privacy Guard & Token Parsimony by Prompt and Context Handling and LLM Routing

author.name: Alessio Langiu

entry.summary: Proposes a 'Privacy Guard' system using on-premise small language models to decompose prompts, perform abstractive summarization, and route high-risk queries to zero-trust models. Formalizes the 'Inseparability Paradigm' linking context management to privacy management.

entry.title: A Tight Expressivity Hierarchy for GNN-Based Entity Resolution in Master Data Management

author.name: Ashwin Ganesan

entry.summary: Establishes a tight expressivity hierarchy for GNN-based entity resolution on bipartite entity-attribute graphs, showing exactly which MPNN architecture extensions are needed for different matching criteria.

entry.title: ASTER -- Agentic Science Toolkit for Exoplanet Research

author.name: Emilie Panek, Alexander Roman, Gaurav Shukla, Leonardo Pagliaro, Katia Matcheva, Konstantin Matchev

entry.summary: Introduces ASTER, an agentic science toolkit for exoplanet research that orchestrates LLM-driven workflows for transmission spectroscopy analysis, combining archival queries, literature search, radiative transfer models, and Bayesian retrieval.

entry.title: TrajectoryMover: Generative Movement of Object Trajectories in Videos

author.name: Kiran Chhatre, Hyeonho Jeong, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Christopher E. Peters, Chun-Hao Paul Huang, Paul Guerrero

entry.summary: TrajectoryMover enables moving an object's 3D motion trajectory in a video while preserving its relative motion, addressing a gap in generative video editing capabilities.

entry.title: Square Superpixel Generation and Representation Learning via Granular Ball Computing

author.name: Shuyin Xia, Meng Yang, Dawei Dai, Fan Chen, Shilin Zhao, Junwei Han, Xinbo Gao, Guoyin Wang, Wen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes square superpixel generation using granular ball computing principles, enabling better alignment with regular operators like convolutions and facilitating end-to-end deep learning integration.

entry.title: Detecting Unknown Objects via Energy-based Separation for Open World Object Detection

author.name: Jun-Woo Heo, Keonhee Park, Gyeong-Moon Park

entry.summary: DEUS proposes energy-based separation for open-world object detection, using energy scores to better separate known from unknown objects and mitigate catastrophic forgetting during incremental learning.

entry.title: Bioinspired123D: Generative 3D Modeling System for Bioinspired Structures

author.name: Rachel K. Luu, Markus J. Buehler

entry.summary: Bioinspired123D introduces a code-as-geometry pipeline that generates fabricable 3D structures by having a language model output Blender Python scripts encoding biologically inspired geometries, rather than using dense visual representations like meshes or point clouds.

entry.title: GraSP-STL: A Graph-Based Framework for Zero-Shot Signal Temporal Logic Planning via Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ancheng Hou, Ruijia Liu, Xiang Yin

entry.summary: GraSP-STL proposes a graph-search framework for zero-shot planning under Signal Temporal Logic specifications using only offline trajectory data, learning goal-conditioned value functions to induce reachability metrics for planning.

entry.title: Distributed Predictive Control Barrier Functions: Towards Scalable Safety Certification in Modular Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Jonas Ohnemus, Alexandre Didier, Ahmed Aboudonia, Andrea Carron, Melanie N. Zeilinger

entry.summary: Introduces distributed predictive control barrier functions (D-PCBF) for safety-critical multi-agent systems, providing formal plug-and-play safety guarantees under varying network topologies with model-based predictions.

entry.title: Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks

author.name: Gianluca Peri, Timoteo Carletti, Duccio Fanelli, Diego Febbe

entry.summary: Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks (SHONNs) incorporate higher-order interactions in general-purpose feedforward networks through spectral methods, moving beyond the typical limitation of higher-order networks being useful only for explicit hypergraph inputs.

entry.title: PHONOS: PHOnetic Neutralization for Online Streaming Applications

author.name: Waris Quamer, Mu-Ruei Tseng, Ghady Nasrallah, Ricardo Gutierrez-Osuna

entry.summary: Presents PHONOS, a streaming module for real-time speaker anonymization that neutralizes non-native accents to sound native-like. Achieves 81% reduction in non-native accent detection with 40ms look-ahead.

entry.title: On the Relationship between Bayesian Networks and Probabilistic Structural Causal Models

author.name: Peter J. F. Lucas, Eleanora Zullo, Fabio Stella

entry.summary: Studies the relationship between Bayesian networks and probabilistic structural causal models, examining when BNs can be mapped to SCMs. Shows linear algebra and linear programming offer key tools for this mapping.

entry.title: Assessing Multimodal Chronic Wound Embeddings with Expert Triplet Agreement

author.name: Fabian Kabus, Julia Hindel, Jelena Bratuli\'c, Meropi Karakioulaki, Ayush Gupta, Cristina Has, Thomas Brox, Abhinav Valada, Harald Binder

entry.summary: Introduces TriDerm, a multimodal framework for learning wound representations from small cohorts of rare skin disease cases, evaluated using expert triplet judgments that encode clinical similarity.

entry.title: Leveraging Synthetic Data for Enhancing Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Detection

author.name: Rosario Leonardi, Antonino Furnari, Francesco Ragusa, Giovanni Maria Farinella

entry.summary: Demonstrates that synthetic data can significantly improve egocentric hand-object interaction detection, with +5-12% AP gains when combined with minimal real labeled data.

entry.title: CReF: Cross-modal and Recurrent Fusion for Depth-conditioned Humanoid Locomotion

author.name: Yuan Hao, Ruiqi Yu, Shixin Luo, Guoteng Zhang, Jun Wu, Qiuguo Zhu

entry.summary: CReF proposes a single-stage depth-conditioned humanoid locomotion framework that learns directly from raw depth images without explicit geometric abstractions, using cross-modal and recurrent fusion for traversing complex terrain.

entry.title: Differentiable Initialization-Accelerated CPU-GPU Hybrid Combinatorial Scheduling

author.name: Mingju Liu, Jiaqi Yin, Alvaro Velasquez, Cunxi Yu

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid CPU-GPU framework for combinatorial scheduling using differentiable optimization to warm-start commercial ILP solvers. The differentiable presolving generates high-quality partial solutions that enable better early pruning.

entry.title: CivicShield: A Cross-Domain Defense-in-Depth Framework for Securing Government-Facing AI Chatbots Against Multi-Turn Adversarial Attacks

author.name: KrishnaSaiReddy Patil

entry.summary: Proposes CivicShield, a seven-layer defense-in-depth framework for government-facing AI chatbots against multi-turn adversarial attacks, drawing from network security, formal verification, biological immune systems, and zero-trust cryptography.

entry.title: IMPACT: Influence Modeling for Open-Set Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiaohui Zhou, Yijie Wang, Hongzuo Xu, Weixuan Liang, Xiaoli Li, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: IMPACT introduces influence modeling for open-set time series anomaly detection, addressing the failure of image-based pseudo anomaly generation methods when applied to sequential data.

entry.title: Omni-NegCLIP: Enhancing CLIP with Front-Layer Contrastive Fine-Tuning for Comprehensive Negation Understanding

author.name: Jingqi Xu

entry.summary: Omni-NegCLIP improves CLIP's understanding of negation expressions (both presence-based and absence-based) through modified contrastive loss fine-tuning of front layers.

entry.title: CIPHER: Counterfeit Image Pattern High-level Examination via Representation

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Youngung Han, Seoyoung Ju, Yeonju Jean, YooHyun Kim, Minseo Choi, SuYeon Lim, Kyungtae Park, Seungwoo Baek, Sieun Hyeon, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: CIPHER detects deepfakes by reusing and fine-tuning discriminators originally trained for image generation (ProGAN, diffusion models), extracting scale-adaptive and temporal-consistency features.

entry.title: RAAP: Retrieval-Augmented Affordance Prediction with Cross-Image Action Alignment

author.name: Qiyuan Zhuang, He-Yang Xu, Yijun Wang, Xin-Yang Zhao, Yang-Yang Li, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: RAAP introduces retrieval-augmented affordance prediction that decouples contact localization from action direction prediction, transferring contact points via dense correspondence and predicting actions through alignment-based learning.

entry.title: Few-shot Writer Adaptation via Multimodal In-Context Learning

author.name: Tom Simon, Stephane Nicolas, Pierrick Tranouez, Clement Chatelain, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal in-context learning framework for handwritten text recognition that enables inference-time writer adaptation without gradient computation, using only a few examples.

entry.title: Quantization with Unified Adaptive Distillation to enable multi-LoRA based one-for-all Generative Vision Models on edge

author.name: Sowmya Vajrala, Aakash Parmar, Prasanna R, Sravanth Kodavanti, Manjunath Arveti, Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala, Ashok Senapati

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for deploying multiple generative vision tasks on edge devices using a single shared model with multi-LoRA adapters, combined with quantization and adaptive distillation. Eliminates redundant storage from separate model binaries per task.

entry.title: UniRank: End-to-End Domain-Specific Reranking of Hybrid Text-Image Candidates

author.name: Yupei Yang, Lin Yang, Wanxi Deng, Lin Qu, Shikui Tu, Lei Xu

entry.summary: Proposes UniRank for reranking hybrid text-image candidate sets, addressing modality gap where text rerankers are biased toward text candidates. Uses VLMs while avoiding computational overhead of treating all candidates as images.

entry.title: Enhancing Structural Mapping with LLM-derived Abstractions for Analogical Reasoning in Narratives

author.name: Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Yifan Jiang, Stefano De Giorgis, Frank van Harmelen, Filip Ilievski

entry.summary: Proposes YARN framework for analogical reasoning in narratives, using LLMs to decompose narratives into units, abstract them, and then apply structural mapping. Tests whether LLM-derived abstractions improve analogy detection.

entry.title: A Regression Framework for Understanding Prompt Component Impact on LLM Performance

author.name: Andrew Lauziere, Jonathan Daugherty, Taisa Kushner

entry.summary: Proposes a statistical framework using regression models to understand how specific prompt features impact LLM performance. Explains 72-77% of performance variation through individual prompt portions.

entry.title: VAN-AD: Visual Masked Autoencoder with Normalizing Flow For Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: PengYu Chen, Shang Wan, Xiaohou Shi, Yuan Chang, Yan Sun, Sajal K. Das

entry.summary: Proposes VAN-AD, combining visual masked autoencoders with normalizing flows for time series anomaly detection. Aims for foundation model-like generalization across different datasets.

entry.title: Liquid Networks with Mixture Density Heads for Efficient Imitation Learning

author.name: Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Compares liquid neural networks with mixture density heads against diffusion policies for imitation learning, showing liquid policies use half the parameters, achieve lower prediction error, and run 1.8x faster at inference across multiple robotics benchmarks.

entry.title: Maximin Learning of Individualized Treatment Effect on Multi-Domain Outcomes

author.name: Yuying Lu, Wenbo Fei, Yuanjia Wang, Molei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DRIFT, a maximin framework for estimating individualized treatment effects from high-dimensional clinical data using latent factor representations and adversarial learning, designed for precision mental health applications.

entry.title: Q-BIOLAT: Binary Latent Protein Fitness Landscapes for QUBO-Based Optimization

author.name: Truong-Son Hy

entry.summary: Introduces Q-BIOLAT, a framework for protein fitness optimization using binary latent spaces and QUBO formulation, showing that representations with similar predictive accuracy can have fundamentally different optimization landscapes.

entry.title: Stability and Sensitivity Analysis of Relative Temporal-Difference Learning: Extended Version

author.name: Masoud S. Sakha, Rushikesh Kamalapurkar, Sean Meyn

entry.summary: Analyzes relative temporal-difference learning with linear function approximation, establishing stability conditions and showing that using empirical state-action distribution as baseline ensures stability for any discount factor and baseline weight.

entry.title: Symbolic Density Estimation: A Decompositional Approach

author.name: Angelo Rajendram, Xieting Chu, Vijay Ganesh, Max Fieg, Aishik Ghosh

entry.summary: Introduces AI-Kolmogorov, a framework for symbolic density estimation through a multi-stage pipeline of clustering, nonparametric estimation, support estimation, and symbolic regression to produce interpretable density models.

entry.title: Reducing Oracle Feedback with Vision-Language Embeddings for Preference-Based RL

author.name: Udita Ghosh, Dripta S. Raychaudhuri, Jiachen Li, Konstantinos Karydis, Amit Roy-Chowdhury

entry.summary: Proposes ROVED, a hybrid framework combining vision-language embeddings with targeted oracle feedback for preference-based RL, deferring to human oracle only for high-uncertainty samples to reduce feedback costs.

entry.title: InkDrop: Invisible Backdoor Attacks Against Dataset Condensation

author.name: He Yang, Dongyi Lv, Song Ma, Wei Xi, Zhi Wang, Hanlin Gu, Yajie Wang

entry.summary: InkDrop proposes stealthy backdoor attacks against dataset condensation by leveraging model decision boundary uncertainty to embed imperceptible malicious patterns. Addresses the overlooked dimension of attack stealthiness in dataset condensation security.

entry.title: Variational Neurons in Transformers for Language Modeling

author.name: Yves Ruffenach

entry.summary: Introduces variational neurons into Transformer feed-forward layers, replacing deterministic units with local variational units to embed uncertainty into internal computation. Evaluates on compact language modeling with both predictive and probabilistic criteria.

entry.title: Optimistic Actor-Critic with Parametric Policies for Linear Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Max Qiushi Lin, Reza Asad, Kevin Tan, Haque Ishfaq, Csaba Szepesvari, Sharan Vaswani

entry.summary: Proposes optimistic actor-critic with parametric log-linear policies for linear MDPs, addressing the impracticality of implicit NPG policies by providing explicit parameterization with exploration guarantees.

entry.title: Subspace Optimization for Backpropagation-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Damian S\'ojka, Sebastian Cygert, Marc Masana

entry.summary: PACE is a backpropagation-free continual test-time adaptation system using CMA-ES with Fastfood projection to optimize normalization layer parameters in low-dimensional subspace, with domain-specialized memory for efficient adaptation.

entry.title: Steering Sparse Autoencoder Latents to Control Dynamic Head Pruning in Vision Transformers (Student Abstract)

author.name: Yousung Lee, Dongsoo Har

entry.summary: Proposes integrating Sparse Autoencoders with dynamic head pruning in Vision Transformers, using interpretable sparse latents to steer pruning decisions. Per-class steering reveals compact, class-specific head subsets that preserve or improve accuracy while reducing head usage.

entry.title: Dictionary-based Pathology Mining with Hard-instance-assisted Classifier Debiasing for Genetic Biomarker Prediction from WSIs

author.name: Ling Zhang, Boxiang Yun, Ting Jin, Qingli Li, Xinxing Li, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes D2Bio for predicting genetic biomarkers from whole-slide images, using dictionary-based hierarchical pathology mining and hard-instance-assisted classifier debiasing to improve representation and reduce overfitting.

entry.title: Forecastability as an Information-Theoretic Limit on Prediction

author.name: Peter Maurice Catt

entry.summary: Develops forecastability as an information-theoretic limit on prediction under logarithmic loss, showing mutual information equals maximum achievable loss reduction. Derives structural properties and compression bounds.

entry.title: D-SPEAR: Dual-Stream Prioritized Experience Adaptive Replay for Stable Reinforcement Learninging Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yu Zhang, Karl Mason

entry.summary: Proposes D-SPEAR, a dual-stream replay framework that decouples actor and critic sampling for robotic manipulation RL. Critic uses prioritized replay while actor uses low-error transitions to stabilize training.

entry.title: Empirical Likelihood for Nonsmooth Functionals

author.name: Hongseok Namkoong

entry.summary: Develops bootstrap empirical likelihood method for partially nonsmooth functionals, motivated by policy evaluation where smoothness fails when optima aren't unique. Uses geometric reduction to tangent cones.

entry.title: Decoding Functional Networks for Visual Categories via GNNs

author.name: Shira Karmi, Galia Avidan, Tammy Riklin Raviv

entry.summary: Uses signed Graph Neural Networks on 7T fMRI data to decode visual category-specific functional connectivity states in the brain. Bridges machine learning and neuroscience by moving from voxel-level to connectivity-based representations along ventral and dorsal visual pathways.

entry.title: LA-Sign: Looped Transformers with Geometry-aware Alignment for Skeleton-based Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Muxin Pu, Mei Kuan Lim, Chun Yong Chong, Chen Change Loy

entry.summary: LA-Sign proposes a looped transformer framework with geometry-aware alignment for skeleton-based sign language recognition, using recurrence instead of deeper architectures to refine motion understanding.

entry.title: GazeCLIP: Gaze-Guided CLIP with Adaptive-Enhanced Fine-Grained Language Prompt for Deepfake Attribution and Detection

author.name: Yaning Zhang, Linlin Shen, Zitong Yu, Chunjie Ma, Zan Gao

entry.summary: GazeCLIP uses gaze guidance and adaptive fine-grained language prompts based on CLIP for deepfake attribution and detection, proposing a new benchmark for evaluating performance on novel generators.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Prediction: A Unified Framework Harnessing Positional and Semantic Uncertainties

author.name: Jintao Sun, Hu Zhang, Gangyi Ding, Zhedong Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework jointly modeling positional and semantic uncertainties in map data for trajectory prediction, using a dual-head architecture for independent uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: SeGPruner: Semantic-Geometric Visual Token Pruner for 3D Question Answering

author.name: Wenli Li, Kai Zhao, Haoran Jiang, Enquan Yang, Yi Su, Dan Zeng

entry.summary: SeGPruner prunes visual tokens for 3D question answering by combining semantic importance from VLMs with geometric cues from 3D point clouds, improving inference efficiency under token budgets.

entry.title: Clinical DVH metrics as a loss function for 3D dose prediction in head and neck radiotherapy

author.name: Ruochen Gao, Marius Staring, Frank Dankers

entry.summary: Proposes a clinical DVH metric loss that directly optimizes dose-volume histogram metrics for 3D dose prediction in head and neck radiotherapy, better aligning training with clinical evaluation criteria.

entry.title: FED-Bench: A Cross-Granular Benchmark for Disentangled Evaluation of Facial Expression Editing

author.name: Fengjian Xue, Xuecheng Wu, Heli Sun, Yunyun Shi, Shi Chen, Liangyu Fu, Jinheng Xie, Dingkang Yang, Hao Wang, Junxiao Xue, Liang He

entry.summary: FED-Bench provides a comprehensive benchmark with 747 triplets for evaluating facial expression editing, addressing systemic biases in current evaluation metrics that favor lazy or overfit editing.

entry.title: OmniRoam: World Wandering via Long-Horizon Panoramic Video Generation

author.name: Yuheng Liu, Xin Lin, Xinke Li, Baihan Yang, Chen Wang, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Hao Tan, Kai Zhang, Xiaohui Xie, Zifan Shi, Yiwei Hu

entry.summary: OmniRoam is a controllable panoramic video generation framework that enables long-horizon scene wandering by exploiting panoramic representation's inherent spatial-temporal consistency. It uses a preview-then-refine pipeline with trajectory control.

entry.title: A Semantic Observer Layer for Autonomous Vehicles: Pre-Deployment Feasibility Study of VLMs for Low-Latency Anomaly Detection

author.name: Kunal Runwal, Swaraj Gajare, Daniel Adejumo, Omkar Ankalkope, Siddhant Baroth, Aliasghar Arab

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic observer layer for autonomous vehicles using a quantized vision-language model (Cosmos-Reason1-7B) running at 1-2 Hz to detect context-dependent anomalies that pixel-level detectors miss, achieving ~500ms inference with NVFP4 quantization.

entry.title: Do covariates explain why these groups differ? The choice of reference group can reverse conclusions in the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition

author.name: Manuel Quintero, Advik Shreekumar, William T. Stephenson, Tamara Broderick

entry.summary: Demonstrates that the choice of reference group in the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition can reverse substantive conclusions about whether outcome differences between groups are explained by covariates, with real-world examples showing this is a practical concern.

entry.title: Does Anthropic’s Constitution Really Capture Virtue Ethics? Toward a virtue ethical alternative to Constitutional AI (with comments by Claude)

author.name: Masaharu Mizumoto

entry.summary: Analyzes whether Anthropic's Constitutional AI truly captures virtue ethics as claimed, arguing it remains largely rule-based. Proposes a virtue-ethical alternative grounded in holistic human intuitions rather than explicit rules.

entry.title: SafeDMPs: Integrating Formal Safety with DMPs for Adaptive HRI

author.name: Soumyodipta Nath, Pranav Tiwari, Ravi Prakash

entry.summary: SafeDMPs integrates Dynamic Movement Primitives with Control Barrier Functions in a non-optimization-based, closed-form approach to achieve both robustness to disturbances and provable collision safety for human-robot interaction.

entry.title: MMFace-DiT: A Dual-Stream Diffusion Transformer for High-Fidelity Multimodal Face Generation

author.name: Bharath Krishnamurthy, Ajita Rattani

entry.summary: Proposes MMFace-DiT, a dual-stream diffusion transformer for multimodal face generation that natively fuses text and spatial priors rather than appending control modules to pre-trained pipelines.

entry.title: Developing Adaptive Context Compression Techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs) in Long-Running Interactions

author.name: Payal Fofadiya, Sunil Tiwari

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive context compression framework for LLMs in long interactions, integrating importance-aware memory selection, coherence-sensitive filtering, and dynamic budget allocation.

entry.title: MemRerank: Preference Memory for Personalized Product Reranking

author.name: Zhiyuan Peng, Xuyang Wu, Huaixiao Tou, Yi Fang, Yi Gong

entry.summary: MemRerank distills user purchase history into preference memories for personalized product reranking, trained with RL using downstream reranking performance as supervision.

entry.title: NeoNet: An End-to-End 3D MRI-Based Deep Learning Framework for Non-Invasive Prediction of Perineural Invasion via Generation-Driven Classification

author.name: Youngung Han, Minkyung Cha, Kyeonghun Kim, Induk Um, Myeongbin Sho, Joo Young Bae, Jaewon Jung, Jung Hyeok Park, Seojun Lee, Nam-Joon Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: NeoNet is an end-to-end 3D deep learning framework for non-invasive prediction of perineural invasion in cholangiocarcinoma from MRI, integrating segmentation, generation (3D LDM), and classification.

entry.title: TrafficMoE: Heterogeneity-aware Mixture of Experts for Encrypted Traffic Classification

author.name: Qing He, Xiaowei Fu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: TrafficMoE uses mixture-of-experts to handle heterogeneity in encrypted traffic classification, separating structured headers from randomized payloads to avoid entangling protocol signals with encryption noise.

entry.title: KEditVis: A Visual Analytics System for Knowledge Editing of Large Language Models

author.name: Zhenning Chen, Hanbei Zhan, Yanwei Huang, Xin Wu, Dazhen Deng, Di Weng, Yingcai Wu

entry.summary: Presents KEditVis, a visual analytics system for understanding knowledge editing in LLMs. Helps users identify optimal model layers for editing and compare editing strategies through interactive visualizations.

entry.title: TSHA: A Benchmark for Visual Language Models in Trustworthy Safety Hazard Assessment Scenarios

author.name: Qiucheng Yu, Ruijie Xu, Mingang Chen, Xuequan Lu, Jianfeng Dong, Chaochao Lu, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Introduces TSHA benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on indoor safety hazard assessment, comprising 81,800+ real-world images with rigorous evaluation protocols.

entry.title: GSR-GNN: Training Acceleration and Memory-Saving Framework of Deep GNNs on Circuit Graph

author.name: Yuebo Luo, Shiyang Li, Yifei Feng, Vishal Kancharla, Shaoyi Huang, Caiwen Ding

entry.summary: Proposes GSR-GNN, a framework enabling training of very deep GNNs (hundreds of layers) on circuit graphs using reversible residual modules and group-wise sparse operators to reduce memory and compute.

entry.title: Diagnosing Non-Markovian Observations in Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Based Violation Scoring

author.name: Naveen Mysore

entry.summary: Introduces a prediction-based scoring method to detect non-Markovian observations in RL by testing whether historical observations reduce prediction error beyond what the current observation provides.

entry.title: BLOSSOM: Block-wise Federated Learning Over Shared and Sparse Observed Modalities

author.name: Pranav M R, Jayant Chandwani, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem, Arnab K. Paul

entry.summary: Proposes BLOSSOM, a multimodal federated learning framework supporting clients with arbitrary modality subsets through block-wise aggregation that selectively shares components while keeping task-specific blocks local.

entry.title: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays: A Simultaneous Decision-Making Approach

author.name: Zirui Xu, Vasileios Tzoumas

entry.summary: Proposes the Distributed Online Greedy (DOG) algorithm for multi-agent submodular maximization with communication delays, integrating adversarial bandit learning with simultaneous decision-making to avoid sequential multi-hop communication.

entry.title: Kernel Dynamics under Path Entropy Maximization

author.name: Jnaneshwar Das

entry.summary: Proposes a variational framework treating kernel functions as dynamical variables subject to path entropy maximization, connecting RG flow and neural tangent kernel evolution as special cases.

entry.title: SIMR-NO: A Spectrally-Informed Multi-Resolution Neural Operator for Turbulent Flow Super-Resolution

author.name: Muhammad Abid, Omer San

entry.summary: SIMR-NO introduces a hierarchical neural operator for turbulent flow super-resolution that factorizes inverse mapping across intermediate resolutions and combines deterministic interpolation with spectral inductive biases. Targets physically faithful reconstruction at large upscaling factors.

entry.title: Policy-Controlled Generalized Share: A General Framework with a Transformer Instantiation for Strictly Online Switching-Oracle Tracking

author.name: Hongkai Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Policy-Controlled Generalized Share (PCGS), a strictly online framework using causal Transformers as update controllers for switching-oracle tracking in non-stationary prediction. Provides pathwise weighted regret guarantees.

entry.title: FairGC: Fairness-aware Graph Condensation

author.name: Yihan Gao, Chenxi Huang, Wen Shi, Ke Sun, Ziqi Xu, Xikun Zhang, Mingliang Hou, Renqiang Luo

entry.summary: FairGC embeds fairness directly into graph condensation by using distributional alignment, spectral feature correction, and fairness-aware optimization to prevent amplifying demographic disparities in synthetic graph datasets.

entry.title: ChemCLIP: Bridging Organic and Inorganic Anticancer Compounds Through Contrastive Learning

author.name: Mohamad Koohi-Moghadam, Hongzhe Sun, Hongyan Li, Kyongtae Tyler Bae

entry.summary: ChemCLIP bridges organic and inorganic anticancer compounds through contrastive learning, creating unified representations based on shared anticancer activities rather than structural similarity across 44K organic and 5K metal complexes.

entry.title: Mixture of Experts with Soft Nearest Neighbor Loss: Resolving Expert Collapse via Representation Disentanglement

author.name: Abien Fred Agarap, Arnulfo P. Azcarraga

entry.summary: Addresses expert collapse in Mixture-of-Experts by using Soft Nearest Neighbor Loss to pre-condition the latent space before gating, minimizing distances among class-similar points to resolve structural expert collapse.

entry.title: Stringological sequence prediction I: efficient algorithms for predicting highly repetitive sequences

author.name: Vanessa Kosoy

entry.summary: Proposes novel sequence prediction algorithms based on stringology, with efficient time/space complexity and mistake bounds related to stringological complexity measures like smallest straight-line program size.

entry.title: Online Statistical Inference of Constant Sample-averaged Q-Learning

author.name: Saunak Kumar Panda, Tong Li, Ruiqi Liu, Yisha Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for online statistical inference of sample-averaged Q-learning, adapting the functional central limit theorem and constructing confidence intervals via random scaling.

entry.title: PRUE: A Practical Recipe for Field Boundary Segmentation at Scale

author.name: Gedeon Muhawenayo, Caleb Robinson, Subash Khanal, Zhanpei Fang, Isaac Corley, Alexander Wollam, Tianyi Gao, Leonard Strnad, Ryan Avery, Lyndon Estes, Ana M. T\'arano, Nathan Jacobs, Hannah Kerner

entry.summary: Presents PRUE, conducting the first systematic evaluation of segmentation and geospatial foundation models for global agricultural field boundary delineation. Shows U-Net outperforms instance-based and GFM alternatives on the FTW benchmark.

entry.title: Weakly Convex Ridge Regularization for 3D Non-Cartesian MRI Reconstruction

author.name: German Sh\^ama Wache, Chaithya G R, Asma Tanabene, Sebastian Neumayer

entry.summary: Proposes weakly convex ridge regularization for 3D non-Cartesian MRI reconstruction, benchmarked against state-of-the-art on both retrospective and prospective acquisitions. Achieves comparable performance to PnP with a 3D DRUNet while maintaining convergence guarantees.

entry.title: A Comparative Study in Surgical AI: Datasets, Foundation Models, and Barriers to Med-AGI

author.name: Kirill Skobelev, Eric Fithian, Yegor Baranovski, Jack Cook, Sandeep Angara, Shauna Otto, Zhuang-Fang Yi, John Zhu, Daniel A. Donoho, X. Y. Han, Neeraj Mainkar, Margaux Masson-Forsythe

entry.summary: Comprehensive comparative study of surgical AI examining datasets, foundation models, and barriers to medical AGI. Notes AI lags behind on surgical benchmarks compared to other biomedical tasks due to multimodal complexity.

entry.title: Secure Reinforcement Learning: On Model-Free Detection of Man in the Middle Attacks

author.name: Rishi Rani, Massimo Franceschetti

entry.summary: Extends Bellman Deviation Detection framework for detecting man-in-the-middle attacks in RL-based cyber-physical systems. Proves agent's learning time for security scales linearly with adversary's learning time.

entry.title: M2H-MX: Multi-Task Dense Visual Perception for Real-Time Monocular Spatial Understanding

author.name: U. V. B. L. Udugama, George Vosselman, Francesco Nex

entry.summary: M2H-MX presents a real-time multi-task perception model for monocular spatial understanding, combining depth and semantic estimation with register-gated global context in a lightweight decoder.

entry.title: ConInfer: Context-Aware Inference for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation

author.name: Wenyang Chen, Zhanxuan Hu, Yaping Zhang, Hailong Ning, Yonghang Tai

entry.summary: ConInfer introduces context-aware inference for training-free open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation, leveraging spatial and semantic correlations in large-scale scenes rather than isolated patch-wise predictions.

entry.title: FOSCU: Feasibility of Synthetic MRI Generation via Duo-Diffusion Models for Enhancement of 3D U-Nets in Hepatic Segmentation

author.name: Youngung Han, Kyeonghun Kim, Seoyoung Ju, Yeonju Jean, Minkyung Cha, Seohyoung Park, Hyeonseok Jung, Nam-Joon Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: FOSCU integrates a 3D latent diffusion model with ControlNet (Duo-Diffusion) to generate synthetic MRI volumes and segmentation labels for enhancing 3D U-Net hepatic segmentation training.

entry.title: FedDBP: Enhancing Federated Prototype Learning with Dual-Branch Features and Personalized Global Fusion

author.name: Ningzhi Gao, Siquan Huang, Leyu Shi, Ying Gao

entry.summary: FedDBP proposes a federated prototype learning method with dual-branch feature projectors balancing fidelity and discriminability, plus personalized global prototype fusion using Fisher information.

entry.title: Kilohertz-Safe: A Scalable Framework for Constrained Dexterous Retargeting

author.name: Yinxiao Tian, Ziyi Yang, Zinan Zhao, Zhen Kan

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable motion retargeting framework for dexterous hand teleoperation that reformulates the nonlinear retargeting problem into a convex quadratic program, enabling kilohertz-level control with formal safety guarantees for collision avoidance.

entry.title: Kernel-SDF: An Open-Source Library for Real-Time Signed Distance Function Estimation using Kernel Regression

author.name: Zhirui Dai, Tianxing Fan, Mani Amani, Jaemin Seo, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Hyondong Oh, Nikolay Atanasov

entry.summary: Kernel-SDF is an open-source library for real-time signed distance function estimation using kernel regression, addressing limitations of voxel-based, neural, and Gaussian process methods for large-scale uncertainty-aware SDF estimation from streaming sensor data.

entry.title: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization in the Component-Wise L1 Norm for Sparse Data

author.name: Giovanni Seraghiti, K\'evin Dubrulle, Arnaud Vandaele, Nicolas Gillis

entry.summary: Studies NMF with component-wise L1 norm, proving it is NP-hard even for rank-1, and showing it strongly enforces sparsity for sparse inputs—useful for heavy-tailed noise and outliers, but problematic with false zeros.

entry.title: What it's like to be an AI safety grantmaker (and why we need more of them)

author.name: Julian Hazell

entry.summary: Describes the work of AI safety grantmaking, arguing the ecosystem needs more grantmakers to handle growing funding (heading toward $1B+/year). Details how grantmaking involves proactive grant generation, strategic advising, and ecosystem coordination beyond just evaluating proposals.

entry.title: CLaD: Planning with Grounded Foresight via Cross-Modal Latent Dynamics

author.name: Andrew Jeong, Jaemin Kim, Sebin Lee, Sung-Eui Yoon

entry.summary: CLaD models how proprioceptive and semantic states jointly evolve under actions using asymmetric cross-attention, predicting grounded latent foresights for robotic manipulation planning via self-supervised objectives.

entry.title: Aligning Validation with Deployment: Target-Weighted Cross-Validation for Spatial Prediction

author.name: Alexander Brenning, Thomas Suesse

entry.summary: Proposes Target-Weighted Cross-Validation (TWCV), a cross-validation estimator that accounts for covariate shift and task-difficulty shift between validation and deployment distributions in spatial prediction settings.

entry.title: A Latent Risk-Aware Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Operational Success in Clinical Trials based on TrialsBank

author.name: Iness Halimi, Emmanuel Piffo, Oumnia Boudersa, Yvan Marcel Carre Vilmorin, Melissa Ait-ikhlef, Karima Kone, Andy Tan, Augustin Medina, Juliette Hernando, Sheila Ernest, Vatche Bartekian, Karine Lalonde, Mireille E Schnitzer, Gianolli Dorcelus

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical latent risk-aware ML framework for predicting clinical trial operational success using 13,700 trials from a proprietary database. Focuses on variables available at trial design phase for practical applicability.

entry.title: Multi-Layered Memory Architectures for LLM Agents: An Experimental Evaluation of Long-Term Context Retention

author.name: Sunil Tiwari, Payal Fofadiya

entry.summary: Presents a multi-layer memory framework (working, episodic, semantic) for long-horizon dialogue systems with adaptive retrieval gating and retention regularization.

entry.title: Improving Ensemble Forecasts of Abnormally Deflecting Tropical Cyclones with Fused Atmosphere-Ocean-Terrain Data

author.name: Qixiang Li, Shuwei Huo, Chong Wang, Xiaofeng Li, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Constructs a multimodal atmosphere-ocean-terrain dataset (AOT-TCs) for tropical cyclone forecasting and proposes ensemble methods for abnormally deflecting cyclones.

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Spatiotemporal Forecasting for 3D Cloud Fields

author.name: Fu Wang, Qifeng Lu, Xinyu Long, Meng Zhang, Xiaofei Yang, Weijia Cao, Xiaowen Chu

entry.summary: QENO proposes a hybrid quantum-inspired spatiotemporal forecasting framework for 3D cloud field prediction, combining classical spatiotemporal encoding with quantum-inspired nonlocal reasoning.

entry.title: M-MiniGPT4: Multilingual VLLM Alignment via Translated Data

author.name: Seung Hun Han, Youssef Mohamed, Mohamed Elhoseiny

entry.summary: M-MiniGPT4 achieves strong multilingual vision-language understanding across 11 languages using a mixture of native and translated data, with a multilingual alignment training stage.

entry.title: From Skeletons to Semantics: Design and Deployment of a Hybrid Edge-Based Action Detection System for Public Safety

author.name: Ganen Sethupathy, Lalit Dumka, Jan Schagen

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid edge-based action detection system combining skeleton-based motion analysis with vision-language models for public safety monitoring. Balances privacy, latency, and accuracy constraints.

entry.title: Wildfire Suppression: Complexity, Models, and Instances

author.name: Gustavo Delazeri, Marcus Ritt

entry.summary: Proves NP-completeness of wildfire suppression resource allocation variants and proposes a new MIP formulation achieving state-of-the-art results. Introduces physics-grounded benchmark instances.

entry.title: Trimodal Deep Learning for Glioma Survival Prediction: A Feasibility Study Integrating Histopathology, Gene Expression, and MRI

author.name: Iain Swift, JingHua Ye

entry.summary: Pilot study extending bimodal deep learning (histopathology + genomics) for glioma survival prediction by incorporating FLAIR MRI as a third modality. Tests multiple fusion strategies across 664 patients.

entry.title: Epileptic Seizure Prediction Using Patient-Adaptive Transformer Networks

author.name: Mohamed Mahdi, Asma Baghdadi

entry.summary: Proposes patient-adaptive transformer framework for epileptic seizure prediction using self-supervised pretraining on EEG followed by patient-specific fine-tuning for 30-second horizon prediction.

entry.title: Conformalized Signal Temporal Logic Inference under Covariate Shift

author.name: Yixuan Wang, Danyang Li, Matthew Cleaveland, Roberto Tron, Mingyu Cai

entry.summary: Extends conformal prediction for Signal Temporal Logic inference to handle covariate shift between training and deployment, providing statistical guarantees for learned temporal logic rules under distribution shift.

entry.title: Variational Learning of Fractional Posteriors

author.name: Kian Ming A. Chai, Edwin V. Bonilla

entry.summary: Introduces a variational objective for learning fractional posteriors that lower bounds data evidence, extending to hierarchical models and VAEs. Shows fractional posteriors improve calibration compared to standard variational bounds.

entry.title: Cross-attentive Cohesive Subgraph Embedding to Mitigate Oversquashing in GNNs

author.name: Tanvir Hossain, Muhammad Ifte Khairul Islam, Lilia Chebbah, Charles Fanning, Esra Akbas

entry.summary: Proposes cross-attentive cohesive subgraph embeddings to mitigate oversquashing in GNNs, enriching node representations with cohesive structural information to capture long-range dependencies.

entry.title: TMTE: Effective Multimodal Graph Learning with Task-aware Modality and Topology Co-evolution

author.name: Yinlin Zhu, Xunkai Li, Di Wu, Wang Luo, Miao Hu, Di Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TMTE for multimodal graph learning that jointly and iteratively optimizes graph topology and multimodal representations in a task-aware manner, addressing topology quality limitations in real-world multimodal-attributed graphs.

entry.title: RG-TTA: Regime-Guided Meta-Control for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Time Series

author.name: Indar Kumar, Akanksha Tiwari, Sai Krishna Jasti, Ankit Hemant Lade

entry.summary: Proposes RG-TTA, a meta-controller for test-time adaptation in streaming time series that modulates adaptation intensity based on distributional similarity to known regimes using multiple statistical tests.

entry.title: FedDES: Graph-Based Dynamic Ensemble Selection for Personalized Federated Learning

author.name: Brianna Mueller, W. Nick Street

entry.summary: Proposes FedDES, a decentralized personalized federated learning framework using dynamic ensemble selection at the instance level, allowing each sample to be served by the most relevant peer models.

entry.title: Physics-Embedded Feature Learning for AI in Medical Imaging

author.name: Pulock Das, Al Amin, Kamrul Hasan, Rohan Thompson, Azubike D. Okpalaeze, Liang Hong

entry.summary: PhysNet integrates tumor growth dynamics (reaction-diffusion model) directly into intermediate CNN feature representations rather than only at the output, improving interpretability and clinical trust for medical imaging. This physics-embedded approach addresses the black-box limitation of standard deep learning in healthcare.

entry.title: FI-KAN: Fractal Interpolation Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan

entry.summary: FI-KAN introduces fractal interpolation function bases into Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, providing learnable fractal dimension that adapts to target regularity. Hybrid variant outperforms standard KAN on Hölder regularity benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning Partial Action Replacement in Offline MARL

author.name: Yue Jin, Giovanni Montana

entry.summary: PLCQL formulates Partial Action Replacement subset selection in offline MARL as a contextual bandit problem, learning state-dependent PAR policies via PPO with uncertainty-weighted rewards.

entry.title: LACE: Loss-Adaptive Capacity Expansion for Continual Learning

author.name: Shivnath Tathe

entry.summary: LACE expands model capacity during continual learning by monitoring loss signals to detect domain boundaries, adding new projection layer dimensions when sustained loss deviation indicates insufficient capacity.

entry.title: Evolutionary Warm-Starts for Reinforcement Learning in Industrial Continuous Control

author.name: Tom Maus, Stephan Frank, Tobias Glasmachers

entry.summary: Investigates using CMA-ES evolution strategies to generate demonstrations that warm-start RL agents for industrial continuous control tasks. Shows CMA-ES-guided initialization significantly improves stability and performance in a sorting benchmark.

entry.title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Staging Using Integrated RGB and Thermal Imaging

author.name: Gulengul Mermer, Mustafa Furkan Aksu, Gozde Ozsezer, Sevki Cetinkalp, Orhan Er, Mehmet Kemal Gullu

entry.summary: Develops a multimodal deep learning system for diabetic foot ulcer staging using both RGB and thermal imaging captured by a Raspberry Pi-based portable device. Evaluates on a 1,205-sample hospital dataset with six stages.

entry.title: Follow Your Heart: Landmark-Guided Transducer Pose Scoring for Point-of-Care Echocardiography

author.name: Zaiyang Guo, Jessie N. Dong, Filippos Bellos, Jilei Hao, Emily J. MacKay, Trevor Chan, Shir Goldfinger, Sethu Reddy, Steven Vance, Jason J. Corso, Alison M. Pouch

entry.summary: Presents a multi-task network for echocardiography that provides transducer pose scoring feedback for A4CH view acquisition and automatically estimates left ventricular ejection fraction, targeting novice users.

entry.title: CarbonEdge: Carbon-Aware Deep Learning Inference Framework for Sustainable Edge Computing

author.name: Guilin Zhang, Wulan Guo, Ziqi Tan, Hailong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces CarbonEdge, a carbon-aware deep learning inference framework for edge computing. Proposes carbon-aware scheduling that extends weighted scoring with a carbon efficiency metric.

entry.title: Energy Score-Guided Neural Gaussian Mixture Model for Predictive Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Yang Yang, Chunlin Ji, Haoyang Li, Ke Deng

entry.summary: Proposes NE-GMM, integrating Gaussian Mixture Models with Energy Score for predictive uncertainty quantification. Addresses training instability and mode collapse in standard parametric approaches.

entry.title: Generating Humanless Environment Walkthroughs from Egocentric Walking Tour Videos

author.name: Yujin Ham, Junho Kim, Vivek Boominathan, Guha Balakrishnan

entry.summary: Develops a generative algorithm to realistically remove humans and their shadows from egocentric walking tour videos, using semi-synthetic paired training data for environment modeling applications.

entry.title: CCDNet: Learning to Detect Camouflage against Distractors in Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Zikai Liao, Zhaozheng Yin

entry.summary: CCDNet proposes a camouflage-aware counter-distraction network for infrared small target detection, using weighted multi-branch perceptrons to handle low-contrast targets and false-alarm distractors.

entry.title: Emotion Diffusion Classifier with Adaptive Margin Discrepancy Training for Facial Expression Recognition

author.name: Rongkang Dong, Cuixin Yang, Cong Zhang, Yushen Zuo, Kin-Man Lam

entry.summary: Introduces Emotion Diffusion Classifier (EmoDC) for facial expression recognition using conditional generative diffusion models with adaptive margin discrepancy training for improved robustness.

entry.title: SkeletonContext: Skeleton-side Context Prompt Learning for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition

author.name: Ning Wang, Tieyue Wu, Naeha Sharif, Farid Boussaid, Guangming Zhu, Lin Mei, Mohammed Bennamoun, zhang liang

entry.summary: SkeletonContext enriches skeletal motion representations with language-driven contextual semantics via cross-modal context prompts for zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition.

entry.title: Compressive sensing inspired self-supervised single-pixel imaging

author.name: Jijun Lu, Yifan Chen, Libang Chen, Yiqiang Zhou, Ye Zheng, Mingliang Chen, Zhe Sun, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: SISTA-Net combines compressive sensing theory with self-supervised learning for single-pixel imaging, unfolding ISTA into a network with hybrid CNN-Visual State Space architecture.

entry.title: Multi-Feature Fusion Approach for Generative AI Images Detection

author.name: Abderrezzaq Sendjasni, Mohamed-Chaker Larabi

entry.summary: Evaluates a multi-feature fusion framework combining MSCN features, CLIP embeddings, and multiscale texture features for detecting AI-generated images across diverse generative models.

entry.title: Polyhedral Unmixing: Bridging Semantic Segmentation with Hyperspectral Unmixing via Polyhedral-Cone Partitioning

author.name: Antoine Bottenmuller (CMM, PSL, STIM), Etienne Decenci\`ere (CMM, PSL, STIM), Petr Dokl\'adal (CMM, PSL, STIM)

entry.summary: This paper formally connects semantic segmentation and hyperspectral unmixing by showing that pixel classification under the linear mixing model induces polyhedral-cone regions in spectral space, enabling a direct segmentation-to-unmixing pipeline.

entry.title: Large Neighborhood Search for Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Path Finding with Precedence Constraints

author.name: Viraj Parimi, Brian C. Williams

entry.summary: Proposes a Large Neighborhood Search approach for jointly optimizing task assignment, precedence constraints, and path finding for multi-robot systems, extending the MAPF-PC framework to handle the combined TAPF-PC problem.

entry.title: Passive iFIR filters for data-driven velocity control in robotics

author.name: Yi Zhang, Zixing Wang, Fulvio Forni

entry.summary: Presents a passive, data-driven velocity control method for robotic manipulators using VRFT-based iFIR controllers that achieve up to 74.5% tracking error reduction over PID using only 3 minutes of probing data while guaranteeing stability via passivity constraints.

entry.title: Penalized GMM Framework for Inference on Functionals of Nonparametric Instrumental Variable Estimators

author.name: Edvard Bakhitov

entry.summary: Develops a penalized GMM framework for automatic debiased inference on functionals of nonparametric instrumental variable estimators, achieving 90-96% coverage rates and applying to demand elasticity estimation.

entry.title: Your AI Travel agent would book you a bullfight: benchmarking implicit animal compassion in Agentic AI

author.name: Jasmine Brazilek

entry.summary: Introduces TAC (Travel Agent Compassion), a benchmark testing whether AI travel agents book animal exploitation activities (elephant trekking, bullfights) when humane alternatives exist. Every frontier model tested books the harmful option more often than not.

entry.title: On the Optimal Number of Grids for Differentially Private Non-Interactive $K$-Means Clustering

author.name: Gokularam Muthukrishnan, Anshoo Tandon

entry.summary: Proposes a refined grid-size selection rule for differentially private non-interactive K-means clustering, deriving the optimal grid number by minimizing quantization bias and noise trade-off, accounting for cluster count.

entry.title: CT-to-X-ray Distillation Under Tiny Paired Cohorts: An Evidence-Bounded Reproducible Pilot Study

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Weiqi Yan, Hongjiang Wei

entry.summary: Studies cross-modality teacher-student distillation from CT to X-ray for binary disease classification, investigating whether CT supervision at training time can improve X-ray classifiers without CT at inference.

entry.title: MAPLE: Multi-Path Adaptive Propagation with Level-Aware Embeddings for Hierarchical Multi-Label Image Classification

author.name: Boshko Koloski, Marjan Stoimchev, Jurica Levati\'c, Dragi Kocev, Sa\v{s}o D\v{z}eroski

entry.summary: MAPLE proposes a hierarchical multi-label classification framework for remote sensing with graph-based semantic initialization, GCN structure encoding, and adaptive multi-modal fusion for multi-path label hierarchies.

entry.title: SurgTEMP: Temporal-Aware Surgical Video Question Answering with Text-guided Visual Memory for Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy

author.name: Shi Li (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Vinkle Srivastav (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Nicolas Chanel (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Saurav Sharma (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Nabani Banik (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Lorenzo Arboit (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Kun Yuan (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France), Pietro Mascagni (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France, Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, Italy), Nicolas Padoy (University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, Strasbourg, France)

entry.summary: SurgTEMP is a multimodal LLM framework for surgical video question answering that incorporates temporal awareness and text-guided visual memory for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. It addresses limitations of static frame analysis in surgical VQA by handling scattered temporal windows and hierarchical assessment levels.

entry.title: Industrial-Grade Robust Robot Vision for Screw Detection and Removal under Uneven Conditions

author.name: Tomoki Ishikura, Genichiro Matsuda, Takuya Kiyokawa, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Proposes an automated screw detection and removal system for recycling air conditioner outdoor units, achieving 99.8% screw detection recall despite severe degradation and ±0.75mm manipulation accuracy, validated on 120 real units.

entry.title: Stable Walking for Bipedal Locomotion under Foot-Slip via Virtual Nonholonomic Constraints

author.name: Leonardo Colombo, \'Alvaro Rodr\'iguez Abella, Alexandre Anahory Simoes, Anthony Bloch

entry.summary: Proposes a control framework for bipedal walking under foot-slip by incorporating slip through virtual nonholonomic constraints, yielding a slip-compatible hybrid zero dynamics manifold for stable locomotion on low-friction terrain.

entry.title: Symmetrizing Bregman Divergence on the Cone of Positive Definite Matrices: Which Mean to Use and Why

author.name: Tushar Sial, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Uncovers variational principles behind symmetrizing Bregman divergences on positive definite matrices, proving that arithmetic mean in primal space is canonical for forward symmetrization for any mirror map, and characterizing reverse symmetrization for three common mirror maps.

entry.title: Monocular Building Height Estimation from PhiSat-2 Imagery: Dataset and Method

author.name: Yanjiao Song, Bowen Cai, Timo Balz, Zhenfeng Shao, Neema Simon Sumari, James Magidi, Walter Musakwa

entry.summary: Constructs a PhiSat-2 building height estimation dataset from 26 cities worldwide and proposes TSONet, a two-stream ordinal network for monocular building height estimation from satellite imagery.

entry.title: Interacting Multiple Model Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots

author.name: Wanlei Li, Zichang Chen, Shilei Li, Xiaogang Xiong, Yunjiang Lou

entry.summary: Proposes an interacting multiple model (IMM) approach for legged robot odometry that handles violations of the idealized point-contact assumption by maintaining multiple contact models simultaneously.

entry.title: An Interactive LLM-Based Simulator for Dementia-Related Activities of Daily Living

author.name: Kruthika Gangaraju, Shu-Fen Wung, Kevin Berner, Jing Wang, Fengpei Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces a web-based LLM simulator (using gpt-5-mini) that generates multi-turn, severity-conditioned patient behaviors for dementia care training, allowing caregivers to practice ADL assistance scenarios with realistic behavioral responses.

entry.title: "I Just Need GPT to Refine My Prompts": Rethinking Onboarding and Help-Seeking with Generative 3D Modeling Tools

author.name: Kanak Gautam, Poorvi Bhatia, Parmit K. Chilana

entry.summary: Observational study with 26 participants examining how people approach prompt-based generative AI tools for 3D modeling. Finds the prompt box becomes the primary entry point for learning, collapsing traditional onboarding.

entry.title: Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification

author.name: Guan Wang, Shuyin Xia, Lei Qian, Guoyin Wang, Yi Liu, Yi Wang, Wei Wang
