entry.summary: Proposes a granular-ball based graph coarsening method for scalable GCN training on large graphs, using multi-granularity information in graph structure.

entry.title: MELT: Improve Composed Image Retrieval via the Modification Frequentation-Rarity Balance Network

author.name: Guozhi Qiu, Zhiwei Chen, Zixu Li, Qinlei Huang, Zhiheng Fu, Xuemeng Song, Yupeng Hu

entry.summary: MELT addresses frequency bias in composed image retrieval by balancing attention between frequent and rare modification semantics and improving similarity estimation under hard negatives.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Anomaly Detection in Spacecraft Telemetry on Edge Devices

author.name: Christopher Goetze, Tim Schlippe, Daniel Lakey

entry.summary: Investigates spacecraft telemetry anomaly detection approaches optimized for edge deployment. Through Pareto-optimal architecture optimization, dramatically reduces computational requirements while maintaining detection performance.

entry.title: Mean Masked Autoencoder with Flow-Mixing for Encrypted Traffic Classification

author.name: Xiao Liu, Xiaowei Fu, Fuxiang Huang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Mean MAE (MMAE), a teacher-student masked autoencoder with flow mixing strategy for encrypted traffic classification. Uses self-distillation to advance from byte-level reconstruction to multi-granularity comprehension of network traffic.

entry.title: 6GAgentGym: Tool Use, Data Synthesis, and Agentic Learning for Network Management

author.name: Jiao Chen, Jianhua Tang, Xiaotong Yang, Zuohong Lv

entry.summary: Presents 6GAgentGym, an interactive environment with 42 tools for training autonomous 6G network management agents through closed-loop interaction, calibrated on NS-3 simulation data.

entry.title: Hybrid Framework for Robotic Manipulation: Integrating Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models

author.name: Md Saad, Sajjad Hussain, Mohd Suhaib

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid framework combining RL for low-level robotic control with LLMs for high-level task planning. Shows 33.5% decrease in task completion time on Franka Emika Panda arm in PyBullet simulation.

entry.title: Boundary-aware Prototype-driven Adversarial Alignment for Cross-Corpus EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Guangli Li, Canbiao Wu, Na Tian, Li Zhang, Zhen Liang

entry.summary: Proposes Prototype-driven Adversarial Alignment (PAA) framework for cross-corpus EEG emotion recognition, addressing class-conditional mismatch and decision boundary distortion in domain transfer.

entry.title: PiCSRL: Physics-Informed Contextual Spectral Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mitra Nasr Azadani, Syed Usama Imtiaz, Nasrin Alamdari

entry.summary: Presents PiCSRL, combining physics-informed features with contextual spectral reinforcement learning for adaptive environmental sensing in high-dimensional, low-sample-size settings.

entry.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Localized Wildfire Spread Based on Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Bryan Shaddy, Haitong Qin, Brianna Binder, James Haley, Riya Duddalwar, Kyle Hilburn, Assad Oberai

entry.summary: Develops a probabilistic wildfire spread prediction model using conditional flow matching, treating fire progression as a stochastic process conditioned on environmental inputs. Trained on coupled atmosphere-wildfire simulations.

entry.title: Match or Replay: Self Imitating Proximal Policy Optimization

author.name: Gaurav Chaudhary, Laxmidhar Behera, Washim Uddin Mondal

entry.summary: Proposes a self-imitating PPO variant that uses optimal transport distance to guide exploration by matching state visitation distributions to successful trajectories, with separate strategies for dense and sparse rewards.

entry.title: Prototype-Aligned Federated Soft-Prompts for Continual Web Personalization

author.name: Canran Xiao, Liwei Hou

entry.summary: Proposes ProtoFed-SP, a privacy-preserving web personalization framework using dual-timescale soft prompts (fast session-level, slow long-term) with differentially private federated aggregation of prototypes.

entry.title: What-If Explanations Over Time: Counterfactuals for Time Series Classification

author.name: Udo Schlegel, Thomas Seidl

entry.summary: Surveys counterfactual explanation methods for time series classification, covering nearest-neighbor, pattern-driven, gradient-based, and generative approaches, highlighting unique temporal challenges.

entry.title: Diffusion Maps is not Dimensionality Reduction

author.name: Julio Candanedo, Alejandro Pati\~no

entry.summary: Clarifies that diffusion maps provide spectral representations of intrinsic geometry rather than dimensionality reduction, comparing with Isomap and UMAP on Swiss roll to show DMAP needs many modes to recover the chart.

entry.title: Koopman-based surrogate modeling for reinforcement-learning-control of Rayleigh-Benard convection

author.name: Tim Plotzki, Sebastian Peitz

entry.summary: Investigates using Linear Recurrent Autoencoder Networks (LRANs) as surrogate models to accelerate RL-based control of Rayleigh-Bénard convection, addressing distribution shift challenges when policies induce unseen states. Compares static vs. iteratively refined surrogate training strategies.

entry.title: Graph Vector Field: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Health Risk Assessment from Heterogeneous Wearable and Environmental Data Streams

author.name: Silvano Coletti, Francesca Fallucchi

entry.summary: Graph Vector Field (GVF) models health risk as a vector-valued field on time-varying simplicial complexes, coupling discrete differential geometry with mixture-of-experts for multimodal wearable/environmental health data. Uses Hodge-Helmholtz decomposition for risk decomposition.

entry.title: OptINC: Optical In-Network-Computing for Scalable Distributed Learning

author.name: Sijie Fei, Grace Li Zhang, Bing Li, Ulf Schlichtmann

entry.summary: OptINC proposes optical in-network computing architecture for distributed learning, using Mach-Zehnder interferometers in optical interconnects to perform gradient averaging and quantization in the optical domain.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Predicting Hydrogen Sorption in Geological Formations: Thermodynamically Constrained Deep Learning Integrating Classical Adsorption Theory

author.name: Mohammad Nooraiepour, Mohammad Masoudi, Zezhang Song, Helge Hellevang

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed neural network for predicting hydrogen sorption in geological materials, embedding classical adsorption theory and thermodynamic constraints. Dramatically improves generalization from single-sample R² of 0.80-0.90 to multi-sample datasets.

entry.title: Key-Embedded Privacy for Decentralized AI in Biomedical Omics

author.name: Rongyu Zhang, Hongyu Dong, Gaole Dai, Ziqi Qiao, Shenli Zheng, Yuan Zhang, Aosong Cheng, Xiaowei Chi, Jincai Luo, Pin Li, Li Du, Dan Wang, Yuan Du, Xudong Xing, Jianxu Chen, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: INFL is a lightweight federated learning method for biomedical omics using Implicit Neural Representations with embedded secret keys for privacy, supporting plug-and-play coordinate-conditioned modules.

entry.title: EMPD: An Event-based Multimodal Physiological Dataset for Remote Pulse Wave Detection

author.name: Qian Feng, Pengfei Li, Rongshan Gao, Jiale Xu, Rui Gong, Yidi Li

entry.summary: EMPD is the first benchmark dataset for non-contact physiological sensing via event cameras, using laser-assisted acquisition to detect pulse waves from skin vibrations with neuromorphic sensors.

entry.title: From Diffusion To Flow: Efficient Motion Generation In MotionGPT3

author.name: Jaymin Ban, JiHong Jeon, SangYeop Jeong

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled empirical study comparing diffusion and rectified flow objectives within the MotionGPT3 framework for text-driven motion generation. Tests whether advantages of rectified flow seen in image/audio transfer to motion.

entry.title: Neural Approximation of Generalized Voronoi Diagrams

author.name: Panagiotis Rigas, George Ioannakis, Ioannis Emiris

entry.summary: Introduces VoroFields, a hierarchical neural-field framework for approximating generalized Voronoi diagrams under arbitrary point-to-site distances. Uses continuous differentiable surrogate fields with hierarchical decomposition.

entry.title: On-Device Super Resolution Imaging Using Low-Cost SPAD Array and Embedded Lightweight Deep Learning

author.name: Zhenya Zang, Xingda Li, David Day Uei Li

entry.summary: Presents LiteSR, a lightweight super-resolution neural network for consumer-grade SPAD arrays with 48x32 resolution, reconstructing 256x256 images. Deployed on Arduino microcontroller for on-device inference.

entry.title: PeopleSearchBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating AI-Powered People Search Platforms

author.name: Wei Wang, Tianyu Shi, Shuai Zhang, Boyang Xia, Zequn Xie, Chenyu Zeng, Qi Zhang, Lynn Ai, Yaqi Yu, Kaiming Zhang, Feiyue Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PeopleSearchBench, an open-source benchmark comparing AI-powered people search platforms across 119 queries with Criteria-Grounded Verification using live web search for factual relevance.

entry.title: Data is All You Need: Markov Chain Car-Following (MC-CF) Model

author.name: Sungyong Chung, Yanlin Zhang, Nachuan Li, Dana Monzer, Alireza Talebpour

entry.summary: Introduces Markov Chain Car-Following model representing state transitions as a Markov process with empirical acceleration distributions. Outperforms physics-based models on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset.

entry.title: Enhancing Box and Block Test with Computer Vision for Post-Stroke Upper Extremity Motor Evaluation

author.name: David Robinson, Animesh Gupta, Elizabeth Clark, Olga Melnik, Qiushi Fu, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Presents a computer vision framework for analyzing upper-extremity movement during the Box and Block Test for post-stroke motor evaluation, using joint angles without depth sensors.

entry.title: Multimodal Models Meet Presentation Attack Detection on ID Documents

author.name: Marina Villanueva, Juan M. Espin, Juan E. Tapia

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal models (Paligemma, Llava, Qwen) for presentation attack detection on ID documents, finding that current models struggle with this task despite combining visual and textual modalities.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Federated Learning under Data Heterogeneity for Label-Scarce Diatom Classification

author.name: Mingkun Tan, Xilu Wang, Michael Kloster, Tim W. Nattkemper

entry.summary: Investigates self-supervised federated learning for diatom classification under stage-specific data heterogeneity, studying how different heterogeneity patterns in pre-training vs fine-tuning affect performance.

entry.title: NeuroBRIDGE: Behavior-Conditioned Koopman Dynamics with Riemannian Alignment for Early Substance Use Initiation Prediction from Longitudinal Functional Connectome

author.name: Badhan Mazumder, Sir-Lord Wiafe, Vince D. Calhoun, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: NeuroBRIDGE is a graph neural network framework that models longitudinal changes in brain functional connectivity using Riemannian geometry and Koopman dynamics to predict adolescent substance use initiation. It captures temporal brain network evolution conditioned on behavioral data and was evaluated on the ABCD dataset.

entry.title: STRADAViT: Towards a Foundational Model for Radio Astronomy through Self-Supervised Transfer

author.name: Andrea DeMarco, Ian Fenech Conti, Hayley Camilleri, Ardiana Bushi, Simone Riggi

entry.summary: STRADAViT is a self-supervised Vision Transformer framework for radio astronomy that uses continued pretraining on multi-survey radio data (MeerKAT, ASKAP, LOFAR, SKA) with radio-astronomy-aware augmentations for transferable image encoders.

entry.title: Bootstrap Perception Under Hardware Depth Failure for Indoor Robot Navigation

author.name: Nishant Pushparaju, Vivek Mattam, Aliasghar Arab

entry.summary: Presents a bootstrap perception system for indoor robots that handles depth sensor failure (78% pixel loss on reflective surfaces) by using surviving valid pixels to calibrate monocular depth estimation, creating a failure-aware sensing hierarchy.

entry.title: SuperGrasp: Single-View Object Grasping via Superquadric Similarity Matching, Evaluation, and Refinement

author.name: Lijingze Xiao, Jinhong Du, Yang Cong, Supeng Diao, Yu Ren

entry.summary: SuperGrasp is a two-stage framework for single-view robotic grasping that first generates grasp candidates via superquadric similarity matching, then evaluates and refines them using a learned evaluation-refinement network.

entry.title: Koopman Operator Framework for Modeling and Control of Off-Road Vehicle on Deformable Terrain

author.name: Kartik Loya, Phanindra Tallapragada

entry.summary: Develops a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven framework using Koopman operator methods to create linear representations of complex terramechanics for predictive control of off-road vehicles on deformable terrain.

entry.title: mlr3mbo: Bayesian Optimization in R

author.name: Marc Becker, Lennart Schneider, Martin Binder, Lars Kotthoff, Bernd Bischl

entry.summary: mlr3mbo is a comprehensive R toolbox for Bayesian optimization supporting single/multi-objective optimization, parallelization, and custom algorithm construction, with extensive empirical evaluation on the YAHPO Gym benchmark suite.

entry.title: Monday AI Radar #19

author.name: Against Moloch

entry.summary: Weekly AI safety and capabilities news roundup covering Boaz Barak's state-of-AI-safety assessment, Claude Code updates, and broader observations about the gap between lab preparedness and government readiness for AI risks.

entry.title: EarthEmbeddingExplorer: A Web Application for Cross-Modal Retrieval of Global Satellite Images

author.name: Yijie Zheng, Weijie Wu, Bingyue Wu, Long Zhao, Guoqing Li, Mikolaj Czerkawski, Konstantin Klemmer

entry.summary: EarthEmbeddingExplorer is a web application enabling cross-modal retrieval (text, visual, geolocation) of global satellite images using precomputed Earth embeddings, democratizing access to Earth observation foundation models.

entry.title: Reconfiguration of supernumerary robotic limbs for human augmentation

author.name: Mustafa Mete, Anastasia Bolotnikova, Alexander Schuessler, Jamie Paik

entry.summary: Introduces a reconfigurable supernumerary robotic limb (SRL) framework with quantitative analysis of human augmentation ratios, evaluating how SRL configuration shapes workspace extension and human-robot collaboration potential.

entry.title: iPoster: Content-Aware Layout Generation for Interactive Poster Design via Graph-Enhanced Diffusion Models

author.name: Xudong Zhou, Jinyuan Liang, Qiuyi Guo, Guozheng Li

entry.summary: iPoster enables interactive poster layout generation with user-specified constraints using a graph-enhanced diffusion architecture with masking strategies for constraint preservation.

entry.title: Multimodal Forecasting for Commodity Prices Using Spectrogram-Based and Time Series Representations

author.name: Soyeon Park, Doohee Chung, Charmgil Hong

entry.summary: Presents SEMF, combining wavelet spectrograms processed by Vision Transformers with temporal encoding of exogenous variables via cross-attention for commodity price forecasting.

entry.title: Taming the Instability: A Robust Second-Order Optimizer for Federated Learning over Non-IID Data

author.name: Yuanqiao Zhang, Tiantian He, Yuan Gao, Yixin Wang, Yew-Soon Ong, Maoguo Gong, A. K. Qin, Hui Li

entry.summary: FedRCO proposes a second-order optimization framework for federated learning with gradient anomaly monitoring, fail-safe resilience protocols, and approximate curvature optimization for non-IID data.

entry.title: Label-efficient Training Updates for Malware Detection over Time

author.name: Luca Minnei, Cristian Manca, Giorgio Piras, Angelo Sotgiu, Maura Pintor, Daniele Ghiani, Davide Maiorca, Giorgio Giacinto, Battista Biggio

entry.summary: Proposes a label-efficient framework for updating malware detectors over time by systematically evaluating active learning and semi-supervised learning strategies to handle distribution drift with reduced labeling costs.

entry.title: Multiverse: Language-Conditioned Multi-Game Level Blending via Shared Representation

author.name: In-Chang Baek, Jiyun Jung, Geum-Hwan Hwang, Sung-Hyun Kim, Kyung-Joong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Multiverse, a language-conditioned multi-game level generator that enables cross-game level blending through textual specifications. Uses shared latent space with threshold-based multi-positive contrastive supervision.

entry.title: Beyond Freshness and Semantics: A Coupon-Collector Framework for Effective Status Updates

author.name: Youssef Ahmed, Arnob Ghosh, Chih-Chun Wang, Ness B. Shroff

entry.summary: Addresses status update scheduling over unreliable channels using a coupon-collector framework with expiring coupons. Proves optimal schedule is doubly thresholded and designs Structure-Aware Q-learning.

entry.title: Pan-Cancer Mapping of the Tumor Immune Landscape through Metagene Clustering and Predictive Modeling

author.name: Soham Chatterjee

entry.summary: Uses metagene clustering and predictive modeling to map the tumor immune landscape across pan-cancer types. Identifies novel immune-related gene clusters and evaluates their prognostic significance.

entry.title: Dual-Imbalance Continual Learning for Real-World Food Recognition

author.name: Xiaoyan Zhang, Jiangpeng He

entry.summary: Addresses dual imbalance in continual food recognition: long-tailed class distributions within tasks and varying numbers of new categories across incremental steps.

entry.title: Transmittance-Guided Structure-Texture Decomposition for Nighttime Image Dehazing

author.name: Francesco Moretti, Giulia Bianchi, Andrea Gallo

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage nighttime image dehazing framework integrating transmittance correction with structure-texture layered optimization to jointly address glow, low visibility, and color distortion.

entry.title: Associative Constructive Evolution: Enhancing Metaheuristics through Hebbian-Learned Generative Guidance

author.name: Shanxian Lin, Yuichi Nagata, Haichuan Yang

entry.summary: ACE proposes a framework that enhances metaheuristic algorithms (PSO, EA) by coupling them with a learned generative construction automaton using Hebbian learning to accumulate and reuse procedural knowledge from successful search trajectories.

entry.title: Communication Outage-Resistant UUV State Estimation: A Variational History Distillation Approach

author.name: Shuyue Li, Miguel L\'opez-Ben\'itez, Eng Gee Lim, Fei Ma, Qian Dong, Mengze Cao, Limin Yu, Xiaohui Qin

entry.summary: Proposes Variational History Distillation (VHD) for maintaining underwater vehicle state estimation accuracy during communication outages, treating trajectory prediction as approximate Bayesian reasoning to handle unmodeled ocean currents.

entry.title: HapCompass: A Rotational Haptic Device for Contact-Rich Robotic Teleoperation

author.name: Xiangshan Tan, Jingtian Ji, Tianchong Jiang, Pedro Lopes, Matthew R. Walter

entry.summary: HapCompass is a low-cost wearable haptic device that renders 2D directional force cues by mechanically rotating a single vibration motor, improving teleoperation success rates for contact-rich manipulation tasks.

entry.title: Multi-fidelity approaches for general constrained Bayesian optimization with application to aircraft design

author.name: Oihan Cordelier, Youssef Diouane, Nathalie Bartoli, Eric Laurendeau

entry.summary: Proposes novel multi-fidelity selection strategies for constrained Bayesian optimization in aircraft design, considering constraints alongside the objective when deciding how to integrate multiple simulation fidelity levels.

entry.title: Evaluating a Data-Driven Redesign Process for Intelligent Tutoring Systems

author.name: Qianru Lyu, Conrad Borchers, Meng Xia, Karen Xiao, Paulo F. Carvalho, Kenneth R. Koedinger, Vincent Aleven

entry.summary: Tests a data-driven redesign process for intelligent tutoring systems on four math units with 123 students. While learning gains didn't differ, redesigned tutors showed more productive time-on-task, more skills practiced, and greater efficiency.

entry.title: Agenda-based Narrative Extraction: Steering Pathfinding Algorithms with Large Language Models

author.name: Brian Felipe Keith-Norambuena, Carolina In\'es Rojas-C\'ordova, Claudio Juvenal Meneses-Villegas, Elizabeth Johanna Lam-Esquenazi, Ang\'elica Mar\'ia Flores-Bustos, Ignacio Alejandro Molina-Villablanca, Joshua Emanuel Leyton-Vallejos

entry.summary: Introduces agenda-based narrative extraction that uses LLMs to steer pathfinding algorithms toward user-specified perspectives during storyline construction from document collections.

entry.title: Performance Evaluation of LLMs in Automated RDF Knowledge Graph Generation

author.name: Ioana Ramona Martin, Tudor Cioara, Ionut Anghel, Gabriel Arcas

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs for automated RDF knowledge graph generation from cloud system logs. Compares multiple architectures and prompting strategies for RDF extraction.

entry.title: Scalable Maximum Entropy Population Synthesis via Persistent Contrastive Divergence

author.name: Mirko Degli Esposti

entry.summary: Proposes GibbsPCDSolver for scalable maximum entropy population synthesis using Persistent Contrastive Divergence, enabling synthetic population generation from census data with more than 20 categorical attributes.

entry.title: Principal Prototype Analysis on Manifold for Interpretable Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bodla Krishna Vamshi, Haizhao Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Principal Prototype Analysis on manifolds for interpretable RL, extending Prototype-Wrapper Networks with manifold-aware prototypes to maintain interpretability-performance balance.

entry.title: NeiGAD: Augmenting Graph Anomaly Detection via Spectral Neighbor Information

author.name: Qing Qing, Huafei Huang, Mingliang Hou, Renqiang Luo, Mohsen Guizani

entry.summary: NeiGAD captures neighbor information through spectral graph analysis for graph anomaly detection, providing a plug-and-play module that uses adjacency matrix eigenvectors to encode local neighbor interactions.

entry.title: TDEC: Deep Embedded Image Clustering with Transformer and Distribution Information

author.name: Ruilin Zhang, Haiyang Zheng, Hongpeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TDEC, a deep embedded image clustering method combining transformers with distribution information for improved feature learning. Claims first joint consideration of global perception through transformers and distribution-aware clustering.

entry.title: Parameter Estimation in Stochastic Differential Equations via Wiener Chaos Expansion and Stochastic Gradient Descent

author.name: Francisco Delgado-Vences, Jos\'e Juli\'an Pav\'on-Espa\~nol, Arelly Ornelas

entry.summary: Addresses inverse parameter estimation for SDEs by combining Wiener Chaos Expansion with Stochastic Gradient Descent, reducing stochastic inference to deterministic optimization.

entry.title: Bayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data

author.name: Amuche Ibenegbu, Pierre Lafaye de Micheaux, Rohitash Chandra

entry.summary: Extends MICE imputation to a Bayesian framework (Bayes-MICE) using MCMC sampling for time series data, incorporating temporally informed initialization and time-lagged features.

entry.title: SurgNavAR: An Augmented Reality Surgical Navigation Framework for Optical See-Through Head Mounted Displays

author.name: Abdullah Thabit, Mohamed Benmahdjoub, Rafiuddin Jinabade, Hizirwan S. Salim, Marie-Lise C. van Veelen, Mark G. van Vledder, Eppo B. Wolvius, Theo van Walsum

entry.summary: SurgNavAR presents an integrated augmented reality surgical navigation framework for optical see-through head-mounted displays, handling patient localization, instrument tracking, preoperative data alignment, and real-time visualization. Aims to lower barriers for AR surgical navigation research.

entry.title: Learning Semantic Priorities for Autonomous Target Search

author.name: Max Lodel, Nils Wilde, Robert Babu\v{s}ka, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.title: Research Summary: March 31, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by fundamental impossibility results in AI safety and alignment, alongside practical advances in efficiency and open pretraining.

  • Next-Token Prediction and Regret Minimization establishes rigorous theoretical links between the LLM training paradigm and online decision-making under adversarial conditions
  • daVinci-LLM addresses a critical reproducibility gap by releasing a fully open pretraining pipeline at industrial scale, including data, code, and intermediate checkpoints
  • Information-Theoretic Limits of Safety Verification and Reward Hacking as Equilibrium both prove structural impossibility results — the former for verifying self-improving systems, the latter showing reward hacking is an unavoidable equilibrium under minimal axioms
  • UK AISI's reproduction of Anthropic's Emergent Misalignment finding using open-source models strengthens evidence that reward hacking can produce misaligned behaviors in non-production RL settings

On the practical side, HISA delivers up to an order-of-magnitude speedup for DeepSeek-style sparse attention in long-context inference. SARL removes the dependence on verifiable rewards in RLVR by rewarding reasoning topology directly. The Price of Meaning proves that interference and forgetting are geometric inevitabilities in any semantic memory system. FormalProofBench reveals frontier models achieve only ~33.5% on graduate-level Lean 4 proofs, while MazeBench shows high maze-solving accuracy in GPT-5.4 stems from text-based BFS conversion rather than genuine visual planning.

entry.title: Next-Token Prediction and Regret Minimization

entry.summary: Studies when next-token prediction models trained on a distribution can yield low adversarial regret in online decision-making. Shows that with unbounded context, any distribution is exponentially close to a low-regret distribution, but bounded context introduces fundamental limitations.

entry.title: daVinci-LLM:Towards the Science of Pretraining

author.name: Yiwei Qin, Yixiu Liu, Tiantian Mi, Muhang Xie, Zhen Huang, Weiye Si, Pengrui Lu, Siyuan Feng, Xia Wu, Liming Liu, Ye Luo, Jinlong Hou, Qipeng Guo, Yu Qiao, Pengfei Liu

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Safety Verification for Self-Improving Systems

author.name: Arsenios Scrivens

entry.title: Reward Hacking as Equilibrium under Finite Evaluation

entry.summary: Proves that semantic memory systems inherently face interference, forgetting, and false recall as a mathematical consequence of the geometric structure enabling semantic generalization. author.name: Ming Liu, Yunbei Zhang, Shilong Liu, Liwen Wang, Wensheng Zhang

entry.summary: Wan-R1 applies reinforcement learning with verifiable reward functions to video generation models for spatial reasoning tasks like maze-solving. Shows multimodal reward models fail catastrophically, motivating task-grounded reward design.

entry.title: $AutoDrive\text{-}P^3$: Unified Chain of Perception-Prediction-Planning Thought via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yuqi Ye, Zijian Zhang, Junhong Lin, Shangkun Sun, Changhao Peng, Wei Gao

entry.summary: AutoDrive-P3 uses reinforcement fine-tuning to create a unified chain-of-thought framework for autonomous driving that integrates perception, prediction, and planning in VLMs, rather than treating them as separate modules.

entry.title: Beyond Completion: Probing Cumulative State Tracking to Predict LLM Agent Performance

author.name: Dengzhe Hou, Lingyu Jiang, Deng Li, Zirui Li, Fangzhou Lin, Kazunori D Yamada

entry.summary: Introduces Working Memory Fidelity-Active Manipulation (WMF-AM), a probe for cumulative arithmetic state tracking in LLMs, and shows it predicts agent performance (Kendall's tau = 0.612) beyond simple task-completion rates. Evaluated on 20 open-weight models.

entry.title: TianJi:An autonomous AI meteorologist for discovering physical mechanisms in atmospheric science

author.name: Kaikai Zhang, Xiang Wang, Haoluo Zhao, Nan Chen, Mengyang Yu Jing-Jia Luo, Tao Song, Fan Meng

entry.summary: Introduces TianJi, an 'AI meteorologist' system that autonomously drives complex numerical models to verify physical mechanisms in atmospheric science. Uses LLM-driven multi-agent architecture for literature research and experiment design.

entry.title: Reasoning as Energy Minimization over Structured Latent Trajectories

author.name: David K. Johansson

entry.summary: Proposes Energy-Based Reasoning via Structured Latent Planning (EBRM), modeling reasoning as gradient-based optimization of multi-step latent trajectories under a learned energy function. Decomposes energy into per-step compatibility, transition consistency, and trajectory smoothness.

entry.title: COvolve: Adversarial Co-Evolution of Large-Language-Model-Generated Policies and Environments via Two-Player Zero-Sum Game

author.name: Alkis Sygkounas, Rishi Hazra, Andreas Persson, Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires, Amy Loutfi

entry.summary: Introduces COvolve, a co-evolutionary framework where LLMs generate both environments and agent policies as executable code in a two-player zero-sum game. Environments expose policy weaknesses while policies adapt, creating an automated curriculum.

entry.title: Strategic Candidacy in Generative AI Arenas

author.name: Chris Hays, Rachel Li, Bailey Flanigan, Manish Raghavan

entry.summary: Analyzes strategic manipulation in AI evaluation arenas (like Chatbot Arena) where model producers can submit multiple variants to artificially boost rankings. Establishes theoretical and empirical conditions under which such gaming is beneficial and proposes countermeasures.

entry.title: SafetyDrift: Predicting When AI Agents Cross the Line Before They Actually Do

author.name: Aditya Dhodapkar, Farhaan Pishori

entry.summary: Introduces SafetyDrift, a framework modeling AI agent safety trajectories as absorbing Markov chains to predict when sequences of individually safe actions will compound into safety violations. Key insight: all agents eventually violate safety if unsupervised.

entry.title: A Multi-agent AI System for Deep Learning Model Migration from TensorFlow to JAX

author.name: Stoyan Nikolov, Bernhard Konrad, Moritz Gronbach, Niket Kumar, Ann Yan, Varun Singh, Yaning Liang, Parthasarathy Ranganathan

entry.summary: Describes a multi-agent AI system from Google for automatically migrating deep learning models from TensorFlow to JAX, using an AI planner combining static analysis with AI instructions for complex code components.

entry.title: Conditional Factuality Controlled LLMs with Generalization Certificates via Conformal Sampling

author.name: Kai Ye, Qingtao Pan, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes Conditional Factuality Control (CFC), a post-hoc conformal framework for LLMs providing conditional (not just marginal) coverage guarantees for hallucination control, with set-valued outputs and feature-conditional thresholds.

entry.title: RAD-LAD: Rule and Language Grounded Autonomous Driving in Real-Time

author.name: Anurag Ghosh, Srinivasa Narasimhan, Manmohan Chandraker, Francesco Pittaluga

entry.summary: Presents RAD-LAD, combining a rule-based planner (RAD) and a language-action planner (LAD) for autonomous driving. LAD runs at ~20Hz for motion planning, achieving ~3x lower latency than prior driving language models while setting new SOTA on nuPlan benchmarks.

entry.title: Geometry-aware similarity metrics for neural representations on Riemannian and statistical manifolds

author.name: N Alex Cayco Gajic, Arthur Pellegrino

entry.summary: Introduces Metric Similarity Analysis (MSA), a method using Riemannian geometry to compare the intrinsic geometry of neural representations under the manifold hypothesis, capturing distinctions that extrinsic similarity measures miss.

entry.title: Live Interactive Training for Video Segmentation

author.name: Xinyu Yang, Haozheng Yu, Yihong Sun, Bharath Hariharan, Jennifer J. Sun

entry.summary: Introduces LIT (Live Interactive Training), a framework where video segmentation models like SAM2 learn online from user corrections via continual LoRA updates at inference time, reducing repetitive user effort.

entry.title: MOOZY: A Patient-First Foundation Model for Computational Pathology

author.name: Yousef Kotp, Vincent Quoc-Huy Trinh, Christopher Pal, Mahdi S. Hosseini

entry.summary: Presents MOOZY, a patient-first foundation model for computational pathology that models dependencies across all slides from the same patient via a case transformer, combining multi-stage self-supervision on 77K+ public slides.

entry.title: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3

author.name: Claudia Cuttano, Gabriele Trivigno, Christoph Reich, Daniel Cremers, Carlo Masone, Stefan Roth

entry.summary: INSID3 demonstrates that DINOv3's scaled-up dense self-supervised features are sufficient for in-context segmentation without any training or auxiliary models, achieving competitive results with a minimalist single-backbone approach.

entry.title: StreamingVLA: Streaming Vision-Language-Action Model with Action Flow Matching and Adaptive Early Observation

author.name: Yiran Shi, Dongqi Guo, Tianchen Zhao, Feng Gao, Liangzhi Shi, Chao Yu, ZhiJian Mo, Qihua Xiao, XiaoShuai Peng, Qingmin Liao, Yu Wang

entry.summary: StreamingVLA enables asynchronous parallel execution across VLA stages (observation, action generation, execution) in a streaming manner, addressing the high latency from sequential stage execution in current VLA models.

entry.title: Why Cognitive Robotics Matters: Lessons from OntoAgent and LLM Deployment in HARMONIC for Safety-Critical Robot Teaming

author.name: Sanjay Oruganti, Sergei Nirenburg, Marjorie McShane, Jesse English, Michael Roberts, Christian Arndt, Ramviyas Parasuraman, Luis Sentis

entry.summary: HARMONIC pairs OntoAgent cognitive architecture with a reactive tactical layer for safety-critical robot teaming, and functionally evaluates whether LLMs can replicate OntoAgent's cognitive capabilities under identical conditions, finding significant gaps.

entry.title: MemGuard-Alpha: Detecting and Filtering Memorization-Contaminated Signals in LLM-Based Financial Forecasting via Membership Inference and Cross-Model Disagreement

author.name: Anisha Roy, Dip Roy

entry.summary: Introduces MemGuard-Alpha, a post-generation framework to detect and filter memorization-contaminated signals in LLM-based financial forecasting, combining membership inference with cross-model disagreement scoring.

entry.title: Structural Graph Probing of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haoyu He, Yue Zhuo, Yu Zheng, Qi R. Wang

entry.summary: Studies VLMs through neural topology by representing layers as correlation graphs from neuron co-activations. Shows cross-modal structure consolidates around hub neurons whose removal causally degrades performance, revealing population-level organization.

entry.title: Transparency as Architecture: Structural Compliance Gaps in EU AI Act Article 50 II

author.name: Vera Schmitt, Niklas Kruse, Premtim Sahitaj, Julius Sch\"oning

entry.summary: Analyzes structural compliance gaps in EU AI Act Article 50 II regarding transparency requirements for AI-generated content. Demonstrates that compliance cannot be reduced to post-hoc labeling using synthetic data generation and fact-checking as case studies.

entry.title: CounterMoral: Editing Morals in Language Models

author.name: Michael Ripa, Jim Davies

entry.summary: Introduces CounterMoral, a benchmark dataset for evaluating how well model editing techniques can modify moral judgments across diverse ethical frameworks in language models. Tests various editing techniques on multiple models.

entry.title: Let the Agent Steer: Closed-Loop Ranking Optimization via Influence Exchange

author.name: Yin Cheng, Liao Zhou, Xiyu Liang, Dihao Luo, Tewei Lee, Kailun Zheng, Weiwei Zhang, Mingchen Cai, Jian Dong, Andy Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Sortify, a fully autonomous LLM-driven ranking optimization agent deployed in large-scale production recommendation systems. Reframes ranking as continuous influence exchange, closing the loop from diagnosis to parameter deployment without human intervention.

entry.title: CARV: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Yongkang Du, Xiaohan Zou, Minhao Cheng, Lu Lin

entry.summary: Introduces CARV, a benchmark for compositional analogical reasoning in vision with 5,500 samples requiring models to extract rules from multiple image pairs and compose new transformations. Even Gemini-2.5 Pro achieves limited performance.

entry.title: CoT2-Meta: Budgeted Metacognitive Control for Test-Time Reasoning

author.name: Siyuan Ma, Bo Gao, Zikai Xiao, Hailong Wang, Xinlei Yu, Rui Qian, Jiayu Qian, Luqi Gong, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CoT2-Meta, a training-free metacognitive reasoning framework that adds meta-level control over chain-of-thought generation with expansion, pruning, repair, stopping, and fallback decisions. Combines tree-structured search with an online process oracle under matched inference budgets.

entry.title: CoE: Collaborative Entropy for Uncertainty Quantification in Agentic Multi-LLM Systems

author.name: Kangkang Sun, Jun Wu, Jianhua Li, Minyi Guo, Xiuzhen Che, Jianwei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Collaborative Entropy (CoE), an information-theoretic metric for semantic uncertainty in multi-LLM systems that combines intra-model semantic entropy with inter-model divergence. Addresses the gap of single-model-centric uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: MiroEval: Benchmarking Multimodal Deep Research Agents in Process and Outcome

author.name: Fangda Ye, Yuxin Hu, Pengxiang Zhu, Yibo Li, Ziqi Jin, Yao Xiao, Yibo Wang, Lei Wang, Zhen Zhang, Lu Wang, Yue Deng, Bin Wang, Yifan Zhang, Liangcai Su, Xinyu Wang, He Zhao, Chen Wei, Qiang Ren, Bryan Hooi, An Bo, Shuicheng Yan, Lidong Bing

entry.summary: Introduces MiroEval, a benchmark for evaluating deep research systems with 100 tasks (70 text, 30 multimodal) that assesses both process and outcome, supports periodic updates, and uses a dual-path pipeline for task construction.

entry.title: Towards a Medical AI Scientist

author.name: Hongtao Wu, Boyun Zheng, Dingjie Song, Yu Jiang, Jianfeng Gao, Lei Xing, Lichao Sun, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces Medical AI Scientist, the first autonomous research framework for clinical research that enables clinically grounded ideation through clinician-engineer co-reasoning and transforms literature into actionable evidence.

entry.title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs

author.name: Yadi Cao, Sicheng Lai, Jiahe Huang, Yang Zhang, Zach Lawrence, Rohan Bhakta, Izzy F. Thomas, Mingyun Cao, Chung-Hao Tsai, Zihao Zhou, Yidong Zhao, Hao Liu, Alessandro Marinoni, Alexey Arefiev, Rose Yu

entry.summary: Introduces SimulCost, the first benchmark for cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations using LLM agents. Spans 2,916 single-round and 1,900 multi-round tasks across 12 simulators from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and plasma physics.

entry.title: UMI-Underwater: Learning Underwater Manipulation without Underwater Teleoperation

author.name: Hao Li, Long Yin Chung, Jack Goler, Ryan Zhang, Xiaochi Xie, Huy Ha, Shuran Song, Mark Cutkosky

entry.summary: Introduces UMI-Underwater, a system for underwater robotic grasping that transfers grasp knowledge from on-land demonstrations through depth-based affordance representations, bridging the domain gap via geometric alignment and diffusion policies.

entry.title: The Geometry of Harmful Intent: Training-Free Anomaly Detection via Angular Deviation in LLM Residual Streams

author.name: Isaac Llorente-Saguer

entry.summary: Presents LatentBiopsy, a training-free method for detecting harmful prompts by analyzing angular deviation in LLM residual stream activations from a safe reference direction, requiring only 200 safe normative prompts.

entry.title: Multiple-Prediction-Powered Inference

author.name: Charlie Cowen-Breen, Alekh Agarwal, Stephen Bates, William W. Cohen, Jacob Eisenstein, Amir Globerson, Adam Fisch

entry.summary: Introduces MultiPPI, a framework for statistically efficient estimation by optimally allocating resources across multiple data sources of varying quality, with theoretical guarantees and demonstrations across three LLM evaluation scenarios.

entry.title: TurboAngle: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Uniform Angle Quantization

author.name: Dipkumar Patel

entry.summary: Proposes TurboAngle, a KV cache compression method using angle quantization in the Fast Walsh-Hadamard domain with per-layer precision allocation, achieving near-lossless compression at 3.28-3.67 bits per element across 1B-7B models.

entry.title: Difference Feedback: Generating Multimodal Process-Level Supervision for VLM Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Feiding, Yongkang Zhang, Yuhao Liao, Zijian Zeng, Chunzheng Zhu, Yaozong Zheng, Yafei Liu, Yeling Peng, Youwei Wang, Sibo Wang, Huiming Yang, Linglin Liao, Shunzhi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Differential Feedback for VLM reinforcement learning that automatically constructs token/step-level supervision by repairing erroneous reasoning trajectories, enabling process-level visual alignment without costly human annotations.

entry.title: ResAdapt: Adaptive Resolution for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Huanxuan Liao, Zhongtao Jiang, Yupu Hao, Yuqiao Tan, Shizhu He, Jun Zhao, Kun Xu, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ResAdapt, a framework that learns to allocate visual resolution budgets per-frame before encoding for multimodal LLMs, formulating allocation as a contextual bandit problem to balance spatial resolution and temporal context.

entry.title: AdaptToken: Entropy-based Adaptive Token Selection for MLLM Long Video Understanding

author.name: Haozhe Qi, Kevin Qu, Mahdi Rad, Rui Wang, Alexander Mathis, Marc Pollefeys

entry.summary: Proposes AdaptToken, a training-free framework using MLLM self-uncertainty (response entropy) as a global control signal for adaptive token selection in long video understanding, enabling early stopping when sufficient evidence is gathered.

entry.title: High dimensional theory of two-phase optimizers

author.name: Atish Agarwala

entry.summary: Analyzes LA-DiLoCo (a two-phase optimizer) on high-dimensional linear regression, showing the single-worker variant provides different signal-noise tradeoffs than SGD and that multi-worker versions generate beneficial additional noise.

entry.title: Preconditioned Attention: Enhancing Efficiency in Transformers

author.name: Hemanth Saratchandran

entry.summary: Introduces preconditioned attention that adds a conditioning matrix to each attention head, theoretically shown to reduce the condition number of attention matrices and improve optimization.

entry.title: FlowRL: A Taxonomy and Modular Framework for Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion Policies

author.name: Chenxiao Gao, Edward Chen, Tianyi Chen, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Introduces FlowRL, a comprehensive taxonomy and modular JAX-based framework for reinforcement learning with diffusion/flow policies, unifying disparate approaches to RL with probabilistic policy representations.

entry.title: A Provable Energy-Guided Test-Time Defense Boosting Adversarial Robustness of Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mujtaba Hussain Mirza, Antonio D'Orazio, Odelia Melamed, Iacopo Masi

entry.summary: Proposes ET3, a training-free test-time defense for Large Vision-Language Models that enhances adversarial robustness by minimizing the energy of input samples, with theoretical guarantees under reasonable assumptions.

entry.title: Communicating about Space: Language-Mediated Spatial Integration Across Partial Views

author.name: Ankur Sikarwar, Debangan Mishra, Sudarshan Nikhil, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Aishwarya Agrawal

entry.summary: Introduces COSMIC benchmark for collaborative spatial communication where two MLLM agents observe a 3D scene from different viewpoints and exchange messages to solve spatial queries. Reveals capability hierarchy in MLLMs' spatial understanding.

entry.title: TerraSeg: Self-Supervised Ground Segmentation for Any LiDAR

author.name: Ted Lentsch, Santiago Montiel-Mar\'in, Holger Caesar, Dariu M. Gavrila

entry.summary: Introduces TerraSeg, the first self-supervised domain-agnostic model for LiDAR ground segmentation, trained on OmniLiDAR - a unified dataset of 22M scans across 15 sensor models from 12 public benchmarks.

entry.title: Bridging Visual Representation and Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yuhang Han, Yuyang Wu, Zhengbo Jiao, Yiyu Wang, Xuyang Liu, Shaobo Wang, Hanlin Xu, Xuming Hu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes KAWHI, a plug-and-play reward reweighting mechanism for RLVR in Large Vision-Language Models that explicitly incorporates visual representations into the reinforcement learning optimization loop, addressing the representational bottleneck.

entry.title: From None to All: Self-Supervised 3D Reconstruction via Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Ranran Huang, Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Krystian Mikolajczyk

entry.summary: Introduces NAS3R, a self-supervised feed-forward framework that jointly learns 3D geometry and camera parameters from uncalibrated, unposed views with only 2D photometric supervision, requiring no ground truth or pretrained priors.

entry.title: Towards Domain-Generalized Open-Vocabulary Object Detection: A Progressive Domain-invariant Cross-modal Alignment Method

author.name: Xiaoran Xu, Xiaoshan Yang, Jiangang Yang, Yifan Xu, Jian Liu, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: Formalizes Domain-Generalized Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (DG-OVOD), showing that visual distribution shifts cause collapse of cross-modal alignment spaces. Proposes progressive domain-invariant cross-modal alignment to maintain novel category detection under domain shift.

entry.title: Gated Condition Injection without Multimodal Attention: Towards Controllable Linear-Attention Transformers

author.name: Yuhe Liu, Zhenxiong Tan, Yujia Hu, Songhua Liu, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Explores controllable diffusion models with linear attention architectures for efficient on-device generation. Proposes gated condition injection that supports multiple heterogeneous condition types without multimodal attention.

entry.title: Ink Detection from Surface Topography of the Herculaneum Papyri

author.name: Giorgio Angelotti, Federica Nicolardi, Paul Henderson, W. Brent Seales

entry.summary: Uses machine learning on 3D optical profilometry data to detect ink on carbonized Herculaneum papyri based on surface morphology rather than density contrast. Demonstrates that surface topography alone can distinguish inked from uninked regions.

entry.title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Grounded Decoding for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Tripti Shukla, Zsolt Kira

entry.summary: SAGE mitigates VLM hallucinations by dynamically modulating self-attention during decoding, targeting attention sink tokens that accumulate disproportionate attention. Intervenes during generation rather than post-hoc.

entry.title: MathGen: Revealing the Illusion of Mathematical Competence through Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Ruiyao Liu, Hui Shen, Ping Zhang, Yunta Hsieh, Yifan Zhang, Jing Xu, Sicheng Chen, Junchen Li, Jiawei Lu, Jianing Ma, Jiaqi Mo, Qi Han, Zhen Zhang, Zhongwei Wan, Jing Xiong, Xin Wang, Ziyuan Liu, Hangrui Cao, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: MathGen benchmarks text-to-image models on generating mathematically correct visual outputs across 900 problems with executable verifiers. Reveals that current models largely fail at visual mathematical reasoning.

entry.title: ExFusion: Efficient Transformer Training via Multi-Experts Fusion

author.name: Jiacheng Ruan, Daize Dong, Xiaoye Qu, Tong Zhu, Ting Liu, Yuzhuo Fu, Yu Cheng, Suncheng Xiang

entry.summary: ExFusion improves Transformer training efficiency by temporarily upcycling FFN into multi-expert configuration during pre-training, then fusing experts back into a single FFN for deployment, gaining MoE benefits without MoE costs.

entry.title: Learning Multi-View Spatial Reasoning from Cross-View Relations

author.name: Suchae Jeong, Jaehwi Song, Haeone Lee, Hanna Kim, Jian Kim, Dongjun Lee, Dong Kyu Shin, Changyeon Kim, Dongyoon Hahm, Woogyeol Jin, Juheon Choi, Kimin Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Cross-View Relations (XVR), a 100K-sample dataset for teaching VLMs multi-view spatial reasoning from 3D scenes and robotic trajectories. Covers correspondence, verification, and localization tasks.

entry.title: Drift-AR: Single-Step Visual Autoregressive Generation via Anti-Symmetric Drifting

author.name: Zhen Zou, Xiaoxiao Ma, Mingde Yao, Jie Huang, LinJiang Huang, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Drift-AR unifies acceleration of both autoregressive and diffusion stages in AR-Diffusion hybrid models using prediction entropy as a signal for both speculative decoding quality and diffusion correction effort.

entry.title: Explaining CLIP Zero-shot Predictions Through Concepts

author.name: Onat Ozdemir, Anders Christensen, Stephan Alaniz, Zeynep Akata, Emre Akbas

entry.summary: EZPC bridges CLIP's zero-shot classification with concept bottleneck models by projecting CLIP embeddings into a concept space learned from language descriptions, enabling interpretable explanations of CLIP predictions without additional supervision.

entry.title: ConceptWeaver: Weaving Disentangled Concepts with Flow

author.name: Jintao Chen, Aiming Hao, Xiaoqing Chen, Chengyu Bai, Chubin Chen, Yanxun Li, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: ConceptWeaver introduces a differential probing technique to analyze flow-based generative models, revealing three distinct generation stages (Blueprint, Instantiation, Instantiation), and leverages this insight for disentangled concept customization from one-shot sources.

entry.title: GEditBench v2: A Human-Aligned Benchmark for General Image Editing

author.name: Zhangqi Jiang, Zheng Sun, Xianfang Zeng, Yufeng Yang, Xuanyang Zhang, Yongliang Wu, Wei Cheng, Gang Yu, Xu Yang, Bihan Wen

entry.summary: GEditBench v2 introduces a comprehensive image editing benchmark with 1,200 real-world queries spanning 23 tasks including open-set editing, plus PVC-Judge, an open-source pairwise visual consistency assessment model.

entry.title: DreamLite: A Lightweight On-Device Unified Model for Image Generation and Editing

author.name: Kailai Feng, Yuxiang Wei, Bo Chen, Yang Pan, Hu Ye, Songwei Liu, Chenqian Yan, Yuan Gao

entry.summary: DreamLite is a compact 0.39B parameter on-device diffusion model supporting both text-to-image generation and text-guided editing within a single network, using a pruned mobile U-Net backbone with in-context spatial concatenation.

entry.title: SonoWorld: From One Image to a 3D Audio-Visual Scene

author.name: Derong Jin, Xiyi Chen, Ming C. Lin, Ruohan Gao

entry.summary: SonoWorld generates 3D audio-visual scenes from a single image, creating 360° panoramas lifted into navigable 3D scenes with language-guided spatial audio anchors rendering ambisonics for various source types.

entry.title: SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild

author.name: Patrick Rim, Kevin Harris, Braden Copple, Shangchen Han, Xu Xie, Ivan Shugurov, Sizhe An, He Wen, Alex Wong, Tomas Hodan, Kun He

entry.summary: SHOW3D introduces a marker-less multi-camera system worn as a backpack rig for capturing 3D hand-object interaction data in genuine in-the-wild conditions, synchronized with VR headset for precise annotations.

entry.title: DiffSoup: Direct Differentiable Rasterization of Triangle Soup for Extreme Radiance Field Simplification

author.name: Kenji Tojo, Bernd Bickel, Nobuyuki Umetani

entry.summary: DiffSoup introduces a radiance field representation using a small number of triangles with neural textures and binary opacity, showing that binary opacity is directly differentiable via stochastic masking for extreme model simplification.

entry.title: Pandora: Articulated 3D Scene Graphs from Egocentric Vision

author.name: Alan Yu, Yun Chang, Christopher Xie, Luca Carlone

entry.summary: Pandora builds articulated 3D scene graphs from egocentric data captured by Project Aria glasses, transferring human exploration knowledge (including articulated object interactions) to robot maps.

entry.title: Safety Guardrails in the Sky: Realizing Control Barrier Functions on the VISTA F-16 Jet

author.name: Andrew W. Singletary, Max H. Cohen, Tamas G. Molnar, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Implements control barrier function (CBF)-based 'Guardrails' runtime assurance on a real F-16 fighter jet, demonstrating safe autonomous flight at the edge of operational limits. Blends human/AI commands with safety-guaranteed control actions.

entry.title: Omni-Modal Dissonance Benchmark: Systematically Breaking Modality Consensus to Probe Robustness and Calibrated Abstention

author.name: Zabir Al Nazi, Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Md Rizwan Parvez

entry.summary: Introduces OMD-Bench, a benchmark for omni-modal models where initially congruent modalities (video, audio, text) are systematically corrupted to isolate each modality's contribution and test calibrated abstention.

entry.title: The Geometry of Robustness: Optimizing Loss Landscape Curvature and Feature Manifold Alignment for Robust Finetuning of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Shivang Chopra, Shaunak Halbe, Chengyue Huan, Brisa Maneechotesuwan, Zsolt Kira

entry.summary: Proposes GRACE framework addressing the three-way trade-off between ID accuracy, OOD generalization, and adversarial robustness when fine-tuning VLMs, using geometric insights about loss landscape curvature and feature manifold alignment.

entry.title: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Models

author.name: Ji Ma, Wei Suo, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates hallucination patterns in Multimodal Chain-of-Thought models, finding fabricated texts primarily occur in associative reasoning steps. Proposes targeted mitigation based on this finding.

entry.title: Concerning Uncertainty -- A Systematic Survey of Uncertainty-Aware XAI

author.name: Helena L\"ofstr\"om, Tuwe L\"ofstr\"om, Anders Hjort, Fatima Rabia Yapicioglu

entry.summary: Systematic survey of uncertainty-aware explainable AI (UAXAI), examining how uncertainty is incorporated into explanatory pipelines via Bayesian, Monte Carlo, and Conformal methods. Identifies fragmented evaluation practices and limited user-centered assessment in the field.

entry.title: SkyNet: Belief-Aware Planning for Partially-Observable Stochastic Games

author.name: Adam Haile

entry.summary: Extends MuZero to partially observable, stochastic, multi-player environments by introducing explicit belief modeling (SkyNet/Belief-Aware MuZero). Addresses limitations of MuZero's latent encoding for representing uncertainty over unobserved variables.

entry.title: Entropic Claim Resolution: Uncertainty-Driven Evidence Selection for RAG

author.name: Davide Di Gioia

entry.summary: Introduces Entropic Claim Resolution (ECR), reframing RAG reasoning as entropy minimization over competing answer hypotheses. Selects evidence claims by maximizing Expected Entropy Reduction rather than semantic similarity.

entry.title: Generative Shape Reconstruction with Geometry-Guided Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Linus H\"arenstam-Nielsen, Dmitrii Pozdeev, Thomas Dag\`es, Nikita Araslanov, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: Introduces GG-Langevin, a probabilistic approach for 3D shape reconstruction that unifies geometric fidelity with generative shape priors through Langevin dynamics guided by diffusion models. Balances measurement consistency with shape plausibility.

entry.title: Codebase-Memory: Tree-Sitter-Based Knowledge Graphs for LLM Code Exploration via MCP

author.name: Martin Vogel, Falk Meyer-Eschenbach, Severin Kohler, Elias Gr\"unewald, Felix Balzer

entry.summary: Introduces Codebase-Memory, a system that builds persistent Tree-Sitter-based knowledge graphs of codebases via MCP, enabling LLM coding agents to explore code with 10x fewer tokens while maintaining 83% vs 92% answer quality.

entry.title: Agent-Driven Autonomous Reinforcement Learning Research: Iterative Policy Improvement for Quadruped Locomotion

author.name: Nimesh Khandelwal, Shakti S. Gupta

entry.summary: Documents a case study where an AI agent autonomously conducts reinforcement learning research for quadruped locomotion, iteratively designing experiments, diagnosing failures, and improving reward/terrain configurations across 70+ experiments.

entry.title: On Token's Dilemma: Dynamic MoE with Drift-Aware Token Assignment for Continual Learning of Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Chongyang Zhao, Mingsong Li, Haodong Lu, Dong Gong

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses 'routing-drift' in MoE-based continual learning for vision-language models, where old-task tokens get attracted to new experts. Proposes token-level analysis and drift-aware assignment.

entry.title: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents

author.name: Zhaopeng Feng, Liangcai Su, Zhen Zhang, Xinyu Wang, Xiaotian Zhang, Xiaobin Wang, Runnan Fang, Qi Zhang, Baixuan Li, Shihao Cai, Rui Ye, Hui Chen, Jiang Yong, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chenxiong Qian, Pengjun Xie, Bryan Hooi, Zuozhu Liu, Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSwing, an adaptive parallel context management routing system for long-horizon web agents that dynamically switches context management strategies based on search efficiency and terminal precision needs.

entry.title: A Systematic Taxonomy of Security Vulnerabilities in the OpenClaw AI Agent Framework

author.name: Surada Suwansathit, Yuxuan Zhang, Guofei Gu

entry.summary: Presents a systematic taxonomy of 190 security advisories filed against OpenClaw, an AI agent runtime, organized by architectural layer and trust-violation type, revealing vulnerability patterns unique to AI agent systems.

entry.title: Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks

author.name: Gianluca Peri, Timoteo Carletti, Duccio Fanelli, Diego Febbe

entry.summary: Introduces Spectral Higher-Order Neural Networks (SHONNs) that incorporate higher-order interactions in general-purpose feedforward networks, moving beyond the typical graph neural network paradigm. This extends higher-order neural networks to work without requiring explicit hypergraph-structured input data.

entry.title: CirrusBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agents Beyond Correctness in Real-World Cloud Service Environments

author.name: Yi Yu, Guangquan Hu, Chenghuang Shen, Xingyan Liu, Jing Gu, Hangyi Sun, Junzhuo Ma, Weiting Liu, Jianfeng Liu, Mingyue Pu, Yu Wang, Zhengdong Xiao, Rui Xie, Longjiu Luo, Qianrong Wang, Gurong Cui, Honglin Qiao, Wenlian Lu

entry.summary: Introduces CirrusBench, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in real-world cloud service environments, built from authentic customer support tickets to assess resolution efficiency and robustness beyond synthetic benchmarks.

entry.title: On-the-fly Repulsion in the Contextual Space for Rich Diversity in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Omer Dahary, Benaya Koren, Daniel Garibi, Daniel Cohen-Or

entry.summary: Proposes applying repulsion in the contextual space of diffusion transformers to increase visual diversity in text-to-image generation, addressing the typicality bias where models converge on narrow visual solutions.

entry.title: Liquid Networks with Mixture Density Heads for Efficient Imitation Learning

author.name: Nikolaus Correll

entry.summary: Compares liquid neural networks with mixture density heads against diffusion policies on robotics tasks, finding liquid policies use ~half the parameters, achieve 2.4x lower offline error, and run 1.8x faster at inference.

entry.title: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Wilailuck Treerath, Fabrizio Pittorino

entry.summary: Formalizes Tabular Active In-Context Learning (Tab-AICL) for tabular foundation models like TabPFN, instantiating it with four acquisition rules and showing improved performance under small labeling budgets.

entry.title: Decomposing Discrimination: Causal Mediation Analysis for AI-Driven Credit Decisions

author.name: Duraimurugan Rajamanickam

entry.summary: Formalizes causal mediation analysis for AI-driven credit decisions, providing identification strategies for natural direct and indirect effects under treatment-induced confounding where protected attributes affect both mediators and outcomes.

entry.title: Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Detection and Localization with Image-Level Supervision

author.name: Yizhou Jin, Yuezhu Feng, Jinjin Zhang, Peng Wang, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ReAL, which activates MLLMs' intrinsic reasoning potential for anomaly detection and pixel-level localization using only image-level supervision, extracting anomaly-related tokens from autoregressive reasoning without external vision modules.

entry.title: Incentivizing Temporal-Awareness in Egocentric Video Understanding Models

author.name: Zhiyang Xu, Tian Qin, Bowen Jin, Zhengfeng Lai, Meng Cao, Lifu Huang, Peng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TGPO, a reinforcement learning method for incentivizing temporal awareness in egocentric video understanding MLLMs by contrasting outputs from ordered vs shuffled video frames to derive calibrated rewards.

entry.title: TrackMAE: Video Representation Learning via Track Mask and Predict

author.name: Renaud Vandeghen, Fida Mohammad Thoker, Marc Van Droogenbroeck, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: Proposes TrackMAE, a masked video modeling approach that explicitly uses motion trajectories from point tracking as reconstruction signals and for motion-aware masking, improving motion-centric video representation learning.

entry.title: Complet4R: Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction

author.name: Weibang Wang, Kenan Li, Zhuoguang Chen, Yijun Yuan, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Complet4R, an end-to-end framework for geometrically complete 4D reconstruction using a decoder-only transformer that accumulates full context onto each frame, including occluded regions visible in other frames.

entry.title: TokenDial: Continuous Attribute Control in Text-to-Video via Spatiotemporal Token Offsets

author.name: Zhixuan Liu, Peter Schaldenbrand, Yijun Li, Long Mai, Aniruddha Mahapatra, Cusuh Ham, Jean Oh, Jui-Hsien Wang

entry.summary: TokenDial introduces slider-style continuous attribute control for text-to-video models by learning additive offsets in spatiotemporal token space. This enables fine-grained control over appearance and motion without retraining the backbone or losing identity/temporal coherence.

entry.title: Learning to See through Illumination Extremes with Event Streaming in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Baoheng Zhang, Jiahui Liu, Gui Zhao, Weizhou Zhang, Yixuan Ma, Jun Jiang, Yingxian Chen, Wilton W. T. Fok, Xiaojuan Qi, Hayden Kwok-Hay So

entry.summary: Event-MLLM enhances multimodal LLMs with event camera streams for visual reasoning under extreme illumination. Uses an Illumination Indicator from DINOv2 to adaptively fuse event and RGB data, with a correction loss aligning to normal-light semantics.

entry.title: TIR-Agent: Training an Explorative and Efficient Agent for Image Restoration

author.name: Yisheng Zhang, Guoli Jia, Haote Hu, Shanxu Zhao, Kaikai Zhao, Long Sun, Xinwei Long, Kai Tian, Che Jiang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian, Kaiyan Zhang, Bowen Zhou

entry.summary: TIR-Agent trains a vision-language agent for image restoration using a two-stage pipeline (SFT + RL). Replaces heuristic tool scheduling with a learned policy for degradation-aware task ordering and tool composition.

entry.title: MuSEAgent: A Multimodal Reasoning Agent with Stateful Experiences

author.name: Shijian Wang, Jiarui Jin, Runhao Fu, Zexuan Yan, Xingjian Wang, Mengkang Hu, Eric Wang, Xiaoxi Li, Kangning Zhang, Li Yao, Wenxiang Jiao, Xuelian Cheng, Yuan Lu, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: MuSEAgent introduces a multimodal reasoning agent that learns and leverages stateful experiences for decision-making. Uses hindsight reasoning to abstract interaction data into atomic decision experiences stored in a quality-filtered bank.

entry.title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory and Skills

author.name: Zefeng He, Siyuan Huang, Xiaoye Qu, Yafu Li, Tong Zhu, Yu Cheng, Yang Yang

entry.summary: GEMS introduces an agent-native multimodal generation framework with memory and skills, using multi-agent loops for iterative quality improvement and persistent trajectory-level memory. Inspired by Claude Code-style agent frameworks.

entry.title: ObjectMorpher: 3D-Aware Image Editing via Deformable 3DGS Models

author.name: Yuhuan Xie, Aoxuan Pan, Yi-Hua Huang, Chirui Chang, Peng Dai, Xin Yu, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: ObjectMorpher converts 2D image edits into 3D-aware operations by lifting objects into 3D Gaussian Splatting representations. Users can drag control points while ARAP constraints ensure physically plausible deformations, with a composite diffusion module handling lighting harmonization.

entry.title: From Pixels to Reality: Physical-Digital Patch Attacks on Real-World Camera

author.name: Victoria Leonenkova, Ekaterina Shumitskaya, Dmitriy Vatolin, Anastasia Antsiferova

entry.summary: DiPA demonstrates a new class of adversarial attacks against face recognition cameras where adversarial patches are displayed on smartphone screens rather than printed, enabling rapid deployment and improved transferability using ensemble face recognition models.

entry.title: PoseDreamer: Scalable and Photorealistic Human Data Generation Pipeline with Diffusion Models

author.name: Lorenza Prospero, Orest Kupyn, Ostap Viniavskyi, Jo\~ao F. Henriques, Christian Rupprecht

entry.summary: PoseDreamer uses diffusion models to generate large-scale synthetic datasets with 3D mesh annotations for human pose estimation, combining controllable generation with DPO for control alignment and curriculum-based hard sample mining.

entry.title: HandX: Scaling Bimanual Motion and Interaction Generation

author.name: Zimu Zhang, Yucheng Zhang, Xiyan Xu, Ziyin Wang, Sirui Xu, Kai Zhou, Bing Zhou, Chuan Guo, Jian Wang, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui

entry.summary: HandX presents a unified foundation for bimanual hand motion generation spanning data, annotation, and evaluation, including a new motion-capture dataset and decoupled annotation strategy for scalable bimanual interaction data.

entry.title: ANVIL: Accelerator-Native Video Interpolation via Codec Motion Vector Priors

author.name: Shibo Liu

entry.summary: ANVIL achieves real-time video frame interpolation on mobile NPUs by reusing H.264 decoder motion vectors to prealign frames, eliminating learned optical flow and spatial sampling operators that are bottlenecks on mobile accelerators.

entry.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution of Code and Test Populations

author.name: Kaushitha Silva, Srinath Perera

entry.summary: BACE uses Bayesian anchored co-evolution of code and test populations for LLM-based code generation, treating generated tests as noisy sensors with Bayesian updates rather than absolute ground truth.

entry.title: Beyond Viewpoint Generalization: What Multi-View Demonstrations Offer and How to Synthesize Them for Robot Manipulation?

author.name: Boyang Cai, Qiwei Liang, Jiawei Li, Shihang Weng, Zhaoxin Zhang, Tao Lin, Xiangyu Chen, Wenjie Zhang, Jiaqi Mao, Weisheng Xu, Bin Yang, Jiaming Liang, Junhao Cai, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Systematically studies multi-view demonstrations for robot manipulation, finding they consistently improve performance, reveal non-monotonic behavior with view coverage, and break single-view scaling limitations.

entry.title: HiFlow: Tokenization-Free Scale-Wise Autoregressive Policy Learning via Flow Matching

author.name: Daichi Yashima, Koki Seno, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes HiFlow, a tokenization-free coarse-to-fine autoregressive policy for robot action generation using flow matching instead of discrete codebooks. Removes quantization error inherent in discretizing low-dimensional continuous robot actions. Achieves strong results by combining hierarchical autoregressive structure with continuous flow matching.

entry.title: Blocking live failures with synchronous monitors

author.name: Adam Kaufman

entry.summary: Discusses synchronous monitoring as an AI control mechanism, where a monitor reviews actions before they execute to prevent rather than just detect harmful behavior. Analyzes latency tradeoffs and implementation considerations.

entry.title: AutoMS: Multi-Agent Evolutionary Search for Cross-Physics Inverse Microstructure Design

author.name: Zhenyuan Zhao, Yu Xing, Tianyang Xue, Lingxin Cao, Xin Yan, Lin Lu

entry.summary: Introduces AutoMS, a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework for inverse microstructure design using LLM-driven evolutionary search. LLMs serve as 'semantic navigators' to initialize search spaces while a Simulation-Aware Evolutionary Search ensures physical validity.

entry.title: Quantification of Credal Uncertainty: A Distance-Based Approach

author.name: Xabier Gonzalez-Garcia, Siu Lun Chau, Julian Rodemann, Michele Caprio, Krikamol Muandet, Humberto Bustince, S\'ebastien Destercke, Eyke H\"ullermeier, Yusuf Sale

entry.summary: Proposes a distance-based approach using Integral Probability Metrics to quantify total, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty for credal sets in multiclass classification. The measures have clear semantic interpretations and satisfy theoretical desiderata.

entry.title: What an Autonomous Agent Discovers About Molecular Transformer Design: Does It Transfer?

author.name: Edward Wijaya

entry.summary: Shows that autonomous architecture search for molecular transformers is counterproductive for SMILES but beneficial for natural language, with proteins in between. Based on 3,106 experiments, demonstrating domain-specific architectural needs.

entry.title: EpiPersona: Persona Projection and Episode Coupling for Pluralistic Preference Modeling

author.name: Yujie Zhang, Weikang Yuan, Zhuoren Jiang, Pengwei Yan

entry.summary: Introduces EpiPersona, a framework for pluralistic preference modeling that separates stable persona traits from episode-specific factors. Projects preferences into a low-dimensional persona space with discrete codes, then couples with current episode context.

entry.title: Unsupervised Behavioral Compression: Learning Low-Dimensional Policy Manifolds through State-Occupancy Matching

author.name: Andrea Fraschini, Davide Tenedini, Riccardo Zamboni, Mirco Mutti, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: Introduces Occupancy-based Policy Compression for deep RL, replacing myopic action-matching with state-occupancy matching to learn low-dimensional policy manifolds that better capture behavioral similarity.

entry.title: Grounding Social Perception in Intuitive Physics

author.name: Lance Ying, Aydan Y. Huang, Aviv Netanyahu, Andrei Barbu, Boris Katz, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Tianmin Shu

entry.summary: Introduces PHASE, a large dataset of physically simulated 2D agent interactions for studying social perception grounded in intuitive physics and psychology, bridging physical reasoning with social inference.

entry.title: GIFT: Bootstrapping Image-to-CAD Program Synthesis via Geometric Feedback

author.name: Giorgio Giannone, Anna Clare Doris, Amin Heyrani Nobari, Kai Xu, Akash Srivastava, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces GIFT, a method for bootstrapping image-to-CAD program synthesis by generating diverse verified training examples through geometric feedback, addressing the data scarcity bottleneck in CAD generation.

entry.title: KV Cache Quantization for Self-Forcing Video Generation: A 33-Method Empirical Study

author.name: Suraj Ranganath, Vaishak Menon, Anish Patnaik

entry.summary: Comprehensive empirical study of 33 KV cache compression methods for self-forcing video generation, covering 610 prompt-level observations across quantization and cache-policy variants.

entry.title: ChemCLIP: Bridging Organic and Inorganic Anticancer Compounds Through Contrastive Learning

author.name: Mohamad Koohi-Moghadam, Hongzhe Sun, Hongyan Li, Kyongtae Tyler Bae

entry.summary: Introduces ChemCLIP, a contrastive learning framework bridging organic and inorganic anticancer compounds by learning unified representations based on shared anticancer activities, enabling knowledge transfer from data-rich organic to data-scarce metal complex domains.

entry.title: AMIGO: Agentic Multi-Image Grounding Oracle Benchmark

author.name: Min Wang, Ata Mahjoubfar

entry.summary: Introduces AMIGO, a long-horizon benchmark for evaluating agentic VLMs on hidden-target identification across galleries of visually similar images through sequential yes/no questioning, testing uncertainty-driven question selection and constraint tracking.

entry.title: Gaussian Joint Embeddings For Self-Supervised Representation Learning

author.name: Yongchao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Joint Embeddings (GJE), a probabilistic alternative to deterministic self-supervised learning that models joint density of context and target representations using Gaussians, replacing black-box prediction with closed-form conditional inference.

entry.title: Spectral-Aware Text-to-Time Series Generation with Billion-Scale Multimodal Meteorological Data

author.name: Shijie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MeteoCap-3B, a billion-scale weather dataset with expert captions, and MTransformer for spectral-aware text-to-time-series generation of meteorological data.

entry.title: Online Learning of Kalman Filtering: From Output to State Estimation

author.name: Lintao Ye, Ankang Zhang, Ming Chi, Bin Du, Jianghai Hu

entry.summary: Studies learning Kalman filtering with unknown system models, proposing an online optimization framework achieving log(T) regret for output estimation and characterizing fundamental limitations for state estimation.

entry.title: Interpretable Physics Extraction from Data for Linear Dynamical Systems using Lie Generator Networks

author.name: Shafayeth Jamil, Rehan Kapadia

entry.summary: Introduces Lie Generator Networks (LGN) for learning linear dynamical systems by learning a structured generator matrix A and computing trajectories via matrix exponentiation, providing physical guarantees that Neural ODEs lack.

entry.title: TTE-CAM: Built-in Class Activation Maps for Test-Time Explainability in Pretrained Black-Box CNNs

author.name: Kerol Djoumessi, Philipp Berens

entry.summary: Introduces TTE-CAM, a test-time framework that converts pretrained black-box CNNs into self-explainable models by replacing the classification head with a convolution-based module initialized from original weights, producing faithful class activation maps without retraining.

entry.title: FusionAgent: A Multimodal Agent with Dynamic Model Selection for Human Recognition

author.name: Jie Zhu, Xiao Guo, Yiyang Su, Anil Jain, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FusionAgent, an agentic framework using MLLMs to dynamically select which biometric models (face, gait, body shape) to invoke for each test sample in whole-body human recognition, using reinforcement fine-tuning.

entry.title: UniDAC: Universal Metric Depth Estimation for Any Camera

author.name: Girish Chandar Ganesan, Yuliang Guo, Liu Ren, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes UniDAC for universal metric depth estimation that generalizes across diverse camera types (pinhole, fisheye, 360°) using a single model, without requiring large-FoV training data or separate models per domain.

entry.title: MotiMem: Motion-Aware Approximate Memory for Energy-Efficient Neural Perception in Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Haohua Que, Mingkai Liu, Jiayue Xie, Haojia Gao, Jiajun Sun, Hongyi Xu, Handong Yao, Fei Qiao

entry.summary: Proposes MotiMem, a hardware-software co-designed memory interface for autonomous vehicles that uses motion-aware region of interest detection and hybrid sparsity-aware coding to reduce memory energy by 47-72% with minimal perception loss.

entry.title: MEDIC-AD: Towards Medical Vision-Language Model's Clinical Intelligence

author.name: Woohyeon Park, Jaeik Kim, Sunghwan Steve Cho, Pa Hong, Wookyoung Jeong, Yoojin Nam, Namjoon Kim, Ginny Y. Wong, Ka Chun Cheung, Jaeyoung Do

entry.summary: Presents MEDIC-AD, a clinically oriented medical VLM with learnable anomaly-aware tokens for lesion detection, inter-image difference tokens for temporal tracking, and dedicated visual grounding for explainability.

entry.title: K$\alpha$LOS finds Consensus: A Meta-Algorithm for Evaluating Inter-Annotator Agreement in Complex Vision Tasks

author.name: David Tschirschwitz, Volker Rodehorst

entry.summary: Proposes KαLOS, a meta-algorithm for evaluating inter-annotator agreement in vision tasks that handles instance correspondence and provides standardized dataset quality evaluation, arguing benchmark progress is stagnating due to label noise.

entry.title: HD-VGGT: High-Resolution Visual Geometry Transformer

author.name: Tianrun Chen, Yuanqi Hu, Yidong Han, Hanjie Xu, Deyi Ji, Qi Zhu, Chunan Yu, Xin Zhang, Cheng Chen, Chaotao Ding, Ying Zang, Xuanfu Li, Jin Ma, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes HD-VGGT extending Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer to high-resolution inputs through strategies to manage token growth and handle visually ambiguous regions with unstable features.

entry.title: SpatialStack: Layered Geometry-Language Fusion for 3D VLM Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Jiang Zhang, Shijie Zhou, Bangya Liu, Achuta Kadambi, Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialStack, a hierarchical fusion framework that progressively aligns vision, geometry, and language representations across model layers for improved 3D spatial reasoning in VLMs, going beyond late-stage fusion.

entry.title: LOME: Learning Human-Object Manipulation with Action-Conditioned Egocentric World Model

author.name: Quankai Gao, Jiawei Yang, Qiangeng Xu, Le Chen, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LOME, an egocentric world model that generates realistic human-object interaction videos conditioned on input image, text prompt, and per-frame human actions (body poses and hand gestures).

entry.title: MV-RoMa: From Pairwise Matching into Multi-View Track Reconstruction

author.name: Jongmin Lee, Seungyeop Kang, Sungjoo Yoo

entry.summary: MV-RoMa extends pairwise dense matching to multi-view settings, jointly estimating correspondences from a source image to multiple targets. It uses efficient architecture design with pairwise results as geometric priors to avoid full cross-attention costs.

entry.title: V-CAST: Video Curvature-Aware Spatio-Temporal Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models

author.name: Xinying Lin, Xuyang Liu, Yiyu Wang, Teng Ma, Wenqi Ren
