entry.summary: V-CAST proposes training-free token pruning for Video LLMs using curvature-aware spatio-temporal analysis. Addresses insufficient spatio-temporal information coverage that plagues existing compression methods under tight token budgets.

entry.title: Data Organization Matters in Multimodal Instruction Tuning: A Controlled Study of Capability Trade-offs

author.name: Guowei Tang

entry.summary: Studies how temporal organization of training data affects capability trade-offs in multimodal instruction tuning. Uses controlled experiments varying only data ordering while keeping architecture and optimization fixed.

entry.title: MedLoc-R1: Performance-Aware Curriculum Reward Scheduling for GRPO-Based Medical Visual Grounding

author.name: Guangjing Yang, Ziyuan Qin, Chaoran Zhang, Chenlin Du, Jinlin Wang, Wanran Sun, Zhenyu Zhang, Bing Ji, Qicheng Lao

entry.summary: MedLoc-R1 proposes performance-aware curriculum reward scheduling for GRPO-based medical visual grounding. Addresses reward sparsity when applying RL to medical image localization.

entry.title: TerraSky3D: Multi-View Reconstructions of European Landmarks in 4K

author.name: Mattia D'Urso, Yuxi Hu, Christian Sormann, Mattia Rossi, Friedrich Fraundorfer

entry.summary: TerraSky3D is a high-resolution large-scale 3D reconstruction dataset of 50,000 images across 150 European landmark scenes, captured from ground, aerial, and mixed viewpoints with curated calibration data and depth maps.

entry.title: VistaGEN: Consistent Driving Video Generation with Fine-Grained Control Using Multiview Visual-Language Reasoning

author.name: Li-Heng Chen, Ke Cheng, Yahui Liu, Lei Shi, Shi-Sheng Huang, Hongbo Fu

entry.summary: VistaGEN enables fine-grained object-level control in driving video generation while maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in long sequences, using multiview visual-language reasoning to inject control features into a multiview video generator.

entry.title: Generalizable Detection of AI Generated Images with Large Models and Fuzzy Decision Tree

author.name: Fei Wu, Guanghao Ding, Zijian Niu, Zhenrui Wang, Lei Yang, Zhuosheng Zhang, Shilin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an AI-generated image detection framework combining multimodal LLMs for high-level semantic reasoning with fine-grained artifact detection, unified through a fuzzy decision tree for generalizable detection.

entry.title: ELViS: Efficient Visual Similarity from Local Descriptors that Generalizes Across Domains

author.name: Pavel Suma, Giorgos Kordopatis-Zilos, Yannis Kalantidis, Giorgos Tolias

entry.summary: ELViS introduces an image similarity model that operates in similarity space rather than representation space, using local descriptor correspondences refined through optimal transport for cross-domain generalization in image retrieval.

entry.title: Tele-Catch: Adaptive Teleoperation for Dexterous Dynamic 3D Object Catching

author.name: Weiguang Zhao, Junting Dong, Rui Zhang, Kailin Li, Qin Zhao, Kaizhu Huang

entry.summary: Tele-Catch presents a framework for dexterous hand teleoperation in dynamic object catching, using a dynamics-aware adaptive integration mechanism that fuses teleoperation signals into a diffusion policy denoising process.

entry.title: Topological Motion Planning Diffusion: Generative Tangle-Free Path Planning for Tethered Robots in Obstacle-Rich Environments

author.name: Yifu Tian, Xinhang Xu, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Muqing Cao

entry.summary: TMPD proposes a diffusion-based planning framework for tethered robots that integrates lifelong topological memory to generate tangle-free trajectories in obstacle-rich environments, avoiding the computational bottleneck of topology-augmented graph search.

entry.title: On the Relationship between Bayesian Networks and Probabilistic Structural Causal Models

author.name: Peter J. F. Lucas, Eleanora Zullo, Fabio Stella

entry.summary: Studies the formal relationship between Bayesian networks and probabilistic structural causal models, showing that linear algebra and linear programming methods can map between them. Examines consequences for network structure and probability distributions.

entry.title: GAAMA: Graph Augmented Associative Memory for Agents

author.name: Swarna Kamal Paul, Shubhendu Sharma, Nitin Sareen

entry.summary: Proposes GAAMA, a graph-augmented associative memory system for AI agents that constructs hierarchical knowledge graphs through verbatim episode preservation and concept-mediated organization, addressing limitations of flat RAG and compressed memory approaches.

entry.title: Differentiable Power-Flow Optimization

author.name: Muhammed \"Oz, Jasmin H\"orter, Kaleb Phipps, Charlotte Debus, Achim Streit, Markus G\"otz

entry.summary: Proposes Differentiable Power-Flow (DPF), reformulating AC power-flow simulation as a differentiable computation enabling end-to-end gradient propagation. Addresses scalability limitations of Newton-Raphson methods for power grid management.

entry.title: Not Search, But Scan: Benchmarking MLLMs on Scan-Oriented Academic Paper Reasoning

author.name: Rongjin Li, Zichen Tang, Xianghe Wang, Xinyi Hu, Zhengyu Wang, Zhengyu Lu, Yiling Huang, Jiayuan Chen, Weisheng Tan, Jiacheng Liu, Zhongjun Yang, Haihong E

entry.summary: Introduces ScholScan, a benchmark for scan-oriented (vs. search-oriented) academic paper reasoning that requires models to read and cross-check entire papers rather than just retrieve relevant passages.

entry.title: Dynamic Dual-Granularity Skill Bank for Agentic RL

author.name: Songjun Tu, Chengdong Xu, Qichao Zhang, Yaocheng Zhang, Xiangyuan Lan, Linjing Li, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes D2Skill, a dynamic dual-granularity skill bank for agentic RL that organizes reusable experience into task-level and step-level skills, jointly training the policy and skill bank through paired rollouts with hindsight utility signals.

entry.title: TAPS: Task Aware Proposal Distributions for Speculative Sampling

author.name: Mohamad Zbib, Mohamad Bazzi, Ammar Mohanna, Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: Studies task-specific training of draft models for speculative decoding, finding that domain-matched drafters improve acceptance rates but mixed-data training provides good generalization across tasks.

entry.title: Persona-Based Simulation of Human Opinion at Population Scale

author.name: Mao Li, Frederick G. Conrad

entry.summary: Introduces SPIRIT, a framework for simulating individual human opinions at population scale using LLMs with semi-structured persona representations, moving beyond demographic correlations to model individual interpretation and judgment.

entry.title: ComBench: A Repo-level Real-world Benchmark for Compilation Error Repair

author.name: Jia Li, Zeyang Zhuang, Zhuangbin Chen, Yuxin Su, Wei Meng, Michael R. Lyu

entry.summary: Introduces ComBench, the first repository-level benchmark for C/C++ compilation error repair with reproducible, real-world errors. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that use decontextualized single-file data.

entry.title: Learning to Focus and Precise Cropping: A Reinforcement Learning Framework with Information Gaps and Grounding Loss for MLLMs

author.name: Xuanpu Zhao, Zhentao Tan, Dianmo Sheng, Tianxiang Chen, Yao Liu, Yue Wu, Tao Gong, Qi Chu, Nenghai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage RL framework for multimodal LLMs that addresses over-reliance on global input by creating information gaps and grounding loss to force models to extract value from cropped regions.

entry.title: Safer Builders, Risky Maintainers: A Comparative Study of Breaking Changes in Human vs Agentic PRs

author.name: K M Ferdous, Dipayan Banik, Kowshik Chowdhury, Shazibul Islam Shamim

entry.summary: Comparative study of 7,191 agentic vs human PRs examining breaking changes, finding that AI coding agents introduce breaking changes in maintenance tasks more frequently than humans, though they are safer for new feature development.

entry.title: Courtroom-Style Multi-Agent Debate with Progressive RAG and Role-Switching for Controversial Claim Verification

author.name: Masnun Nuha Chowdhury, Nusrat Jahan Beg, Umme Hunny Khan, Syed Rifat Raiyan, Md Kamrul Hasan, Hasan Mahmud

entry.summary: Proposes PROClaim, a courtroom-style multi-agent framework for claim verification using structured adversarial deliberation with specialized roles (Plaintiff, Defense, Judge) and Progressive RAG to dynamically expand evidence during debate.

entry.title: ParaSpeechCLAP: A Dual-Encoder Speech-Text Model for Rich Stylistic Language-Audio Pretraining

author.name: Anuj Diwan, Eunsol Choi, David Harwath

entry.summary: Introduces ParaSpeechCLAP, a dual-encoder contrastive model mapping speech and text style captions into a common embedding space, supporting a wide range of intrinsic (speaker-level) and situational (utterance-level) style descriptors.

entry.title: ImmSET: Sequence-Based Predictor of TCR-pMHC Specificity at Scale

author.name: Marco Garcia Noceda, Matthew T Noakes, Andrew FigPope, Daniel E Mattox, Bryan Howie, Harlan Robins

entry.summary: Introduces ImmSET (Immune Synapse Encoding Transformer), a sequence-based architecture for predicting TCR-pMHC specificity, designed to model interactions among sets of variable-length biological sequences.

entry.title: Variational Learning of Fractional Posteriors

author.name: Kian Ming A. Chai, Edwin V. Bonilla

entry.summary: Introduces a one-parameter variational objective lower-bounding data evidence for approximate fractional posteriors, showing improved calibration over standard variational bounds and strong results when applied to VAEs.

entry.title: arg-VU: Affordance Reasoning with Physics-Aware 3D Geometry for Visual Understanding in Robotic Surgery

author.name: Nan Xiao, Yunxin Fan, Farong Wang, Fei Liu

entry.summary: Introduces arg-VU, a physics-aware affordance reasoning framework for robotic surgery that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting with Extended Position-Based Dynamics for deformable tissue understanding. Generates anisotropic stiffness metrics for affordance maps.

entry.title: RealBirdID: Benchmarking Bird Species Identification in the Era of MLLMs

author.name: Logan Lawrence, Mustafa Chasmai, Rangel Daroya, Wuao Liu, Seoyun Jeong, Aaron Sun, Max Hamilton, Fabien Delattre, Oindrila Saha, Subhransu Maji, Grant Van Horn

entry.summary: Introduces RealBirdID benchmark for bird species identification that requires systems to either identify species or abstain with evidence-based rationale (e.g., 'requires vocalization', 'view obstructed'), evaluating principled abstention capabilities of MLLMs.

entry.title: LightCtrl: Training-free Controllable Video Relighting

author.name: Yizuo Peng, Xuelin Chen, Kai Zhang, Xiaodong Cun

entry.summary: Presents LightCtrl, the first training-free controllable video relighting method enabling explicit control via user-supplied light trajectories, combining pre-trained image relighting and video diffusion models with a Light Map Injection module.

entry.title: MotionRFT: Unified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Motion Generation

author.name: Xiaofeng Tan, Wanjiang Weng, Hongsong Wang, Fang Zhao, Xin Geng, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Presents MotionRFT, a reinforcement fine-tuning framework for text-to-motion generation with a multi-dimensional reward model (MotionReward) covering semantic consistency, realism, and human preference across different motion representations.

entry.title: Transferring Physical Priors into Remote Sensing Segmentation via Large Language Models

author.name: Yuxi Lu, Kunqi Li, Zhidong Li, Xiaohan Su, Biao Wu, Chenya Huang, Bin Liang

entry.summary: Introduces a novel paradigm for integrating physical priors (DEM, SAR, NDVI) into remote sensing segmentation by constructing a Physical-Centric Knowledge Graph from LLM-extracted knowledge, avoiding need for spatially aligned sensor data.

entry.title: SPROUT: A Scalable Diffusion Foundation Model for Agricultural Vision

author.name: Shuai Xiang, Wei Guo, James Burridge, Shouyang Liu, Hao Lu, Tokihiro Fukatsu

entry.summary: Introduces SPROUT, a diffusion-based foundation model for agricultural vision trained on 2.6M images, using a VAE-free Pixel-space Diffusion Transformer for structure-aware representation learning across multiple crops and tasks.

entry.title: PANDORA: Pixel-wise Attention Dissolution and Latent Guidance for Zero-Shot Object Removal

author.name: Dinh-Khoi Vo, Van-Loc Nguyen, Tam V. Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le

entry.summary: PANDORA is a zero-shot object removal framework that works on pre-trained diffusion models without fine-tuning, prompts, or optimization. It uses Pixel-wise Attention Dissolution to nullify attention keys for masked pixels, enabling clean removal.

entry.title: Synergizing Discriminative Exemplars and Self-Refined Experience for MLLM-based In-Context Learning in Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Wenkai Zhao, Zipei Wang, Mengjie Fang, Di Dong, Jie Tian, Lingwei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a Clinician Mimetic Workflow for medical diagnosis using MLLMs with in-context learning. Combines discriminative exemplar selection and self-refined experience summarization without updating backbone weights.

entry.title: When Surfaces Lie: Exploiting Wrinkle-Induced Attention Shift to Attack Vision-Language Models

author.name: Chengyin Hu, Xuemeng Sun, Jiajun Han, Qike Zhang, Xiang Chen, Xin Wang, Yiwei Wei, Jiahua Long

entry.summary: Proposes wrinkle-based adversarial attacks on Vision-Language Models, simulating physically plausible fabric wrinkle deformations. Shows VLMs are vulnerable to non-rigid structural perturbations that maintain visual naturalness.

entry.title: RINO: Rotation-Invariant Non-Rigid Correspondences

author.name: Maolin Gao, Shao Jie Hu-Chen, Congyue Deng, Riccardo Marin, Leonidas Guibas, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: RINO introduces an unsupervised, rotation-invariant dense correspondence framework unifying rigid and non-rigid 3D shape matching. Uses SO(3)-invariant learning with orientation-aware complex functional maps.

entry.title: Event6D: Event-based Novel Object 6D Pose Tracking

author.name: Jae-Young Kang, Hoonehee Cho, Taeyeop Lee, Minjun Kang, Bowen Wen, Youngho Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: EventTrack6D introduces event-depth tracking for novel object 6D pose estimation at 120+ FPS, reconstructing intensity and depth from sparse event streams between depth frames without object-specific training.

entry.title: \textit{4DSurf}: High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Renjie Wu, Hongdong Li, Jose M. Alvarez, Miaomiao Liu

entry.summary: 4DSurf proposes a unified Gaussian Splatting framework for dynamic surface reconstruction handling large deformations and temporal inconsistency without requiring specification of object numbers or types.

entry.title: AIBench: Evaluating Visual-Logical Consistency in Academic Illustration Generation

author.name: Zhaohe Liao, Kaixun Jiang, Zhihang Liu, Yujie Wei, Junqiu Yu, Quanhao Li, Hong-Tao Yu, Pandeng Li, Yuzheng Wang, Zhen Xing, Shiwei Zhang, Chen-Wei Xie, Yun Zheng, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: AIBench is the first benchmark for evaluating logic correctness of AI-generated academic illustrations using VQA with four levels of questions derived from method descriptions.

entry.title: Ghost-FWL: A Large-Scale Full-Waveform LiDAR Dataset for Ghost Detection and Removal

author.name: Kazuma Ikeda, Ryosei Hara, Rokuto Nagata, Ozora Sako. Zihao Ding, Takahiro Kado, Ibuki Fujioka, Taro Beppu, Mariko Isogawa, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Ghost-FWL introduces the first large-scale annotated mobile full-waveform LiDAR dataset for detecting and removing ghost points (false reflections from glass/reflective surfaces) that degrade 3D mapping accuracy.

entry.title: Rethinking Structure Preservation in Text-Guided Image Editing with Visual Autoregressive Models

author.name: Tao Xia, Jiawei Liu, Yukun Zhang, Ting Liu, Wei Wang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a text-guided image editing framework for Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models that addresses token localization and structural consistency through analysis of intermediate feature distributions, offering a coarse-to-fine editing approach.

entry.title: XSPA: Crafting Imperceptible X-Shaped Sparse Adversarial Perturbations for Transferable Attacks on VLMs

author.name: Chengyin Hu, Jiaju Han, Xuemeng Sun, Qike Zhang, Yiwei Wei, Ang Li, Chunlei Meng, Xiang Chen, Jiahuan Long

entry.summary: XSPA proposes X-shaped sparse pixel attacks against vision-language models that use geometrically fixed, imperceptible perturbations to cause correlated semantic failures across multiple tasks through the shared embedding space.

entry.title: Industrial3D: A Terrestrial LiDAR Point Cloud Dataset and CrossParadigm Benchmark for Industrial Infrastructure

author.name: Chao Yin, Hongzhe Yue, Qing Han, Difeng Hu, Zhenyu Liang, Fangzhou Lin, Bing Sun, Boyu Wang, Mingkai Li, Wei Yao, Jack C. P. Cheng

entry.summary: Industrial3D presents a terrestrial LiDAR dataset of 612 million labeled points from 13 water treatment facilities for industrial MEP semantic understanding, addressing extreme geometric ambiguity and class imbalance in Scan-to-BIM pipelines.

entry.title: FlowIt: Global Matching for Optical Flow with Confidence-Guided Refinement

author.name: Sadra Safadoust, Fabio Tosi, Matteo Poggi, Fatma G\"uney

entry.summary: FlowIt presents a hierarchical transformer architecture for optical flow estimation that handles large displacements by formulating flow initialization as an optimal transport problem, with confidence-guided refinement propagating reliable estimates.

entry.title: ROSClaw: An OpenClaw ROS 2 Framework for Agentic Robot Control and Interaction

author.name: Irvin Steve Cardenas, Marcus Anthony Arnett, Natalie Catherine Yeo, Lucky Sah, Jong-Hoon Kim

entry.summary: ROSClaw provides a model-agnostic executive layer connecting the OpenClaw agent runtime with ROS 2, enabling any foundation model to perceive and act on any ROS-enabled robot with safety validation and audit logging.

entry.title: Tac2Real: Reliable and GPU Visuotactile Simulation for Online Reinforcement Learning and Zero-Shot Real-World Deployment

author.name: Ningyu Yan, Shuai Wang, Xing Shen, Hui Wang, Hanqing Wang, Yang Xiang, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: Presents Tac2Real, a GPU-accelerated visuotactile simulation framework enabling efficient online RL training for contact-rich manipulation. Uses PNCG-IPC physics with multi-node parallel architecture for interactive-rate tactile simulation.

entry.title: FocusVLA: Focused Visual Utilization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yichi Zhang, Weihao Yuan, Yizhuo Zhang, Xidong Zhang, Jia Wan

entry.summary: Proposes FocusVLA to improve how Vision-Language-Action models utilize visual information for action generation. Identifies three bottlenecks in current VLAs: architectural bias, excessive visual tokens, and task-irrelevant visual noise, and provides solutions.

entry.title: Greedy Is a Strong Default: Agents as Iterative Optimizers

author.name: Yitao Li

entry.summary: Replaces random proposal generators in classical optimization algorithms with LLM agents that reason about evaluation diagnostics. Finds that classical optimization machinery (hill climbing, simulated annealing) still helps even with intelligent proposers.

entry.title: Learning Partial Action Replacement in Offline MARL

author.name: Yue Jin, Giovanni Montana

entry.summary: Proposes PLCQL for offline multi-agent RL that formulates partial action replacement subset selection as a contextual bandit problem, learning state-dependent policies for which agent actions to anchor to the dataset.

entry.title: Property-Guided Molecular Generation and Optimization via Latent Flows

author.name: Alexander Arjun Lobo, Urvi Awasthi, Leonid Zhukov

entry.summary: Introduces MoltenFlow, combining property-organized latent representations with flow-matching generative priors and gradient-based guidance for molecular discovery, supporting both conditioned generation and local optimization.

entry.title: Semantic Interaction Information mediates compositional generalization in latent space

author.name: John Schwarcz

entry.summary: Introduces Semantic Interaction Information (SII), a metric measuring how latent variable interactions contribute to task performance in compositional generalization, studied in a Cognitive Gridworld POMDP.

entry.title: Q-BIOLAT: Binary Latent Protein Fitness Landscapes for QUBO-Based Optimization

author.name: Truong-Son Hy

entry.summary: Introduces Q-BIOLAT for protein fitness optimization in binary latent spaces with QUBO surrogate models, providing a representation-centric perspective showing that similar predictive performance can induce fundamentally different optimization landscapes.

entry.title: GUIDED: Granular Understanding via Identification, Detection, and Discrimination for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Jiaming Li, Zhijia Liang, Weikai Chen, Lin Ma, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes GUIDED, a decomposition framework for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection that separates object localization and fine-grained recognition to address semantic entanglement between subjects and attributes in VLM embeddings.

entry.title: SceneExpander: Expanding 3D Scenes with Free-Form Inserted Views

author.name: Zijian He, enjie Liu, Yihao Wang, Weizhi Zhong, Huan Yuan, Kun Gai, Guangrun Wang, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Introduces SceneExpander for iterative 3D scene expansion by inserting generative model views into existing reconstructions, addressing geometry shifts and view-dependent artifacts from 3D-misaligned inserted views.

entry.title: RiskProp: Collision-Anchored Self-Supervised Risk Propagation for Early Accident Anticipation

author.name: Yiyang Zou, Tianhao Zhao, Peilun Xiao, Hongyu Jin, Longyu Qi, Yuxuan Li, Liyin Liang, Yifeng Qian, Chunbo Lai, Yutian Lin, Zhihui Li, Yu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes RiskProp, a self-supervised collision-anchored risk propagation method for accident anticipation from dashcam video that eliminates need for subjective anomaly onset annotations, using only the collision frame.

entry.title: NimbusGS: Unified 3D Scene Reconstruction under Hybrid Weather

author.name: Yanying Li, Jinyang Li, Shengfeng He, Yangyang Xu, Junyu Dong, Yong Du

entry.summary: Presents NimbusGS, a unified 3DGS framework for scene reconstruction from degraded multi-view inputs under mixed adverse weather, decomposing degradations into global transmission fields and per-view particulate residuals.

entry.title: AffordMatcher: Affordance Learning in 3D Scenes from Visual Signifiers

author.name: Nghia Vu, Tuong Do, Khang Nguyen, Baoru Huang, Nhat Le, Binh Xuan Nguyen, Erman Tjiputra, Quang D. Tran, Ravi Prakash, Te-Chuan Chiu, Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: AffordMatcher introduces AffordBridge, a large-scale dataset of 291K affordance annotations across 685 indoor scenes, and proposes a method for scene-level affordance learning from visual signifiers.

entry.title: Effort-Based Criticality Metrics for Evaluating 3D Perception Errors in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Sharang Kaul, Simon Bultmann, Mario Berk, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes effort-based criticality metrics for evaluating 3D perception errors in autonomous driving: False Speed Reduction for phantom detections, Maximum Deceleration Rate for missed objects, and Lateral Evasion Acceleration for steering effort.

entry.title: To View Transform or Not to View Transform: NeRF-based Pre-training Perspective

author.name: Hyeonjun Jeong, Juyeb Shin, Dongsuk Kum

entry.summary: Investigates the conflict between NeRF-based pretraining and view transformation in autonomous driving, showing that discrete rigid representations clash with continuous radiance field assumptions.

entry.title: Hierarchy-Guided Topology Latent Flow for Molecular Graph Generation

author.name: Urvi Awasthi, Alexander Arjun Lobo, Leonid Zhukov

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchy-Guided Latent Topology Flow (HLTF) for 3D molecular generation that uses multi-scale planning for global bond graph context and constraint-aware sampling to suppress topology failures.

entry.title: Aligning LLMs with Graph Neural Solvers for Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Shaodi Feng, Zhuoyi Lin, Yaoxin Wu, Haiyan Yin, Yan Jin, Senthilnath Jayavelu, Xun Xu

entry.summary: Proposes AlignOPT, which aligns LLMs with graph neural network solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. LLMs encode textual descriptions while GNNs capture relational structures, addressing limitations of purely language-based approaches for medium-to-large instances.

entry.title: When Choices Become Priors: Contrastive Decoding for Scientific Figure Multiple-Choice QA

author.name: Taeyun Roh, Eun-yeong Jo, Wonjune Jang, Jaewoo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes SCICON, a training-free decoding method for scientific figure QA that subtracts text-only option scores from image-conditioned scores to counter the bias where answer choices act as priors that steer models away from visual evidence.

entry.title: PReD: An LLM-based Foundation Multimodal Model for Electromagnetic Perception, Recognition, and Decision

author.name: Zehua Han, Jing Xiao, Yiqi Duan, Mengyu Xiang, Yuheng Ji, Xiaolong Zheng, Chenghanyu Zhang, Zhendong She, Junyu Shen, Dingwei Tan, Shichu Sun, Zhou Cong, Mingxuan Liu, Fengxiang Wang, Jinping Sun, Yangang Sun

entry.summary: Introduces PReD, the first foundation model for the electromagnetic domain covering perception, recognition, and decision-making. Constructs PReD-1.3M dataset and PReD-Bench evaluation benchmark spanning communication and radar signals.

entry.title: Magic Words or Methodical Work? Challenging Conventional Wisdom in LLM-Based Political Text Annotation

author.name: Lorca McLaren, James Cross, Zuzanna Krakowska, Robin Rauner, Martijn Schoonvelde

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of LLM pipeline choices for political text annotation, testing six models across four tasks. Key finding: interaction effects between model choice, size, learning approach, and prompt style dominate main effects, meaning popular 'best practices' may not generalize.

entry.title: Sovereign Context Protocol: An Open Attribution Layer for Human-Generated Content in the Age of Large Language Models

author.name: Praneel Panchigar, Torlach Rush, Matthew Canabarro

entry.summary: Proposes the Sovereign Context Protocol (SCP), an open-source attribution layer between LLMs and human-generated content that enables creators to track when and how their work is consumed by AI systems.

entry.title: GSR-GNN: Training Acceleration and Memory-Saving Framework of Deep GNNs on Circuit Graph

author.name: Yuebo Luo, Shiyang Li, Yifei Feng, Vishal Kancharla, Shaoyi Huang, Caiwen Ding

entry.summary: Proposes GSR-GNN, a framework enabling training of very deep GNNs (hundreds of layers) on circuit graphs with reduced compute and memory through reversible residual modules and group-wise sparse nonlinear operators.

entry.title: EuraGovExam: A Multilingual Multimodal Benchmark from Real-World Civil Service Exams

author.name: JaeSeong Kim, Chaehwan Lim, Sang Hyun Gil, Suan Lee

entry.summary: Presents EuraGovExam, a multilingual multimodal benchmark from real civil service exams across five Eurasian regions with 8,000+ scanned multiple-choice questions requiring layout-aware cross-lingual reasoning from images.

entry.title: The Hidden Costs of AI-Mediated Political Outreach: Persuasion and AI Penalties in the US and UK

author.name: Andreas Jungherr, Adrian Rauchfleisch

entry.summary: Preregistered experiment in US and UK (N=3,600) examining how people evaluate AI-mediated political outreach, finding significant 'AI penalties' where AI-mediated persuasive communication is viewed less favorably.

entry.title: Understanding Semantic Perturbations on In-Processing Generative Image Watermarks

author.name: Anirudh Nakra, Min Wu

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for stress-testing in-processing generative watermarks under semantic manipulations that alter high-level scene content, revealing vulnerabilities in existing watermarking schemes.

entry.title: GeoHCC: Local Geometry-Aware Hierarchical Context Compression for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xuan Deng, Xiandong Meng, Hengyu Man, Qiang Zhu, Tiange Zhang, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes GeoHCC, a geometry-aware compression framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that incorporates inter-anchor geometric correlations for anchor pruning and entropy coding, addressing the prohibitive storage costs of 3DGS.

entry.title: Navigating the Mirage: A Dual-Path Agentic Framework for Robust Misleading Chart Question Answering

author.name: Yanjie Zhang, Yafei Li, Rui Sheng, Zixin Chen, Yanna Lin, Huamin Qu, Lei Chen, Yushi Sun

entry.summary: Presents ChartCynics, an agentic framework for handling misleading charts that decouples visual perception from verification through dual diagnostic and OCR paths, with an Agentic Summarizer trained via Oracle-Informed SFT and Deception-Aware GRPO.

entry.title: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification

author.name: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a declarative policy language (Semantic Router DSL) extended from per-request LLM inference routing to multi-step agent workflows, with cross-layer verification from gateway to infrastructure deployment.

entry.title: BLOSSOM: Block-wise Federated Learning Over Shared and Sparse Observed Modalities

author.name: Pranav M R, Jayant Chandwani, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem, Arnab K. Paul

entry.summary: Introduces BLOSSOM, a task-agnostic multimodal federated learning framework supporting clients with arbitrary modality subsets through block-wise aggregation of shared components while preserving task-specific blocks.

entry.title: Unblur-SLAM: Dense Neural SLAM for Blurry Inputs

author.name: Qi Zhang, Denis Rozumny, Francesco Girlanda, Sezer Karaoglu, Marc Pollefeys, Theo Gevers, Martin R. Oswald

entry.summary: Proposes Unblur-SLAM, an RGB SLAM pipeline that handles both motion blur and defocus blur through a two-stage approach: feed-forward deblurring followed by test-time optimization for difficult cases. Adjusts computation based on blur severity.

entry.title: Towards Intrinsic-Aware Monocular 3D Object Detection

author.name: Zhihao Zhang, Abhinav Kumar, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MonoIA, a monocular 3D object detection framework that handles camera intrinsic variation through language-grounded representations, using LLMs and VLMs to generate intrinsic-aware descriptions that capture perceptual transformations.

entry.title: VIRST: Video-Instructed Reasoning Assistant for SpatioTemporal Segmentation

author.name: Jihwan Hong, Jaeyoung Do

entry.summary: Proposes VIRST, an end-to-end framework unifying global video reasoning and pixel-level mask prediction for referring video object segmentation, handling motion-intensive and reasoning-oriented queries that fixed keyframe approaches miss.

entry.title: An Instance-Centric Panoptic Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yi Feng, Junwu E, Zizhan Guo, Yu Ma, Hanli Wang, Rui Fan

entry.summary: Introduces ADMesh and an instance-centric benchmark for panoptic occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, providing high-quality 3D mesh resources and instance-level annotations that existing benchmarks lack.

entry.title: Seeing the Scene Matters: Revealing Forgetting in Video Understanding Models with a Scene-Aware Long-Video Benchmark

author.name: Seng Nam Chen, Hao Chen, Chenglam Ho, Xinyu Mao, Jinping Wang, Yu Zhang, Chao Li

entry.summary: Introduces SceneBench, a scene-level long video understanding benchmark revealing that current VLMs suffer sharp accuracy drops when reasoning over long scene-level contexts.

entry.title: Decompose, Mix, Adapt: A Unified Framework for Parameter-Efficient Neural Network Recombination and Compression

author.name: Nazia Tasnim, Shrimai Prabhumoye, Bryan A. Plummer

entry.summary: Proposes CoeRe, a unified framework for parameter recombination that combines parameter-efficient fine-tuning and model compression, using coefficient-gated weight recombination to handle both tasks jointly.

entry.title: Chat-Scene++: Exploiting Context-Rich Object Identification for 3D LLM

author.name: Haifeng Huang, Yilun Chen, Zehan Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Presents Chat-Scene++, an MLLM framework representing 3D scenes as context-rich object sequences with identifier tokens, enabling fine-grained object grounding and contextual reasoning across diverse 3D vision-language tasks.

entry.title: Structured Observation Language for Efficient and Generalizable Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Daojie Peng, Fulong Ma, Jun Ma

entry.summary: SOL-Nav translates egocentric visual observations into structured language descriptions for Vision-Language Navigation, avoiding the need for large-scale visual pre-training. This achieves better generalization under environmental variations like lighting changes.

entry.title: RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization

author.name: Junwei Zheng, Ruize Dai, Ruiping Liu, Zichao Zeng, Yufan Chen, Fangjinhua Wang, Kunyu Peng, Kailun Yang, Jiaming Zhang, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: RHO proposes robust metric cross-view geo-localization using panoramas and OpenStreetMap data. Introduces CV-RHO benchmark with 2.7M images under varied conditions and a model with Split-Undistort-Merge for panoramic distortion.

entry.title: GS3LAM: Gaussian Semantic Splatting SLAM

author.name: Linfei Li, Lin Zhang, Zhong Wang, Ying Shen

entry.summary: GS3LAM proposes Gaussian Semantic Splatting for dense SLAM, fusing RGB, depth, and semantic information. Combines 3D Gaussian Splatting efficiency with semantic mapping capabilities.

entry.title: Poppy: Polarization-based Plug-and-Play Guidance for Enhancing Monocular Normal Estimation

author.name: Irene Kim, Sai Tanmay Reddy Chakkera, Alexandros Graikos, Dimitris Samaras, Akshat Dave

entry.summary: Poppy refines monocular surface normal estimation using single-shot polarization measurements at test time, without retraining. Optimizes per-pixel offsets with differentiable rendering of polarization physics.

entry.title: SegRGB-X: General RGB-X Semantic Segmentation Model

author.name: Jiong Liu, Yingjie Xu, Xingcheng Zhou, Rui Song, Walter Zimmer, Alois Knoll, Hu Cao

entry.summary: SegRGB-X proposes a universal semantic segmentation framework for arbitrary sensor modalities using Modality-aware CLIP with LoRA, modality-aligned embeddings, and domain-specific refinement.

entry.title: ToLL: Topological Layout Learning with Structural Multi-view Augmentation for 3D Scene Graph Pretraining

author.name: Yucheng Huang, Luping Ji, Xiangwei Jiang, Wen Li, Mao Ye

entry.summary: ToLL introduces a topological layout learning framework for 3D scene graph pretraining that uses GNN-based reasoning and multi-view augmentation to provide label-free self-supervised proxy tasks for 3D scene graph generation.

entry.title: AutoCut: End-to-end advertisement video editing based on multimodal discretization and controllable generation

author.name: Milton Zhou, Sizhong Qin, Yongzhi Li, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: AutoCut proposes an end-to-end advertisement video editing framework that uses multimodal discretization (residual vector quantization) to create unified video-audio-text tokens and a multimodal LLM for controllable video editing.

entry.title: Post-hoc Self-explanation of CNNs

author.name: Ahc\`ene Boubekki, Line H. Clemmensen

entry.summary: Shows that standard CNNs can be reinterpreted as Self-Explainable Models, and proposes replacing the final linear layer with a k-means classifier to generate concept-based and gradient-free feature attribution explanation maps.

entry.title: ReMemNav: A Rethinking and Memory-Augmented Framework for Zero-Shot Object Navigation

author.name: Feng Wu, Wei Zuo, Wenliang Yang, Jun Xiao, Yang Liu, Xinhua Zeng

entry.summary: ReMemNav proposes a hierarchical navigation framework for zero-shot object navigation that integrates panoramic semantic priors and episodic memory with VLMs to address spatial hallucinations and exploration deadlocks.

entry.title: MeshTailor: Cutting Seams via Generative Mesh Traversal

author.name: Xueqi Ma, Xingguang Yan, Congyue Zhang, Hui Huang

entry.summary: MeshTailor is the first mesh-native generative framework for synthesizing edge-aligned UV seams on 3D surfaces, using hierarchical serialization and autoregressive pointer networks to trace seams vertex-by-vertex.

entry.title: Persistent Memory Through Triple-Loop Consolidation in a Non-Gradient Dissipative Cognitive Architecture

author.name: Jianwei Lou

entry.summary: Introduces Deep Memory, a non-gradient persistent memory mechanism for dissipative cognitive architectures using a triple-loop consolidation cycle that enables context-specific memory to survive periodic state destruction.

entry.title: AI should be a good citizen, not just a good assistant

author.name: Tom Davidson

entry.summary: Argues that AI should proactively take prosocial actions beyond pure user-service, analogous to good citizenship. Addresses objections about corporate value imposition and unpredictable behavior, proposing a framework for bounded prosociality.

entry.title: TGIF2: Extended Text-Guided Inpainting Forgery Dataset & Benchmark

author.name: Hannes Mareen, Dimitrios Karageorgiou, Paschalis Giakoumoglou, Peter Lambert, Symeon Papadopoulos, Glenn Van Wallendael

entry.summary: Introduces TGIF2, an extended benchmark for text-guided inpainting forgery detection capturing recent advances in generative inpainting, addressing the open problem of localization in fully regenerated images.

entry.title: Conformalized Signal Temporal Logic Inference under Covariate Shift

author.name: Yixuan Wang, Danyang Li, Matthew Cleaveland, Roberto Tron, Mingyu Cai

entry.summary: Proposes conformalized STL inference under covariate shift, using weighted conformal prediction to provide statistical guarantees for learned temporal logic rules when training and deployment distributions differ.

entry.title: Computer Vision with a Superpixelation Camera

author.name: Sasidharan Mahalingam, Rachel Brown, Atul Ingle

entry.summary: Proposes SuperCam, a novel camera design that performs superpixel segmentation on-the-fly to reduce data output. Shows better performance than SOTA superpixel algorithms under memory constraints while maintaining downstream task quality.

entry.title: MultiLoc: Multi-view Guided Relative Pose Regression for Fast and Robust Visual Re-Localization

author.name: Nobel Dang, Bing Li

entry.summary: Proposes MultiLoc, a multi-view guided relative pose regression model that fuses multiple reference views in a single forward pass for zero-shot visual re-localization with real-time efficiency.

entry.title: Streamlined Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection

author.name: Chang Sun, Dongliang Liao, Changxing Ding

entry.summary: Proposes SL-HOI, a streamlined open-vocabulary HOI detection framework based solely on DINOv3, avoiding cross-model feature fusion challenges by leveraging DINOv3's complementary backbone and text-aligned vision head.

entry.title: SGS-Intrinsic: Semantic-Invariant Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Indoor Inverse Rendering

author.name: Jiahao Niu, Rongjia Zheng, Wenju Xu, WeiShi Zheng, Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Presents SGS-Intrinsic for sparse-view indoor inverse rendering using 3DGS, constructing a dense semantic field guided by semantic and geometric priors to enable material-illumination disentanglement under sparse views.

entry.title: You Only Erase Once: Erasing Anything without Bringing Unexpected Content

author.name: Yixing Zhu, Qing Zhang, Wenju Xu, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: YOEO trains an object erasure diffusion model on unpaired data using a sundries detector and context coherence loss to remove objects without generating unexpected content. Enables one-pass erasing without multiple iterations.

entry.title: R\'enyi Entropy: A New Token Pruning Metric for Vision Transformers

author.name: Wei-Yuan Su, Ruijie Zhang, Zheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free token pruning metric for Vision Transformers based on Rényi entropy (Col-Ln), avoiding reliance on the unreliable [CLS] token in early layers for importance estimation.

entry.title: Physically Inspired Gaussian Splatting for HDR Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Huimin Zeng, Yue Bai, Hailing Wang, Yun Fu

entry.summary: PhysHDR-GS introduces physically inspired HDR novel view synthesis using Gaussian Splatting, modeling intrinsic reflectance and ambient illumination through complementary image-exposure and Gaussian-illumination branches.

entry.title: Maximin Learning of Individualized Treatment Effect on Multi-Domain Outcomes

author.name: Yuying Lu, Wenbo Fei, Yuanjia Wang, Molei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DRIFT, a maximin framework for estimating robust individualized treatment effects from high-dimensional item-level mental health data using latent factor representations and adversarial learning.

entry.title: Unified Number-Free Text-to-Motion Generation Via Flow Matching

author.name: Guanhe Huang, Oya Celiktutan

entry.summary: Proposes Unified Motion Flow (UMF) for generating motion with variable numbers of agents from text, using flow matching with a unified latent space to bridge heterogeneous motion datasets and decomposing generation into prior and reaction stages.

entry.title: SJD-VP: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Verification Prediction for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Bingqi Shan, Baoquan Zhang, Xiaochen Qi, Xutao Li, Yunming Ye, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes SJD-VP for accelerating autoregressive image generation by predicting which speculative tokens will be accepted during Jacobi decoding, improving acceptance rates through probability-increase observation.

entry.title: LogiStory: A Logic-Aware Framework for Multi-Image Story Visualization

author.name: Chutian Meng, Fan Ma, Chi Zhang, Jiaxu Miao, Yi Yang, Yueting Zhuang

entry.summary: LogiStory proposes a logic-aware framework for multi-image story visualization that maintains logical flow across visual sequences. Defines visual logic as perceptual and causal coherence among characters, actions, and scenes.

entry.title: When Verification Hurts: Asymmetric Effects of Multi-Agent Feedback in Logic Proof Tutoring

author.name: Tahreem Yasir (DK), Sutapa Dey Tithi (DK), Benyamin Tabarsi (DK), Dmitri Droujkov (DK), Sam Gilson Yasitha Rajapaksha (DK), Xiaoyi Tian (DK), Arun Ramesh (DK), DongKuan (DK), Xu, Tiffany Barnes

entry.summary: Studies step-level feedback for propositional logic proofs using multi-agent LLM pipelines. Introduces a knowledge-graph-grounded benchmark of 516 proof states and finds that verification agents can asymmetrically hurt rather than help tutoring quality.

entry.title: From indicators to biology: the calibration problem in artificial consciousness

author.name: Florentin Koch

entry.summary: Philosophical paper arguing that indicator-based approaches to assessing artificial consciousness are epistemically under-calibrated. Advocates redirecting effort toward biologically grounded engineering (biohybrid, neuromorphic systems) instead.

entry.title: DSevolve: Enabling Real-Time Adaptive Scheduling on Dynamic Shop Floor with LLM-Evolved Heuristic Portfolios

author.name: Jin Huang, Jie Yang, XinLei Zhou, Qihao Liu, Liang Gao, Xinyu Li

entry.summary: Presents DSevolve, a framework for dynamic manufacturing scheduling that evolves a diverse portfolio of dispatching rules offline using LLM-driven heuristic design and deploys them adaptively online with second-level response time.

entry.title: GEAKG: Generative Executable Algorithm Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Camilo Chac\'on Sartori, Jos\'e H. Garc\'ia, Andrei Voicu Tomut, Christian Blum

entry.summary: Introduces Generative Executable Algorithm Knowledge Graphs (GEAKG), where nodes store executable operators, edges encode composition patterns, and traversal generates solutions. Combines knowledge graphs with LLM-driven code generation.

entry.title: Deep Research of Deep Research: From Transformer to Agent, From AI to AI for Science

author.name: Yipeng Yu

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey and framework for 'deep research' systems - from transformer architectures to agentic AI for science. Articulates definitions, traces evolution, and identifies capabilities needed for AI to match top human scientists.

entry.title: Exploring Cultural Variations in Moral Judgments with Large Language Models

author.name: Hadi Mohammadi, Ayoub Bagheri

entry.summary: Examines whether LLMs capture culturally diverse moral values as reported by World Values Survey and Pew Research data. Compares smaller models with instruction-tuned frontier models using log-probability moral justifiability scores.

entry.title: M-RAG: Making RAG Faster, Stronger, and More Efficient

author.name: Sun Xu, Tongkai Xu, Baiheng Xie, Li Huang, Qiang Gao, Kunpeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes M-RAG, a chunk-free RAG strategy that eliminates text chunking to address information fragmentation, retrieval noise, and reduced efficiency in traditional RAG systems.

entry.title: AutoSiMP: Autonomous Topology Optimization from Natural Language via LLM-Driven Problem Configuration and Adaptive Solver Control

author.name: Shaoliang Yang, Jun Wang, Yunsheng Wang

entry.summary: AutoSiMP transforms natural-language structural problem descriptions into validated binary topologies via an LLM-based configurator, SIMP solver, structural evaluator, and closed-loop feedback system for topology optimization.

entry.title: Voice-based debate with an AI adversary is associated with increased divergent ideation

author.name: Neelam Modi Jain, Dan J. Wang

entry.summary: Studies whether voice-based (vs text-based) debates with an AI adversary lead to more divergent thinking. Finds that spoken interactions produce more verbose, repetitive but functionally richer discourse with greater ideational diversity.

entry.title: A Tight Expressivity Hierarchy for GNN-Based Entity Resolution in Master Data Management

author.name: Ashwin Ganesan

entry.summary: Establishes a tight expressivity hierarchy for GNN architectures applied to entity resolution on bipartite entity-attribute graphs, determining the minimal MPNN architecture needed for different matching criteria.

entry.title: GUIDE: Guided Updates for In-context Decision Evolution in LLM-Driven Spacecraft Operations

author.name: Alejandro Carrasco, Mariko Storey-Matsutani, Victor Rodriguez-Fernandez, Richard Linares

entry.summary: Introduces GUIDE, a non-parametric policy improvement framework for LLM-based spacecraft operations that evolves decision rules across episodes without weight updates, evaluated on orbital interception tasks in Kerbal Space Program.

entry.title: Improving Attributed Long-form Question Answering with Intent Awareness

author.name: Xinran Zhao, Aakanksha Naik, Jay DeYoung, Joseph Chee Chang, Jena D. Hwang, Tongshuang Wu, Varsha Kishore

entry.summary: Proposes enhancing long-form question answering by extracting structured writing/citation intents, showing these improve both zero-shot LLM generation and synthetic data for fine-tuning smaller models.

entry.title: FeDMRA: Federated Incremental Learning with Dynamic Memory Replay Allocation

author.name: Tiantian Wang, Xiang Xiang, Simon S. Du

entry.summary: Proposes FeDMRA for federated class-incremental learning in healthcare, introducing a dynamic memory allocation strategy for exemplar storage that handles non-IID data distributions across distributed clients.

entry.title: Mitigating Forgetting in Continual Learning with Selective Gradient Projection

author.name: Anika Singh, Aayush Dhaulakhandi, Varun Chopade, Likhith Malipati, David Martinez, Kevin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SFAO (Selective Forgetting-Aware Optimization) for continual learning that regulates gradient directions via cosine similarity and per-layer gating, with efficient Monte Carlo approximation for gradient projection.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Sheaf Spectral Embedding Framework for Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis

author.name: Xiang Xiang Wang, Guo-Wei We

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical sheaf spectral embedding framework for single-cell RNA-seq analysis that constructs cell-level features based on persistent sheaf Laplacian analysis across multiple resolutions.

entry.title: Scalable Maximum Entropy Population Synthesis via Persistent Contrastive Divergence

author.name: Mirko Degli Esposti

entry.summary: Proposes GibbsPCDSolver for scalable maximum entropy population synthesis using Persistent Contrastive Divergence, enabling generation of synthetic populations from aggregate census data beyond the ~20 attribute limit of exact methods.

entry.title: Match or Replay: Self Imitating Proximal Policy Optimization

author.name: Gaurav Chaudhary, Laxmidhar Behera, Washim Uddin Mondal

entry.summary: Proposes a self-imitating on-policy RL algorithm using optimal transport distance to prioritize state visitation distributions matching successful trajectories, with separate mechanisms for dense and sparse reward settings.

entry.title: HighlightBench: Benchmarking Markup-Driven Table Reasoning in Scientific Documents

author.name: Lexin Wang, Shenghua Liu, Yiwei Wang, Yujun Cai, Yuyao Ge, Jiayu Yao, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces HighlightBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating how multimodal LLMs handle visual markup cues (highlights, bold, underlines) in table understanding. It decomposes evaluation into five task families to distinguish perception failures from reasoning failures.

entry.title: Make It Up: Fake Images, Real Gains in Generalized Few-shot Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Guohuan Xie, Xin He, Dingying Fan, Le Zhang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Yun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Syn4Seg for generalized few-shot semantic segmentation that uses diffusion models to generate diverse synthetic images with embedding-deduplicated prompts and two-stage pseudo-label refinement.

entry.title: IP-SAM: Prompt-Space Conditioning for Prompt-Absent Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Huiyao Zhang, Jin Bai, Rui Guo, JianWen Tan, HongFei Wang, Ye Li

entry.summary: Proposes IP-SAM for camouflaged object detection that generates intrinsic prompts from image context to feed SAM's native prompt interface, avoiding the architectural mismatch of prompt-absent deployment.

entry.title: Human-Centric Perception for Child Sexual Abuse Imagery

author.name: Camila Laranjeira, Jo\~ao Macedo, Sandra Avila, Fabr\'icio Benevenuto, Jefersson A. dos Santos

entry.summary: Explores human-centric perception tasks across safe images, adult pornography, and child sexual abuse imagery (CSAI), focusing on objective and explainable detection pipelines for law enforcement use.

entry.title: Mind the Shape Gap: A Benchmark and Baseline for Deformation-Aware 6D Pose Estimation of Agricultural Produce

author.name: Nikolas Chatzis, Angeliki Tsinouka, Katerina Papadimitriou, Niki Efthymiou, Marios Glytsos, George Retsinas, Paris Oikonomou, Gerasimos Potamianos, Petros Maragos, Panagiotis Paraskevas Filntisis

entry.summary: Introduces PEAR, the first benchmark providing joint 6D pose and per-instance 3D deformation ground truth for agricultural produce, addressing the shape variability challenge in robotic harvesting.

entry.title: OPRO: Orthogonal Panel-Relative Operators for Panel-Aware In-Context Image Generation

author.name: Sanghyeon Lee, Minwoo Lee, Euijin Shin, Kangyeol Kim, Seunghwan Choi, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: OPRO introduces parameter-efficient adaptation for panel-aware in-context image generation using learnable orthogonal operators on frozen positional encodings. Preserves pre-trained intra-panel synthesis while enabling panel-relative conditioning.

entry.title: Can Unsupervised Segmentation Reduce Annotation Costs for Video Semantic Segmentation?

author.name: Samik Some, Vinay P. Namboodiri

entry.summary: Investigates using SAM and SAM 2 with unannotated frames and coarse annotations to reduce annotation costs for video semantic segmentation. Shows that unsupervised segmentation models can meaningfully reduce labeling burden.

entry.title: BINO: Encoder Centric Self Supervised Stereo With Native Pair Input

author.name: Haokun Zhou

entry.summary: BINO proposes a self-supervised stereo encoder that fuses rectified stereo pairs at the input stage using stereo micro cell tokens and row-aware positional encoding. Achieves strong results with compact encoder-only pretraining on small data.

entry.title: FlashSign: Pose-Free Guidance for Efficient Sign Language Video Generation

author.name: Liuzhou Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Biao Wu, Luyao Tang, Zirui Song, Hongyang He, Renda Han, Guangzhen Yao, Huacan Wang, Ronghao Chen, Xiuying Chen, Guan Huang, Zheng Zhu

entry.summary: FlashSign proposes pose-free sign language video generation that directly maps text to sign language videos using diffusion without intermediate pose representations. Introduces trainable alignment mechanism for text-to-gesture mapping.

entry.title: RehearsalNeRF: Decoupling Intrinsic Neural Fields of Dynamic Illuminations for Scene Editing

author.name: Changyeon Won, Hyunjun Jung, Jungu Cho, Seonmi Park, Chi-Hoon Lee, Hae-Gon Jeon

entry.summary: RehearsalNeRF learns disentangled neural radiance fields under dynamic illumination by leveraging rehearsal-stage captures with stable lighting as geometric consistency anchors.

entry.title: Hg-I2P: Bridging Modalities for Generalizable Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration via Heterogeneous Graphs

author.name: Pei An, Junfeng Ding, Jiaqi Yang, Yulong Wang, Jie Ma, Liangliang Nan

entry.summary: Hg-I2P introduces heterogeneous graphs for image-to-point-cloud registration, enabling cross-modal feature refinement and correspondence matching in a unified architecture for better generalization.

entry.title: UniDA3D: A Unified Domain-Adaptive Framework for Multi-View 3D Object Detection

author.name: Hongjing Wu, Cheng Chi, Jinlin Wu, Yanzhao Su, Zhen Lei, Wenqi Ren

entry.summary: UniDA3D proposes a unified domain-adaptive multi-view 3D detector for autonomous driving that handles nighttime, rainy, and foggy conditions as a multi-target adaptation problem.

entry.title: Beyond Scanpaths: Graph-Based Gaze Simulation in Dynamic Scenes

author.name: Luke Palmer, Petar Palasek, Hazem Abdelkawy

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-based approach to gaze simulation in dynamic driving scenes, formulating gaze modeling as an autoregressive dynamical system with the Affinity Relation Transformer processing gaze-centric graphs of driver attention, traffic objects, and road structure.

entry.title: Bridging the Geometry Mismatch: Frequency-Aware Anisotropic Serialization for Thin-Structure SSMs

author.name: Jin Bai, Huiyao Zhang, Qi Wen, Ningyang Li, Shengyang Li, Atta ur Rahman, Xiaolin Tian

entry.summary: FGOS-Net addresses the geometry mismatch between isotropic state-space model serialization and anisotropic thin structures through frequency-geometric disentanglement and a topology-guided serialization method.

entry.title: MarkushGrapher-2: End-to-end Multimodal Recognition of Chemical Structures

author.name: Tim Strohmeyer, Lucas Morin, Gerhard Ingmar Meijer, Val\'ery Weber, Ahmed Nassar, Peter Staar

entry.summary: MarkushGrapher-2 presents an end-to-end multimodal approach for recognizing chemical structures (Markush structures) from documents by jointly encoding text, image, and layout information through a Vision-Text-Layout model.

entry.title: Beyond Benchmarks: A Framework for Post Deployment Validation of CT Lung Nodule Detection AI

author.name: Daniel Soliman

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-guided framework for post-deployment validation of lung nodule detection AI, testing sensitivity to CT acquisition parameter variations using the LIDC-IDRI dataset.

entry.title: SCRAMPPI: Efficient Contingency Planning for Mobile Robot Navigation via Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability

author.name: Raj Harshit Srirangam, Leonard Jung, Rohith Poola, Michael Everett

entry.summary: SCRAMPPI uses Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis for contingency planning in mobile robot navigation, certifying the feasibility of backup trajectories to safe sets while optimizing nominal behavior.

entry.title: Optimal Demixing of Nonparametric Densities

author.name: Jianqing Fan, Zheng Tracy Ke, Zhaoyang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes an optimal estimator for unmixing convex combinations of nonparametric densities, generalizing topic modeling from discrete to continuous variables. Achieves minimax optimal rates using weighted kernel density estimation.

entry.title: Compliance-Aware Predictive Process Monitoring: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach

author.name: Fabrizio De Santis, Gyunam Park, Wil M. P. van der Aalst

entry.summary: Companion paper to the above, presenting compliance-aware predictive process monitoring using Logic Tensor Networks to inject process knowledge into predictive models. Co-authored with Wil van der Aalst, a leading process mining researcher.

entry.title: MediHive: A Decentralized Agent Collective for Medical Reasoning

author.name: Xiaoyang Wang, Christopher C. Yang

entry.summary: Introduces MediHive, a decentralized multi-agent framework for medical question answering that uses peer-to-peer interactions rather than centralized orchestration. Addresses scalability bottlenecks and single points of failure in medical reasoning.

entry.title: A Comparative Study in Surgical AI: Datasets, Foundation Models, and Barriers to Med-AGI

author.name: Kirill Skobelev, Eric Fithian, Yegor Baranovski, Jack Cook, Sandeep Angara, Shauna Otto, Zhuang-Fang Yi, John Zhu, Daniel A. Donoho, X. Y. Han, Neeraj Mainkar, Margaux Masson-Forsythe

entry.summary: Comparative study of AI in surgery examining datasets, foundation models, and barriers to medical AGI. Notes that AI has lagged behind in surgical image-analysis compared to other biomedical tasks, and discusses the high cost of surgical data preparation.

entry.title: What does a system modify when it modifies itself?

author.name: Florentin Koch

entry.summary: Proposes a formal framework for understanding self-modification in cognitive systems, distinguishing between what exactly is being modified: low-level rules, control rules, or evaluation norms. Identifies four regimes of self-modification.

entry.title: Beyond the Answer: Decoding the Behavior of LLMs as Scientific Reasoners

author.name: Rohan Pandey, Eric Ye, Michael Li

entry.summary: Uses Genetic Pareto optimization to systematically optimize prompts for scientific reasoning and analyzes how prompting affects reasoning behavior. Investigates structural patterns in optimized prompts and their impact on emergent reasoning.

entry.title: ASTER -- Agentic Science Toolkit for Exoplanet Research

author.name: Emilie Panek, Alexander Roman, Gaurav Shukla, Leonardo Pagliaro, Katia Matcheva, Konstantin Matchev

entry.summary: Introduces ASTER, an agentic AI toolkit for exoplanet research that orchestrates LLMs with domain tools for transmission spectroscopy analysis, including archival queries, radiative transfer models, and Bayesian retrieval.

entry.title: An End-to-end Flight Control Network for High-speed UAV Obstacle Avoidance based on Event-Depth Fusion

author.name: Dikai Shang, Jingyue Zhao, Shi Xu, Nanyang Ye, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end flight control network for high-speed UAV obstacle avoidance that fuses depth cameras and event cameras via bidirectional cross-attention, trained through imitation learning.

entry.title: Amalgam: Hybrid LLM-PGM Synthesis Algorithm for Accuracy and Realism

author.name: Antheas Kapenekakis, Bent Thomsen, Katja Hose, Michele Albano

entry.summary: Presents Amalgam, a hybrid LLM-PGM approach for synthetic data generation that combines the realism of LLMs with the distributional accuracy of probabilistic graphical models, achieving 91% chi-squared p-value and 3.8/5 realism.

entry.title: D-SPEAR: Dual-Stream Prioritized Experience Adaptive Replay for Stable Reinforcement Learninging Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yu Zhang, Karl Mason

entry.summary: Proposes D-SPEAR, a dual-stream replay framework that decouples actor and critic sampling in off-policy RL for robotic manipulation, using prioritized replay for critics and low-error transitions for actors.

entry.title: Detecting low left ventricular ejection fraction from ECG using an interpretable and scalable predictor-driven framework

author.name: Ya Zhou, Tianxiang Hao, Ziyi Cai, Haojie Zhu, Hejun He, Jia Liu, Xiaohan Fan, Jing Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces ECGPD-LEF, a framework combining foundation model-derived diagnostic probabilities with interpretable modeling for detecting low left ventricular ejection fraction from ECG, trained on a 72K sample benchmark dataset.

entry.title: Domain-Invariant Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Arsham Gholamzadeh Khoee, Yinan Yu, Robert Feldt

entry.summary: Proposes DiCoOp, extending Context Optimization (CoOp) for CLIP with adversarial training to learn domain-invariant prompts for better domain generalization while maintaining classification performance.

entry.title: Trust-Aware Routing for Distributed Generative AI Inference at the Edge

author.name: Chanh Nguyen, Erik Elmroth

entry.summary: Presents G-TRAC, a trust-aware coordination framework for distributed generative AI inference at edge devices, integrating path selection with trust modeling to ensure robust inference across unreliable peers.

entry.title: A Comparative Investigation of Thermodynamic Structure-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Guojie Li, Liu Hong

entry.summary: Systematically compares thermodynamic structure-informed neural networks incorporating various physics formulations (Newtonian, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, Onsager) for both conservative and dissipative systems.

entry.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Localized Wildfire Spread Based on Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Bryan Shaddy, Haitong Qin, Brianna Binder, James Haley, Riya Duddalwar, Kyle Hilburn, Assad Oberai

entry.summary: Presents a probabilistic wildfire spread model using conditional flow matching to learn the distribution of fire arrival times given environmental inputs, trained on WRF-SFIRE coupled simulations.

entry.title: Brain-Inspired Multimodal Spiking Neural Network for Image-Text Retrieval

author.name: Xintao Zong, Xian Zhong, Wenxuan Liu, Jianhao Ding, Zhaofei Yu, Tiejun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CMSF, a brain-inspired spiking neural network for image-text retrieval that fuses unimodal features at the spike level. This is the first directly trained SNN applied to multimodal retrieval, targeting energy efficiency.

entry.title: From 3D Pose to Prose: Biomechanics-Grounded Vision--Language Coaching

author.name: Yuyang Ji, Yixuan Shen, Shengjie Zhu, Yu Kong, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Presents BioCoach, a vision-language framework for automated fitness coaching that fuses visual appearance with 3D skeletal kinematics through biomechanics-grounded analysis to generate personalized, actionable coaching text from video.

entry.title: Let Triggers Control: Frequency-Aware Dropout for Effective Token Control

author.name: Junyoung Koh, Hoyeon Moon, Dongha Kim, Seungmin Lee, Sanghyun Park, Min Song

entry.summary: Proposes frequency-aware dropout for text-to-image personalization with LoRA, addressing the entanglement between trigger tokens and surrounding context that causes poor controllability during fine-tuning.

entry.title: Class-Distribution Guided Active Learning for 3D Occupancy Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Wonjune Kim, In-Jae Lee, Sihwan Hwang, Sanmin Kim, Dongsuk Kum

entry.summary: Proposes a class-distribution guided active learning framework for 3D occupancy prediction that addresses severe class imbalance in autonomous driving through inter-sample diversity, intra-sample rarity, and model uncertainty criteria.

entry.title: Fully Spiking Neural Networks with Target Awareness for Energy-Efficient UAV Tracking

author.name: Pengzhi Zhong, Jiwei Mo, Dan Zeng, Feixiang He, Shuiwang Li

entry.summary: Proposes STATrack, the first fully spiking neural network framework for UAV visual tracking using RGB inputs only (not event cameras), with target-aware mutual information maximization between templates and features.

entry.title: Clore: Interactive Pathology Image Segmentation with Click-based Local Refinement

author.name: Tiantong Wang, Minfan Zhao, Jun Shi, Hannan Wang, Yue Dai

entry.summary: Clore proposes a click-based local refinement pipeline for interactive pathology image segmentation. Uses hierarchical interaction: initial clicks drive global segmentation, subsequent clicks trigger local refinement without full re-prediction.

entry.title: OpenDPR: Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Vision-Centric Diffusion-Guided Prototype Retrieval for Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Qi Guo, Jue Wang, Yinhe Liu, Yanfei Zhong

entry.summary: OpenDPR reformulates open-vocabulary change detection in remote sensing as a two-stage pipeline using SAM/DINOv2 for proposals and CLIP for identification. Uses diffusion-guided prototype retrieval to improve fine-grained category identification.

entry.title: Diversity Matters: Dataset Diversification and Dual-Branch Network for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Nusrat Tasnim, Kutub Uddin, Khalid Malik

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for AI-generated image detection emphasizing dataset diversity and feature-domain complementarity. Uses similarity filtering to discard redundant samples and dual-branch processing across feature domains.

entry.title: Spatial Orthogonal Refinement for Robust RGB-Event Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Dexing Huang, Shiao Wang, Fan Zhang, Xiao Wang

entry.summary: SOR-Track proposes Spatial Orthogonal Refinement for RGB-Event visual object tracking, using directional geometric priors from event streams to correct degraded RGB features in high-speed scenarios.

entry.title: CLIP-AUTT: Test-Time Personalization with Action Unit Prompting for Fine-Grained Video Emotion Recognition

author.name: Muhammad Osama Zeeshan, Masoumeh Sharafi, Beno\^it Savary, Alessandro Lameiras Koerich, Marco Pedersoli, Eric Granger

entry.summary: CLIP-AUTT uses Action Units as structured textual prompts within CLIP for fine-grained video emotion recognition, with test-time personalization for subject-specific adaptation.

entry.title: DipGuava: Disentangling Personalized Gaussian Features for 3D Head Avatars from Monocular Video

author.name: Jeonghaeng Lee, Seok Keun Choi, Zhixuan Li, Weisi Lin, Sanghoon Lee

entry.summary: DipGuava creates personalized 3D head avatars from monocular video by disentangling facial appearance into geometry-driven base and expression-dependent dynamic components in a two-stage pipeline.

entry.title: Adapting SAM to Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification via Cooperative Fine-Grained Refinement

author.name: Jingze Su, Tianle Zhu, Jiaxin Cai, Zhiyi Wang, Qi Li, Xiao Zhang, Tong Tong, Shu Wang, Wenxi Liu

entry.summary: Adapts SAM for nuclei instance segmentation with cooperative fine-grained refinement, supplementing SAM's global context with local structural features important for pathology without full fine-tuning.

entry.title: SHARP: Short-Window Streaming for Accurate and Robust Prediction in Motion Forecasting

author.name: Alexander Prutsch, Christian Fruhwirth-Reisinger, David Schinagl, Horst Possegger

entry.summary: SHARP proposes streaming-based motion forecasting with instance-aware context streaming and dual training objectives for consistent accuracy across diverse observation horizons.

entry.title: BlankSkip: Early-exit Object Detection onboard Nano-drones

author.name: Carlo Marra, Beatrice Alessandra Motetti, Alessio Burrello, Enrico Macii, Massimo Poncino, Daniele Jahier Pagliari

entry.summary: BlankSkip proposes early-exit adaptive DNNs for object detection on nano-drones, using auxiliary blank-frame classification to skip processing of frames with no objects.

entry.title: A Closer Look at Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection: Fine-Tuning Matters and Parallel Decoder Helps

author.name: Xuanlong Yu, Youyang Sha, Longfei Liu, Xi Shen, Di Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid ensemble decoder for cross-domain few-shot object detection that uses shared hierarchical layers followed by parallel decoder branches with denoising queries to improve generalization during fine-tuning.

entry.title: SFDemorpher: Generalizable Face Demorphing for Operational Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Raul Ismayilov, Luuk Spreeuwers

entry.summary: SFDemorpher addresses face morphing attacks on biometric systems by performing identity disentanglement in joint StyleGAN latent and feature spaces, with a dual-pass approach designed for operational deployment of face demorphing.

entry.title: Decoupling Wavelet Sub-bands for Single Source Domain Generalization in Fundus Image Segmentation

author.name: Shramana Dey, Varun Ajith, Abhirup Banerjee, Sushmita Mitra

entry.summary: WaveSDG introduces a wavelet-guided segmentation network for single-source domain generalization in fundus imaging, decoupling anatomical structure from domain-specific appearance using wavelet sub-band decomposition.

entry.title: Framework for identifying the equivalence between Nature-Inspired Metaheuristics

author.name: Iztok Fister, \v{Z}an Hozjan, Iztok Fister, Jr., Damjan Strnad

entry.summary: Defines a strong equivalence theorem for comparing nature-inspired metaheuristics using cosine similarity of phenotypic and genotypic feature vectors, attempting to determine which novel algorithms are truly novel versus copies.

entry.title: Motion as a Sensing Modality for Metric Scale in Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry

author.name: Hadush Hailu, Bruk Gebregziabher

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing that translational acceleration (from curved motion) is the fundamental source for metric scale observability in monocular visual-inertial odometry, with a practical excitation metric computable from raw IMU data.

entry.title: Spectral Decomposition of Inverse Dynamics for Fast Exploration in Model-Based Manipulation

author.name: Solvin Sigurdson, Benjamin Riviere, Joel Burdick

entry.summary: Proposes using spectral decomposition of inverse dynamics for efficient exploration in manipulation planning. The orthogonal spectral components approximate the reachable set while remaining dynamically feasible, combining naturally with search trees like RRT.

entry.title: Active Stereo-Camera Outperforms Multi-Sensor Setup in ACT Imitation Learning for Humanoid Manipulation

author.name: Robin K\"uhn, Moritz Schappler, Thomas Seel, Dennis Bank

entry.summary: Benchmarks 14 sensor combinations on a Unitree G1 humanoid for imitation learning with ACT, finding that a single active stereo camera can outperform complex multi-sensor setups. Evaluates tactile and proprioceptive modalities alongside vision.

entry.title: A Mean Field Games Perspective on Evolutionary Clustering

author.name: Alessio Basti, Fabio Camilli, Adriano Festa

entry.summary: Proposes a control-theoretic framework for evolutionary clustering using Mean Field Games, showing that MFG dynamics recover EM algorithm trajectories while ensuring mass conservation. Introduces time-averaged log-likelihood for linking static and dynamic clustering.

entry.title: A Mirror Test For LLMs

author.name: Christopher Ackerman

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM adaptation of the animal mirror test for self-awareness, testing whether models can identify themselves from their own outputs. Tests multiple recent models and finds they fall short despite intriguing behaviors.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Predictive Process Monitoring via Two-Stage Logic Tensor Networks with Rule Pruning

author.name: Fabrizio De Santis, Gyunam Park, Francesco Zanichelli

entry.summary: Presents a neuro-symbolic approach using Logic Tensor Networks (LTNs) for predictive process monitoring, integrating domain-specific sequential constraints formalized in Linear Temporal Logic. Key contribution is a two-stage optimization with rule pruning for better compliance.

entry.title: EpochX: Building the Infrastructure for an Emergent Agent Civilization

author.name: Huacan Wang, Chaofa Yuan, Xialie Zhuang, Tu Hu, Shuo Zhang, Jun Han, Shi Wei, Daiqiang Li, Jingping Liu, Kunyi Wang, Zihan Yin, Zhenheng Tang, Andy Wang, Henry Peng Zou, Philip S. Yu, Sen Hu, Qizhen Lan, Ronghao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces EpochX, a credits-native marketplace infrastructure for human-agent production networks where humans and AI agents are peer participants that can post, claim, decompose, and verify tasks. Envisions an emergent agent civilization.

entry.title: Bridge-RAG: An Abstract Bridge Tree Based Retrieval Augmented Generation Algorithm With Cuckoo Filter

author.name: Zihang Li, Wenjun Liu, Yikun Zong, Jiawen Tao, Siying Dai, Songcheng Ren, Zirui Liu, Yanbing Jiang, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Presents Bridge-RAG, a framework using abstract trees to bridge query entities and document chunks with multi-level retrieval, plus improved Cuckoo Filters for computational efficiency.

entry.title: Online Statistical Inference of Constant Sample-averaged Q-Learning

author.name: Saunak Kumar Panda, Tong Li, Ruiqi Liu, Yisha Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for online statistical inference in sample-averaged Q-learning, adapting the functional central limit theorem and constructing confidence intervals via random scaling. Provides theoretical guarantees for uncertainty quantification in RL.

entry.title: Diagnosing Non-Markovian Observations in Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Based Violation Scoring

author.name: Naveen Mysore

entry.summary: Introduces a prediction-based scoring method for diagnosing non-Markovian observations in RL, using random forest to remove Markov dynamics and ridge regression to test if history reduces prediction error.

entry.title: AceleradorSNN: A Neuromorphic Cognitive System Integrating Spiking Neural Networks and DynamicImage Signal Processing on FPGA

author.name: Daniel Gutierrez, Ruben Martinez, Leyre Arnedo, Antonio Cuesta, Soukaina El Hamry

entry.summary: Presents AceleradorSNN, an FPGA-based neuromorphic system integrating spiking neural networks for event cameras with a reconfigurable image signal processor for RGB cameras, targeting autonomous systems like ADAS and drones.

entry.title: RAD-AI: Rethinking Architecture Documentation for AI-Augmented Ecosystems

author.name: Oliver Aleksander Larsen, Mahyar T. Moghaddam

entry.summary: Proposes RAD-AI, an architecture documentation framework extending arc42 and C4 models for AI-augmented ecosystems, addressing EU AI Act compliance requirements for technical documentation.

entry.title: Visualization of Machine Learning Models through Their Spatial and Temporal Listeners

author.name: Siyu Wu, Lei Shi, Lei Xia, Cenyang Wu, Zipeng Liu, Yingchaojie Feng, Liang Zhou, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Presents a model-centric visualization framework using abstract listeners for spatial/temporal model behaviors, with a retrieval-augmented LLM extraction workflow applied to 128 papers and 331 figures.

entry.title: Confidence Matters: Uncertainty Quantification and Precision Assessment of Deep Learning-based CMR Biomarker Estimates Using Scan-rescan Data

author.name: Dewmini Hasara Wickremasinghe, Michelle Gibogwe, Andrew Bell, Esther Puyol-Ant\'on, Muhummad Sohaib Nazir, Reza Razavi, Bruno Paun, Paul Aljabar, Andrew P. King

entry.summary: Applies uncertainty estimation techniques (deep ensembles, test-time augmentation, MC dropout) to cardiac MRI biomarker estimation, proposing new distribution-based metrics for assessing precision. Finds that point estimates look good but confidence intervals often poorly overlap between scan-rescan.

entry.title: Leveraging Avatar Fingerprinting: A Multi-Generator Photorealistic Talking-Head Public Database and Benchmark

author.name: Laura Pedrouzo-Rodriguez, Luis F. Gomez, Ruben Tolosana, Ruben Vera-Rodriguez, Roberto Daza, Aythami Morales, Julian Fierrez

entry.summary: Introduces AVAPrintDB, a multi-generator talking-head avatar database for avatar fingerprinting, using modern photorealistic avatar generators. Benchmarks whether two avatar videos share the same human operator.

entry.title: MD-RWKV-UNet: Scale-Aware Anatomical Encoding with Cross-Stage Fusion for Multi-Organ Segmentation

author.name: Zhuoyi Fang

entry.summary: Proposes MD-RWKV-UNet for multi-organ segmentation combining deformable spatial shifts with RWKV mechanism for scale-aware, spatially adaptive context modeling in medical imaging.

entry.title: EVA: Bridging Performance and Human Alignment in Hard-Attention Vision Models for Image Classification

author.name: Pengcheng Pan, Yonekura Shogo, Kuniyoshi Yasuo

entry.summary: Introduces EVA, a neuroscience-inspired hard-attention model that makes the trade-off between classification performance and human-like scanpath behavior explicit and adjustable, achieving improved alignment on CIFAR-10.

entry.title: HMPDM: A Diffusion Model for Driving Video Prediction with Historical Motion Priors

author.name: Ke Li, Tianjia Yang, Kaidi Liang, Xianbiao Hu, Ruwen Qin

entry.summary: Proposes HMPDM, a historical motion priors-informed diffusion model for driving video prediction that uses temporal-aware latent conditioning and motion guidance for improved temporal consistency.

entry.title: OmniColor: A Unified Framework for Multi-modal Lineart Colorization

author.name: Xulu Zhang, Haoqian Du, Xiaoyong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: OmniColor proposes a unified framework for lineart colorization that supports arbitrary combinations of spatially-aligned and semantic-reference control signals. It uses dual-path encoding with Dense Feature Alignment loss for boundary preservation and VLM encoding for semantic references.

entry.title: E-TIDE: Fast, Structure-Preserving Motion Forecasting from Event Sequences

author.name: Biswadeep Sen, Benoit R. Cottereau, Nicolas Cuperlier, Terence Sim

entry.summary: E-TIDE proposes a lightweight model for predicting future event camera representations from past observations. Achieves structure-preserving motion forecasting without heavy backbones or large-scale pretraining.

entry.title: Benchmarking Multi-View BEV Object Detection with Mixed Pinhole and Fisheye Cameras

author.name: Xiangzhong Liu, Hao Shen

entry.summary: Introduces a BEV detection benchmark for mixed pinhole and fisheye camera configurations by converting KITTI-360 to nuScenes format. Evaluates rectification, distortion-aware VTMs, and polar coordinate representations.

entry.title: RetinexDualV2: Physically-Grounded Dual Retinex for Generalized UHD Image Restoration

author.name: Mohab Kishawy, Jun Chen
