entry.summary: RetinexDualV2 proposes a physically grounded dual-branch framework for UHD image restoration using task-specific physical priors to guide Retinex decomposition. Handles multiple degradation types without structural modifications.

entry.title: Robust Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval with Noisy Correspondence

author.name: Qiya Song, Yiqiang Xie, Yuan Sun, Renwei Dian, Xudong Kang

entry.summary: Addresses noisy correspondence in remote sensing image-text retrieval, revealing that existing datasets contain mismatched descriptions. Proposes a robust retrieval method handling noisy pairs.

entry.title: ColorFLUX: A Structure-Color Decoupling Framework for Old Photo Colorization

author.name: Bingchen Li, Zhixin Wang, Fan Li, Jiaqi Xu, Jiaming Guo, Renjing Pei, Xin Li, Zhibo Chen

entry.summary: ColorFLUX proposes a structure-color decoupling strategy for old photo colorization built on the FLUX diffusion model. It separates structure preservation from color restoration to handle unique degradation patterns in vintage photographs.

entry.title: DinoDental: Benchmarking DINOv3 as a Unified Vision Encoder for Dental Image Analysis

author.name: Kun Tang, Xinquan Yang, Mianjie Zheng, Xuefen Liu, Xuguang Li, Xiaoqi Guo, Ruihan Chen, Linlin Shen, He Meng

entry.summary: DinoDental benchmarks DINOv3 as a unified vision encoder for dental image analysis, evaluating whether this self-supervised foundation model can serve as a reliable off-the-shelf encoder across diverse dental imaging tasks without domain-specific pretraining.

entry.title: Divide and Restore: A Modular Task-Decoupled Framework for Universal Image Restoration

author.name: Joanna Wiekiera, Martyna Zur

entry.summary: Proposes a modular task-decoupled image restoration framework with a lightweight CNN classifier that routes images to specialized restoration modules, offering extensibility without joint retraining.

entry.title: External Benchmarking of Lung Ultrasound Models for Pneumothorax-Related Signs: A Manifest-Based Multi-Source Study

author.name: Takehiro Ishikawa

entry.summary: Develops a manifest-based external benchmark for lung ultrasound AI evaluation, testing pneumothorax-related sign detection including clinically important challenge states (lung point, lung pulse) beyond simple binary classification.

entry.title: LLM-Enabled Low-Altitude UAV Natural Language Navigation via Signal Temporal Logic Specification Translation and Repair

author.name: Yuqi Ping, Huahao Ding, Tianhao Liang, Longyu Zhou, Guangyu Lei, Xinglin Chen, Junwei Wu, Jieyu Zhou, Tingting Zhang

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to translate natural language UAV navigation instructions into Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications, then synthesizes trajectories via MILP. Includes a repair mechanism for invalid or incomplete STL formulas.

entry.title: Flip Stunts on Bicycle Robots using Iterative Motion Imitation

author.name: Jeonghwan Kim, Shamel Fahmi, Seungeun Rho, Sehoon Ha, Gabriel Nelson

entry.summary: Demonstrates front-flips on bicycle robots using RL with Iterative Motion Imitation (IMI), starting from infeasible reference motions and iteratively refining toward feasible agile behaviors. Validated on Ultra-Mobility Vehicle hardware.

entry.title: MPC as a Copilot: A Predictive Filter Framework with Safety and Stability Guarantees

author.name: Yunda Yan, Chenxi Tao, Jinya Su, Cunjia Liu, Shihua Li

entry.summary: Introduces PS2F (Predictive Safety-Stability Filter), a unified MPC-based framework that guarantees both constraint satisfaction and asymptotic stability for learning-based control. Uses cascaded optimization with MPC as a 'copilot'.

entry.title: The Conjugate Domain Dichotomy: Exact Risk of M-Estimators under Infinite-Variance Noise in High Dimensions

author.name: Charalampos Agiropoulos

entry.summary: Studies M-estimation in high dimensions with infinite-variance noise, showing that the asymptotic behavior depends on whether the Fenchel conjugate domain of the loss function is bounded. Establishes an exact risk characterization.

entry.title: Why Aggregate Accuracy is Inadequate for Evaluating Fairness in Law Enforcement Facial Recognition Systems

author.name: Khalid Adnan Alsayed

entry.summary: Argues that aggregate accuracy metrics are inadequate for evaluating fairness in facial recognition systems used by law enforcement, demonstrating how aggregate metrics can mask demographic disparities in error rates.

entry.title: Kempe Swap K-Means: A Scalable Near-Optimal Solution for Semi-Supervised Clustering

author.name: Yuxuan Ren, Shijie Deng

entry.summary: Proposes Kempe Swap K-Means for constrained clustering with must-link and cannot-link constraints, using Kempe chain swaps from graph coloring theory to refine cluster assignments.

entry.title: Unified Restoration-Perception Learning: Maritime Infrared-Visible Image Fusion and Segmentation

author.name: Weichao Cai, Weiliang Huang, Biao Xue, Chao Huang, Fei Yuan, Bob Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for maritime infrared-visible image fusion and segmentation that jointly addresses restoration and perception, along with a new marine-specific dataset capturing coupled degradations.

entry.title: Which Reconstruction Model Should a Robot Use? Routing Image-to-3D Models for Cost-Aware Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Akash Anand, Aditya Agarwal, Leslie Pack Kaelbling

entry.summary: Proposes SCOUT, a routing framework that selects among multiple 3D reconstruction models based on cost-quality tradeoffs for robotic manipulation tasks. Decouples viewpoint-dependent quality from absolute quality to make routing decisions.

entry.title: Moving Beyond Review: Applying Language Models to Planning and Translation in Reflection

author.name: Seyed Parsa Neshaei, Richard Lee Davis, Tanja K\"aser

entry.summary: Proposes Pensée, an LLM-based tool supporting planning and translation stages of reflective writing (inspired by Cognitive Process Theory), moving beyond the typical feedback-on-finished-text paradigm.

entry.title: Tunable Domain Adaptation Using Unfolding

author.name: Snehaa Reddy, Jayaprakash Katual, Satish Mulleti

entry.summary: Proposes domain adaptation methods for regression tasks based on interpretable unrolled networks, enabling controlled adaptation during inference by leveraging tunable parameters that depend on domain variables.

entry.title: Cost-Matching Model Predictive Control for Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Humanoid Locomotion

author.name: Wenqi Cai, Kyriakos G. Vamvoudakis, S\'ebastien Gros, Anthony Tzes

entry.summary: Proposes a cost-matching approach for humanoid locomotion that trains a parameterized MPC to approximate action-value functions from high-fidelity data. Avoids repeatedly solving MPC during training while maintaining MPC structure for deployment.

entry.title: Multiverse: Language-Conditioned Multi-Game Level Blending via Shared Representation

author.name: In-Chang Baek, Jiyun Jung, Sung-Hyun Kim, Geum-Hwan Hwang, Kyung-Joong Kim

entry.summary: Introduces Multiverse, a language-conditioned multi-game level generator that enables cross-game level blending through text specifications by learning a shared latent space aligning text and level structures. Uses contrastive learning to link semantically related levels across different game domains.

entry.title: TokenDance: Token-to-Token Music-to-Dance Generation with Bidirectional Mamba

author.name: Ziyue Yang, Kaixing Yang, Xulong Tang

entry.summary: Presents TokenDance, a two-stage music-to-dance generation framework using Finite Scalar Quantization for dual-modality tokenization and Bidirectional Mamba for efficient token-level generation. Addresses limited generalization of existing dance models.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Debate Engine: Identity-Grounded Cognitive Architecture for Resilient LLM-Based Ethical Tutoring

author.name: Jakub Mas{\l}owski, Jaros{\l}aw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Proposes a Heterogeneous Debate Engine for LLM-based ethical tutoring that enforces doctrinal fidelity while maintaining generative flexibility. Addresses semantic drift and logical deterioration in multi-agent dialectical systems.

entry.title: Dual-Stage LLM Framework for Scenario-Centric Semantic Interpretation in Driving Assistance

author.name: Jean Douglas Carvalho, Hugo Taciro Kenji, Ahmad Mohammad Saber, Glaucia Melo, Max Mauro Dias Santos, Deepa Kundur

entry.summary: Presents a dual-stage LLM framework for scenario-centric semantic interpretation in driving assistance, constructing deterministic temporal scenario windows from multimodal driving data and evaluating risk reasoning under fixed prompt constraints.

entry.title: SLOW: Strategic Logical-inference Open Workspace for Cognitive Adaptation in AI Tutoring

author.name: Yuang Wei, Ruijia Li, Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes SLOW, a tutoring framework inspired by dual-process theory that provides a dedicated reasoning workspace for cognitive diagnosis, affective perception, and pedagogical decision-making, separating deliberate reasoning from fast intuitive generation.

entry.title: T-Norm Operators for EU AI Act Compliance Classification: An Empirical Comparison of Lukasiewicz, Product, and G\"odel Semantics in a Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning System

author.name: Adam Laabs

entry.summary: Pilot study comparing three t-norm operators (Łukasiewicz, Product, Gödel) as logical conjunction mechanisms in a neuro-symbolic system for EU AI Act compliance classification. Evaluates on 1,035 annotated AI system descriptions across four risk categories.

entry.title: The Ultimate Tutorial for AI-driven Scale Development in Generative Psychometrics: Releasing AIGENIE from its Bottle

author.name: Lara Russell-Lasalandra, Hudson Golino, Luis Eduardo Garrido, Alexander P. Christensen

entry.summary: Presents AIGENIE, an R package that integrates LLM text generation with network psychometric methods to automate early-stage psychological scale development entirely in silico, from item generation to structural validation.

entry.title: ReCQR: Incorporating conversational query rewriting to improve Multimodal Image Retrieval

author.name: Yuan Hu, ZhiYu Cao, PeiFeng Li, QiaoMing Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces conversational query rewriting (CQR) into multimodal image retrieval, constructing a multi-turn dialogue rewriting dataset. Uses LLMs to generate rewritten candidates with LLM-as-Judge for quality control.

entry.title: Mimetic Alignment with ASPECT: Evaluation of AI-inferred Personal Profiles

author.name: Ruoxi Shang, Dan Marshall, Edward Cutrell, Denae Ford

entry.summary: Presents ASPECT, a pipeline that uses LLMs to infer communication style profiles from workplace data without per-person fine-tuning. Achieves moderate alignment with self-assessments in a 20-person study.

entry.title: Autonomous Agent-Orchestrated Digital Twins (AADT): Leveraging the OpenClaw Framework for State Synchronization in Rare Genetic Disorders

author.name: Hongzhuo Chen, Zhanliang Wang, Quan M. Nguyen, Gongbo Zhang, Chunhua Weng, Kai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an autonomous agent-orchestrated digital twin framework for rare genetic disorders using OpenClaw's proactive monitoring mechanism to continuously synchronize patient representations with evolving clinical and genomic data.

entry.title: Zero-shot Vision-Language Reranking for Cross-View Geolocalization

author.name: Yunus Talha Erzurumlu, John E. Anderson, William J. Shuart, Charles Toth, Alper Yilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes using zero-shot VLMs as rerankers for cross-view geolocalization, finding that pairwise comparison strategies improve Top-1 accuracy while pointwise methods fail catastrophically.

entry.title: Beyond Descriptions: A Generative Scene2Audio Framework for Blind and Low-Vision Users to Experience Vista Landscapes

author.name: Chitralekha Gupta, Jing Peng, Ashwin Ram, Shreyas Sridhar, Christophe Jouffrais, Suranga Nanayakkara

entry.summary: Presents Scene2Audio, a framework generating non-verbal audio representations of landscapes for blind/low-vision users using generative models informed by psychoacoustics, validated through user studies.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Dialectical Refinement for Enhanced Argument Classification

author.name: Jakub B\k{a}ba, Jaros{\l}aw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Proposes MAD-ACC, a multi-agent debate framework for argument component classification that uses dialectical refinement between proponent and opponent agents to resolve classification ambiguities in argument mining.

entry.title: MRI-to-CT synthesis using drifting models

author.name: Qing Lyu, Jianxu Wang, Jeremy Hudson, Ge Wang, Chirstopher T. Whitlow

entry.summary: Benchmarks drifting models against multiple generative methods (UNet, VAE, WGAN-GP, diffusion) for MRI-to-CT pelvis synthesis, evaluating image fidelity and structural consistency on two datasets.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Cooperative Tactical Deconfliction of Small Unmanned Aerial Systems

author.name: Iman Sharifi, Alex Zongo, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Investigates fine-tuning LLMs as decision-makers for cooperative multi-agent tactical deconfliction of small unmanned aerial systems in low-altitude airspace.

entry.title: A Convex Route to Thermomechanics: Learning Internal Energy and Dissipation

author.name: Hagen Holthusen, Paul Steinmann, Ellen Kuhl

entry.summary: Presents a physics-based neural network framework for thermomechanical constitutive model discovery, using internal energy and dissipation potential (rather than Helmholtz energy) to avoid complex convexity constraints.

entry.title: Boundary-aware Prototype-driven Adversarial Alignment for Cross-Corpus EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Guangli Li, Canbiao Wu, Na Tian, Li Zhang, Zhen Liang

entry.summary: Proposes a Prototype-driven Adversarial Alignment framework for cross-corpus EEG emotion recognition, progressively instantiated in three configurations to address class-conditional mismatch and decision boundary distortion.

entry.title: Real-time Appearance-based Gaze Estimation for Open Domains

author.name: Zhenhao Li, Zheng Liu, Seunghyun Lee, Amin Fadaeinejad, Yuanhao Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a robust appearance-based gaze estimation framework addressing generalization gaps in unconstrained scenarios (facial wearables, poor lighting) through augmentation ensemble and label fidelity improvements without additional human annotations.

entry.title: Beyond Mortality: Advancements in Post-Mortem Iris Recognition through Data Collection and Computer-Aided Forensic Examination

author.name: Rasel Ahmed Bhuiyan, Parisa Farmanifard, Renu Sharma, Andrey Kuehlkamp, Aidan Boyd, Patrick J Flynn, Kevin W Bowyer, Arun Ross, Dennis Chute, Adam Czajka

entry.summary: Contributes new NIR and visible-light post-mortem iris datasets and develops specialized algorithms for comparing iris images of deceased subjects, advancing forensic identification capabilities.

entry.title: LLM Enhanced Action Recognition via Hierarchical Global-Local Skeleton-Language Model

author.name: Ruosi Wang, Fangwei Zuo, Lei Li, Zhaoqiang Xia

entry.summary: Proposes HocSLM for skeleton-based action recognition that combines hierarchical global-local network topology with LLM-generated action semantic descriptions for cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Dual-Path Learning based on Frequency Structural Decoupling and Regional-Aware Fusion for Low-Light Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Ji-Xuan He, Jia-Cheng Zhao, Feng-Qi Cui, Jinyang Huang, Yang Liu, Sirui Zhao, Meng Li, Zhi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DTP, a dual-path framework for low-light image super-resolution that explicitly separates luminance and texture into independent frequency components for specialized modeling and coherent reconstruction.

entry.title: Annotation-Free Detection of Drivable Areas and Curbs Leveraging LiDAR Point Cloud Maps

author.name: Fulong Ma, Daojie Peng, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a map-based automatic data labeler (MADL) that uses LiDAR point cloud maps to generate annotation-free training data for drivable area and curb detection. Overcomes occlusion and sparsity issues from single-frame approaches.

entry.title: Amped: Adaptive Multi-stage Non-edge Pruning for Edge Detection

author.name: Yuhan Gao, Xinqing Li, Xin He, Bing Li, Xinzhong Zhu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Yun Liu

entry.summary: Amped proposes adaptive multi-stage non-edge token pruning for Transformer-based edge detectors. Identifies and removes high-confidence non-edge tokens early to reduce computation while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Customized Visual Storytelling with Unified Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Wei-Hua Li, Cheng Sun, Chu-Song Chen

entry.summary: VstoryGen integrates character/background references with textual descriptions and shot-type control for customized visual storytelling. Uses parameter-efficient prompt tuning on movie data for cinematic diversity.

entry.title: Inference-time Trajectory Optimization for Manga Image Editing

author.name: Ryosuke Furuta

entry.summary: Presents an inference-time adaptation method for manga image editing that adjusts the generation trajectory of pretrained models at test time without retraining. Addresses the domain gap between natural images and manga.

entry.title: ForestSim: A Synthetic Benchmark for Intelligent Vehicle Perception in Unstructured Forest Environments

author.name: Pragat Wagle, Zheng Chen, Lantao Liu

entry.summary: ForestSim presents a high-fidelity synthetic dataset for semantic segmentation in unstructured forest environments. Addresses the scarcity of annotated data for off-road autonomous driving scenarios.

entry.title: Progressive Prompt-Guided Cross-Modal Reasoning for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Jiachen Li, Hongyun Wang, Jinyu Xu, Wenbo Jiang, Yanchun Ma, Yongjian Liu, Qing Xie, Bolong Zheng

entry.summary: PPCR proposes progressive prompt-guided cross-modal reasoning for referring image segmentation, explicitly structuring the reasoning process from linguistic descriptions to target regions.

entry.title: Energy-Aware Imitation Learning for Steering Prediction Using Events and Frames

author.name: Hu Cao, Jiong Liu, Xingzhuo Yan, Rui Song, Yan Xia, Walter Zimmer, Guang Chen, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Proposes energy-aware imitation learning for steering prediction using event cameras and RGB frames, with an Energy-driven Cross-modality Fusion Module for reliable autonomous driving predictions.

entry.title: Octree-based Learned Point Cloud Geometry Compression: A Lossy Perspective

author.name: Kaiyu Zheng, Wei Gao, Huiming Zheng

entry.summary: Analyzes octree-based learned point cloud compression for lossy settings, proposing leaf node lossy compression for object point clouds and variable rate approaches for LiDAR data.

entry.title: RAWIC: Bit-Depth Adaptive Lossless Raw Image Compression

author.name: Chunhang Zheng, Tongda Xu, Mingli Xie, Yan Wang, Dou Li

entry.summary: RAWIC introduces a bit-depth-adaptive learned lossless compression framework for Bayer-pattern raw images, handling varying bit depths and sensor characteristics.

entry.title: Contour-Guided Query-Based Feature Fusion for Boundary-Aware and Generalizable Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation

author.name: Zahid Ullah, Sieun Choi, Jihie Kim

entry.summary: CGQR-Net proposes contour-guided query refinement for cardiac ultrasound segmentation, integrating multi-resolution features with contour-derived structural priors for boundary-aware segmentation.

entry.title: SVGS: Single-View to 3D Object Editing via Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Pengcheng Xue, Yan Tian, Qiutao Song, Ziyi Wang, Linyang He, Weiping Ding, Mahmoud Hassaballah, Karen Egiazarian, Wei-Fa Yang, Leszek Rutkowski

entry.summary: SVGS enables text-driven 3D scene editing from single views via Gaussian Splatting, addressing view consistency issues of multi-view editing approaches.

entry.title: Event-Based Method for High-Speed 3D Deformation Measurement under Extreme Illumination Conditions

author.name: Banglei Guan, Yifei Bian, Zibin Liu, Haoyang Li, Xuanyu Bai, Taihang Lei, Bin Li, Yang Shang, Qifeng Yu

entry.summary: Presents an integrated method using multi-event camera arrays for high-speed 3D deformation monitoring of large structures under extreme illumination. Covers calibration through measurement for event cameras in structural health monitoring applications.

entry.title: SEA: Evaluating Sketch Abstraction Efficiency via Element-level Commonsense Visual Question Answering

author.name: Jiho Park, Sieun Choi, Jaeyoon Seo, Minho Sohn, Yeana Kim, Jihie Kim

entry.summary: SEA introduces a reference-free metric for evaluating sketch abstraction efficiency, assessing how economically a sketch represents class-defining visual elements while preserving semantic recognizability using commonsense knowledge.

entry.title: Curriculum-Guided Myocardial Scar Segmentation for Ischemic and Non-ischemic Cardiomyopathy

author.name: Nivetha Jayakumar, Jonathan Pan, Shuo Wang, Bishow Paudel, Nisha Hosadurg, Cristiane C. Singulane, Sivam Bhatt, Amit R. Patel, Miaomiao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a curriculum learning framework for myocardial scar segmentation from LGE-CMR images, progressively training from high-confidence regions to difficult diffuse scars to handle annotation inconsistencies and imaging challenges.

entry.title: ORSIFlow: Saliency-Guided Rectified Flow for Optical Remote Sensing Salient Object Detection

author.name: Haojing Chen, Yutong Li, Zhihang Liu, Tao Tan, Haoyu Bian, Qiuju Ma

entry.summary: ORSIFlow reformulates remote sensing salient object detection as a deterministic latent flow generation problem using rectified flow, enabling efficient few-step inference with saliency-guided features.

entry.title: Toward Actionable Digital Twins for Radiation-Based Imaging and Therapy: Mathematical Formulation, Modular Workflow, and an OpenKBP-Based Dose-Surrogate Prototype

author.name: Hsin-Hsiung Huang, Bulent Soykan

entry.summary: Presents a modular framework for actionable digital twins in radiation therapy, coupling patient data, model, solver, calibration, and decision modules for uncertainty-aware treatment planning.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Iris Recognition: Performance Challenges and Outlook

author.name: Christina Karakosta, Lian Alhedaithy, William J. Knottenbelt

entry.summary: Investigates performance challenges of privacy-preserving iris recognition using Fully Homomorphic Encryption, surveying the current landscape and identifying barriers to practical deployment.

entry.title: Evolutionary Algorithms for Generating Graphs Matching Desired Laplacian Spectra

author.name: Hendrik Richter, Frank Neumann

entry.summary: Presents an evolutionary algorithm approach to generate graphs matching desired Laplacian spectral properties, using the spectral descriptor as part of a fitness function to evolve diverse graph structures with consistent properties.

entry.title: Bridging the Awareness Gap: Socially Mediated State Externalization for Transparent Distributed Home Robots

author.name: Wenzheng Zhao, Manideep Duggi, Fengpei Yuan

entry.summary: Investigates whether a co-located social mediator robot (Pepper) can bridge the state awareness gap for out-of-sight task robots (Stretch 3) through real-time verbal and visual state externalization.

entry.title: Surface-Constrained Offline Warping with Contact-Aware Online Pose Projection for Safe Robotic Trajectory Execution

author.name: Farong Wang, Sai Swaminathan, Fei Liu

entry.summary: Presents a two-stage framework for robotic tool motion along curved surfaces, with offline surface-constrained warping using diffeomorphic deformation followed by online contact-aware pose projection for execution regulation.

entry.title: Where-to-Learn: Analytical Policy Gradient Directed Exploration for On-Policy Robotic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Leixin Chang, Xinchen Yao, Ben Liu, Liangjing Yang, Hua Chen

entry.summary: Proposes 'Where-to-Learn,' a directed exploration method for on-policy RL that uses analytical policy gradients from a differentiable dynamics model to guide exploration toward high-reward regions. Combines physics-based guidance with RL exploration rather than relying on entropy or novelty.

entry.title: A Foldable and Agile Soft Electromagnetic Robot for Multimodal Navigation in Confined and Unstructured Environments

author.name: Zhihao Lv, Xiaoyong Zhang, Mengfan Zhang, Xiaoyu Song, Xingyue Liu, Yide Liu, Shaoxing Qu, Guoyong Mao

entry.summary: Introduces M-SEMR, a foldable soft electromagnetic robot with 9+ locomotion modes designed for gastrointestinal tract navigation. Driven by Laplace forces under static magnetic field, achieves rapid mode transitions and exceptional agility.

entry.title: Feel Robot Feels: Tactile Feedback Array Glove for Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Feiyu Jia, Xiaojie Niu, Sizhe Yang, Qingwei Ben, Tao Huang, Feng zhao, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: Presents TAG, a low-cost glove system integrating magnetic hand motion capture with high-resolution tactile feedback for dexterous teleoperation. Uses non-contact magnetic sensing for drift-free tracking and vibrotactile arrays for feedback.

entry.title: Retrospective Counterfactual Prediction by Conditioning on the Factual Outcome: A Cross-World Approach

author.name: Juraj Bodik

entry.summary: Studies retrospective counterfactual prediction under the Neyman-Rubin model, estimating what would have happened under different treatment conditioned on observed outcomes. Uses cross-world correlation bounds to address non-identification.

entry.title: Pangram (AI detection software) can be evaded

author.name: Eye You

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Pangram, a leading AI text detection tool claiming 99.98% accuracy, can be evaded with fairly unsophisticated techniques. Challenges the reliability of AI detection tools in adversarial settings.

entry.title: DRIVE-Nav: Directional Reasoning, Inspection, and Verification for Efficient Open-Vocabulary Navigation

author.name: Maoguo Gao, Zejun Zhu, Zhiming Sun, Zhengwei Ma, Longze Yuan, Zhongjing Ma, Zhigang Gao, Jinhui Zhang, Suli Zou

entry.summary: Proposes DRIVE-Nav for open-vocabulary object navigation that organizes exploration around persistent directions rather than raw frontiers. Reduces redundant revisits by tracking directional candidates and restricting decisions to relevant forward directions.

entry.title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks in Robotic Perception

author.name: Ziad Sharawy, Mohammad Nakshbandiand, Sorin Mihai Grigorescu

entry.summary: Addresses adversarial attack detection for semantic segmentation in robotic perception, focusing on specialized architectures and detection strategies for safety-critical robotics applications.

entry.title: Embedding Provenance in Computer Vision Datasets with JSON-LD

author.name: Lynn Vonderhaar, Timothy Elvira, Tyler Thomas Procko, Omar Ochoa

entry.summary: Proposes embedding provenance metadata in computer vision datasets using JSON-LD, providing structured tracking of image capture settings, preprocessing steps, and model architecture iterations.

entry.title: A Cross-Scale Decoder with Token Refinement for Off-Road Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Seongkyu Choi Jhonghyun An

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-scale decoder with token refinement for off-road semantic segmentation, addressing annotation ambiguity and class similarity in irregular terrain. Handles thick uncertain transition regions.

entry.title: Reliability-Aware Weighted Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Maps for Heart Rate Monitoring

author.name: Arpan Bairagi, Rakesh Dey, Siladittya Manna, Umapada Pal

entry.summary: Presents a reliability-aware weighted multi-scale spatio-temporal map for remote photoplethysmography that models pixel reliability to suppress environmental noise, combined with SSL contrastive learning using Swin-Unet.

entry.title: Reducing Mental Workload through On-Demand Human Assistance for Physical Action Failures in LLM-based Multi-Robot Coordination

author.name: Shoichi Hasegawa, Akira Taniguchi, Lotfi El Hafi, Gustavo Alfonso Garcia Ricardez, Tadahiro Taniguchi

entry.summary: Proposes REPAIR, a human-in-the-loop framework for recovering from physical execution failures in LLM-based multi-robot coordination. Uses Mixed Reality for remote error resolution while minimizing operator mental workload.

entry.title: The Risk Quadrangle in Optimization: An Overview with Recent Results and Extensions

author.name: Bogdan Grechuk, Anton Malandii, Terry Rockafellar, Stan Uryasev

entry.summary: Comprehensive overview and extension of the Risk Quadrangle framework integrating risk, deviation, regret, and error functionals for optimization and statistical estimation. Introduces several new quadrangles and connections to machine learning.

entry.title: Vertical Consensus Inference for High-Dimensional Random Partition

author.name: Khai Nguyen, Yang Ni, Peter Mueller

entry.summary: Introduces Vertical Consensus Inference (VCI) for high-dimensional Bayesian clustering, splitting data into vertical shards of reduced dimensionality and combining shard-level posteriors with entropic regularization.

entry.title: LLM Readiness Harness: Evaluation, Observability, and CI Gates for LLM/RAG Applications

author.name: Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

entry.summary: Presents a readiness harness for LLM/RAG applications that combines automated benchmarks, observability, and CI quality gates to produce deployment readiness scores with Pareto frontiers across multiple metrics.

entry.title: Debiasing Large Language Models toward Social Factors in Online Behavior Analytics through Prompt Knowledge Tuning

author.name: Hossein Salemi, Jitin Krishnan, Hemant Purohit

entry.summary: Investigates incorporating social attribution theory into LLM reasoning for online behavior analytics, using prompt knowledge tuning to include user goals as dispositional knowledge to reduce bias.

entry.title: Culturally Adaptive Explainable LLM Assessment for Multilingual Information Disorder: A Human-in-the-Loop Approach

author.name: Maziar Kianimoghadam Jouneghani

entry.summary: Proposes a human-in-the-loop framework for culturally adaptive LLM assessment of multilingual information disorder, grounding model outputs in human-written rationales from native-speaking annotators.

entry.title: CarbonEdge: Carbon-Aware Deep Learning Inference Framework for Sustainable Edge Computing

author.name: Guilin Zhang, Wulan Guo, Ziqi Tan, Hailong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces CarbonEdge, a carbon-aware deep learning inference framework for edge computing that extends model partitioning with carbon footprint estimation and green scheduling for tunable performance-carbon tradeoffs.

entry.title: Copilot-Assisted Second-Thought Framework for Brain-to-Robot Hand Motion Decoding

author.name: Yizhe Li (University of Birmingham, Birmingham, United Kingdom), Shixiao Wang (University of Birmingham, Birmingham, United Kingdom), Jian K. Liu (University of Birmingham, Birmingham, United Kingdom)

entry.summary: Proposes a CNN-attention hybrid model for decoding hand kinematics from EEG during grasp-and-lift tasks, extending to EEG-EMG multimodal decoding with high correlation values (PCC up to 0.99).

entry.title: CiQi-Agent: Aligning Vision, Tools and Aesthetics in Multimodal Agent for Cultural Reasoning on Chinese Porcelains

author.name: Wenhan Wang, Zhixiang Zhou, Zhongtian Ma, Yanzhu Chen, Ziyu Lin, Hao Sheng, Pengfei Liu, Honglin Ma, Wenqi Shao, Qiaosheng Zhang, Yu Qiao

entry.summary: Presents an off-axis compliant Remote Center of Motion joint for neuroendoscopic manipulation with near-isotropic stiffness and minimal parasitic motion. Based on the Tetra II concept with optimized mobility and constraining panels.

entry.title: EBuddy: a workflow orchestrator for industrial human-machine collaboration

author.name: Michele Banfi, Rocco Felici, Stefano Baraldo, Oliver Avram, Anna Valente

entry.summary: Presents EBuddy, a voice-guided workflow orchestrator for industrial human-machine collaboration using finite state machines. Operationalizes expert knowledge as state-grounded constraints for spoken interaction.

entry.title: Vision-Based Robotic Disassembly Combined with Real-Time MFA Data Acquisition

author.name: Federico Zocco, Maria Pozzi, Monica Malvezzi

entry.summary: Presents early work on vision-based robotic disassembly of PC desktops for critical raw material recovery, using edge-device object detection. Combines circular economy goals with robotic automation.

entry.title: Why Corrigibility Matters (If It Matters At All)

author.name: Savannah Harlan

entry.summary: Philosophical discussion of corrigibility's importance, defining it in the general agent-invariant sense of 'correctability'. Explores connections to human morality and why corrigibility matters for AI alignment.

entry.title: EZASP -- Facilitating the usage of ASP

author.name: Rafael Martins, Matthias Knorr, Ricardo Gon\c{c}alves

entry.summary: Presents EZASP, a tool to make Answer Set Programming more accessible to beginners by implementing the Easy ASP methodology with additional structure and a well-defined language fragment. This is a niche programming languages/education contribution.

entry.title: Engineering Mythology: A Digital-Physical Framework for Culturally-Inspired Public Art

author.name: Jnaneshwar Das, Christopher Filkins, Rajesh Moharana, Ekadashi Barik, Bishweshwar Das, David Ayers, Christopher Skiba, Rodney Staggers Jr, Mark Dill, Swig Miller, Daniel Tulberg, Patrick Smith, Seth Brink, Kyle Breen, Harish Anand, Ramon Arrowsmith

entry.summary: Describes the digital-physical workflow for creating 'Navagunjara Reborn' for Burning Man 2025, linking digital sculpting, distributed fabrication, photogrammetry, and digital twins across India and the US.

entry.title: Proposing a Game Theory Approach to Explore Group Dynamics with Social Robot

author.name: Giulia Pusceddu

entry.summary: Proposes using game theory (Public Good Game) to study whether social robots can foster cooperation among group members. Early-stage research proposal for investigating robot influence on group dynamics.

entry.title: RDEx-SOP: Exploitation-Biased Reconstructed Differential Evolution for Fixed-Budget Bound-Constrained Single-Objective Optimization

author.name: Sichen Tao, Yifei Yang, Ruihan Zhao, Kaiyu Wang, Sicheng Liu, Shangce Gao

entry.summary: Documents RDEx-SOP, a differential evolution variant for the IEEE CEC 2025 numerical optimization competition, combining success-history adaptation with exploitation-biased search.

entry.title: RDEx-CSOP: Feasibility-Aware Reconstructed Differential Evolution with Adaptive epsilon-Constraint Ranking

author.name: Sichen Tao, Yifei Yang, Ruihan Zhao, Kaiyu Wang, Sicheng Liu, Shangce Gao

entry.summary: Documents RDEx-CSOP, a constrained differential evolution variant for the IEEE CEC 2025 competition with epsilon-constraint handling.

entry.title: RDEx-MOP: Indicator-Guided Reconstructed Differential Evolution for Fixed-Budget Multiobjective Optimization

author.name: Sichen Tao, Yifei Yang, Ruihan Zhao, Kaiyu Wang, Sicheng Liu, Shangce Gao

entry.summary: Documents RDEx-MOP, a multiobjective differential evolution variant for the IEEE CEC 2025 competition with indicator-based selection.

entry.title: Cost of Cultured Meat: workshop, modeling, resources, feedback

author.name: david reinstein

entry.summary: Announces a workshop and shares resources for modeling cultivated meat cost trajectories and their implications for animal welfare funding decisions. Includes an interactive cost modeling tool.

entry.title: Take note of how brightness makes you feel

author.name: Adam Zerner

entry.summary: Personal account of lighting optimization in living spaces, arguing that typical rooms are too dim (100-500 lux) and that 1000+ lux improves mood and productivity. Discusses the spectrum of SAD-like responses to brightness.

entry.title: On Badness of Death

author.name: MarkelKori

entry.summary: Philosophical discussion of death and life extension ethics across various moral frameworks, presented as a Socratic dialogue. Argues that most ethical systems can justify supporting life extension.

entry.title: God Can Send An Email

author.name: AlphaAndOmega

entry.summary: Personal essay about psychedelic experiences (psilocybin and LSD) by a psychiatry resident dealing with treatment-resistant depression. Explores subjective effects and philosophical reflections.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 30, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research surfaces critical findings about hidden failure modes in LLM training and evaluation, alongside important safety and agent benchmarking work.

  • A study on Chain-of-Thought faithfulness divergence finds that in 55.4% of cases, reasoning models internally acknowledge misleading hints but suppress this in visible answers—a major alignment concern.
  • Sharp capacity scaling analysis of the Muon optimizer vs SGD through associative memory theory provides formal grounding for Muon's empirical gains in LLM training.
  • Weight tying is shown to bias shared embeddings toward the output (unembedding) space due to dominant output gradients—a mechanistic insight relevant to nearly all modern LLMs.
  • When Perplexity Lies demonstrates that distilled hybrid models matching teacher log-likelihood can fail dramatically at generation, exposing a 2× quality gap hidden by standard metrics.

On the applied side, a Judge Agent reduces silent failures in AI-generated scientific simulations from tried-but-wrong to validated outputs. AIRA_2 addresses key bottlenecks in AI research agents with strong MLE-bench results. PAPO stabilizes RLHF by decoupling outcome and process reward advantages, mitigating reward hacking.

  • Beyond identifiability provides finite-sample guarantees for causal representation learning with only logarithmically many interventions.
  • BeSafe-Bench evaluates behavioral safety of situated agents across Web, Mobile, and Embodied domains, finding widespread risk.
  • SWE-PRBench reveals frontier models detect only 15–31% of human-flagged code review issues, exposing a large capability gap.

entry.title: Sharp Capacity Scaling of Spectral Optimizers in Learning Associative Memory

author.name: Juno Kim, Eshaan Nichani, Denny Wu, Alberto Bietti, Jason D. Lee

entry.summary: Provides sharp capacity scaling analysis of Muon vs SGD optimizers through the linear associative memory problem. Shows Muon's storage capacity significantly exceeds SGD's under power law frequency distributions, offering theoretical explanation for Muon's empirical success.

entry.title: Why Models Know But Don't Say: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Divergence Between Thinking Tokens and Answers in Open-Weight Reasoning Models

author.name: Richard J. Young

entry.summary: Studies faithfulness divergence in reasoning models where thinking tokens acknowledge misleading hints that the visible answer omits. In 55.4% of hint-following cases, thinking tokens contain hint-related content absent from the answer, showing directional asymmetry.

entry.title: AIRA_2: Overcoming Bottlenecks in AI Research Agents

author.name: Karen Hambardzumyan, Nicolas Baldwin, Edan Toledo, Rishi Hazra, Michael Kuchnik, Bassel Al Omari, Thomas Simon Foster, Anton Protopopov, Jean-Christophe Gagnon-Audet, Ishita Mediratta, Kelvin Niu, Michael Shvartsman, Alisia Lupidi, Alexis Audran-Reiss, Parth Pathak, Tatiana Shavrina, Despoina Magka, Hela Momand, Derek Dunfield, Nicola Cancedda, Pontus Stenetorp, Carole-Jean Wu, Jakob Nicolaus Foerster, Yoram Bachrach, Martin Josifoski

entry.summary: Introduces AIRA_2, an AI research agent that addresses three bottlenecks: single-GPU throughput, validation-based overfitting, and fixed single-turn LLM operators. Achieves 40.3% on MLE-bench-30 using asynchronous multi-GPU execution, hidden consistent evaluation, and ReAct agents.

entry.title: Beyond identifiability: Learning causal representations with few environments and finite samples

author.name: Inbeom Lee, Tongtong Jin, Bryon Aragam

entry.summary: Provides explicit finite-sample guarantees for learning causal representations with only a logarithmic number of unknown multi-node interventions. Shows that intervention targets need not be designed in advance, bridging the gap between identifiability theory and practical estimation in causal representation learning.

entry.title: A Judge Agent Closes the Reliability Gap in AI-Generated Scientific Simulation

author.name: Chengshuai Yang

entry.summary: Introduces a Judge Agent that automates mathematical validation (well-posedness, convergence, error certification) for AI-generated scientific simulation code. Reduces silent failure rate from 42% to 1.5% across 134 test cases in 12 scientific domains.

entry.title: BeSafe-Bench: Unveiling Behavioral Safety Risks of Situated Agents in Functional Environments

author.name: Yuxuan Li, Yi Lin, Peng Wang, Shiming Liu, Xuetao Wei

entry.summary: Presents BeSafe-Bench, a behavioral safety benchmark for situated AI agents across Web, Mobile, Embodied VLM, and Embodied VLA domains. Uses functional environments with nine categories of safety-critical risks to evaluate unintentional behavioral safety risks.

entry.title: SWE-PRBench: Benchmarking AI Code Review Quality Against Pull Request Feedback

author.name: Deepak Kumar

entry.summary: SWE-PRBench benchmarks AI code review against human pull request feedback with 350 PRs. Finds frontier models detect only 15-31% of human-flagged issues on diff-only configuration, with performance degrading as more context is provided—a surprising finding.

entry.title: When Perplexity Lies: Generation-Focused Distillation of Hybrid Sequence Models

author.name: Juan Gabriel Kostelec, Xiang Wang, Axel Laborieux, Christos Sourmpis, Qinghai Guo

entry.summary: Shows that distilled hybrid models (Transformer to efficient architecture) can match teachers on log-likelihood benchmarks but fail dramatically when generating autoregressively (20.8pp gap), and proposes a Hybrid Kimi Delta Attention architecture with generation-focused distillation.

entry.title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret for Unconstrained Linear Bandits

author.name: Alberto Rumi, Andrew Jacobsen, Nicol\`o Cesa-Bianchi, Fabio Vitale

entry.summary: Achieves the first optimal dynamic regret bound of O(√(d(1+S_T)T)) for unconstrained adversarial linear bandits without prior knowledge of the number of comparator switches S_T, resolving an open problem in the field.

entry.title: SlopCodeBench: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Degrade Over Long-Horizon Iterative Tasks

author.name: Gabriel Orlanski, Devjeet Roy, Alexander Yun, Changho Shin, Alex Gu, Albert Ge, Dyah Adila, Frederic Sala, Aws Albarghouthi

entry.summary: Introduces SlopCodeBench, a benchmark for evaluating how coding agents degrade over iterative development tasks. Tracks verbosity and structural erosion across 20 problems and 93 checkpoints where agents repeatedly extend their own prior solutions.

entry.title: Selective Deficits in LLM Mental Self-Modeling in a Behavior-Based Test of Theory of Mind

author.name: Christopher Ackerman

entry.summary: Develops a novel behavioral test of Theory of Mind for LLMs that requires strategic action rather than mere description. Finds selective deficits in LLM mental self-modeling—models can model others' mental states better than their own across a wide range of models.

entry.title: Reflect to Inform: Boosting Multimodal Reasoning via Information-Gain-Driven Verification

author.name: Shuai Lv, Chang Liu, Feng Tang, Yujie Yuan, Aojun Zhou, Kui Zhang, Xi Yang, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Identifies that MLLMs progressively drift from image evidence during long-form generation, falling back on textual priors. Proposes Visual Re-Examination (VRE), a self-evolving training framework that activates latent visual verification capabilities.

entry.title: Automated near-term quantum algorithm discovery for molecular ground states

author.name: Fabian Finger, Frederic Rapp, Pranav Kalidindi, Kerry He, Kante Yin, Alexander Koziell-Pipe, David Zsolt Manrique, Gabriel Greene-Diniz, Stephen Clark, Hamza Fawzi, Bernardino Romera Paredes, Alhussein Fawzi, Konstantinos Meichanetzidis

entry.summary: Uses the Hive AI platform (LLM-driven evolutionary program synthesis) to automatically discover quantum algorithms for molecular ground state problems. Discovers circuits with significant resource reductions compared to state-of-the-art near-term quantum algorithms.

entry.title: Stabilizing Rubric Integration Training via Decoupled Advantage Normalization

author.name: Zelin Tan, Zhouliang Yu, Bohan Lin, Zijie Geng, Hejia Geng, Yudong Zhang, Mulei Zhang, Yang Chen, Shuyue Hu, Zhenfei Yin, Chen Zhang, Lei Bai

entry.summary: Proposes PAPO, which integrates process-level evaluation into GRPO through decoupled advantage normalization, composing outcome and process rewards separately to avoid reward hacking from process reward models while maintaining richer supervision than outcome-only rewards.

entry.title: Weight Tying Biases Token Embeddings Towards the Output Space

author.name: Antonio Lopardo, Avyukth Harish, Catherine Arnett, Akshat Gupta

entry.summary: Shows that weight tying in language models biases the shared embedding matrix toward the output (unembedding) function due to dominant output gradients early in training, degrading early-layer computations. Proposes gradient scaling as mitigation.

entry.title: Complete Causal Identification from Ancestral Graphs under Selection Bias

author.name: Leihao Chen and Joris M. Mooij

entry.summary: Develops a sound and complete causal identification algorithm for Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAGs) under selection bias. Extends Pearl's causal calculus to a general measure-theoretic version, handling latent variables and selection variables.

entry.title: Can AI Scientist Agents Learn from Lab-in-the-Loop Feedback? Evidence from Iterative Perturbation Discovery

author.name: Gilles Wainrib, Barbara Bodinier, Haitem Dakhli, Josep Monserrat, Almudena Espin Perez, Sabrina Carpentier, Roberta Codato, John Klein

entry.summary: Tests whether LLM-based scientific agents can genuinely learn from experimental feedback in Cell Painting screening, finding a 53.4% increase in discoveries with feedback access. Uses shuffling experiments to distinguish genuine learning from prompt-induced recall.

entry.title: DFM-VLA: Iterative Action Refinement for Robot Manipulation via Discrete Flow Matching

author.name: Jiayi Chen, Wenxuan Song, Shuai Chen, Jingbo Wang, Zhijun Li, and Haoang Li

entry.summary: DFM-VLA introduces discrete flow matching for iterative refinement of action tokens in vision-language-action models for robotics. Unlike autoregressive or discrete diffusion VLAs, it allows revising previously generated tokens across iterations.

entry.title: Mitigating the Reasoning Tax in Vision-Language Fine-Tuning with Input-Adaptive Depth Aggregation

author.name: Yiming Ren, Yujiu Yang, Junjie Wang

entry.summary: Identifies that VLM fine-tuning causes a 'reasoning tax' by disrupting cross-depth representation access. Proposes IADA, a lightweight input-adaptive depth aggregation mechanism that restores reasoning performance with +9 points on Qwen3-VL-2B.

entry.title: Generation Is Compression: Zero-Shot Video Coding via Stochastic Rectified Flow

author.name: Ziyue Zeng, Xun Su, Haoyuan Liu, Bingyu Lu, Yui Tatsumi, Hiroshi Watanabe

entry.summary: Proposes GVC, a zero-shot video compression framework that uses pretrained video generative models as the codec itself, converting deterministic rectified-flow ODEs to SDEs at inference for codebook-driven compression without retraining.

entry.title: GaussianGPT: Towards Autoregressive 3D Gaussian Scene Generation

author.name: Nicolas von L\"utzow, Barbara R\"ossle, Katharina Schmid, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner

entry.summary: Introduces GaussianGPT, a fully autoregressive transformer that generates 3D Gaussian scenes via next-token prediction, using a sparse 3D convolutional autoencoder with vector quantization and 3D rotary positional embeddings.

entry.title: Detecting Non-Membership in LLM Training Data via Rank Correlations

author.name: Pranav Shetty and Mirazul Haque and Zhiqiang Ma and Xiaomo Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a dataset-level non-membership detection test using rank correlations in normalized token log probabilities between models. Shows models that haven't seen a dataset exhibit higher rank correlation than when one has been trained on it.

entry.title: Fus3D: Decoding Consolidated 3D Geometry from Feed-forward Geometry Transformer Latents

author.name: Laura Fink, Linus Franke, George Kopanas, Marc Stamminger, Peter Hedman

entry.summary: Proposes Fus3D, a feed-forward method for dense SDF regression from unstructured images in under 3 seconds without camera calibration. Key insight: intermediate features of pretrained geometry transformers already encode a powerful joint world representation that existing pipelines discard.

entry.title: Clawed and Dangerous: Can We Trust Open Agentic Systems?

author.name: Shiping Chen, Qin Wang, Guangsheng Yu, Xu Wang, Liming Zhu

entry.summary: Analyzes fundamental security challenges of open agentic systems (coding assistants, browser copilots) where plans are generated at runtime from untrusted inputs, actions use delegated authority, and everything is probabilistic.

entry.title: Ask or Assume? Uncertainty-Aware Clarification-Seeking in Coding Agents

author.name: Nicholas Edwards, Sebastian Schuster

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLM agents' ability to ask clarifying questions when facing underspecified coding tasks, proposing an uncertainty-aware multi-agent scaffold that achieves 69.4% resolve rate on an underspecified SWE-bench variant, significantly outperforming single-agent baselines.

entry.title: GUIDE: Resolving Domain Bias in GUI Agents through Real-Time Web Video Retrieval and Plug-and-Play Annotation

author.name: Rui Xie, Zhi Gao, Chenrui Shi, Zirui Shang, Lu Chen, and Qing Li

entry.summary: GUIDE is a training-free framework that resolves domain bias in GUI agents by automatically mining domain-specific expertise from web tutorial videos through retrieval-augmented annotation. Addresses the gap between general VLM capabilities and domain-specific software operation knowledge.

entry.title: Switch Attention: Towards Dynamic and Fine-grained Hybrid Transformers

author.name: Yusheng Zhao, Hourun Li, Bohan Wu, Jingyang Yuan, Meng Zhang, Yichun Yin, Lifeng Shang, Ming Zhang

entry.summary: Switch Attention (SwiAttn) enables dynamic per-token routing between full attention and sliding window attention in transformers. Each token adaptively chooses its attention pattern, enabling fine-grained efficiency-performance trade-offs.

entry.title: Can AI Models Direct Each Other? Organizational Structure as a Probe into Training Limitations

author.name: Rui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ManagerWorker, a two-agent pipeline where an expensive text-only manager model directs a cheap worker model for SWE-bench tasks. A strong manager + weak worker (62%) matches a strong single agent (60%) at lower cost.

entry.title: Entanglement as Memory: Mechanistic Interpretability of Quantum Language Models

author.name: Nathan Roll

entry.summary: First mechanistic interpretability study of quantum language models, showing that two-qubit models with entangling gates learn qualitatively different memory strategies than classical baselines, while single-qubit models are exactly classically simulable.

entry.title: The internal law of a material can be discovered from its boundary

author.name: Francesco Regazzoni

entry.summary: Introduces Neural-DFEM, a method that discovers hyperelastic material laws from boundary-only measurements by embedding a differentiable finite element solver in the learning loop. This removes the need for full-field displacement or stress-strain data.

entry.title: How Open Must Language Models be to Enable Reliable Scientific Inference?

author.name: James A. Michaelov, Catherine Arnett, Tyler A. Chang, Pamela D. Rivi\`ere, Samuel M. Taylor, Cameron R. Jones, Sean Trott, Roger P. Levy, Benjamin K. Bergen, Micah Altman

entry.summary: Analyzes how restrictions on model openness (closed vs. open models) threaten reliable scientific inference, arguing that closed models are generally ill-suited for scientific research. Recommends systematic identification of inference threats and model selection justifications.

entry.title: The Limits of Learning from Pictures and Text: Vision-Language Models and Embodied Scene Understanding

author.name: Gillian Rosenberg, Skylar Stadhard, Bruce C. Hansen, Michelle R. Greene

entry.summary: Compares 18 VLMs to 2,000+ human observers across 15 scene understanding tasks including affordances, sensory experiences, and future prediction, finding VLMs excel at general knowledge but struggle with embodied understanding like sensory properties.

entry.title: VGGRPO: Towards World-Consistent Video Generation with 4D Latent Reward

author.name: Zhaochong An, Orest Kupyn, Th\'eo Uscidda, Andrea Colaco, Karan Ahuja, Serge Belongie, Mar Gonzalez-Franco, Marta Tintore Gazulla

entry.summary: Proposes VGGRPO, a latent geometry-guided framework for post-training video diffusion models to improve geometric consistency, introducing 4D latent rewards computed in latent space to avoid costly VAE decoding and extending to dynamic scenes.

entry.title: Learning to Commit: Generating Organic Pull Requests via Online Repository Memory

author.name: Mo Li, L.H. Xu, Qitai Tan, Ting Cao, and Yunxin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes 'Learning to Commit,' a framework for coding agents that learns repository-specific change patterns from commit history via Online Repository Memory, producing more 'organic' pull requests that respect project conventions and avoid internal API duplication.

entry.title: VLA-OPD: Bridging Offline SFT and Online RL for Vision-Language-Action Models via On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Zhide Zhong, Haodong Yan, Junfeng Li, Junjie He, Tianran Zhang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes VLA-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework for Vision-Language-Action models that bridges offline SFT and online RL by having an expert teacher provide dense token-level supervision on the student's self-generated trajectories.

entry.title: Consistency Amplifies: How Behavioral Variance Shapes Agent Accuracy

author.name: Aman Mehta

entry.summary: Studies behavioral consistency of LLM-based coding agents on SWE-bench, comparing Claude 4.5 Sonnet, GPT-5, and Llama-3.1-70B. Finds higher consistency correlates with higher accuracy across models, but within a model, consistency can amplify both correct and incorrect patterns.

entry.title: On the Expressive Power of Contextual Relations in Transformers

author.name: Demi\'an Fraiman

entry.summary: Introduces a measure-theoretic framework for transformer expressiveness, modeling texts as probability measures and contextual relations as coupling measures. Proves a universal approximation theorem for the proposed Sinkhorn Transformer architecture.

entry.title: Dynamic Tokenization via Reinforcement Patching: End-to-end Training and Zero-shot Transfer

author.name: Yulun Wu, Sravan Kumar Ankireddy, Samuel Sharpe, Nikita Seleznev, Dehao Yuan, Hyeji Kim, Nam H. Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes ReinPatch, the first framework to jointly optimize sequence patching policy and downstream backbone using reinforcement learning. Formulates patch boundary placement as a discrete decision process, enabling variable-sized data-driven patches for time series.

entry.title: LEMON: a foundation model for nuclear morphology in Computational Pathology

author.name: Lo\"ic Chadoutaud (1, 2, 3), Alice Blondel (1, 2, 3), Hana Feki (1, 2, 3), Jacqueline Fontugne (4, 5), Emmanuel Barillot (1, 2, 3), Thomas Walter (1, 2, 3) ((1) Institut Curie, Paris, France, (2) Mines Paris PSL, Centre for Computational Biology (CBIO), Paris, France, (3) INSERM U1331, Paris, France, (4) Institut Curie, U1353/UMR9029 IRIS, Equipe IMPACT, Paris, France, (5) Department of Pathology, Universit\'e Paris-Saclay, UVSQ, Institut Curie, Saint-Cloud, France)

entry.summary: Introduces LEMON, a self-supervised foundation model for single-cell image representation learning in computational pathology. Trained on millions of cell images from diverse tissues and cancer types for scalable single-cell analyses.

entry.title: ExVerus: Verus Proof Repair via Counterexample Reasoning

author.name: Jun Yang, Yuechun Sun, Yi Wu, Rodrigo Caridad, Yongwei Yuan, Jianan Yao, Shan Lu, Kexin Pei

entry.summary: Presents EXVERUS, a counterexample-guided framework enabling LLMs to reason about Verus proofs using behavioral feedback. When proofs fail, it generates counterexamples and guides the LLM to generalize them into inductive invariants.

entry.title: "Oops! ChatGPT is Temporarily Unavailable!": A Diary Study on Knowledge Workers' Experiences of LLM Withdrawal

author.name: Eunseo Oh, Suyoun Lee, Jae Young Choi, Soobin Park, Youn-kyung Lim

entry.summary: A diary study with 10 knowledge workers examining what happens when LLMs are temporarily withdrawn from work practices. Finds LLMs have become infrastructural to knowledge work, with withdrawal disrupting workflows but also leading participants to reclaim professional values.

entry.title: Beyond Where to Look: Trajectory-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal RLVR

author.name: Jinda Lu, Junkang Wu, Jinghan Li, Kexin Huang, Shuo Yang, Mingzhu Chen, Jiancan Wu, Kuien Liu, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: TGRL proposes trajectory-guided reinforcement learning for multimodal LLMs that guides models to integrate visual evidence into fine-grained reasoning using expert trajectories from stronger models, with token-level reweighting and trajectory filtering.

entry.title: Sparse Auto-Encoders and Holism about Large Language Models

author.name: Jumbly Grindrod

entry.summary: Examines whether sparse autoencoders challenge the holistic interpretation of LLM semantics, arguing that the discovery of interpretable latent features may undermine claims that LLMs implement meaning holism. A philosophical analysis of mechanistic interpretability.

entry.title: ARTA: Adaptive Mixed-Resolution Token Allocation for Efficient Dense Feature Extraction

author.name: David Hagerman, Roman Naeem, Erik Brorsson, Fredrik Kahl, Lennart Svensson

entry.summary: ARTA introduces a mixed-resolution coarse-to-fine vision transformer that starts with low-resolution tokens and adaptively allocates finer tokens near semantic boundaries. This targeted allocation reduces computation while maintaining strong dense prediction performance.

entry.title: PhysVid: Physics Aware Local Conditioning for Generative Video Models

author.name: Saurabh, Pathak, Elahe Arani, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Bahram Zonooz

entry.summary: PhysVid introduces physics-aware local conditioning for video generation, operating over temporally contiguous chunks with physics-grounded descriptions. Uses negative physics prompts at inference to steer generation away from physically implausible trajectories.

entry.title: From Human Cognition to Neural Activations: Probing the Computational Primitives of Spatial Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Jiyuan An, Liner Yang, Mengyan Wang, Luming Lu, Weihua An, Erhong Yang

entry.summary: Probes spatial reasoning in LLMs by decomposing it into three cognitive primitives: relational composition, representational transformation, and stateful updating. Evaluates multilingual LLMs and analyzes internal representations using linear probes.

entry.title: MPDiT: Multi-Patch Global-to-Local Transformer Architecture For Efficient Flow Matching and Diffusion Model

author.name: Quan Dao, Dimitris Metaxas

entry.summary: MPDiT introduces a multi-patch transformer for diffusion/flow-matching models where early blocks use larger patches for global context and later blocks use smaller patches for local details. Reduces computation by up to 50% in GFLOPs.

entry.title: Realtime-VLA V2: Learning to Run VLAs Fast, Smooth, and Accurate

author.name: Chen Yang, Yucheng Hu, Yunchao Ma, Yunhuan Yang, Jing Tan, Haoqiang Fan

entry.summary: Realtime-VLA V2 describes practical deployment techniques for running VLA models on real robots at speeds approaching human operation. Covers calibration, planning & control, and methods to identify optimal execution speed.

entry.title: A Formal Framework for Uncertainty Analysis of Text Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Steffen Herbold, Florian Lemmerich

entry.summary: Provides a formal framework for measuring uncertainty in LLM text generation that models prompting, generation, and interpretation as interconnected autoregressive processes in a sampling tree. Shows how existing uncertainty methods are special cases.

entry.title: 120 Minutes and a Laptop: Minimalist Image-goal Navigation via Unsupervised Exploration and Offline RL

author.name: Xiaoming Liu, Borong Zhang, Qingbiao Li, Steven Morad

entry.summary: MINav achieves image-goal visual navigation by collecting data and training a policy in under 120 minutes on a consumer laptop with no human intervention. Uses offline goal-conditioned RL with unsupervised exploration and hindsight relabeling.

entry.title: Conditional Diffusion for 3D CT Volume Reconstruction from 2D X-rays

author.name: Martin Rath, Morteza Ghahremani, Yitong Li, Ashkan Taghipour, Marcus Makowski, Christian Wachinger

entry.summary: Proposes AXON, a multi-stage diffusion framework that reconstructs 3D CT volumes from real (not synthetic) 2D X-rays using a coarse-to-fine strategy with Brownian Bridge diffusion. This addresses a clinically important gap since most prior work relied on synthetic projections.

entry.title: Beyond MACs: Hardware Efficient Architecture Design for Vision Backbones

author.name: Moritz Nottebaum, Matteo Dunnhofer, Christian Micheloni

entry.summary: Demonstrates that MACs are a poor proxy for execution time on edge devices and proposes LowFormer, a vision backbone family with Lowtention (lightweight attention alternative) optimized for actual hardware efficiency rather than theoretical FLOP counts.

entry.title: Make Geometry Matter for Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Shihua Zhang, Qiuhong Shen, Shizun Wang, Tianbo Pan, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoSR, a framework that makes VLMs actively reason with geometry tokens by introducing Geometry-Unleashing Masking that strategically masks visual portions to force reliance on geometric cues for spatial reasoning.

entry.title: PerceptionComp: A Video Benchmark for Complex Perception-Centric Reasoning

author.name: Shaoxuan Li, Zhixuan Zhao, Hanze Deng, Zirun Ma, Shulin Tian, Zuyan Liu, Yushi Hu, Haoning Wu, Yuhao Dong, Benlin Liu, Ziwei Liu, and Ranjay Krishna

entry.summary: Introduces PerceptionComp, a manually annotated benchmark of 1,114 questions on 279 videos requiring complex, multi-hop visual reasoning across temporally separated evidence, where human performance significantly exceeds current MLLMs.

entry.title: Ruka-v2: Tendon Driven Open-Source Dexterous Hand with Wrist and Abduction for Robot Learning

author.name: Xinqi (Lucas) Liu, Ruoxi Hu, Alejandro Ojeda Olarte, Zhuoran Chen, Kenny Ma, Charles Cheng Ji, Lerrel Pinto, Raunaq Bhirangi, Irmak Guzey

entry.summary: Presents Ruka-v2, an open-source tendon-driven humanoid hand adding 2-DOF wrist and finger abduction/adduction over the original Ruka, buildable for under $1,300, with teleoperation demonstrations.

entry.title: Label-Free Cross-Task LoRA Merging with Null-Space Compression

author.name: Wonyoung Lee, Wooseong Jeong, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: NSC Merging proposes a label-free, output-agnostic method for cross-task LoRA merging based on null-space compression geometry. Works across classification and regression tasks, unlike entropy-based approaches.

entry.title: Evaluating Neural Language Models as Cognitive Models of Language Acquisition

author.name: H\'ector Javier V\'azquez Mart\'inez, Annika Lea Heuser, Charles Yang, Jordan Kodner

entry.summary: Argues that prominent benchmarks for evaluating LMs' syntactic capabilities lack structural diversity found in linguistic studies. Shows that when trained on child-scale data, LMs can be matched by simple baselines, questioning their value as cognitive models of language acquisition.

entry.title: Adversarial News and Lost Profits: Manipulating Headlines in LLM-Driven Algorithmic Trading

author.name: Advije Rizvani, Giovanni Apruzzese, Pavel Laskov

entry.summary: Demonstrates that adversarial manipulations of news headlines can mislead LLM-based algorithmic trading systems, quantifying the monetary risk. Adversarial content remains invisible to human readers but affects LLM sentiment analysis.

entry.title: Unlocking Strong Supervision: A Data-Centric Study of General-Purpose Audio Pre-Training Methods

author.name: Xuanru Zhou, Yiwen Shao, Wei-Cheng Tseng, Dong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces a data-centric pipeline for audio pre-training with a high-fidelity captioner creating strong labels and the first Unified Tag System bridging speech, music, and environmental sounds. Shows data quality drives performance more than pre-training objective choice.

entry.title: RealChart2Code: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Real Data and Multi-Task Evaluation

author.name: Jiajun Zhang, Yuying Li, Zhixun Li, Xingyu Guo, Jingzhuo Wu, Leqi Zheng, Yiran Yang, Jianke Zhang, Qingbin Li, Shannan Yan, Zhetong Li, Changguo Jia, Junfei Wu, Zilei Wang, Qiang Liu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces RealChart2Code, a large-scale benchmark with 2,800+ instances for evaluating VLMs on chart generation from real-world data. First to evaluate iterative code refinement in multi-turn settings, revealing significant performance gaps in current models.

entry.title: When Identities Collapse: A Stress-Test Benchmark for Multi-Subject Personalization

author.name: Zhihan Chen, Yuhuan Zhao, Yijie Zhu, Xinyu Yao

entry.summary: Identifies the 'Illusion of Scalability' in multi-subject text-to-image models: while models handle 2-4 subjects well, they suffer catastrophic identity collapse at 6-10 subjects. Constructs a 75-prompt stress-test benchmark to systematically evaluate this failure.

entry.title: DataFlex: A Unified Framework for Data-Centric Dynamic Training of Large Language Models

author.name: Hao Liang, Zhengyang Zhao, Meiyi Qiang, Mingrui Chen, Lu Ma, Rongyi Yu, Hengyi Feng, Shixuan Sun, Zimo Meng, Xiaochen Ma, Xuanlin Yang, Qifeng Cai, Ruichuan An, Bohan Zeng, Zhen Hao Wong, Chengyu Shen, Runming He, Zhaoyang Han, Yaowei Zheng, Fangcheng Fu, Conghui He, Bin Cui, Zhiyu Li, Weinan E, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: DataFlex presents a unified framework for data-centric dynamic LLM training built on LLaMA-Factory, supporting sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting in a single system with consistent interfaces.

entry.title: A Universal Vibe? Finding and Controlling Language-Agnostic Informal Register with SAEs

author.name: Uri Z. Kialy and Avi Shtarkberg and Ayal Klein

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to probe whether informal language register (slang) is represented as language-specific or universal features in Gemma-2-9B-IT across English, Hebrew, and Russian. Finds a small but robust set of language-agnostic informal register features.

entry.title: Preference-Aligned LoRA Merging: Preserving Subspace Coverage and Addressing Directional Anisotropy

author.name: Wooseong Jeong, Wonyoung Lee, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: TARA-Merging addresses LoRA module merging by analyzing subspace coverage and directional anisotropy. Proposes preference-weighted alignment of merging weights to preserve critical task-specific directions during multi-LoRA combination.

entry.title: SALMUBench: A Benchmark for Sensitive Association-Level Multimodal Unlearning

author.name: Cai Selvas-Sala, Lei Kang, Lluis Gomez

entry.summary: SALMUBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating fine-grained association-level forgetting in multimodal models like CLIP. Built on synthetic persona-attribute data with controlled Compromised and Clean models trained from scratch on 400M pairs.

entry.title: DiffusionAnything: End-to-End In-context Diffusion Learning for Unified Navigation and Pre-Grasp Motion

author.name: Iana Zhura, Yara Mahmoud, Jeffrin Sam, Hung Khang Nguyen, Didar Seyidov, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: DiffusionAnything presents a unified image-space diffusion policy handling both navigation and manipulation with only 5 minutes of self-supervised data per task. Uses multi-scale FiLM conditioning and trajectory-aligned depth projection.

entry.title: ClipTTT: CLIP-Guided Test-Time Training Helps LVLMs See Better

author.name: Mriganka Nath, Anurag Das, Jiahao Xie, and Bernt Schiele

entry.summary: ClipTTT uses CLIP's image-text alignment as guidance for test-time training of LVLMs under visual corruptions. Adapts LVLMs on-the-fly with a single test sample to mitigate corruption-induced hallucinations.

entry.title: Rocks, Pebbles and Sand: Modality-aware Scheduling for Multimodal Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Konstantinos Papaioannou and Thaleia Dimitra Doudali

entry.summary: Proposes RPS-Serve, a modality-aware scheduler for multimodal LLM inference that classifies requests by resource demand (videos as 'rocks', images as 'pebbles', text as 'sand') to avoid head-of-line blocking. This addresses a real systems bottleneck as multimodal workloads become dominant in production LLM serving.

entry.title: CADSmith: Multi-Agent CAD Generation with Programmatic Geometric Validation

author.name: Jesse Barkley, Rumi Loghmani, and Amir Barati Farimani

entry.summary: Presents CADSmith, a multi-agent pipeline for text-to-CAD generation using CadQuery code with two nested correction loops: one for execution errors and one for geometric validation using OpenCASCADE measurements plus a vision-language model judge.

entry.title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification

author.name: Zehai He, Wenyi Hong, Zhen Yang, Ziyang Pan, Mingdao Liu, Xiaotao Gu, Jie Tang

entry.summary: Introduces Vision2Web, a hierarchical benchmark for visual website development spanning static UI generation to full-stack development, with 193 tasks, 918 prototype images, and workflow-based agent verification using GUI agents and VLM judges.

entry.title: Tunable Soft Equivariance with Guarantees

author.name: Md Ashiqur Rahman, Lim Jun Hao, Jeremiah Jiang, Teck-Yian Lim, Raymond A. Yeh

entry.summary: Proposes a general framework for constructing soft equivariant models by projecting weights into a designed subspace, with theoretical bounds on equivariance error. Applicable to any pretrained architecture including ViT and ResNet.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Depth from Defocus

author.name: Yiming Zuo, Hongyu Wen, Venkat Subramanian, Patrick Chen, Karhan Kayan, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide, Jia Deng

entry.summary: Proposes FOSSA, a Transformer-based architecture for zero-shot depth from defocus with a novel stack attention layer and focus distance embedding, plus a new real-world benchmark ZEDD with 8.3x more scenes than previous benchmarks.

entry.title: Contrastive Conformal Sets

author.name: Yahya Alkhatib and Wee Peng Tay

entry.summary: Extends conformal prediction to contrastive learning by constructing minimum-volume conformal sets with learnable multi-norm constraints. Guarantees coverage of positive samples while maximizing negative sample exclusion.

entry.title: KMM-CP: Practical Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift via Selective Kernel Mean Matching

author.name: Siddhartha Laghuvarapu, Rohan Deb, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Proposes KMM-CP, a conformal prediction framework using Kernel Mean Matching for covariate-shift correction. Shows KMM directly controls bias-variance components governing coverage error, improving stability when training and test distributions have limited overlap.

entry.title: Fundamental Limits of Neural Network Sparsification: Evidence from Catastrophic Interpretability Collapse

author.name: Dip Roy, Rajiv Misra, Sanjay Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Investigates whether interpretable features survive extreme neural network sparsification (90% activation reduction) in VAE-SAE architectures. Discovers a paradox where global representation quality improves while fine-grained interpretability collapses.

entry.title: Sommelier: Scalable Open Multi-turn Audio Pre-processing for Full-duplex Speech Language Models

author.name: Kyudan Jung, Jihwan Kim, Soyoon Kim, Jeongoon Kim, Jaegul Choo, Cheonbok Park

entry.summary: Presents Sommelier, an open-source data processing pipeline for full-duplex speech language models, addressing the scarcity of high-quality multi-speaker conversational data by handling overlapping speech, back-channeling, and diarization errors.

entry.title: ReCUBE: Evaluating Repository-Level Context Utilization in Code Generation

author.name: Jiseung Hong, Benjamin G. Ascoli, Jinho D. Choi

entry.summary: Introduces ReCUBE, a benchmark measuring how well LLMs leverage repository-level context during code generation by having them reconstruct masked files using surrounding repository context.

entry.title: ViGoR-Bench: How Far Are Visual Generative Models From Zero-Shot Visual Reasoners?

author.name: Haonan Han, Jiancheng Huang, Xiaopeng Sun, Junyan He, Rui Yang, Jie Hu, Xiaojiang Peng, Lin Ma, Xiaoming Wei, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Introduces ViGoR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating visual reasoning in generative AI models across image-to-image and video tasks. Features dual-track evaluation of intermediate processes and final results with evidence-grounded automated judging.

entry.title: ATime-Consistent Benchmark for Repository-Level Software Engineering Evaluation

author.name: Xianpeng (Simon) Sun, Haonan Sun, Tian Yu, Sheng Ma, Qincheng Zhang, Lifei Rao, Chen Tian

entry.summary: Proposes a time-consistent benchmark methodology for repository-level software engineering evaluation that addresses temporal contamination by snapshotting repositories at time T0 and evaluating on future pull requests in (T0, T1].

entry.title: Gaussian Shannon: High-Precision Diffusion Model Watermarking Based on Communication

author.name: Yi Zhang, Hongbo Huang, Liang-Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Gaussian Shannon proposes a watermarking framework for diffusion models that treats the diffusion process as a noisy communication channel, enabling both robust tracing and exact bit recovery from AI-generated images.

entry.title: Dynamic Token Compression for Efficient Video Understanding through Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shida Wang and YongXiang Hua and Zhou Tao and Haoyu Cao and Linli Xu

entry.summary: SCORE proposes RL-based adaptive video token compression using a surprise-augmented state representation with inter-frame residuals. A lightweight policy network learns where to compress visual tokens based on temporal dynamics and motion saliency.

entry.title: OVI-MAP:Open-Vocabulary Instance-Semantic Mapping

author.name: Zilong Deng, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Johanna Wald, Daniel Barath

entry.summary: Introduces OVI-MAP for incremental open-vocabulary 3D instance-semantic mapping that decouples instance reconstruction from semantic inference, building class-agnostic 3D maps from RGB-D and applying VLM features only to selected views for efficiency.

entry.title: A Lyapunov Analysis of Softmax Policy Gradient for Stochastic Bandits

author.name: Tor Lattimore

entry.summary: Adapts Lyapunov analysis of softmax policy gradient from continuous to discrete time for k-armed stochastic bandits, proving regret bounds of O(k log(k) log(n)/η) with appropriately chosen learning rate.

entry.title: Machine Unlearning under Retain-Forget Entanglement

author.name: Jingpu Cheng, Ping Liu, Qianxiao Li, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-phase optimization framework for machine unlearning when retain and forget sets are entangled via shared features or semantic similarity, using augmented Lagrangian methods and Wasserstein-regularized gradient projection.

entry.title: Beyond Language: Grounding Referring Expressions with Hand Pointing in Egocentric Vision

author.name: Ling Li, Bowen Liu, Zinuo Zhan, Peng Jie, Jianhui Zhong, Kenglun Chang, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: Introduces EgoPoint-Ground, the first large-scale dataset (15K+ samples) for egocentric deictic visual grounding combining hand-pointing and speech for object localization, with multi-grained annotations including hand-target bounding box pairs.

entry.title: Detailed Geometry and Appearance from Opportunistic Motion

author.name: Ryosuke Hirai, Kohei Yamashita, Antoine Gu\'edon, Ryo Kawahara, Vincent Lepetit, Ko Nishino

entry.summary: Exploits opportunistic object motion in scenes captured by fixed cameras to obtain additional virtual viewpoints for 3D reconstruction, handling the coupled challenges of pose estimation and appearance variation under static illumination using 2D Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: Learning to Recorrupt: Noise Distribution Agnostic Self-Supervised Image Denoising

author.name: Brayan Monroy, Jorge Bacca, Juli\'an Tachella

entry.summary: Presents Learning to Recorrupt (L2R), a self-supervised image denoising method that doesn't require knowledge of the noise distribution. Uses a learnable monotonic neural network to learn the recorruption process through a min-max objective.

entry.title: Generative Score Inference for Multimodal Data

author.name: Xinyu Tian and Xiaotong Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Generative Score Inference (GSI), a framework using deep generative models to create synthetic samples for approximating conditional score distributions, enabling uncertainty quantification across multimodal learning problems.

entry.title: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models for Conditional Density Estimation in Regression

author.name: Rafael Izbicki and Pedro L. C. Rodrigues

entry.summary: Benchmarks tabular foundation models (TabPFN, TabICL) as conditional density estimators against traditional CDE methods on 39 real-world datasets. Finds foundation models don't consistently dominate but show strong performance at small sample sizes.

entry.title: ETA-VLA: Efficient Token Adaptation via Temporal Fusion and Intra-LLM Sparsification for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yiru Wang, Anqing Jiang, Shuo Wang, Yuwen Heng, Zichong Gu, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes ETA-VLA, an efficient Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous driving that reduces computational cost via temporal token fusion and intra-LLM sparse aggregation. Dynamically prunes redundant visual tokens guided by textual queries.

entry.title: Doctorina MedBench: End-to-End Evaluation of Agent-Based Medical AI

author.name: Anna Kozlova, Stanislau Salavei, Pavel Satalkin, Hanna Plotnitskaya, Sergey Parfenyuk

entry.summary: Presents Doctorina MedBench, an evaluation framework for agent-based medical AI through simulated physician-patient dialogues. Uses the D.O.T.S. metric covering Diagnosis, Observations, Treatment, and dialogue efficiency.
