entry.summary: Proposes RefReward-SR, an LR-reference-aware reward model for preference-aligned super-resolution that moves beyond GT-dependent metrics to better match human perceptual preferences.

entry.title: Le MuMo JEPA: Multi-Modal Self-Supervised Representation Learning with Learnable Fusion Tokens

author.name: Ciem Cornelissen, Sam Leroux, Pieter Simoens

entry.summary: Presents Le MuMo JEPA, a self-supervised framework that learns unified representations from RGB images and companion modalities (LiDAR depth, thermal) using learnable fusion tokens as a latent bottleneck in a shared transformer. Extends the JEPA paradigm to multi-modal settings for driving and ADAS applications.

entry.title: The Gait Signature of Frailty: Transfer Learning based Deep Gait Models for Scalable Frailty Assessment

author.name: Laura McDaniel, Basudha Pal, Crystal Szczesny, Yuxiang Guo, Ryan Roemmich, Peter Abadir, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Introduces a publicly available silhouette-based frailty gait dataset and uses transfer learning from large gait recognition models to assess frailty in older adults, including those using walking aids.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Reactive Simulation for Closed-Loop Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Harsh Yadav, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Proposes a goal-oriented closed-loop training paradigm for trajectory prediction with a reactive transformer-based scene decoder, addressing covariate shift from open-loop training.

entry.title: Finding X-Risks and S-Risks by Gradient Descent

author.name: dspeyer

entry.summary: Proposes using gradient descent to find adversarial inputs (backdoors, failure modes) in neural networks as a way to search for X-risks and S-risks, drawing analogy from backdoor detection in image classifiers to broader AI safety concerns.

entry.title: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Understand 3D Spatial Relationships?

author.name: Xianzheng Ma, Tao Sun, Shuai Chen, Yash Bhalgat, Jindong Gu, Angel X Chang, Iro Armeni, Iro Laina, Songyou Peng, Victor Adrian Prisacariu

entry.summary: This paper reveals that fine-tuning a language model on text-only QA pairs can match or surpass 3D-LLMs on SQA3D without any 3D input, suggesting the benchmark allows textual shortcuts. They introduce Real-3DQA, a more rigorous benchmark filtering easy-to-guess questions with structured taxonomy for 3D reasoning assessment.

entry.title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature

author.name: Pouria Mortezaagha, Arya Rahgozar

entry.summary: Proposes GraLC-RAG, a framework combining late chunking with graph-aware structural intelligence for biomedical RAG, including structure-aware chunking, UMLS knowledge graph infusion, and graph-guided hybrid retrieval. Argues MRR is insufficient for full-text scientific documents.

entry.title: Graphs RAG at Scale: Beyond Retrieval-Augmented Generation With Labeled Property Graphs and Resource Description Framework for Complex and Unknown Search Spaces

author.name: Manie Tadayon, Mayank Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces a Graph RAG framework combining Labeled Property Graphs and RDF architectures for handling unknown or semi-structured search spaces, with a novel method for converting documents into RDF triplets using JSON key-value pairs.

entry.title: Do Consumers Accept AIs as Moral Compliance Agents?

author.name: Greg Nyilasy, Abraham Ryan Ade Putra Hito, Jennifer Overbeck, Brock Bastian, Darren W. Dahl

entry.summary: Studies whether consumers accept AI in moral compliance roles (upholding pre-existing norms) versus moral agency roles, finding consumers prefer AI over humans for compliance due to perceived lack of ulterior motives. Five studies provide evidence.

entry.title: URA-Net: Uncertainty-Integrated Anomaly Perception and Restoration Attention Network for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Luo, Peng Xing, Yunkang Cao, Haiming Yao, Weiming Shen, Zechao Li

entry.summary: Proposes URA-Net for unsupervised anomaly detection that explicitly restores abnormal patterns to normality rather than just reconstructing normal patterns, using uncertainty-integrated multi-level semantic features.

entry.title: HUydra: Full-Range Lung CT Synthesis via Multiple HU Interval Generative Modelling

author.name: Ant\'onio Cardoso, Pedro Sousa, Tania Pereira, H\'elder P. Oliveira

entry.summary: Introduces a novel decomposition strategy for synthesizing lung CT images one Hounsfield Unit interval at a time, reducing computational demands of full-range CT synthesis for medical imaging data augmentation.

entry.title: AuthorMix: Modular Authorship Style Transfer via Layer-wise Adapter Mixing

author.name: Sarubi Thillainathan, Ji-Ung Lee, Michael Sullivan, Alexander Koller

entry.summary: Proposes AuthorMix, a modular framework for authorship style transfer using individual LoRA adapters trained on high-resource authors, combined via learned layer-wise mixing for new target styles from few examples.

entry.title: Biased Error Attribution in Multi-Agent Human-AI Systems Under Delayed Feedback

author.name: Teerthaa Parakh, Karen M. Feigh

entry.summary: Studies biased error attribution in multi-agent human-AI systems with delayed feedback, finding asymmetric responses to gains and losses consistent with loss aversion in how humans attribute blame across multiple AI agents.

entry.title: AscendOptimizer: Episodic Agent for Ascend NPU Operator Optimization

author.name: Jiehao Wu, Zixiao Huang, Wenhao Li, Chuyun Shen, Junjie Sheng, Xiangfeng Wang

entry.summary: Presents AscendOptimizer, an episodic agent that optimizes operator performance on Huawei Ascend NPUs through profiling-driven evolutionary search and experience transfer, addressing the knowledge gap in non-CUDA AI accelerators.

entry.title: APreQEL: Adaptive Mixed Precision Quantization For Edge LLMs

author.name: Meriem Bouzouad, Yuan-Hao Chang, Jalil Boukhobza

entry.summary: Proposes APreQEL, an adaptive mixed-precision quantization method for deploying LLMs on edge devices, accounting for different layers' sensitivity to reduced precision.

entry.title: Lightweight Fairness for LLM-Based Recommendations via Kernelized Projection and Gated Adapters

author.name: Nan Cui, Wendy Hui Wang, Yue Ning

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight bias mitigation method for LLM-based recommender systems combining kernelized null-space projection with gated Mixture-of-Experts adapters to remove sensitive attributes without additional training.

entry.title: Unveiling Hidden Convexity in Deep Learning: a Sparse Signal Processing Perspective

author.name: Emi Zeger, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: Survey/review paper highlighting how convex equivalences of ReLU neural networks connect to sparse signal processing, potentially addressing optimization challenges in deep learning through hidden convexity in loss landscapes.

entry.title: Causality-Driven Disentangled Representation Learning in Multiplex Graphs

author.name: Saba Nasiri, Selin Aviyente, Dorina Thanou

entry.summary: Introduces CaDeM, a causal inference-based framework for disentangling shared and layer-specific representations in multiplex graphs using backdoor adjustment to ensure proper separation.

entry.title: Cost-Sensitive Neighborhood Aggregation for Heterophilous Graphs: When Does Per-Edge Routing Help?

author.name: Eyal Weiss

entry.summary: Introduces CSNA, a GNN layer with per-edge routing through concordant/discordant channels based on learned pairwise distances, with theoretical analysis distinguishing adversarial vs. informative heterophily regimes.

entry.title: Large Language Model Guided Incentive Aware Reward Design for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dogan Urgun, Gokhan Gungor

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to automatically synthesize reward programs for cooperative multi-agent RL, evaluating candidates by training policies from scratch under fixed compute budgets.

entry.title: No Single Metric Tells the Whole Story: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Uncertainty Attributions

author.name: Emily Schiller, Teodor Chiaburu, Marco Zullich, Luca Longo

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional evaluation framework for uncertainty attributions in XAI, aligned with the Co-12 framework, introducing metrics for correctness, consistency, continuity, compactness, and a new conveyance property.

entry.title: LLMORPH: Automated Metamorphic Testing of Large Language Models

author.name: Steven Cho, Stefano Ruberto, Valerio Terragni

entry.summary: LLMORPH is an automated testing tool for LLMs performing NLP tasks that uses metamorphic testing to detect faulty behaviors without human-labeled data, leveraging metamorphic relations to generate follow-up test inputs.

entry.title: {\lambda}Split: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy

author.name: Federico Carrara, Talley Lambert, Mehdi Seifi, Florian Jug

entry.summary: λSplit is a self-supervised, physics-informed deep generative model for spectral unmixing in fluorescence microscopy, recovering individual fluorophore concentrations from mixed emission spectra without ground truth data.

entry.title: Object Search in Partially-Known Environments via LLM-informed Model-based Planning and Prompt Selection

author.name: Abhishek Paudel, Abhish Khanal, Raihan I. Arnob, Shahriar Hossain, Gregory J. Stein

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-informed model-based planning framework for object search in partially-known environments, using LLMs to estimate object location likelihoods combined with travel costs for efficient search planning.

entry.title: MedAidDialog: A Multilingual Multi-Turn Medical Dialogue Dataset for Accessible Healthcare

author.name: Shubham Kumar Nigam, Suparnojit Sarkar, Piyush Patel

entry.summary: MedAidDialog is a multilingual multi-turn medical dialogue dataset covering seven languages, generated using LLMs to simulate physician-patient consultations, extending the MDDial corpus.

entry.title: A Neuro-Symbolic System for Interpretable Multimodal Physiological Signals Integration in Human Fatigue Detection

author.name: Mohammadreza Jamalifard, Yaxiong Lei, Parasto Azizinezhad, Javier Fumanal-Idocin, Javier Andreu-Perez

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic architecture for fatigue detection from eye-tracking and fNIRS data, combining attention-based encoders with differentiable approximate reasoning rules for interpretable multimodal physiological signal integration.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Consistency Verification Improves Uncertainty Calibration in Medical MCQA

author.name: John Ray B. Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent framework with domain-specific specialist agents and two-phase self-verification for improving uncertainty calibration in medical multiple-choice QA, using S-Score weighted fusion.

entry.title: From Physician Expertise to Clinical Agents: Preserving, Standardizing, and Scaling Physicians' Medical Expertise with Lightweight LLM

author.name: Chanyong Luo, Jirui Dai, Zhendong Wang, Kui Chen, Jiaxi Yang, Bingjie Lu, Jing Wang, Jiaxin Hao, Bing Li, Ruiyang He, Yiyu Qiao, Chenkai Zhang, Kaiyu Wang, Zhi Liu, Zeyu Zheng, Yan Li, Xiaohong Gu

entry.summary: Med-Shicheng proposes a framework for LLMs to learn and transfer distinguished physicians' diagnostic-and-therapeutic philosophy using lightweight models. It aims to standardize and scale expert clinical knowledge that is typically slow to develop and hard to transmit. Built on a specific medical knowledge architecture.

entry.title: Revisiting Real-Time Digging-In Effects: No Evidence from NP/Z Garden-Paths

author.name: Amani Maina-Kilaas, Roger Levy

entry.summary: Two experiments on English NP/Z garden-path sentences investigate 'digging-in effects' in human sentence processing, comparing human behavior with LLM predictions. Finds no evidence for real-time digging-in effects, supporting surprisal theory over self-organized processing accounts.

entry.title: Swiss-Bench SBP-002: A Frontier Model Comparison on Swiss Legal and Regulatory Tasks

author.name: Fatih Uenal

entry.summary: Swiss-Bench SBP-002 is a trilingual benchmark of 395 expert-crafted items covering Swiss regulatory compliance across FINMA, Legal-CH, and EFK domains. Evaluates ten frontier models from March 2026 using a structured three-dimension scoring framework with LLM panel judges.

entry.title: PLACID: Privacy-preserving Large language models for Acronym Clinical Inference and Disambiguation

author.name: Manjushree B. Aithal, Ph. D., Alexander Kotz, James Mitchell, Ph. D

entry.summary: PLACID introduces a privacy-preserving cascaded pipeline using small on-device models for clinical acronym disambiguation, avoiding the need to transmit Protected Health Information to external servers. Addresses a practical safety concern in healthcare NLP deployment.

entry.title: When AI Meets Early Childhood Education: Large Language Models as Assessment Teammates in Chinese Preschools

author.name: Xingming Li, Runke Huang, Yanan Bao, Yuye Jin, Yuru Jiao, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Investigates whether AI can serve as scalable assessment tool for teacher-child interaction quality in Chinese preschools. Creates TEPE-TCI-370h dataset and validates AI-extracted quality indicators against human expert judgments across 250,000+ kindergartens.

entry.title: Foundation Model Embeddings Meet Blended Emotions: A Multimodal Fusion Approach for the BLEMORE Challenge

author.name: Masoumeh Chapariniya, Aref Farhadipour, Sarah Ebling, Volker Dellwo, Teodora Vukovic

entry.summary: System for blended emotion recognition combining six encoder families through late fusion. Notable for first use of Gemini Embedding 2.0 for emotion recognition, achieving competitive results from only 2 seconds of video input.

entry.title: Mind the Hitch: Dynamic Calibration and Articulated Perception for Autonomous Trucks

author.name: Morui Zhu, Yongqi Zhu, Song Fu, Qing Yang

entry.summary: Introduces dCAP, a vision-based framework for autonomous trucking that continuously estimates the 6-DoF relative pose between tractor and trailer cameras, addressing the unique articulated geometry challenge of autonomous trucks.

entry.title: An Adapter-free Fine-tuning Approach for Tuning 3D Foundation Models

author.name: Sneha Paul, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila

entry.summary: Proposes MCFT, an adapter-free fine-tuning approach for 3D point cloud foundation models that selectively fine-tunes parts of the encoder while enforcing momentum-based consistency constraints to prevent overfitting in low-data regimes.

entry.title: 3D-LLDM: Label-Guided 3D Latent Diffusion Model for Improving High-Resolution Synthetic MR Imaging in Hepatic Structure Segmentation

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Jaehyeok Bae, Youngung Han, Joo Young Bae, Seoyoung Ju, Junsu Lim, Gyeongmin Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-LLDM, a label-guided 3D latent diffusion model that generates synthetic MR volumes with corresponding segmentation masks for hepatic structure segmentation, using ControlNet-based architecture guided by structural masks.

entry.title: Latent Bias Alignment for High-Fidelity Diffusion Inversion in Real-World Image Reconstruction and Manipulation

author.name: Weiming Chen, Qifan Liu, Siyi Liu, Yushun Tang, Yijia Wang, Zhihan Zhu, Zhihai He

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Bias Alignment for diffusion model inversion, addressing trajectory misalignment between inversion and generation and mismatch with VQ autoencoder reconstruction for high-fidelity real image reconstruction.

entry.title: DecepGPT: Schema-Driven Deception Detection with Multicultural Datasets and Robust Multimodal Learning

author.name: Jiajian Huang, Dongliang Zhu, Zitong YU, Hui Ma, Jiayu Zhang, Chunmei Zhu, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Introduces DecepGPT for multimodal deception detection with structured reasoning chains, along with a new multicultural dataset T4-Deception spanning diverse cultural contexts and scenarios.

entry.title: HyDRA: Hybrid Domain-Aware Robust Architecture for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception

author.name: Minwoo Song, Minhee Kang, Heejin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes HyDRA for collaborative perception that handles heterogeneity in model architectures and data distributions via a unified pipeline integrating intermediate and late fusion with domain-aware routing.

entry.title: HGGT: Robust and Flexible 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Images

author.name: Yumeng Liu, Xiao-Xiao Long, Marc Habermann, Xuanze Yang, Cheng Lin, Yuan Liu, Yuexin Ma, Wenping Wang, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HGGT for 3D hand mesh reconstruction that works with both calibrated and uncalibrated multi-view images, bridging the gap between single-view ease of deployment and multi-view accuracy.

entry.title: A convergent Plug-and-Play Majorization-Minimization algorithm for Poisson inverse problems

author.name: Thibaut Modrzyk (CREATIS), Ane Etxebeste (CREATIS), \'Elie Bretin (ICJ, MMCS), Voichita Maxim (CREATIS)

entry.summary: Presents a convergent plug-and-play algorithm for Poisson inverse problems using majorization-minimization framework with pre-trained Gaussian denoisers, providing convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Heuristic Self-Paced Learning for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation under Adverse Conditions

author.name: Shiqin Wang, Haoyang Chen, Huaizhou Huang, Yinkan He, Dongfang Sun, Xiaoqing Chen, Xingyu Liu, Zheng Wang, Kaiyan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based autonomous class scheduler for domain adaptive semantic segmentation under adverse weather, casting curriculum learning as a sequential decision problem with a policy-gradient approach.

entry.title: GeoRouter: Dynamic Paradigm Routing for Worldwide Image Geolocalization

author.name: Pengyue Jia, Derong Xu, Yingyi Zhang, Xiaopeng Li, Wenlin Zhang, Yi Wen, Yuanshao Zhu, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes GeoRouter, a dynamic routing framework for image geolocalization that adaptively selects between retrieval-based and generation-based paradigms depending on the query. Exploits complementary error profiles between the two approaches.

entry.title: CliPPER: Contextual Video-Language Pretraining on Long-form Intraoperative Surgical Procedures for Event Recognition

author.name: Florian Stilz, Vinkle Srivastav, Nassir Navab, Nicolas Padoy

entry.summary: Introduces CliPPER, a video-language pretraining framework for surgical procedure understanding trained on surgical lecture videos, designed for fine-grained temporal recognition in intraoperative settings.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models vs Human: Perceptual Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Imran Mehmood, Imad Ali Shah, Ming Ronnier Luo, Brian Deegan

entry.summary: Benchmarks six VLMs against human psychophysical data for perceptual image quality assessment across contrast, colorfulness, and preference scales. Finds strong attribute-dependent variability in VLM-human alignment.

entry.title: Decentralized End-to-End Multi-AAV Pursuit Using Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation via Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yude Li, Zhexuan Zhou, Huizhe Li, Yanke Sun, Yenan Wu, Yichen Lai, Yiming Wang, Youmin Gong, Jie Mei

entry.summary: Proposes a decentralized end-to-end MARL framework for cooperative aerial pursuit using raw LiDAR observations, with a Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation representation that unifies obstacle geometry with adversarial intent prediction.

entry.title: Toward Generalist Neural Motion Planners for Robotic Manipulators: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Ivan Lopez-Sanchez, Hao Su, Yunzhu Li, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: A survey paper on generalist neural motion planners for robotic manipulators, analyzing challenges and opportunities in achieving out-of-distribution generalization for motion planning in cluttered environments.

entry.title: Don't Write Off Human Labor, Yet

author.name: burnssa

entry.summary: Argues that human labor may remain necessary even with aligned AI, challenging the assumption of wholesale labor substitution. The post identifies two key conditions: market demand must be defined by human preferences, and human labor must remain complementary to AI capital. Points to labor data suggesting growing demand for human 'specification' inputs.

entry.title: SEGAR: Selective Enhancement for Generative Augmented Reality

author.name: Fanjun Bu, Chenyang Yuan, Hiroshi Yasuda

entry.summary: Presents SEGAR, a framework combining diffusion-based world models with selective correction for augmented reality, generating augmented future frames with region-specific edits while maintaining safety-critical alignment with real observations.

entry.title: HyFI: Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation for Brain-Vision Alignment

author.name: Sangmin Jo, Wootaek Jeong, Da-Woon Heo, Yoohwan Hwang, Heung-Il Suk

entry.summary: Uses hyperbolic space for brain-vision alignment, addressing the modality gap between brain signals and images and the entanglement of semantic/perceptual features in neural activity through hyperbolic feature interpolation.

entry.title: PersonalQ: Select, Quantize, and Serve Personalized Diffusion Models for Efficient Inference

author.name: Qirui Wang, Qi Guo, Yiding Sun, Junkai Yang, Dongxu Zhang, Shanmin Pang, Qing Guo

entry.summary: Presents PersonalQ, a framework for serving personalized diffusion model checkpoints that connects checkpoint selection and quantization through trigger tokens, addressing ambiguous routing and quantization distortion of personalized concepts.

entry.title: MERIT: Memory-Enhanced Retrieval for Interpretable Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Runze Li, Kedi Chen, Guwei Feng, Mo Yu, Jun Wang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MERIT, a training-free knowledge tracing framework combining frozen LLM reasoning with structured pedagogical memory, transforming raw interaction logs into educational insights without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Enhancing AI-Based Tropical Cyclone Track and Intensity Forecasting via Systematic Bias Correction

author.name: Peisong Niu, Haifan Zhang, Yang Zhao, Tian Zhou, Ziqing Ma, Wenqiang Shen, Junping Zhao, Huiling Yuan, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes systematic bias correction for AI-based tropical cyclone forecasting, addressing discretization errors from coarse ERA5 grids and intensity prediction biases from regression losses, especially for strong TCs.

entry.title: GraphRAG for Engineering Diagrams: ChatP&ID Enables LLM Interaction with P&IDs

author.name: Achmad Anggawirya Alimin, Artur M. Schweidtmann

entry.summary: Introduces ChatP&ID, an agentic framework for natural-language interaction with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams using GraphRAG, transforming DEXPI-standard P&IDs into knowledge graphs for grounded, cost-effective querying.

entry.title: flexvec: SQL Vector Retrieval with Programmatic Embedding Modulation

author.name: Damian Delmas

entry.summary: Introduces flexvec, a retrieval system that exposes the embedding matrix and score array as a programmable surface for composable query-time operations (Programmatic Embedding Modulation), achieving 19ms end-to-end on 240K chunks.

entry.title: DALDALL: Data Augmentation for Lexical and Semantic Diverse in Legal Domain by leveraging LLM-Persona

author.name: Janghyeok Choi, Jaewon Lee, Sungzoon Cho

entry.summary: Introduces DALDALL, a persona-based data augmentation framework for legal information retrieval that uses LLM personas (attorneys, prosecutors, judges) to generate diverse synthetic queries, improving lexical and semantic diversity over vanilla prompting.

entry.title: From Overload to Convergence: Supporting Multi-Issue Human-AI Negotiation with Bayesian Visualization

author.name: Mehul Parmar, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Designs a Bayesian visualization tool for multi-issue human-AI negotiation that shows how the space of acceptable agreements narrows over time, finding it improves negotiation outcomes when issues exceed three.

entry.title: A Multimodal Framework for Human-Multi-Agent Interaction

author.name: Shaid Hasan, Breenice Lee, Sujan Sarker, Tariq Iqbal

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction where each robot operates as an autonomous cognitive agent with LLM-driven planning, coordinated through centralized turn-taking mechanisms.

entry.title: Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction

author.name: Benjamin Lange

entry.summary: Analyzes the ethics of Unilateral Relationship Revision Power (URRP) in human-AI companion interactions, arguing that providers' constitutive control over AI companions undermines the normative foundations of personal relationships.

entry.title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT

author.name: Zixiang Jiang, Yulun Zhang, Rishi Veerapaneni, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Dependency PIBT for multi-agent path finding that generalizes PIBT by planning over agent dependencies, allowing paths that conflict with multiple agents simultaneously.

entry.title: PoiCGAN: A Targeted Poisoning Based on Feature-Label Joint Perturbation in Federated Learning

author.name: Tao Liu, Jiguang Lv, Dapeng Man, Weiye Xi, Yaole Li, Feiyu Zhao, Kuiming Wang, Yingchao Bian, Chen Xu, Wu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a targeted poisoning attack on federated learning using conditional GANs for joint feature-label perturbation, designed to bypass model performance tests and anomaly detection defenses.

entry.title: CDMT-EHR: A Continuous-Time Diffusion Framework for Generating Mixed-Type Time-Series Electronic Health Records

author.name: Shaonan Liu, Yuichiro Iwashita, Soichiro Nakako, Masakazu Iwamura, Koichi Kise

entry.summary: Proposes CDMT-EHR, a continuous-time diffusion framework for generating synthetic mixed-type time-series electronic health records, using bidirectional GRUs and addressing limitations of discrete-time formulations.

entry.title: Kirchhoff-Inspired Neural Networks for Evolving High-Order Perception

author.name: Tongfei Chen, Jingying Yang, Linlin Yang, Jinhu L\"u, David Doermann, Chunyu Xie, Long He, Tian Wang, Juan Zhang, Guodong Guo, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Kirchhoff-inspired neural networks that draw on electrical circuit theory to model signal intensity, coupling structure, and state evolution, going beyond standard weight-bias parameterization inspired by biological neurons.

entry.title: Efficient Controller Learning from Human Preferences and Numerical Data Via Multi-Modal Surrogate Models

author.name: Lukas Theiner, Maik Pfefferkorn, Yongpeng Zhao, Sebastian Hirt, Rolf Findeisen

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-modal Bayesian optimization framework integrating low-fidelity numerical data with high-fidelity human preferences for controller tuning, using hierarchical multi-output GP surrogates.

entry.title: Embracing Heteroscedasticity for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yijun Wang, Qiyuan Zhuang, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a heteroscedastic VAE framework (LSG-VAE) for probabilistic time series forecasting that models time-varying conditional variances, addressing the homoscedastic limitation of MSE-based training.

entry.title: MDKeyChunker: Single-Call LLM Enrichment with Rolling Keys and Key-Based Restructuring for High-Accuracy RAG

author.name: Bhavik Mangla

entry.summary: MDKeyChunker is a three-stage RAG pipeline for Markdown documents that performs structure-aware chunking, single-call LLM enrichment with rolling key dictionaries, and key-based restructuring via bin-packing for improved retrieval.

entry.title: Walma: Learning to See Memory Corruption in WebAssembly

author.name: Oussama Draissi, Mark G\"unzel, Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi, Lucas Davi

entry.summary: Walma uses machine learning to detect memory corruption and external tampering in WebAssembly by classifying memory snapshots, providing runtime integrity verification against adversarial hosts.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Learning of Probability Distributions: A Case Study in a Digital Trial of Young Children with Type 1 Diabetes

author.name: Antonio \'Alvarez-L\'opez, Marcos Matabuena

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework for modeling continuous-time evolution of glucose distributions using CGM data from a pediatric Type 1 diabetes trial, representing distributions as Gaussian mixtures with time-varying weights.

entry.title: IslamicMMLU: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Islamic Knowledge

author.name: Ali Abdelaal, Mohammed Nader Al Haffar, Mahmoud Fawzi, Walid Magdy

entry.summary: IslamicMMLU is a benchmark of 10,013 multiple-choice questions across Quran, Hadith, and Fiqh for evaluating LLMs on Islamic knowledge. Evaluation of 26 LLMs shows accuracy ranging from 39.8% to 93.8%, with the Quran track showing the widest performance spread.

entry.title: ConceptKT: A Benchmark for Concept-Level Deficiency Prediction in Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Yu-Chen Kang, Yu-Chien Tang, An-Zi Yen

entry.summary: ConceptKT introduces concept-level deficiency prediction in knowledge tracing, extending beyond binary correctness to identify specific concepts students struggle with. Includes a dataset with labels capturing both required and missing concepts.

entry.title: Variation is the Norm: Embracing Sociolinguistics in NLP

author.name: Anne-Marie Lutgen, Alistair Plum, Verena Blaschke, Barbara Plank, Christoph Purschke

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining sociolinguistics with NLP, arguing that language variation should be embraced rather than normalized away. Case study on Luxembourgish demonstrates how orthographic variation impacts NLP performance, with large discrepancies across models.

entry.title: Semantic Alignment across Ancient Egyptian Language Stages via Normalization-Aware Multitask Learning

author.name: He Huang

entry.summary: Studies word-level semantic alignment across four historical stages of Ancient Egyptian using multitask learning with a shared byte-level tokenizer. Combines MLM, TLM, translation, and POS tagging with Latin transliteration and IPA reconstruction as auxiliary views.

entry.title: A Sociolinguistic Analysis of Automatic Speech Recognition Bias in Newcastle English

author.name: Dana Serditova, Kevin Tang

entry.summary: Sociolinguistic analysis of ASR bias in Newcastle English using the DECTE corpus, classifying 3,000+ transcription errors by linguistic category. Shows how dialectal variation from mainstream accents degrades commercial ASR performance.

entry.title: Evaluating a Multi-Agent Voice-Enabled Smart Speaker for Care Homes: A Safety-Focused Framework

author.name: Zeinab Dehghani, Rameez Raja Kureshi, Koorosh Aslansefat, Faezeh Alsadat Abedi, Dhavalkumar Thakker, Lisa Greaves, Bhupesh Kumar Mishra, Baseer Ahmad, Tanaya Maslekar

entry.summary: Evaluates a multi-agent voice-enabled smart speaker for care homes using a safety-focused framework combining Whisper ASR with RAG. Tests 330 spoken transcripts across 11 care categories from supervised care-home trials.

entry.title: CoRe: Joint Optimization with Contrastive Learning for Medical Image Registration

author.name: Eytan Kats, Christoph Grossbroehmer, Ziad Al-Haj Hemidi, Fenja Falta, Wiebke Heyer, Mattias P. Heinrich

entry.summary: Proposes CoRe, a framework that integrates equivariant contrastive learning directly into medical image registration models, jointly optimizing registration and feature learning rather than using separate pre-training stages.

entry.title: DepthArb: Training-Free Depth-Arbitrated Generation for Occlusion-Robust Image Synthesis

author.name: Hongjin Niu, Jiahao Wang, Xirui Hu, Weizhan Zhang, Lan Ma, Yuan Gao

entry.summary: Proposes DepthArb, a training-free framework for resolving occlusion ambiguities in text-to-image diffusion by arbitrating attention competition between objects based on depth ordering.

entry.title: LGTM: Training-Free Light-Guided Text-to-Image Diffusion Model via Initial Noise Manipulation

author.name: Ryugo Morita, Stanislav Frolov, Brian Bernhard Moser, Ko Watanabe, Riku Takahashi, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: Proposes LGTM, a training-free method for lighting control in text-to-image diffusion by manipulating initial latent noise, avoiding the need for post-generation relighting or fine-tuning.

entry.title: B-MoE: A Body-Part-Aware Mixture-of-Experts "All Parts Matter" Approach to Micro-Action Recognition

author.name: Nishit Poddar, Aglind Reka, Diana-Laura Borza, Snehashis Majhi, Michal Balazia, Abhijit Das, Francois Bremond

entry.summary: Introduces B-MoE, a body-part-aware mixture-of-experts framework for micro-action recognition where each expert specializes in a distinct body region with cross-attention routing for inter-region relationships.

entry.title: RS-SSM: Refining Forgotten Specifics in State Space Model for Video Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Kai Zhu, Zhenyu Cui, Zehua Zang, Jiahuan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes RS-SSM for video semantic segmentation using state space models, addressing the forgotten specifics problem in fixed-size state space compression through complementary refinement mechanisms.

entry.title: ViHOI: Human-Object Interaction Synthesis with Visual Priors

author.name: Songjin Cai, Linjie Zhong, Ling Guo, Changxing Ding

entry.summary: Introduces ViHOI, a framework for 3D human-object interaction synthesis that extracts rich interaction priors from 2D images using VLMs, rather than relying solely on text descriptions of physical constraints.

entry.title: EndoVGGT: GNN-Enhanced Depth Estimation for Surgical 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Falong Fan, Yi Xie, Arnis Lektauers, Bo Liu, Jerzy Rozenblit

entry.summary: Proposes EndoVGGT, a framework for surgical 3D reconstruction that uses a Deformation-aware Graph Attention module to dynamically construct semantic graphs for robust depth estimation across occlusions in deformable tissue.

entry.title: The Free-Market Algorithm: Self-Organizing Optimization for Open-Ended Complex Systems

author.name: Martin Jaraiz

entry.summary: Introduces the Free-Market Algorithm, a metaheuristic optimization inspired by free-market economics where fitness is emergent through supply-and-demand dynamics rather than prescribed, with open-ended search spaces and hierarchical pathway networks.

entry.title: Accelerated Spline-Based Time-Optimal Motion Planning with Continuous Safety Guarantees for Non-Differentially Flat Systems

author.name: Dries Dirckx, Jan Swevers, Wilm Decr\'e

entry.summary: Proposes a spline-based time-optimal motion planning method that decouples separating hyperplane computation from the optimal control problem, significantly reducing computational cost for collision-free trajectory generation.

entry.title: Self Paced Gaussian Contextual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mohsen Sahraei Ardakani, Rui Song

entry.summary: Proposes SPGL, a self-paced curriculum learning method for contextual RL that uses closed-form Gaussian distribution updates instead of expensive inner-loop optimizations, with theoretical convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Towards Training-Free Scene Text Editing

author.name: Yubo Li, Xugong Qin, Peng Zhang, Hailun Lin, Gangyan Zeng, Kexin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TextFlow, a training-free scene text editing framework using Attention Boost and Flow Manifold Steering to modify text in images while maintaining visual realism without requiring task-specific training.

entry.title: Equivariant Filter Transformations for Consistent and Efficient Visual--Inertial Navigation

author.name: Chungeng Tian, Fenghua He, Ning Hao

entry.summary: Presents an equivariant filter transformation approach for visual-inertial navigation, establishing analytical links between filters with different symmetries to enable systematic consistency design and efficient implementation.

entry.title: Linear-Nonlinear Fusion Neural Operator for Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Heng Wu, Junjie Wang, Benzhuo Lu

entry.summary: Introduces LNF-NO, a neural operator that explicitly decouples linear and nonlinear effects through multiplicative fusion, achieving lightweight and interpretable PDE solving.

entry.title: Forecasting with Guidance: Representation-Level Supervision for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jiacheng Wang, Liang Fan, Baihua Li, Luyan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ReGuider, a plug-in method using pretrained time series foundation models as semantic teachers to provide representation-level supervision for forecasting models during training.

entry.title: Spectral Scalpel: Amplifying Adjacent Action Discrepancy via Frequency-Selective Filtering for Skeleton-Based Action Segmentation

author.name: Haoyu Ji, Bowen Chen, Zhihao Yang, Wenze Huang, Yu Gao, Xueting Liu, Weihong Ren, Zhiyong Wang, Honghai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Spectral Scalpel for skeleton-based temporal action segmentation using frequency-selective filtering to amplify differences between adjacent actions and sharpen transition boundaries.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Pareto Optimization: Trade-off Characterization for Assist-as-Needed Training and Performance Evaluation

author.name: Harun Tolasa, Volkan Patoglu

entry.summary: Proposes a human-in-the-loop Pareto optimization approach using Bayesian multi-criteria optimization to characterize trade-offs between task performance and perceived challenge in motor rehabilitation.

entry.title: STEM Agent: A Self-Adapting, Tool-Enabled, Extensible Architecture for Multi-Protocol AI Agent Systems

author.name: Alfred Shen, Aaron Shen

entry.summary: Introduces STEM Agent, a modular architecture inspired by biological pluripotency that unifies five interoperability protocols (A2A, AG-UI, A2UI, UCP, AP2) behind a single gateway and introduces a Caller Profiler for learning user preferences across agent interactions.

entry.title: CLiGNet: Clinical Label-Interaction Graph Network for Medical Specialty Classification from Clinical Transcriptions

author.name: Pronob Kumar Barman, Pronoy Kumar Barman

entry.summary: Introduces CLiGNet for medical specialty classification, first documenting a critical data leakage flaw (SMOTE before train/test split) in prior MTSamples benchmarks, then proposing a GCN-based approach combining Bio-ClinicalBERT with label interaction graphs.

entry.title: Ran Score: a LLM-based Evaluation Score for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Ran Zhang, Yucong Lin, Zhaoli Su, Bowen Liu, Danni Ai, Tianyu Fu, Deqiang Xiao, Jingfan Fan, Yuanyuan Wang, Mingwei Gao, Yuwan Hu, Shuya Gao, Jingtao Li, Jian Yang, Hong Song, Hongliang Sun

entry.title: JFTA-Bench: Evaluate LLM's Ability of Tracking and Analyzing Malfunctions Using Fault Trees

author.name: Yuhui Wang, Zhixiong Yang, Ming Zhang, Shihan Dou, Zhiheng Xi, Enyu Zhou, Senjie Jin, Yujiong Shen, Dingwei Zhu, Yi Dong, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

entry.title: Online library learning in human visual puzzle solving

author.name: Pinzhe Zhao, Emanuele Sansone, Marta Kryven, Bonan Zhao

entry.summary: Studies how humans form reusable abstractions in visual puzzle solving, showing a shift from completeness-focused to efficiency-focused helper creation with experience. Computational modeling aligns with library learning theories.

entry.title: Emergency Preemption Without Online Exploration: A Decision Transformer Approach

author.name: Haoran Su, Hanxiao Deng, Yandong Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a Decision Transformer approach for emergency vehicle signal preemption that eliminates online exploration, enables urgency control via return conditioning, and extends to multi-agent settings. Reduces EV travel time by 37.7%.

entry.title: Unveiling the Mechanism of Continuous Representation Full-Waveform Inversion: A Wave Based Neural Tangent Kernel Framework

author.name: Ruihua Chen, Yisi Luo, Bangyu Wu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Develops a wave-based neural tangent kernel framework to explain why continuous representation FWI (using implicit neural representations) reduces dependence on initial models in full-waveform inversion, addressing slower high-frequency convergence.

entry.title: SynLeaF: A Dual-Stage Multimodal Fusion Framework for Synthetic Lethality Prediction Across Pan- and Single-Cancer Contexts

author.name: Zheming Xing, Siyuan Zhou, Ruinan Wang, Rui Han, Shiming Zhang, Shiqu Chen, Yurui Huang, Jiahao Ma, Yifan Chen, Xuan Wang, Yadong Wang, Junyi Li

entry.summary: Proposes SynLeaF, a dual-stage multimodal fusion framework for synthetic lethality prediction in cancer drug development, addressing modality laziness through a VAE-based cross-encoder with product of experts mechanism.

entry.title: AwesomeLit: Towards Hypothesis Generation with Agent-Supported Literature Research

author.name: Zefei Xie, Yuhan Guo, Kai Xu

entry.summary: Introduces AwesomeLit, a human-agent collaborative visualization system for literature research that helps inexperienced researchers identify gaps and generate hypotheses, addressing the black-box nature of LLM-based research tools.

entry.title: TDATR: Improving End-to-End Table Recognition via Table Detail-Aware Learning and Cell-Level Visual Alignment

author.name: Chunxia Qin, Chenyu Liu, Pengcheng Xia, Jun Du, Baocai Yin, Bing Yin, Cong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes TDATR for end-to-end table recognition using table detail-aware learning and cell-level visual alignment with a perceive-then-fuse strategy for jointly understanding table structure and content.

entry.title: DariMis: Harm-Aware Modeling for Dari Misinformation Detection on YouTube

author.name: Jawid Ahmad Baktash, Mosa Ebrahimi, Mohammad Zarif Joya, Mursal Dawodi

entry.summary: Introduces DariMis, the first annotated dataset of 9,224 Dari-language YouTube videos for misinformation detection, labeled for both information type and harm level. Shows these dimensions are structurally coupled.

entry.title: Can an LLM Detect Instances of Microservice Infrastructure Patterns?

author.name: Carlos Eduardo Duarte, Neil B. Harrison, Filipe Figueiredo Correia, Ademar Aguiar, Pavl\'ina Gon\c{c}alves

entry.summary: Develops MicroPAD, a tool using GPT-5 nano to identify architectural patterns in microservice infrastructure artifacts. Tests LLM effectiveness for pattern detection across multiple programming languages.

entry.title: A Learning Method with Gap-Aware Generation for Heterogeneous DAG Scheduling

author.name: Ruisong Zhou, Haijun Zou, Li Zhou, Chumin Sun, Zaiwen Wen

entry.summary: Proposes WeCAN, an end-to-end RL framework for heterogeneous DAG scheduling that addresses task-pool compatibility and generation-induced optimality gaps with a two-stage single-pass design.

entry.title: WISTERIA: Weak Implicit Signal-based Temporal Relation Extraction with Attention

author.name: Duy Dao Do, Ana\"is Halftermeyer, Thi-Bich-Hanh Dao

entry.summary: Proposes WISTERIA, a framework for temporal relation extraction that identifies pair-specific implicit signals rather than globally salient tokens, examining whether attention components actually encode interpretable temporal evidence.

entry.title: Contrastive Metric Learning for Point Cloud Segmentation in Highly Granular Detectors

author.name: Max Marriott-Clarke, Lazar Novakovic, Elizabeth Ratzer, Robert J. Bainbridge, Loukas Gouskos, Benedikt Maier

entry.summary: Proposes contrastive metric learning for point cloud segmentation in particle physics calorimeters, learning a latent space where same-object points cluster together then using density-based readout.

entry.title: Dual-Criterion Curriculum Learning: Application to Temporal Data

author.name: Gaspard Abel, Eloi Campagne, Mohamed Benloughmari, Argyris Kalogeratos

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Criterion Curriculum Learning combining loss-based and density-based difficulty assessment for temporal data, calibrating training evidence under consideration of data sparsity.

entry.title: MetaKube: An Experience-Aware LLM Framework for Kubernetes Failure Diagnosis

author.name: Wei Sun, Ting Wang, Xinran Tian, Wanshun Lan, Xuhan Feng, Haoyue Li, Fangxin Wang

entry.summary: MetaKube is an LLM framework for Kubernetes failure diagnosis that learns from past operational experience through episodic pattern memory, meta-cognitive routing between intuitive/analytical pathways, and a locally-deployable 8B model. It addresses the static knowledge limitation of existing LLM-based diagnostic systems.

entry.title: Kronecker-Structured Nonparametric Spatiotemporal Point Processes

author.name: Zhitong Xu, Qiwei Yuan, Yinghao Chen, Yan Sun, Bin Shen, Shandian Zhe

entry.summary: Proposes KSTPP, a Kronecker-structured nonparametric spatiotemporal point process that enables interpretable event-wise relationship discovery while maintaining modeling flexibility through GP priors and Kronecker structure.

entry.title: Mixed-signal implementation of feedback-control optimizer for single-layer Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Jonathan Haag, Christian Metzner, Dmitrii Zendrikov, Giacomo Indiveri, Benjamin Grewe, Chiara De Luca, Matteo Saponati

entry.summary: Demonstrates proof-of-concept implementation of feedback-control optimizers for on-chip training of spiking neural networks on mixed-signal neuromorphic hardware, matching numerical simulation performance.

entry.title: PLDR-LLMs Reason At Self-Organized Criticality

author.name: Burc Gokden

entry.summary: Claims that PLDR-LLMs pretrained at self-organized criticality exhibit reasoning at inference time, drawing analogies to second-order phase transitions, universality classes, and renormalization groups from statistical physics.

entry.title: The Mass Agreement Score: A Point-centric Measure of Cluster Size Consistency

author.name: Randolph Wiredu-Aidoo

entry.summary: Introduces the Mass Agreement Score (MAS), a point-centric metric for evaluating cluster size uniformity that is stable under label-count perturbations, addressing instability in traditional cluster evaluation metrics.

entry.title: Praxium: Diagnosing Cloud Anomalies with AI-based Telemetry and Dependency Analysis

author.name: Rohan Kumar, Jason Li, Zongshun Zhang, Syed Mohammad Qasim, Gianluca Stringhini, Ayse Kivilcim Coskun

entry.summary: Praxium uses AI-based telemetry analysis and dependency graphs to diagnose cloud microservice anomalies, automating root cause analysis that traditionally requires expert input.

entry.title: Trust Region Constrained Bayesian Optimization with Penalized Constraint Handling

author.name: Raju Chowdhury, Tanmay Sen, Prajamitra Bhuyan, Biswabrata Pradhan

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian optimization method combining penalty formulation with trust region strategy for constrained optimization in high-dimensional black-box settings.

entry.title: Konkani LLM: Multi-Script Instruction Tuning and Evaluation for a Low-Resource Indian Language

author.name: Reuben Chagas Fernandes, Gaurang S. Patkar

entry.summary: Introduces Konkani-Instruct-100k, a synthetic instruction-tuning dataset for Konkani (a low-resource Indian language) generated through Gemini 3, and develops fine-tuned models handling multiple scripts (Devanagari, Romi, Kannada). Evaluates against open-weight and proprietary models.

entry.title: Infrequent Child-Directed Speech Is Bursty and May Draw Infant Vocalizations

author.name: Margaret Cychosz, Adriana Weisleder

entry.summary: Using longform audio recordings from rural Bolivia and urban U.S., this study finds that child-directed speech, even when infrequent, arrives in concentrated bursts rather than spread across the day. Infants were most likely to vocalize during periods of directed speech.

entry.title: Argument Mining as a Text-to-Text Generation Task

author.name: Masayuki Kawarada, Tsutomu Hirao, Wataru Uchida, Masaaki Nagata

entry.summary: Proposes treating argument mining as a text-to-text generation task using a pretrained encoder-decoder, simultaneously generating span, component, and relation annotations. Eliminates the need for task-specific postprocessing and simplifies the pipeline.

entry.title: Grounding Arabic LLMs in the Doha Historical Dictionary: Retrieval-Augmented Understanding of Quran and Hadith

author.name: Somaya Eltanbouly, Samer Rashwani

entry.summary: Develops a RAG framework grounded in the Doha Historical Dictionary of Arabic for understanding Quran and Hadith texts. Uses diachronic lexicographic knowledge with hybrid retrieval and intent-based routing for historical Arabic text understanding.

entry.title: Samas\=amayik: A Parallel Dataset for Hindi-Sanskrit Machine Translation

author.name: N J Karthika, Keerthana Suryanarayanan, Jahanvi Purohit, Ganesh Ramakrishnan, Jitin Singla, Anil Kumar Gourishetty

entry.summary: Releases Samasamayik, a 92,196 sentence parallel Hindi-Sanskrit corpus focusing on contemporary materials rather than classical texts. Benchmarks with ByT5, NLLB, and IndicTrans-v2 show significant performance gains on in-domain data.

entry.title: PINGALA: Prosody-Aware Decoding for Sanskrit Poetry Generation

author.name: Manoj Balaji Jagadeeshan, Atul Singh, Nallani Chakravartula Sahith, Amrith Krishna, Pawan Goyal

entry.summary: PINGALA proposes prosody-aware decoding for Sanskrit poetry generation, finding that segmenting verses as grouped-lines improves semantic coherence by 10% while maintaining metrical adherence. Leverages Sanskrit's phonemic orthography for phonetically-aware token selection.

entry.title: Representation Learning to Study Temporal Dynamics in Tutorial Scaffolding

author.name: Conrad Borchers, Jiayi Zhang, Ashish Gurung

entry.summary: Introduces an embedding-based approach to analyze scaffolding dynamics in tutoring dialogue by computing cosine similarity between turns, problem statements, and solutions. Applied to 1,576 real-world math tutoring dialogues, revealing systematic differences in task alignment.

entry.title: EnvSocial-Diff: A Diffusion-Based Crowd Simulation Model with Environmental Conditioning and Individual-Group Interaction

author.name: Bingxue Zhao, Qi Zhang, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EnvSocial-Diff, a diffusion-based crowd simulation model that incorporates environmental conditioning (obstacles, lighting, objects of interest) and individual-group interaction dynamics for realistic pedestrian trajectory modeling.

entry.title: CAKE: Real-time Action Detection via Motion Distillation and Background-aware Contrastive Learning

author.name: Hieu Hoang, Dung Trung Tran, Hong Nguyen, Nam-Phong Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes CAKE for online action detection that uses flow-based distillation to transfer motion knowledge into RGB models without computing optical flow at inference, with a Dynamic Motion Adapter and contrastive learning.

entry.title: SemLayer: Semantic-aware Generative Segmentation and Layer Construction for Abstract Icons

author.name: Haiyang Xu, Ronghuan Wu, Li-Yi Wei, Nanxuan Zhao, Chenxi Liu, Cuong Nguyen, Zhuowen Tu, Zhaowen Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SemLayer, a pipeline for restoring semantic layer structure from flattened vector icons using generative models for chromatic differentiation and semantic completion of occluded regions.

entry.title: PosterIQ: A Design Perspective Benchmark for Poster Understanding and Generation

author.name: Yuheng Feng, Wen Zhang, Haodong Duan, Xingxing Zou

entry.summary: Presents PosterIQ, a design-driven benchmark for poster understanding and generation covering composition, typography, and semantic intent, revealing gaps in current MLLMs and diffusion generators.

entry.title: InstanceRSR: Real-World Super-Resolution via Instance-Aware Representation Alignment

author.name: Zixin Guo, Kai Zhao, Luyan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes InstanceRSR for real-world super-resolution that introduces instance-level feature alignment alongside global consistency, using semantic information to recover fine-grained object details.

entry.title: Teacher-Student Diffusion Model for Text-Driven 3D Hand Motion Generation

author.name: Ching-Lam Cheng, Bin Zhu, Shengfeng He

entry.summary: Proposes TSHaMo, a teacher-student diffusion framework for text-driven 3D hand motion generation where the teacher uses auxiliary MANO parameters to guide the student, which operates from text alone at inference time.

entry.title: Bio-Inspired Event-Based Visual Servoing for Ground Robots

author.name: Maral Mordad, Kian Behzad, Debojyoti Biswas, Noah J. Cowan, Milad Siami

entry.summary: Presents a bio-inspired event-based visual servoing framework using Dynamic Vision Sensors for ground robots, showing that spatial kernels applied to asynchronous event streams can analytically isolate specific kinematic states.

entry.title: A Longitudinal Analysis of the CEC Single-Objective Competitions (2010-2024) and Implications for Variational Quantum Optimization

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Nov\'ak, Tom\'a\v{s} Bezd\v{e}k, Ivan Zelinka, Swagatam Das, Martin Beseda

entry.summary: Provides a historical analysis of IEEE CEC single-objective optimization competitions (2010-2024), identifying how benchmark design choices shaped winning algorithms and connecting findings to variational quantum optimization.

entry.title: Task-Space Singularity Avoidance for Control Affine Systems Using Control Barrier Functions

author.name: Kimia Forghani, Suraj Raval, Lamar Mair, Axel Krieger, Yancy Diaz-Mercado

entry.summary: Presents a control barrier function framework for singularity avoidance in control-affine systems, constructing barrier functions based on eigenvalues of the input-output mapping to maintain safety from rank-deficient configurations.

entry.title: Bidirectionality is the Obvious BCI Paradigm

author.name: Elliot Callender

entry.summary: Proposes bidirectional brain-computer interfaces that read and write native neural representations, arguing that current BCI research is missing the obvious step of training models to communicate in 'neuralese' back to the brain.

entry.title: Identification of NMF by choosing maximum-volume basis vectors

author.name: Qianqian Qi, Zhongming Chen, Peter G. M. van der Heijden

entry.summary: Proposes maximum-volume-constrained NMF as an alternative to minimum-volume NMF, making basis vectors as distinct as possible rather than similar, with identifiability guarantees for highly mixed data.

entry.title: Comparative analysis of dual-form networks for live land monitoring using multi-modal satellite image time series

author.name: Iris Dumeur (CB), J\'er\'emy Anger (CB), Gabriele Facciolo (CB)

entry.summary: Compares dual-form attention mechanisms (linear attention and retention) for efficient multi-modal satellite image time series analysis, enabling parallel training with recurrent inference for incremental land monitoring.

entry.title: Boost Like a (Var)Pro: Trust-Region Gradient Boosting via Variable Projection

author.name: Abhijit Chowdhary, Elizabeth Newman, Deepanshu Verma

entry.summary: Introduces VPBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm for separable smooth approximators that fuses variable projection (enforcing linear weight optimality) with trust-region optimization for the nonlinear parameters.

entry.title: KCLNet: Electrically Equivalence-Oriented Graph Representation Learning for Analog Circuits

author.name: Peng Xu, Yapeng Li, Tinghuan Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho, Bei Yu

entry.summary: Presents KCLNet, a graph representation learning framework for analog circuits inspired by Kirchhoff's Current Law, using asynchronous GNN message passing and electrically-simulated representations.

entry.title: Language-Assisted Image Clustering Guided by Discriminative Relational Signals and Adaptive Semantic Centers

author.name: Jun Ma, Xu Zhang, Zhengxing Jiao, Yaxin Hou, Hui Liu, Junhui Hou, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a language-assisted image clustering framework using discriminative cross-modal relational signals and adaptive semantic centers to improve cluster separability beyond naive text-image alignment.

entry.title: Wafer-Level Etch Spatial Profiling for Process Monitoring from Time-Series with Time-LLM

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Munyoung Lee, Seung Hyub Jeon, Kyu Sung Lee

entry.summary: Applies Time-LLM for wafer-level etch spatial profiling by extending LLM reprogramming from time-series forecasting to spatial estimation in semiconductor manufacturing process monitoring.

entry.title: Robust Multilingual Text-to-Pictogram Mapping for Scalable Reading Rehabilitation

author.name: Soufiane Jhilal, Martina Galletti

entry.summary: A multilingual AI-powered system that enhances text with pictograms for children with Special Educational Needs. Evaluated across five languages (English, French, Italian, Spanish, Arabic) through expert clinical review and latency assessment.

entry.title: HAM: A Training-Free Style Transfer Approach via Heterogeneous Attention Modulation for Diffusion Models

author.name: Yeqi He, Liang Li, Zhiwen Yang, Xichun Sheng, Zhidong Zhao, Chenggang Yan

entry.summary: Proposes HAM, a training-free style transfer approach using heterogeneous attention modulation in diffusion models to better balance style reference transfer and content identity preservation.

entry.title: Retinal Layer Segmentation in OCT Images With 2.5D Cross-slice Feature Fusion Module for Glaucoma Assessment

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Heesuk Kim, Wungrak Choi, Jae-Sang Hyun

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D OCT retinal layer segmentation framework with a cross-slice feature fusion module that balances 2D efficiency with 3D contextual information for glaucoma assessment.

entry.title: AMIF: Authorizable Medical Image Fusion Model with Built-in Authentication

author.name: Jie Song, Jun Jia, Wei Sun, Wangqiu Zhou, Tao Tan, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces AMIF, an authorizable medical image fusion model with built-in authentication for IP protection, combining multimodal fusion with watermarking for ownership verification.

entry.title: Positive-First Most Ambiguous: A Simple Active Learning Criterion for Interactive Retrieval of Rare Categories

author.name: Kawtar Zaher, Olivier Buisson, Alexis Joly

entry.summary: Proposes a simple active learning criterion ('Positive-First Most Ambiguous') for interactive retrieval of rare categories in highly imbalanced settings, targeting biodiversity monitoring and ecological applications.

entry.title: Learning What Can Be Picked: Active Reachability Estimation for Efficient Robotic Fruit Harvesting

author.name: Nur Afsa Syeda, Mohamed Elmahallawy, Luis Fernando de la Torre, John Miller

entry.summary: Combines RGB-D perception with active learning to learn fruit reachability as a binary decision problem for robotic harvesting, reducing unnecessary inverse kinematics computation in orchard environments.

entry.title: Adaptive Gaussian Process Search for Simulation-Based Sample Size Estimation in Clinical Prediction Models: Validation of the pmsims R Package

author.name: Oyebayo Ridwan Olaniran, Diana Shamsutdinova, Sarah Markham, Felix Zimmer, Daniel Stahl, Gordon Forbes, Ewan Carr

entry.summary: Presents and validates pmsims, an R package using Gaussian process surrogate modeling for simulation-based sample size determination in clinical prediction models, offering a flexible alternative to analytical approaches.

entry.title: Where Experts Disagree, Models Fail: Detecting Implicit Legal Citations in French Court Decisions

author.name: Avrile Floro (UPHF), Tamara Dhorasoo (UPHF), Soline Pellez (UPHF), Nils Holzenberger

entry.summary: Studies implicit legal citation detection in French court decisions, finding that expert disagreement (κ=0.33) predicts model failures. Introduces a benchmark of 1,015 annotated passage-article pairs and achieves F1=0.70.

entry.title: CN-Buzz2Portfolio: A Chinese-Market Dataset and Benchmark for LLM-Based Macro and Sector Asset Allocation from Daily Trending Financial News

author.name: Liyuan Chen, Shilong Li, Jiangpeng Yan, Shuoling Liu, Qiang Yang, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Introduces CN-Buzz2Portfolio, a benchmark mapping daily trending Chinese financial news to macro and sector asset allocation, addressing the gap between LLM-as-agent evaluation and reproducible financial benchmarking.

entry.title: YOLOv10 with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and vision-language foundation models for interpretable object detection and trustworthy multimodal AI in computer vision perception

author.name: Marios Impraimakis, Daniel Vazquez, Feiyu Zhou

entry.summary: Uses Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks as interpretable post-hoc surrogates to model trustworthiness of YOLOv10 detections, enabling transparent visualization of feature influences on detection confidence.

entry.title: Leveraging LLMs and Social Media to Understand User Perception of Smartphone-Based Earthquake Early Warnings

author.name: Hanjing Wang, S. Mostafa Mousavi, Patrick Robertson, Richard M. Allen, Alexie Barski, Robert Bosch, Nivetha Thiruverahan, Youngmin Cho, Tajinder Gadh, Steve Malkos, Boone Spooner, Greg Wimpey, Marc Stogaitis

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to analyze 500+ social media posts about Android's earthquake early warning system during a 2025 Turkey earthquake, extracting 42 attributes related to user experience and behavior.

entry.title: Residual Attention Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Multiphysics Simulation of Steady-State Electrothermal Energy Systems

author.name: Yuqing Zhou, Ze Tao, Fujun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RA-PINN, a residual attention physics-informed neural network for coupled electrothermal multiphysics simulation, solving velocity, pressure, electric-potential, and temperature fields simultaneously.

entry.title: AI Generalisation Gap In Comorbid Sleep Disorder Staging

author.name: Saswata Bose, Suvadeep Maiti, Shivam Kumar Sharma, Mythirayee S, Tapabrata Chakraborti, Srijitesh Rajendran, Raju S. Bapi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that deep learning sleep staging models trained on healthy subjects generalize poorly to clinical populations with comorbid conditions like ischemic stroke. Introduces iSLEEPS, a new clinically-annotated stroke dataset, and uses Grad-CAM to systematically reveal the generalization gap.

entry.title: The Luna Bound Propagator for Formal Analysis of Neural Networks

author.name: Henry LeCates, Haoze Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Luna, a C++ implementation of alpha-CROWN bound propagation for neural network verification, competitive with the Python state-of-the-art on VNN-COMP 2025 benchmarks.

entry.title: Reservoir-Based Graph Convolutional Networks

author.name: Mayssa Soussia, Gita Ayu Salsabila, Mohamed Ali Mahjoub, Islem Rekik

entry.summary: Proposes integrating reservoir computing into GCNs to handle long-range dependencies and dynamic data without deep stacking, avoiding over-smoothing while maintaining stable information propagation.

entry.title: Towards Safe Learning-Based Non-Linear Model Predictive Control through Recurrent Neural Network Modeling

author.name: Mihaela-Larisa Clement, M\'onika Farsang, Agnes Poks, Johannes Edelmann, Manfred Pl\"ochl, Radu Grosu, Ezio Bartocci

entry.summary: Proposes Sequential-AMPC for learning-based nonlinear MPC approximation with shared parameters across prediction horizon, wrapped with safety-augmented fallback mechanisms for safe deployment.

entry.title: Digital Twin-Assisted Measurement Design and Channel Statistics Prediction

author.name: Robin J. Williams, Mahmoud Saad Abouamer, Petar Popovski

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid wireless channel prediction framework combining uncalibrated digital twins with Gaussian process models to leverage environmental geometry without costly DT calibration.

entry.title: A visual observation on the geometry of UMAP projections of the difference vectors of antonym and synonym word pair embeddings

author.name: Rami Luisto

entry.summary: Reports a curious 'swirl' pattern appearing in UMAP projections of difference vectors between antonym word pair embeddings across multiple embedding models, contrasted with synonym pairs.

entry.title: Generating Hierarchical JSON Representations of Scientific Sentences Using LLMs

author.name: Satya Sri Rajiteswari Nimmagadda, Ethan Young, Niladri Sengupta, Ananya Jana, Aniruddha Maiti

entry.summary: Proposes using a lightweight LLM with a novel structural loss function to generate hierarchical JSON structures from scientific sentences, then tests whether these structures can preserve original meaning when reconstructed. Shows hierarchical formats effectively retain scientific text information.

entry.title: SynMVCrowd: A Large Synthetic Benchmark for Multi-view Crowd Counting and Localization

author.name: Qi Zhang, Daijie Chen, Yunfei Gong, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SynMVCrowd, a large synthetic benchmark for multi-view crowd counting and localization with 50 scenes, many camera views, and crowds up to 1,000 people, addressing overfitting issues with small existing datasets.

entry.title: A^3: Towards Advertising Aesthetic Assessment

author.name: Kaiyuan Ji, Yixuan Gao, Lu Sun, Yushuo Zheng, Zijian Chen, Jianbo Zhang, Xiangyang Zhu, Yuan Tian, Zicheng Zhang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Presents A³, a comprehensive framework for advertising aesthetic assessment with a theory-driven paradigm, dataset, MLLM, and benchmark for evaluating commercial image quality.

entry.title: Granular Ball Guided Stable Latent Domain Discovery for Domain-General Crowd Counting

author.name: Fan Chen, Shuyin Xia, Yi Wang, Xinbo Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a granular ball guided framework for stable latent domain discovery in domain-general crowd counting, using compact local clusters rather than flat clustering on noisy features.

entry.title: Powerful Teachers Matter: Text-Guided Multi-view Knowledge Distillation with Visual Prior Enhancement

author.name: Xin Zhang, Jianyang Xu, Hao Peng, Dongjing Wang, Jingyuan Zheng, Yu Li, Yuyu Yin, Hongbo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TMKD, a knowledge distillation framework using dual-modality teachers (visual + CLIP text) with multi-view inputs and prior-aware prompts for richer supervisory signals.

entry.title: The role of spatial context and multitask learning in the detection of organic and conventional farming systems based on Sentinel-2 time series

author.name: Jan Hemmerling, Marcel Schwieder, Philippe Rufin, Leon-Friedrich Thomas, Mirela Tulbure, Patrick Hostert, Stefan Erasmi

entry.summary: Uses Vision Transformers on Sentinel-2 satellite time series to discriminate organic from conventional farming systems, examining the role of spatial context and multitask learning with crop type classification.

entry.title: Robust Distributed Cooperative Path-Following and Local Replanning for Multi-UAVs Under Differentiated Low-Altitude Paths

author.name: Zimao Sheng, Zirui Yu, Hong'an Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a cooperative control strategy for multi-UAV path following in complex low-altitude terrain with distributed coordination, wind disturbance robustness, and online obstacle avoidance replanning.

entry.title: Dynamic Fusion-Aware Graph Convolutional Neural Network for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations

author.name: Tao Meng, Weilun Tang, Yuntao Shou, Yilong Tan, Jun Zhou, Wei Ai, Keqin Li

entry.summary: Proposes DF-GCN, a dynamic fusion-aware graph convolutional network for multimodal emotion recognition in conversations that uses dynamic parameters for different emotion types instead of fixed fusion parameters. Addresses the limitation of existing GCN methods that balance performance across emotion categories.

entry.title: AI Mental Models: Learned Intuition and Deliberation in a Bounded Neural Architecture

author.name: Laurence Anthony

entry.summary: Tests whether a bounded neural architecture can exhibit separate intuition and deliberation pathways on a syllogistic reasoning benchmark. Proposes a dual-path architecture motivated by computational mental-model theory.

entry.title: PhySe-RPO: Physics and Semantics Guided Relative Policy Optimization for Diffusion-Based Surgical Smoke Removal

author.name: Zining Fang, Chunhui Liu, Bin Xu, Ming Chen, Xiaowei Hu, Cheng Xue

entry.summary: Proposes PhySe-RPO, a diffusion-based framework for surgical smoke removal that uses physics and semantics-guided relative policy optimization. Transforms deterministic restoration into stochastic policy with trajectory-level exploration.

entry.title: Separating Diagnosis from Control: Auditable Policy Adaptation in Agent-Based Simulations with LLM-Based Diagnostics

author.name: Shaoxin Zhong, Yuchen Su, Michael Witbrock

entry.summary: Proposes a three-layer framework separating LLM diagnosis from deterministic policy control for agent-based simulations targeting elderly loneliness. LLMs serve as diagnostic instruments while traceable rules govern policy updates.

entry.title: Minibal: Balanced Game-Playing Without Opponent Modeling

author.name: Quentin Cohen-Solal, Tristan Cazenave

entry.summary: Introduces Minibal, a Minimax variant designed for balanced play in board games, where an AI agent challenges opponents without dominating or conceding. Tested across seven board games.

entry.title: From Instructions to Assistance: a Dataset Aligning Instruction Manuals with Assembly Videos for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Federico Toschi, Nicol\`o Brunello, Andrea Sassella, Vincenzo Scotti, Mark James Carman

entry.summary: Creates a dataset aligning IKEA instruction manuals with assembly videos for evaluating multimodal LLMs on procedural task assistance, targeting AR/VR applications.

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Distribution-Aware Loss Functions for Bimodal Regression

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Carlos Soares, Rita P. Ribeiro, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes distribution-aware loss functions for regression tasks where prediction errors follow bimodal distributions, addressing the mean-collapse problem of standard regression under coexisting confident and ambiguous predictions.

entry.title: Latent Style-based Quantum Wasserstein GAN for Drug Design

author.name: Julien Baglio, Yacine Haddad, Richard Polifka

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum Wasserstein GAN with latent style-based architecture for de novo drug design, aiming to overcome classical GAN training difficulties like mode collapse through quantum computing.

entry.title: LLM-guided headline rewriting for clickability enhancement without clickbait

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Linoy Halifa, Sagiv Bar, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: Frames clickbait not as a separate category but as extreme amplification of engagement cues, and proposes a controllable headline rewriting system that enhances clickability while preserving semantic faithfulness and editorial trust.

entry.title: UAV-DETR: DETR for Anti-Drone Target Detection

author.name: Jun Yang, Dong Wang, Hongxu Yin, Hongpeng Li, Jianxiong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces UAV-DETR for drone detection, featuring WTConv-enhanced backbone and Sliding Window Self-Attention with drastically reduced parameter overhead for detecting miniature drones against complex backgrounds.

entry.title: Avoiding Over-smoothing in Social Media Rumor Detection with Pre-trained Propagation Tree Transformer

author.name: Chaoqun Cui, Caiyan Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a Transformer-based method (P2T3) for rumor detection that avoids the over-smoothing problem inherent in GNNs when processing propagation tree structures. The key insight is that most nodes in rumor trees are 1-level nodes, causing GNN performance degradation.

entry.title: From the AI Act to a European AI Agency: Completing the Union's Regulatory Architecture

author.name: Georgios Pavlidis

entry.summary: Argues for creating a dedicated European AI Agency beyond the existing AI Office established by the EU AI Act, to enhance policy coherence, risk assessment, and international cooperation in AI governance.

entry.title: Concept-based explanations of Segmentation and Detection models in Natural Disaster Management

author.name: Samar Heydari, Jawher Said, Galip \"Umit Yolcu, Evgenii Kortukov, Elena Golimblevskaia, Evgenios Vlachos, Vasileios Mygdalis, Ioannis Pitas, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Leila Arras

entry.summary: Presents an explainability framework for flood segmentation and car detection models using PIDNet and YOLO, extending Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for sigmoid-gated fusion layers in disaster management applications.

entry.title: Targeted Adversarial Traffic Generation : Black-box Approach to Evade Intrusion Detection Systems in IoT Networks

author.name: Islam Debicha, Tayeb Kenaza, Ishak Charfi, Salah Mosbah, Mehdi Sehaki, Jean-Michel Dricot

entry.summary: Evaluates feasibility of black-box evasion attacks against IoT network intrusion detection systems, proposing both attack methods and defense strategies.

entry.title: Upper Entropy for 2-Monotone Lower Probabilities

author.name: Tuan-Anh Vu, S\'ebastien Destercke, Fr\'ed\'eric Pichon

entry.summary: Provides exhaustive algorithmic and complexity analysis of computing upper entropy for 2-monotone lower probabilities, showing the problem has a strongly polynomial solution with significant improvements over past algorithms.

entry.title: LineMVGNN: Anti-Money Laundering with Line-Graph-Assisted Multi-View Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Chung-Hoo Poon, James Kwok, Calvin Chow, Jang-Hyeon Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LineMVGNN, a spatial GNN method using line graphs and multi-view architecture for anti-money laundering on transaction graphs. Addresses limitations of spectral GNNs for directed graphs with multi-dimensional edge features.

entry.title: Resolving gradient pathology in physics-informed epidemiological models

author.name: Nickson Golooba, Woldegebriel Assefa Woldegerima

entry.summary: Proposes CGGS (conflict-gated gradient scaling) to address gradient pathology in physics-informed neural networks for epidemiological SEIR models, where data loss and physics residual gradients conflict.

entry.title: i-IF-Learn: Iterative Feature Selection and Unsupervised Learning for High-Dimensional Complex Data

author.name: Chen Ma, Wanjie Wang, Shuhao Fan

entry.summary: Proposes i-IF-Learn, an iterative unsupervised framework jointly performing feature selection and clustering, with an adaptive statistic that dynamically blends pseudo-label supervision with unsupervised signals.

entry.title: On Gossip Algorithms for Machine Learning with Pairwise Objectives

author.name: Igor Colin (LTCI, S2A, IP Paris), Aur\'elien Bellet (PREMEDICAL), Stephan Cl\'emen\c{c}on (LTCI, IDS, S2A, IP Paris), Joseph Salmon (IROKO, UM)

entry.summary: Extends gossip-based distributed optimization algorithms to pairwise objective functions (like AUC, ranking losses) rather than simple averages, relevant for IoT and decentralized learning settings.

entry.title: TsetlinWiSARD: On-Chip Training of Weightless Neural Networks using Tsetlin Automata on FPGAs

author.name: Shengyu Duan, Marcos L. L. Sartori, Rishad Shafik, Alex Yakovlev

entry.summary: Introduces TsetlinWiSARD, combining Tsetlin Automata with Weightless Neural Networks for efficient on-chip training on FPGAs, addressing the overfitting limitations of memorization-based WNN training.

entry.title: IPatch: A Multi-Resolution Transformer Architecture for Robust Time-Series Forecasting
